function portGeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],over=portOver,inside=portInside,chunkBox=id=>PORT_CHUNK_BOX[id.slice(0,2)];
 const roads=portRoadRects(),zones=PORT_RAIL_ZONES,fp=PORT_BUILDINGS.map(portFp),solRect=s=>({id:s.id,x:s.x,y:s.y,w:s.w,h:s.h});
 const fat=roads.map(r=>portInflate(r,PORT_SW));
 const isLightOrTree=id=>/^PORT-(PL|T)-/.test(id),isWagon=id=>/^STK-/.test(id),isLeg=id=>/-LEG-/.test(id);
 // buildings: inside their chunk, clear of roads (14 px), of the rail zone and of each other, and standing on a yard
 for(const f of fp){const b=chunkBox(f.id);if(!b||!inside(f,b))issues.push(f.id+':bounds');for(const r of roads)if(over(f,{x:r.x-14,y:r.y-14,w:r.w+28,h:r.h+28}))issues.push(f.id+':road:'+r.id);for(const z of zones)if(over(f,z))issues.push(f.id+':rail');if(!PORT_YARDS.some(y=>over(f,y)))issues.push(f.id+':no-yard')}
 for(let i=0;i<fp.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<fp.length;j++)if(over(fp[i],fp[j]))issues.push('building-overlap:'+fp[i].id+':'+fp[j].id);
 // yards: inside the chunk, no road across, no rail, no overlap between yards
 for(const y of PORT_YARDS){const b=chunkBox(y.id);if(!b||!inside(y,b))issues.push(y.id+':bounds');for(const r of roads)if(over(y,r))issues.push(y.id+':road:'+r.id);for(const z of zones)if(over(y,z))issues.push(y.id+':rail')}
 for(let i=0;i<PORT_YARDS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<PORT_YARDS.length;j++)if(over(PORT_YARDS[i],PORT_YARDS[j]))issues.push('yard-overlap:'+PORT_YARDS[i].id+'/'+PORT_YARDS[j].id);
 // solids: not on a road, not on the rail zone (pylon bases and wagons excepted), standing on a yard (or on the apron for the crane legs, piles and wagons)
 for(const s of PORT_SOLIDS){if(s10Own(s))continue;   /* S10 א: C6 ו-D6 — בבדיקה c6d6Audit (021e) */const q=solRect(s);for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r))issues.push(s.id+':road:'+r.id);if(!/^E6-PYLON|^E6-SUB/.test(s.id)&&!isWagon(s.id))for(const z of zones)if(over(q,z))issues.push(s.id+':rail');if(!isLightOrTree(s.id)&&!isWagon(s.id)&&!isLeg(s.id)&&!/^E6-SUB|^E6-PYLON|-PILE/.test(s.id)&&!PORT_YARDS.some(y=>over(q,y)))issues.push(s.id+':no-yard');if(!isLightOrTree(s.id)){for(const f of fp)if(over(q,f))issues.push(s.id+':building:'+f.id)}}
 // containers, tanks, pumps, stalls, equipment: never inside the sidewalk band of a road (it would be painted over)
 for(const b of PORT_BLOCKS){if(s10Own(b))continue;if(!PORT_YARDS.some(y=>inside({x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h},y)))issues.push(b.id+':outside-yard');for(const r of fat)if(over({x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h},r))issues.push(b.id+':under-sidewalk:'+r.id)}
 for(const t of[...PORT_TANKS,...PORT_PUMPS])for(const r of fat)if(over(t,r))issues.push(t.id+':under-sidewalk:'+r.id);
 for(const e of PORT_EQUIPMENT){const q={x:e.x-e.w/2,y:e.y-e.h/2,w:e.w,h:e.h},sw=(e.heading||0)>1?{x:e.x-e.h/2,y:e.y-e.w/2,w:e.h,h:e.w}:q;for(const r of fat)if(over(sw,r))issues.push(e.id+':under-sidewalk:'+r.id)}
 // stalls: inside a yard, clear of solids, buildings, other stalls and of the sidewalks
 for(const s of PORT_STALLS){if(!PORT_YARDS.some(y=>inside(s,y)))issues.push(s.id+':outside-yard');for(const r of fat)if(over(s,r))issues.push(s.id+':under-sidewalk:'+r.id);for(const f of fp)if(over(s,{x:f.x,y:f.y,w:f.w,h:f.h+30}))issues.push(s.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const q of PORT_SOLIDS)if(!s10Own(q)&&!isLightOrTree(q.id)&&!/^PC-/.test(q.id)&&over(s,solRect(q)))issues.push(s.id+':solid:'+q.id)}
 for(let i=0;i<PORT_STALLS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<PORT_STALLS.length;j++)if(over(PORT_STALLS[i],PORT_STALLS[j]))issues.push('stall-overlap:'+PORT_STALLS[i].id+'/'+PORT_STALLS[j].id);
 for(const o of PARKED_CARS.filter(o=>/^PC-(E6|D6)-/.test(o.id)))if(!o.slotRect||!PORT_STALLS.some(s=>s.x===o.slotRect.x&&s.y===o.slotRect.y))issues.push(o.id+':not-in-stall');
 // parked semis are exactly one container wide, and fit their stall
 for(const o of PARKED_CARS.filter(o=>o.ref==='SemiLong')){const I=TurboCity.info(o.asset,{scale:roadVehicleScaleFor(o.asset,o.ref)});if(Math.abs(I.fp[3]-FREIGHT_W)>.3)issues.push(o.id+':width:'+I.fp[3].toFixed(1));if(I.fp[2]>(o.slotRect.w>=o.slotRect.h?o.slotRect.w-4:o.slotRect.h+.5))issues.push(o.id+':too-long-for-stall')}
 // points of interest: inside their chunk, not inside a solid or a building, reachable (inside a yard, on the apron or on the quay)
 for(const p of Object.values(PORT_INTERACTIONS)){if(s10Own(p))continue;const b=PORT_CHUNK_BOX[p.chunk];if(!b||p.x<b.x||p.x>b.x+b.w||p.y<b.y||p.y>b.y+b.h)issues.push(p.id+':bounds');const q=portSolidAt(p.x,p.y,6);if(q&&!/^PORT-PL/.test(q))issues.push(p.id+':poi-inside:'+q);for(const f of fp)if(over({x:p.x-4,y:p.y-4,w:8,h:8},f))issues.push(p.id+':poi-in-building:'+f.id)}
 // lights and trees keep clear of roads, buildings, stalls and the rail zone
 for(const l of PORT_LIGHTS){const q={x:l.x-5,y:l.y-5,w:10,h:10};for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r))issues.push(l.id+':road:'+r.id);for(const f of fp)if(over(q,f))issues.push(l.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const z of zones)if(over(q,z))issues.push(l.id+':rail')}
 for(const t of PORT_TREES){const q={x:t.x-12,y:t.y-12,w:24,h:24};for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r))issues.push(t.id+':road:'+r.id);for(const f of fp)if(over(q,f))issues.push(t.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const z of zones)if(over(q,z))issues.push(t.id+':rail')}
 // roads: never over the rail zone, never over the quay (apron starts at y 4808), every port road ends on the node graph
 for(const r of roads){for(const z of zones)if(over(r,z))issues.push('rail-road:'+r.id);if(r.y+r.h>PORT_APRON_Y)issues.push('road-on-apron:'+r.id)}
 // quay: the crane rails clear the quay-road sidewalk; berths sit inside their chunk and never overlap; ships carry eight boxes across; cranes keep apart at every moment

function b5PedRoute(a,b,paths=B5_PATHS){
 const segs=[];for(const p of paths)for(let i=1;i<p.pts.length;i++){const x=p.pts[i-1],y=p.pts[i];if(Math.hypot(x[0]-y[0],x[1]-y[1])>.01)segs.push({a:x,b:y,points:[x,y]})}
 if(!segs.length)return[];   /* missions 11.11: B5_PATHS ריק מאז p572 (הרחובות הישנים של B5 יצאו) — snap קרס (best=null) ועצר את לולאת המשחק בכל ניווט ברגל ב-B5 (M-B5-BOOKS / M-B5-CIVIC); עכשיו — הניווט הרגיל */
 const near=(p,s)=>{const dx=s.b[0]-s.a[0],dy=s.b[1]-s.a[1],t=clamp(((p.x-s.a[0])*dx+(p.y-s.a[1])*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy),0,1);return[s.a[0]+dx*t,s.a[1]+dy*t]};
 const between=(q,s)=>q[0]>=Math.min(s.a[0],s.b[0])-.01&&q[0]<=Math.max(s.a[0],s.b[0])+.01&&q[1]>=Math.min(s.a[1],s.b[1])-.01&&q[1]<=Math.max(s.a[1],s.b[1])+.01;
 for(let i=0;i<segs.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<segs.length;j++){const x=segs[i],y=segs[j],xh=x.a[1]===x.b[1],yh=y.a[1]===y.b[1];if(xh!==yh){const q=xh?[y.a[0],x.a[1]]:[x.a[0],y.a[1]];if(between(q,x)&&between(q,y)){x.points.push(q);y.points.push(q)}}else for(const q of [x.a,x.b,y.a,y.b])if(between(q,x)&&between(q,y)){x.points.push(q);y.points.push(q)}}
 const snap=p=>{let best=null;for(const s of segs){const q=near(p,s),d=Math.hypot(q[0]-p.x,q[1]-p.y);if(!best||d<best.d)best={q,d,s}}best.s.points.push(best.q);return best.q},start=snap(a),end=snap(b),key=q=>q.map(n=>n.toFixed(2)).join(','),g=new Map(),xy=new Map();
 for(const s of segs){const ps=[...new Map(s.points.map(q=>[key(q),q])).values()].sort((a,b)=>(a[0]-b[0])||(a[1]-b[1]));for(const q of ps){const k=key(q);if(!g.has(k))g.set(k,[]);xy.set(k,{x:q[0],y:q[1]})}for(let i=1;i<ps.length;i++){const x=key(ps[i-1]),y=key(ps[i]),w=Math.hypot(ps[i][0]-ps[i-1][0],ps[i][1]-ps[i-1][1]);g.get(x).push({id:y,w});g.get(y).push({id:x,w})}}
 const sk=key(start),ek=key(end),dist=new Map([[sk,0]]),prev=new Map(),open=new Set(g.keys());while(open.size){let u=null,d=Infinity;for(const k of open)if((dist.get(k)??Infinity)<d){u=k;d=dist.get(k)}if(u===null||u===ek)break;open.delete(u);for(const v of g.get(u)){const nd=d+v.w;if(nd<(dist.get(v.id)??Infinity)){dist.set(v.id,nd);prev.set(v.id,u)}}}if(!dist.has(ek))return[];const ids=[ek];let k=ek;while(k!==sk){k=prev.get(k);if(!k)return[];ids.push(k)}return[{x:a.x,y:a.y},...ids.reverse().map(k=>xy.get(k)),{x:b.x,y:b.y}]
}
function b5GeometryAudit(){const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y,bounds=q=>q.x>=1200&&q.y>=3400&&q.x+q.w<=2400&&q.y+q.h<=4250;for(const b of B5_BUILDINGS){if(!bounds(b.fp))issues.push(b.id+':bounds');if(B5_ROAD_BOXES.some(r=>over(b.fp,r)))issues.push(b.id+':road');if(b5CollisionAt(b.entrance.x,b.entrance.y,5))issues.push(b.id+':blocked-entrance')}for(let i=0;i<B5_BUILDINGS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<B5_BUILDINGS.length;j++)if(over(B5_BUILDINGS[i].fp,B5_BUILDINGS[j].fp))issues.push('buildings:'+B5_BUILDINGS[i].id+'/'+B5_BUILDINGS[j].id);for(const p of B5_PARKING){if(!bounds(p))issues.push(p.id+':bounds');if(B5_ROAD_BOXES.some(r=>over(p,r)))issues.push(p.id+':road');if(B5_BUILDINGS.some(b=>over(p,b.fp)))issues.push(p.id+':building')}for(const t of B5_TREES)if(B5_ROAD_BOXES.some(r=>over({x:t.x-4,y:t.y-4,w:8,h:8},r)))issues.push(t.id+':road');if(!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has('B5'))issues.push('inactive');return{ok:!issues.length,issues,buildings:B5_BUILDINGS.length,parkingSpaces:B5_STALLS.length,accessible:B5_STALLS.filter(s=>s.accessible).length,parkedCars:B5_PARKED.length,paths:B5_PATHS.length,trees:B5_TREES.length,props:B5_PROPS.length,visitors:B5_VISITORS.length,roads:EDGES.filter(e=>e.globalRoadId.startsWith('TC-B5-')).length,connectors:B5_CONNECTORS.map(c=>({id:c.id,x:c.x,y:c.y,neighbor:c.neighbor})),plannedUses:['קמפוס וכיכר סטודנטים','גן תרבות ורחבת מוזיאון','כיכר עירייה וספרייה','מתנ״ס ובית משפט','חניות מוסדות נגישות','שולי גינון ושבילי הליכה']}}
window.__TC_B5_QA=()=>b5GeometryAudit();

 return{id,asset,x,y,scale,rot,label,info:I,fp,entrance};
}

 asph:'#5d6166',pav:'#dcd3bf',conc:'#c4c1b8',hedge:'#4f7f3f',soil:'#7a5f42',soilD:'#5e4832'};
const S12_CROP={wheat:['TR-AG-05','#d4b860','#b8973e'],veg:['TR-AG-03','#5f9a45','#3f7a2f'],sunflower:['TR-AG-02','#7f9a3e','#e8c23a'],orchard:['TR-PK-01','#7fa858','#5f8a45'],allot:['TR-AG-03','#7a5f42','#5f9a45'],
 corn:['TR-AG-02','#7fa04a','#4f7a32'],melon:['TR-AG-01','#9aa860','#4f8a3a'],lettuce:['TR-AG-03','#8fc46a','#5ea54a'],onion:['TR-AG-01','#a6b878','#6f8a4a'],alfalfa:['TR-AG-04','#7fae5a','#5f9a45'],

function s12Fill(c,r,col){c.fillStyle=col;c.fillRect(r[0],r[1],r[2]-r[0],r[3]-r[1])}
function s12Specks(c,r,id,dens,cols,sz){if(Camera.zoom<.32)return;const R=s9Rng(s9Hash('s12'+id)),w=r[2]-r[0],h=r[3]-r[1],N=Math.min(2600,Math.round(w*h/dens));for(let i=0;i<N;i++){c.fillStyle=cols[(R()*cols.length)|0];c.fillRect(r[0]+R()*w,r[1]+R()*h,sz||1.6,sz||1.6)}}
function s12Poly(c,P,w,col,cap){c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=w;c.lineCap=cap||'round';c.lineJoin='round';c.beginPath();P.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):c.moveTo(p[0],p[1]));c.stroke()}
function s12PolyBox(P,m){let x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;for(const p of P){x0=Math.min(x0,p[0]);y0=Math.min(y0,p[1]);x1=Math.max(x1,p[0]);y1=Math.max(y1,p[1])}return[x0-m,y0-m,x1+m,y1+m]}
/* ---- היער: הקרקע (מחטים, עלים, אזוב), ההצללה של שדה הגובה וקווי הגובה (D‑188) ---- */
const S12_FOREST=[[0,-850,1200,0],[1200,-850,2360,0],[0,0,532,692],[668,0,1200,692]];
function s12ForestFloor(c,N){for(const r of S12_FOREST){if(!s12In(r,10))continue;c.fillStyle=b6Pattern('TR-FD-02');c.fillRect(r[0],r[1],r[2]-r[0],r[3]-r[1]);
  c.fillStyle=N?'rgba(10,18,12,.6)':'rgba(34,56,26,.42)';c.fillRect(r[0],r[1],r[2]-r[0],r[3]-r[1]);
  s12Specks(c,r,'ff'+r.join(','),60,N?['rgba(60,70,40,.4)']:['rgba(120,100,60,.35)','rgba(70,100,50,.35)','rgba(150,130,80,.3)','rgba(40,60,30,.35)'],2.2)}
 /* קווי הגובה של שדה הגובה של המשחק (p332) — כל 5 מ׳, חזק כל 25 מ׳; על כל היער של A0, ‏B0, ‏A1 */
 try{const cv=w3ContourCv();if(cv&&!cv.failed){const B=W3H_CBOX,q=W3H.cq;c.save();c.beginPath();for(const r of S12_FOREST)c.rect(r[0],r[1],r[2]-r[0],r[3]-r[1]);c.clip();c.globalAlpha=N?.35:.75;
  const v=[Math.max(-60,viewCX()-viewHW()-40),Math.max(-880,viewCY()-viewHH()-40),Math.min(2420,viewCX()+viewHW()+40),Math.min(700,viewCY()+viewHH()+40)];
  if(v[2]>v[0]&&v[3]>v[1]){c.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;c.drawImage(cv,(v[0]-B[0])*q,(v[1]-B[1])*q,(v[2]-v[0])*q,(v[3]-v[1])*q,v[0],v[1],v[2]-v[0],v[3]-v[1])}c.restore()}}catch(e){s12Err('contours',e)}}
/* ---- השדות: הדוגמה של הקרקע, שורות הגידול והפרטים של כל גידול ---- */
function s12Field(c,f,N){const r=f.rect;if(!s12In(r,10))return;const C=S12_CROP[f.crop]||S12_CROP.grass,w=r[2]-r[0],h=r[3]-r[1],R=s9Rng(s9Hash('fl'+f.id));
 c.fillStyle=b6Pattern(C[0]);c.fillRect(r[0],r[1],w,h);c.fillStyle=N?'rgba(10,16,10,.5)':s9Hex(C[1],1)+'88';c.fillRect(r[0],r[1],w,h);
 c.strokeStyle='rgba(84,70,44,.45)';c.lineWidth=2;c.strokeRect(r[0]+1,r[1]+1,w-2,h-2);
 if(Camera.zoom<.3)return;const H=f.rows==='h',L=H?h:w,step={wheat:9,veg:16,sunflower:14,orchard:40,allot:30,corn:12,melon:22,lettuce:12,onion:9,alfalfa:10,clover:12,potato:14,grass:18}[f.crop]||12;
 if(f.crop==='orchard'||f.crop==='allot')return;   /* העצים של המטע (KIT34) והערוגות — בפריטים */
 for(let s=step/2;s<L;s+=step){const a=H?[r[0]+3,r[1]+s]:[r[0]+s,r[1]+3],b=H?[r[2]-3,r[1]+s]:[r[0]+s,r[3]-3];
  c.strokeStyle=N?'rgba(20,30,18,.6)':s9Hex(C[2],.92);c.lineWidth=f.crop==='wheat'||f.crop==='onion'?2.2:f.crop==='corn'||f.crop==='sunflower'?4.4:3.4;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);c.lineTo(b[0],b[1]);c.stroke();
  c.strokeStyle='rgba(70,52,30,.28)';c.lineWidth=1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[0]+(H?0:step/2),a[1]+(H?step/2:0));c.lineTo(b[0]+(H?0:step/2),b[1]+(H?step/2:0));c.stroke()}
 if(N)return;
 if(f.crop==='sunflower'){for(let i=0,n=Math.min(900,w*h/90);i<n;i++){const x=r[0]+4+R()*(w-8),y=r[1]+4+R()*(h-8);c.fillStyle='#f2c72e';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,2.1,0,6.2832);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#6b4a1e';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,.9,0,6.2832);c.fill()}}
 else if(f.crop==='melon'){for(let i=0,n=Math.min(500,w*h/260);i<n;i++){const x=r[0]+4+R()*(w-8),y=r[1]+4+R()*(h-8);c.fillStyle=f.id==='D1-F2'?'#3f7a32':'#d8c27a';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y,3.2,2.4,R()*3,0,6.2832);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='rgba(30,60,20,.5)';c.lineWidth=.5;c.stroke()}}
 else if(f.crop==='veg'){for(let i=0,n=Math.min(700,w*h/120);i<n;i++){const x=r[0]+4+R()*(w-8),y=r[1]+4+R()*(h-8);c.fillStyle=R()<.5?'#d9432f':'#3f8a32';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,1.3,0,6.2832);c.fill()}}
 else if(f.crop==='wheat'||f.crop==='clover'||f.crop==='alfalfa'||f.crop==='grass'){s12Specks(c,r,'cr'+f.id,90,f.crop==='wheat'?['rgba(250,230,150,.5)','rgba(160,120,50,.35)']:['rgba(200,230,150,.35)','rgba(60,100,40,.3)','rgba(240,240,220,.25)'],1.8)}
 else if(f.crop==='lettuce'){for(let i=0,n=Math.min(800,w*h/80);i<n;i++){const x=r[0]+4+R()*(w-8),y=r[1]+4+R()*(h-8);c.fillStyle=R()<.3?'#b9e08f':'#6fbf4a';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,2.4,0,6.2832);c.fill()}}}
/* ---- השבילים, דרכי השירות, הנחל ---- */
function s12Trails(c,N){const S=S12D.forest;
 for(const f of S.fire_roads){const b=s12PolyBox(f.pts,f.w);if(!s12In(b,0))continue;s12Poly(c,f.pts,f.w+6,'rgba(60,48,30,.35)');s12Poly(c,f.pts,f.w,N?'#5d5040':S12C.gravel);if(!N){c.setLineDash([2,5]);s12Poly(c,f.pts,1.4,'rgba(120,100,70,.5)','butt');c.setLineDash([])}
  if(!N&&Camera.zoom>.5){for(const o of[-7,7]){c.save();c.translate(0,0);c.strokeStyle='rgba(110,86,52,.35)';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();f.pts.forEach((p,i)=>{const q=f.pts[Math.min(i+1,f.pts.length-1)],pp=f.pts[Math.max(i-1,0)],dx=q[0]-pp[0],dy=q[1]-pp[1],l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;const x=p[0]-dy/l*o,y=p[1]+dx/l*o;i?c.lineTo(x,y):c.moveTo(x,y)});c.stroke();c.restore()}}}
 for(const t of [...S.trails,...S12D.b1.paths.map(p=>({...p,park:1}))]){const b=s12PolyBox(t.pts,t.w);if(!s12In(b,0))continue;s12Poly(c,t.pts,t.w+3,'rgba(50,40,24,.3)');s12Poly(c,t.pts,t.w,N?'#4a4132':t.park?'#e2d6b8':S12C.trail)}
 {const s=S.stream,b=s12PolyBox(s.pts,30);if(s12In(b,0)){s12Poly(c,s.pts,s.w+10,N?'#3a3a34':S12C.stone);s12Poly(c,s.pts,s.w,N?'#1f3a4c':S12C.water);s12Poly(c,s.pts,s.w*.35,N?'#2a4a5c':'rgba(220,240,250,.45)');
  if(!N){const R=s9Rng(9);for(let i=1;i<s.pts.length;i++){const a=s.pts[i-1],q=s.pts[i];for(let k=0;k<5;k++){const t=R(),x=a[0]+(q[0]-a[0])*t+(R()-.5)*16,y=a[1]+(q[1]-a[1])*t+(R()-.5)*16;c.fillStyle=R()<.5?'#8f897c':'#a7a193';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y,3+R()*3,2+R()*2,0,0,6.2832);c.fill()}}}}}}
/* ---- התצפיות, החניות של התצפיות, תחילת השבילים, הבריכה, המעיין, רחבת העצים, האחו ופס הביטחון ---- */
function s12Deck(c,r,N){s9Shadow(c,r[0],r[1],r[2],r[3],8,.2);s12Fill(c,r,N?'#4a3626':S12C.deck);c.strokeStyle=N?'#33251a':S12C.deckL;c.lineWidth=.7;c.beginPath();for(let x=r[0]+4;x<r[2];x+=4){c.moveTo(x,r[1]);c.lineTo(x,r[3])}c.stroke();c.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.35)';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.strokeRect(r[0]+.5,r[1]+.5,r[2]-r[0]-1,r[3]-r[1]-1)}
function s12Stalls(c,r,n,kind,N,nose,aisle){const surf=kind==='asphalt'?(N?'#2f3236':S12C.asph):(N?'#5d5442':S12C.gravel);if(aisle){s12Fill(c,aisle,surf);if(kind!=='asphalt'&&!N)s12Specks(c,aisle,'pa'+aisle.join(','),30,['rgba(255,255,255,.3)','rgba(80,66,44,.3)'])}
 s12Fill(c,r,surf);if(kind!=='asphalt'&&!N)s12Specks(c,r,'po'+r.join(','),30,['rgba(255,255,255,.3)','rgba(80,66,44,.3)']);const S=nose==='S',y0=S?r[1]+6:r[1]+2,y1=S?r[3]-2:r[3]-6;   /* S12 — המשך: הקווים עד המעבר */
 const w=(r[2]-r[0])/n;c.strokeStyle=kind==='asphalt'?'rgba(246,244,236,.88)':'rgba(120,96,60,.85)';c.lineWidth=kind==='asphalt'?1.6:2.4;c.beginPath();for(let k=0;k<=n;k++){c.moveTo(r[0]+k*w,y0);c.lineTo(r[0]+k*w,y1)}c.stroke();
 if(kind!=='asphalt'){c.fillStyle='#8a6a44';for(let k=0;k<n;k++)c.fillRect(r[0]+k*w+w*.2,S?r[3]-8:r[1]+4,w*.6,4)}}   /* קורת עץ בראש כל מקום (בחצץ) — בצד של החרטום */   /* קורת עץ בראש כל מקום (בחצץ) */
function s12Sites(c,N){const S=S12D.forest;
 for(const o of S.special){if(o.rect&&!s12In(o.rect,10))continue;if(o.disc&&!e3InView(o.disc[0]-o.disc[2]-20,o.disc[1]-o.disc[2]-20,o.disc[2]*2+40,o.disc[2]*2+40,10))continue;
  if(o.kind==='meadow'){s12Fill(c,o.rect,N?'#2c3a24':S12C.meadow);if(!N)s12Specks(c,o.rect,'md',40,['#f0e46a','#ffffff','#d77bb0','#b9a3e3','rgba(60,90,40,.5)','rgba(200,220,140,.6)'],2.2)}
  else if(o.kind==='firebreak'){s12Fill(c,o.rect,N?'#33402a':S12C.fire);if(!N){c.strokeStyle='rgba(120,140,70,.5)';c.lineWidth=2;for(let y=o.rect[1];y<o.rect[3];y+=10){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(o.rect[0],y);c.lineTo(o.rect[2],y+4);c.stroke()}}}
  else if(o.kind==='landing'){s12Fill(c,o.rect,N?'#4f4636':S12C.gravel);s12Specks(c,o.rect,'ld',24,['rgba(255,255,255,.3)','rgba(80,66,44,.3)','rgba(140,100,60,.35)'])}
  else if(o.kind==='pond'){const [x,y,R]=o.disc;c.fillStyle=N?'#3a3a34':'#a8a294';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,R+6,0,6.2832);c.fill();const g=c.createRadialGradient(x-6,y-6,4,x,y,R);g.addColorStop(0,N?'#1f3a4c':'#7fb6d6');g.addColorStop(1,N?'#16303f':'#3d7f98');c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,R,0,6.2832);c.fill();
   c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.25)';c.lineWidth=1;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,R*.6,0,6.2832);c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#6b7378';c.fillRect(x+R+2,y-3,16,6)}   /* צינור המילוי */
  else if(o.kind==='spring'){const [x,y,R]=o.disc;c.fillStyle=N?'#3a3a34':'#9c968a';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,R+5,0,6.2832);c.fill();c.fillStyle=N?'#1f3a4c':S12C.water;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,R,0,6.2832);c.fill();
   c.fillStyle=N?'#4a4a44':'#c9c3b5';c.fillRect(x-14,y-24,28,10);c.fillStyle=N?'#1f3a4c':'#5f9fc4';c.fillRect(x-12,y-22,24,6)}}   /* השוקת */
 for(const o of S.lookouts){if(!s12In(o.rect,20))continue;s12Deck(c,o.rect,N)}
 for(const o of S.pullouts){if(!s12In(o.aisle?[Math.min(o.rect[0],o.aisle[0]),Math.min(o.rect[1],o.aisle[1]),Math.max(o.rect[2],o.aisle[2]),Math.max(o.rect[3],o.aisle[3])]:o.rect,20))continue;s12Stalls(c,o.rect,o.n,o.kind,N,o.nose,o.aisle)}
 for(const o of S.trailheads){if(!s12In(o.rect,20))continue;s12Fill(c,o.rect,N?'#4f4636':S12C.gravel);s12Specks(c,o.rect,'th'+o.id,26,['rgba(255,255,255,.3)','rgba(80,66,44,.3)'])}
 /* הכניסות של המפה מדרך עפר — חצץ ושולי עפר (בדרכים המקומיות — הנמכה ואספלט) */
 for(const [id,d] of Object.entries(S12D.driveways)){const r=d.game;if(!s12In(r,10))continue;const trk=/^TR-/.test(d.road);s12Fill(c,r,trk?(N?'#4f4636':S12C.gravel):(N?'#2f3236':S12C.asph));if(!trk){c.fillStyle='rgba(214,208,192,.9)';if(r[2]-r[0]>r[3]-r[1]){c.fillRect(r[0],r[1]-1,r[2]-r[0],1.6);c.fillRect(r[0],r[3]-.6,r[2]-r[0],1.6)}else{c.fillRect(r[0]-1,r[1],1.6,r[3]-r[1]);c.fillRect(r[2]-.6,r[1],1.6,r[3]-r[1])}}}}
/* ---- C1, ‏D1, ‏B1: המשטחים ---- */
function s12Surface(c,s,N){const r=s.rect;if(!s12In(r,10))return;
 switch(s.kind){
  case 'gravel':s12Fill(c,r,N?'#4f4636':S12C.gravel);s12Specks(c,r,s.id,24,['rgba(255,255,255,.35)','rgba(80,66,44,.28)']);break;
  case 'garden':s9Garden(c,r,s.id,{});break;
  case 'hedge':s9HedgeStrip(c,r,s.id);break;
  case 'paving':s9Pav(c,r,s.id,S12C.pav);break;
  case 'asphalt':s12Fill(c,r,N?'#2f3236':S12C.asph);break;
  case 'concrete':s9Pav(c,r,s.id,S12C.conc);break;
  case 'track':s12Fill(c,r,N?'#4f4232':S12C.track);s12Specks(c,r,s.id,30,['rgba(255,255,255,.25)','rgba(90,70,40,.3)']);break;
  case 'park':break;   /* B1: הדשא של הפארק (S8) נשאר — רק פריטים מעליו */
  case 'fence':break}}
function s12Allot(c,f,N){const r=f.rect;if(!s12In(r,10))return;s9Grass(c,r,f.id);for(let x=r[0]+10;x<r[2]-24;x+=40)for(let y=r[1]+10;y<r[3]-20;y+=34){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.18)';c.fillRect(x+1,y+2,30,24);c.fillStyle=N?'#3a2c1e':S12C.soil;c.fillRect(x,y,30,24);
  c.strokeStyle='#cfc8b6';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.strokeRect(x,y,30,24);if(!N){const R=s9Rng(s9Hash('al'+x+y)),col=['#5f9a45','#d9432f','#e8c23a','#8fc46a'][(R()*4)|0];for(let k=0;k<3;k++){c.fillStyle=col;c.fillRect(x+3,y+4+k*7,24,3)}}}}
/* ---- הבנייה של הקרקע ---- */
function s12Ground(c,now,N){if(!e3InView(S12_BOX[0],S12_BOX[1],S12_BOX[2]-S12_BOX[0],S12_BOX[3]-S12_BOX[1],40))return;c.save();try{
 s12ForestFloor(c,N);

 for(const t of F.tracks){if(t.kind==='track')s12Surface(c,{...t,kind:'track'},N)}
 for(const s of S12D.c1.surfaces)s12Surface(c,s,N);for(const f of S12D.c1.fields)if(f.crop==='allot')s12Allot(c,f,N);
 for(const s of S12D.d1.surfaces)s12Surface(c,s,N);

 {const P=S12D.c1.parking;if(s12In(P.rect,10)){s12Stalls(c,P.rect,4,'asphalt',N)}}
 s12Trails(c,N);s12Sites(c,N);
 /* הצללים, הכניסות והחזיתות של המבנים */
 for(const b0 of S12_BUILDINGS){const b=s9V(b0),H=s9H(b);if(!e3InView(b.x,b.y-H,b.w,b.h+H+S9_SUN.dy*b.hpx,30))continue;s9Shadow(c,b.x,b.y,b.x+b.w,b.y+b.h,b.hpx);s9Entry(c,b0,N);s9Face(c,b,N)}
 for(const g of S12_GREENHOUSES){if(!e3InView(g.x,g.y-30,g.w+30,g.h+50,20))continue;s9Shadow(c,g.x,g.y,g.x+g.w,g.y+g.h,40,.16);s12Fill(c,[g.x,g.y,g.x+g.w,g.y+g.h],N?'#2c3a30':'#7f9f6a')}
 }catch(e){s12Err('ground',e)}c.restore()}
/* ---- הדרכים של S12 (מתוך rbDraw2): 0 — מתחת לסימונים, 1 — מעליהם ---- */

 // ---- the audit: at every 0.1 s the ball is at a player (≤ 1.6 m), or in a flight that leaves a player and reaches a player, or in the net (≤ 3 s) ----
 function auditSess(S, name) { const out = { name, samples: 0, bad: 0, worst: 0, why: [] };
  S.balls.forEach((L, bi) => { if (!L) return; for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { const s = L[i];

     if (!s.cont) { const p = posAtTr(S.pl[s.j].tr, s.t1), d = Math.hypot(p[0] - s.b[0], p[1] - s.b[1]) / MPX; out.samples++; if (d > 1.6) { out.bad++; out.why.length < 6 && out.why.push(name + ' ball ' + bi + ' reaches #' + s.j + ' at ' + s.t1.toFixed(1) + ' — ' + d.toFixed(2) + ' m'); } }

    if (s.k === 'net') { out.samples++; if (s.t1 - s.t0 > 3.01) { out.bad++; out.why.push(name + ' net ' + (s.t1 - s.t0).toFixed(1) + ' s'); } continue; }
    for (let t = s.t0; t <= s.t1; t += .1) { const b = ballAt(S, bi, t), p = posAtTr(S.pl[s.j].tr, t), d = Math.hypot(p[0] - b.x, p[1] - b.y) / MPX; out.samples++; out.worst = Math.max(out.worst, d); if (d > 1.6) { out.bad++; out.why.length < 6 && out.why.push(name + ' ' + s.k + ' #' + s.j + ' at ' + t.toFixed(1) + ' — ' + d.toFixed(2) + ' m'); } } } });
  return out; }

 const MT = { enter: -26, h1: [0, 180], ht: [180, 230], h2: [230, 410], end: 432 };   /* D‑556: two halves of 180 s (were 90), one match minute = 4 s */
 function genMatch(seed) {
  const R = rng(seed), S = Sess(), N = 23, RF = 22;
  for (let j = 0; j < 22; j++) addPl(S, LKM[j], TUN[0], TUN[1], -40); addPl(S, REF, TUN[0], TUN[1], -40);
  const dirOf = (tm, half) => (tm === 0 ? 1 : -1) * (half === 1 ? 1 : -1);
  const goalX = (tm, half) => dirOf(tm, half) > 0 ? PI_[2] : PI_[0];   // the goal that team tm attacks
  const cur = () => S.pl.map(P => { const l = P.tr[P.tr.length - 1]; return [l[1], l[2]]; });
  function shape(half, ball, poss) { const out = []; for (let j = 0; j < 22; j++) { const tm = j < 11 ? 0 : 1, i = j % 11, d = dirOf(tm, half), f = FORM[i], bu = U(ball[0]), bv = V(ball[1]);
    let u = d > 0 ? f[0] : 1 - f[0], v = f[1];
    if (i === 0) { u = cl(u + (bu - .5) * .05, .015, .985); v = .5 + (bv - .5) * .22; }
    else { u = u + (bu - .5) * .55 + d * (tm === poss ? .06 : -.03); v = v + (bv - .5) * .32; u = cl(u, .05, .95); v = cl(v, .06, .94); }
    out.push([X(u), Y(v)]); }
   out.push([cl(ball[0] - 70, PI_[0] + 30, PI_[2] - 30), cl(ball[1] + (ball[1] < GY ? 90 : -90), PI_[1] + 25, PI_[3] - 25)]);   // the referee: behind the play, on the far diagonal
   return out; }
  function kickoff(half, poss) { const F = shape(half, [X(.5), Y(.5)], poss); for (let j = 0; j < 22; j++) { const tm = j < 11 ? 0 : 1, d = dirOf(tm, half); let u = U(F[j][0]); u = d > 0 ? Math.min(u, .46) : Math.max(u, .54); F[j][0] = X(u); }
   const kk = poss * 11 + 9, mate = poss * 11 + 10, d = dirOf(poss, half); F[kk] = [X(.5) - d * 8, Y(.5)]; F[mate] = [X(.5) - d * 30, Y(.5) + 40]; F[RF] = [X(.5) + 20, Y(.5) + 150]; return F; }
  // move everyone to targets T over dur (each at most vmax m/s, except the ones in `free`)
  function step(t0, dur, T, free, vmax) { const C = cur(); for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) { let [x, y] = T[j]; if (!free || !free.has(j)) { const dx = x - C[j][0], dy = y - C[j][1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dy), m = (vmax || 7) * MPX * dur; if (l > m) { x = C[j][0] + dx / l * m; y = C[j][1] + dy / l * m; } } key(S, j, t0 + dur, x, y); } }
  function hold(t0, dur) { const C = cur(); for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) key(S, j, t0 + dur, C[j][0], C[j][1]); }
  // the walk in from the tunnel (each at his own moment) and out again
  function walkIn(t0, t1, F, half) { for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) { const s = t0 + (j === RF ? 0 : 1 + (j % 11) * .7 + (j < 11 ? 0 : .35)); key(S, j, s, TUN[0] + ((j % 5) - 2) * 4, TUN[1] - 2); key(S, j, t1, F[j][0], F[j][1]); S.pl[j].vis.push([s, 1e9]); } }
  function walkOut(t0) { let last = t0; const C = cur(); for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) { const d = dist(C[j], TUN) / MPX, s = t0 + (j % 11) * .25, e = s + d / 3.2; key(S, j, s, C[j][0], C[j][1]); key(S, j, e, TUN[0] + ((j % 5) - 2) * 4, TUN[1] - 2); const v = S.pl[j].vis; v[v.length - 1][1] = e; last = Math.max(last, e); } return last; }
  let score = [0, 0];
  function half(h, poss, tA, tB) {
   const F = kickoff(h, poss), kk = poss * 11 + 9; walkIn(tA - 24, tA - 2.2, F, h);
   // the referee brings the ball, puts it on the spot
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: RF, t0: tA - 24, t1: tA - 1.2, face: [X(.5), Y(.5)] }); hold(tA - 2.2, 1);
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: RF, j: kk, t0: tA - 1.2, t1: tA, a: null, b: [X(.5), Y(.5), .11], h: .2 }); hold(tA - 1.2, 1.2);
   let t = tA, holder = kk, B = [X(.5), Y(.5)];
   const fix = s => { if (s.k === 'air' && !s.a) { const p = posAtTr(S.pl[s.i].tr, s.t0); s.a = [p[0], p[1], s.za != null ? s.za : 1.05]; } };
   S.balls[0].forEach(fix);
   let first = true;
   while (t < tB - 3) {
    const tm = holder < 11 ? 0 : holder < 22 ? 1 : -1, d = dirOf(tm, h), C = cur(), hp = C[holder], gx = goalX(tm, h), isGK = holder % 11 === 0 && holder < 22;
    const opp = j => (j < 11 ? 0 : 1) !== tm && j < 22;
    if (isGK) {   // the keeper holds the ball, then throws or kicks it to a defender or a midfielder
     const dh = .9 + R() * .8; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + dh, face: [X(.5), Y(.5)] }); step(t, dh, shape(h, hp, tm), new Set([holder]), 4); key(S, holder, t + dh, hp[0], hp[1]); t += dh;
     const cands = []; for (let i = 1; i < 9; i++) cands.push(tm * 11 + i); const r = cands[Math.floor(R() * cands.length)], C2 = cur(), rp = C2[r], dd = dist(hp, rp), dur = cl(dd / MPX / 16, .8, 2.6);
     const T = shape(h, rp, tm); T[r] = rp; step(t, dur, T, new Set([r]), 6.5); key(S, r, t + dur, rp[0], rp[1]);
     bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: holder, j: r, t0: t, t1: t + dur, a: [hp[0] + d * 3, hp[1], 1.4], b: [rp[0] - d * 5, rp[1], .11], h: cl((dd / MPX - 15) * .14, .3, 7) }); t += dur; holder = r; continue; }
    const toGoal = Math.abs(gx - hp[0]), inBox = toGoal < 230 && Math.abs(hp[1] - GY) < 170;
    if (!first && inBox && R() < .55) {   // the shot
     const gk = (1 - tm) * 11, g = C[gk], save = R() > .3, ty = save ? cl(g[1] + (R() - .5) * 40, GY - 34, GY + 34) : (g[1] > GY ? GY - 28 + R() * 8 : GY + 20 + R() * 8);
     const tp = save ? [gx - d * 10, ty] : [gx + d * 9, ty], dd = dist(hp, tp), dur = cl(dd / MPX / 24, .35, 1.4);
     const T = shape(h, tp, tm); T[holder] = [hp[0] + d * 10, hp[1]]; if (save) T[gk] = [tp[0] + d * 0, tp[1] - 3]; else T[gk] = [g[0], g[1] + (ty - g[1]) * .35];
     step(t, dur, T, new Set([gk]), 7);
     if (save) { bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: holder, j: gk, t0: t, t1: t + dur, a: [hp[0] + d * 6, hp[1] + 1, .2], b: [tp[0], tp[1] - 3 + 3.5 + 1, 1.05], h: .5 }); t += dur; holder = gk; continue; }
     bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: holder, j: -1, t0: t, t1: t + dur, a: [hp[0] + d * 6, hp[1] + 1, .2], b: [tp[0], tp[1], .9], h: .4, cont: true }); t += dur;
     score[tm]++; S.goals.push({ t, team: tm });
     // the goal: the scorer runs off, his team after him; the keeper takes the ball out of the net; everyone back for the kick-off
     const sc = holder, corner = [gx - d * 60, hp[1] < GY ? PI_[1] + 40 : PI_[3] - 40], Tc = shape(h, [X(.5), Y(.5)], 1 - tm); Tc[sc] = corner; for (let i = 1; i < 11; i++) { const j = tm * 11 + i; if (j !== sc && i >= 5) Tc[j] = [corner[0] - d * (12 + i * 3), corner[1] + (i % 2 ? 14 : -14)]; }
     Tc[gk] = [tp[0] - d * 9, tp[1] + 4]; step(t, 2.6, Tc, null, 6); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'net', j: gk, t0: t, t1: t + 2.6, p: [tp[0], tp[1]] }); t += 2.6;
     const kick = (1 - tm) * 11 + 9, K = kickoff(h, 1 - tm); hold(t, .01);
     const gp = cur()[gk]; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: gk, t0: t, t1: t + 1.4, face: [X(.5), Y(.5)] }); K[gk] = [gp[0] - d * 25, gp[1]]; step(t, 1.4, K, null, 5); t += 1.4;
     const g2 = cur()[gk], kp = cur()[kick], dd2 = dist(g2, kp), du2 = cl(dd2 / MPX / 17, 1.2, 3.2); K[kick] = [X(.5) + d * 8, Y(.5)]; step(t, du2, K, new Set([kick]), 6.5);
     bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: gk, j: kick, t0: t, t1: t + du2, a: [g2[0], g2[1], 1.4], b: [X(.5), Y(.5), .11], h: cl(dd2 / MPX * .12, 1, 9) }); t += du2;
     const wait = 4 + R() * 3; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: kick, t0: t, t1: t + wait, face: [X(.5) - d * 100, Y(.5)] }); step(t, wait, K, new Set([kick]), 4); key(S, kick, t + wait, X(.5) + d * 8, Y(.5)); t += wait;
     holder = kick; first = true; continue; }
    if (!first && R() < .34 && toGoal > 120) {   // the dribble: 4–10 m forward, a little across
     const len = (4 + R() * 6) * MPX, np = [cl(hp[0] + d * len, PI_[0] + 20, PI_[2] - 20), cl(hp[1] + (R() - .5) * len * .8, PI_[1] + 20, PI_[3] - 20)], dur = len / MPX / (4.6 + R() * 1.6);
     const T = shape(h, np, tm); T[holder] = np; step(t, dur, T, new Set([holder]), 7); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + dur, face: [gx, GY] }); t += dur; continue; }
    // the pass: to a mate, forward if he can; the mate runs to meet it; sometimes cut out by the nearest opponent
    const mates = []; for (let i = 1; i < 11; i++) { const j = tm * 11 + i; if (j === holder) continue; const p = C[j], dd = dist(hp, p); if (dd < 60 || dd > 340) continue; const fw = (p[0] - hp[0]) * d; mates.push([j, Math.max(.05, 1 + fw / 120 + (R() - .5) * .8)]); }
    if (first) { const j = tm * 11 + (R() < .5 ? 6 : 7); mates.length = 0; mates.push([j, 1]); }
    if (!mates.length) { const dur = 1 + R(); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + dur, face: [gx, GY] }); const np = [hp[0] + d * 20, hp[1]]; const T = shape(h, np, tm); T[holder] = np; step(t, dur, T, new Set([holder]), 6); t += dur; continue; }
    let sum = 0; mates.forEach(m => sum += m[1]); let r = R() * sum, rj = mates[0][0]; for (const m of mates) { r -= m[1]; if (r <= 0) { rj = m[0]; break; } }
    const pre = .25 + R() * .5; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + pre, face: C[rj] }); step(t, pre, shape(h, hp, tm), new Set([holder]), 6); key(S, holder, t + pre, hp[0], hp[1]); t += pre;
    const C2 = cur(), Tm = shape(h, C2[rj], tm), rr = C2[rj], tgt = Tm[rj], dd0 = dist(hp, rr), dur0 = cl(dd0 / MPX / 15, .45, 2.4), run = Math.min(dist(rr, tgt), 5.5 * MPX * dur0), rp = run > 1 ? [rr[0] + (tgt[0] - rr[0]) / dist(rr, tgt) * run, rr[1] + (tgt[1] - rr[1]) / dist(rr, tgt) * run] : rr;
    const dd = dist(hp, rp), dur = cl(dd / MPX / 15, .45, 2.4); let rec = rj, bp = rp;
    if (!first && R() < .1 + (dd > 220 ? .12 : 0)) { let best = -1, bd = 1e9; const ip = [lerp(hp[0], rp[0], .72), lerp(hp[1], rp[1], .72)]; for (let j = 0; j < 22; j++) if (opp(j) && j % 11) { const q = dist(C2[j], ip); if (q < bd) { bd = q; best = j; } } if (best >= 0 && bd < 6.2 * MPX * dur * .72) { rec = best; bp = ip; } }
    const T = shape(h, bp, rec < 11 ? 0 : 1); T[rec] = bp; T[holder] = hp; const fd = rec === rj ? dur : dur * .72;
    step(t, fd, T, new Set([rec]), 7); key(S, rec, t + fd, bp[0], bp[1]);
    bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: holder, j: rec, t0: t, t1: t + fd, a: [hp[0] + (rp[0] - hp[0]) / (dd || 1) * 6, hp[1] + (rp[1] - hp[1]) / (dd || 1) * 6 + 1, .11], b: [bp[0] - (bp[0] - hp[0]) / (dd || 1) * 6, bp[1] - (bp[1] - hp[1]) / (dd || 1) * 6 + 1, .11], h: cl((dd / MPX - 16) * .1, 0, 5) });
    t += fd; holder = rec; first = false; }
   // the whistle: the one with the ball gives it to the referee; everyone walks off
   const C = cur(), hp = C[holder], rp = C[RF], dd = dist(hp, rp), dur = cl(dd / MPX / 12, .6, 3.2);
   if (holder % 11 === 0 && holder < 22) bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + .4 }); else bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + .4, face: rp }); hold(t, .4); t += .4;
   const T = cur(); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: holder, j: RF, t0: t, t1: t + dur, a: [hp[0], hp[1], .5], b: [rp[0], rp[1] + 1, 1.05], h: cl(dd / MPX * .08, .5, 4) }); step(t, dur, T, null, 1); key(S, RF, t + dur, rp[0], rp[1]); t += dur;
   const out = walkOut(t); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: RF, t0: t, t1: S.pl[RF].vis[S.pl[RF].vis.length - 1][1], face: TUN }); return out; }
  const e1 = half(1, 0, MT.h1[0], MT.h1[1]); const e2 = half(2, 1, MT.h2[0], MT.h2[1]); S.end = e2; S.ht = e1; S.score = score; S.kind = 'match'; S.tA = MT.enter - 2; return S; }
 // the score at time u (the goals before it)
 function scoreAt(S, u) { const s = [0, 0]; for (const g of S.goals) if (g.t <= u) s[g.team]++; return s; }
 // =====================================================================================================================
 // A3 — the training (a short story): out of the tunnel; two squares passing (two balls); then shots at the keeper in a row; back in
 function genTrain(seed) { const R = rng(seed), S = Sess(), N = 9, CO = 9, GK = 8;
  for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) addPl(S, TRN[j], TUN[0], TUN[1], 0); addPl(S, COACH, TUN[0], TUN[1], 0);
  const SQ = [[420, 1985], [830, 2165]], H = 70, cor = (g, k) => [SQ[g][0] + (k % 2 ? H : -H), SQ[g][1] + (k < 2 ? -H : H)];
  // in: 0–15 (the coach and the keeper too); each group's ball in a player's hands
  for (let j = 0; j <= CO; j++) { const s = j * .6, p = j < 8 ? cor(j < 4 ? 0 : 1, j % 4) : j === GK ? [PI_[0] + 12, GY] : [600, 2025]; key(S, j, s, TUN[0] + ((j % 5) - 2) * 4, TUN[1] - 2); key(S, j, 15, p[0], p[1]); S.pl[j].vis.push([s, 1e9]); }
  // the passing squares: 15–195
  [0, 1].forEach(g => { const pl = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(k => g * 4 + k); let h = pl[0], t = 15; bpush(S, g, { k: 'hand', j: h, t0: 0, t1: 15.4, face: cor(g, 3) }); bpush(S, g, { k: 'air', i: h, j: h, t0: 15.4, t1: 15.8, a: null, b: null, h: 0 });
   const L = S.balls[g], dr = L[1]; const p0 = cor(g, 0); dr.a = [p0[0], p0[1] + 1, 1.0]; dr.b = [p0[0] + (cor(g, 3)[0] - p0[0]) / 140 * 6, p0[1] + (cor(g, 3)[1] - p0[1]) / 140 * 6 + 1, .11]; t = 15.8;
   let prev = -1, hpos = cor(g, 0);
   while (t < 192) { const ctrl = .5 + R() * .5, others = pl.filter(j => j !== h && j !== prev), r = others[Math.floor(R() * others.length)], rc = cor(g, pl.indexOf(r)), rp = [rc[0] + (hpos[0] - rc[0]) * .08, rc[1] + (hpos[1] - rc[1]) * .08];
    bpush(S, g, { k: 'feet', j: h, t0: t, t1: t + ctrl, face: rp }); key(S, h, t + ctrl, hpos[0], hpos[1]); t += ctrl;   // the touch, then the pass
    const dd = dist(hpos, rp), dur = cl(dd / MPX / 12, .6, 1.6), hc = cor(g, pl.indexOf(h)); key(S, r, t, rc[0], rc[1]); key(S, r, t + dur, rp[0], rp[1]); key(S, h, t + dur + .7, hc[0], hc[1]);
    bpush(S, g, { k: 'air', i: h, j: r, t0: t, t1: t + dur, a: [hpos[0] + (rp[0] - hpos[0]) / dd * 6, hpos[1] + (rp[1] - hpos[1]) / dd * 6 + 1, .11], b: [rp[0] + (hpos[0] - rp[0]) / dd * 6, rp[1] + (hpos[1] - rp[1]) / dd * 6 + 1, .11], h: 0 }); t += dur;
    prev = h; h = r; hpos = rp; }
   // the end of the squares: the last one picks the ball up and walks to the coach, gives it to him (group 1) / to the row (group 0)
   const k = pl.indexOf(h), hp = posAtTr(S.pl[h].tr, t); bpush(S, g, { k: 'hand', j: h, t0: t, t1: t + 8, face: [520, 2075] }); key(S, h, t, hp[0], hp[1]);
   const dest = g === 0 ? [508, 2075] : [612, 2027]; key(S, h, t + 8, dest[0], dest[1]); S.end0 = Math.max(S.end0 || 0, t + 8);
   if (g === 1) { bpush(S, g, { k: 'air', i: h, j: CO, t0: t + 8, t1: t + 8.6, a: [dest[0], dest[1] + 1, 1.05], b: [600, 2026, 1.05], h: .3 }); bpush(S, g, { k: 'hand', j: CO, t0: t + 8.6, t1: 330, face: [400, 2075] }); }
   S['g' + g] = { h, t: t + 8 }; });
  // the row: 205–320 — the first in the row runs with the ball and shoots; the keeper saves (and rolls it to the next) or it goes in (he takes it out)
  const g0 = S.g0, row = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], RX = j => 520 + j * 16; let t = Math.max(205, g0.t + .5), q = row.slice(), cur0 = g0.h;
  // everyone to the row (the order of q); the one with the ball first
  q.splice(q.indexOf(cur0), 1); q.unshift(cur0); q.forEach((j, i) => key(S, j, t - 2, RX(i), GY + (i % 2 ? 6 : -6))); key(S, GK, t - 2, PI_[0] + 12, GY);
  bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: cur0, j: cur0, t0: g0.t, t1: t, a: [508, 2076, 1.05], b: [RX(0) - 6, GY + 1, .11], h: 0 }); S.balls[0][S.balls[0].length - 1].a = null;
  { const L = S.balls[0], s = L[L.length - 1], p = posAtTr(S.pl[cur0].tr, s.t0); s.a = [p[0] + 3.5, p[1] + 1, 1.05]; s.t1 = s.t0 + .5; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: cur0, t0: s.t1, t1: t, face: [PI_[0], GY] }); }
  const SP = i => [RX(i), GY + (i % 2 ? 6 : -6)];
  while (t < 300) { const sh = q.shift(), p0 = SP(0), run = [330 + R() * 30, GY + (R() - .5) * 90], dur = dist(p0, run) / MPX / 5.2;
   key(S, sh, t, p0[0], p0[1]); key(S, sh, t + dur, run[0], run[1]); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: sh, t0: t, t1: t + dur, face: [PI_[0], GY] });
   q.forEach((j, i) => { const a = SP(i + 1), b = SP(i); key(S, j, t, a[0], a[1]); key(S, j, t + Math.min(dur, 2.5), b[0], b[1]); }); t += dur;   // the row steps up
   const g = posAtTr(S.pl[GK].tr, t), save = R() > .4, ty = save ? cl(g[1] + (R() - .5) * 36, GY - 32, GY + 32) : (R() < .5 ? GY - 30 : GY + 28), tp = save ? [PI_[0] + 10, ty] : [PI_[0] + 4.5, ty], sd = cl(dist(run, tp) / MPX / 22, .35, 1);
   key(S, GK, t, g[0], g[1]); key(S, GK, t + sd, save ? tp[0] : PI_[0] + 12, save ? ty - 3 : g[1] + (ty - g[1]) * .3);
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: sh, j: save ? GK : -1, t0: t, t1: t + sd, a: [run[0] - 6, run[1] + 1, .2], b: save ? [tp[0] + 3.5, ty - 3 + 1, 1.05] : [tp[0], tp[1], .8], h: .4, cont: !save }); key(S, sh, t + sd, run[0] - 8, run[1]); t += sd;
   const tS = t, back = SP(q.length);   // the shooter jogs back round the side to the end of the row
   key(S, sh, tS + 1.2, run[0] + 6, run[1] + (run[1] < GY ? -30 : 30)); key(S, sh, tS + 6.2, back[0] - 10, GY + 34); key(S, sh, tS + 7.6, back[0], back[1]);
   if (!save) { const gp = [PI_[0] + 2, ty + 4]; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'net', j: GK, t0: t, t1: t + 1.6, p: [tp[0], tp[1]] }); key(S, GK, t + 1.6, gp[0], gp[1]); t += 1.6; }
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: GK, t0: t, t1: t + 1, face: SP(0) }); key(S, GK, t + 1, PI_[0] + 12, GY); t += 1;
   const nx = q[0], np = SP(0), gp2 = posAtTr(S.pl[GK].tr, t), rd = cl(dist(gp2, np) / MPX / 10, 1.6, 3.2);   // the keeper rolls the ball to the next one

   q.push(sh); const tn = Math.max(t + .5, tS + 7.8); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: nx, t0: t, t1: tn, face: [PI_[0], GY] }); key(S, nx, tn, np[0], np[1]); t = tn; }
  // out: the one with the ball carries it; everyone walks to the tunnel
  const L0 = S.balls[0], last = L0[L0.length - 1], ho = last.j; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: ho, t0: t, t1: t + 1e-3 });

 // A4 — the courts. Each a story with its wait: they come from the club, play, go back. A walk along points at a speed:
 function walkPath(S, j, t0, pts, v) { let t = t0; key(S, j, t, pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) { t += dist(pts[i - 1], pts[i]) / MPX / v; key(S, j, t, pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); } return t; }
 const DOOR = [478, 2985];
 // basketball 2 v 2 at the east hoop (the rim 3.05 m): dribble, pass, shot; in (it drops through, the defence takes it out) or off the rim (a rebound)
 function genBasket(seed) { const R = rng(seed), S = Sess(), H = [324, 2995], SP = [[262, 2950], [256, 2995], [262, 3040], [286, 2960], [286, 3030], [248, 2972], [248, 3018], [300, 2944], [300, 3046]];
  for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) addPl(S, YOUTH[j], DOOR[0], DOOR[1], 0);
  const IN = [DOOR, [480, 3104], [372, 3104], [346, 3078]];
  let tEnd = 0; for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { const s = j * 1.4, sp = j < 2 ? SP[j] : [SP[j - 2][0] + 14, SP[j - 2][1]]; tEnd = Math.max(tEnd, walkPath(S, j, s, IN.concat([sp]), 1.5)); S.pl[j].vis.push([s, 1e9]); }
  let t = tEnd + .6; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: 0, t0: 0, t1: t, face: H });
  let off = [0, 1], def = [2, 3], h = 0, passes = 0;
  const guard = (o, oq) => [oq[0] + (H[0] - oq[0]) * .22, oq[1] + (H[1] - oq[1]) * .22 + (o % 2 ? 3 : -3)];
  // the first touch: he puts the ball down and dribbles
  while (t < 240) {
   const C = j => posAtTr(S.pl[j].tr, t), mate = off[0] === h ? off[1] : off[0];
   // dribble to a spot; the mate to another; the defence with them
   const a = SP[Math.floor(R() * SP.length)]; let b = SP[Math.floor(R() * SP.length)]; if (dist(a, b) < 30) b = [a[0] - 20, a[1] + (a[1] < H[1] ? 44 : -44)];
   const dd = cl(1.2 + R() * 1.6, 1.2, 2.8); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'dribble', j: h, t0: t, t1: t + dd, face: H }); key(S, h, t + dd, a[0], a[1]); key(S, mate, t + dd, b[0], b[1]);
   def.forEach((d, i) => { const o = i === 0 ? h : mate, oq = o === h ? a : b, g = guard(o, oq); key(S, d, t + dd, g[0], g[1]); }); t += dd;
   if (passes < 3 && R() < .55) {   // the pass (a chest pass, 1.2 m)
    const hp = C(h), mp = C(mate), du = cl(dist(hp, mp) / MPX / 9, .35, .9); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: h, j: mate, t0: t, t1: t + du, a: [hp[0] + (mp[0] - hp[0]) / dist(hp, mp) * 3.5, hp[1] + 1, 1.2], b: [mp[0] - (mp[0] - hp[0]) / dist(hp, mp) * 3.5, mp[1] + 1, 1.2], h: .15 });
    key(S, h, t + du, hp[0], hp[1]); key(S, mate, t + du, mp[0], mp[1]); def.forEach(d => { const q = C(d); key(S, d, t + du, q[0], q[1]); }); t += du; h = mate; passes++; continue; }
   // the shot: up to the rim (an arc), then in (through the net, a bounce, the defence takes it) or off the rim (a rebound)
   const hp = C(h), su = 1.05, make = R() < .45, rb = make ? def[0] : (R() < .35 ? off[R() < .5 ? 0 : 1] : def[R() < .5 ? 0 : 1]);
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: h, j: -1, t0: t, t1: t + su, a: [hp[0] + 2, hp[1] - 1, 2.3], b: [H[0] - 1, H[1], 3.1], h: 1.6, cont: true }); key(S, h, t + su, hp[0], hp[1]);
   const rp = make ? [H[0] - 16, H[1] + 6] : [H[0] - 24 - R() * 18, H[1] + (R() - .5) * 60], bu = make ? 1.1 : 1.3;
   off.concat(def).forEach(j => { if (j === rb) return; const q = C(j); key(S, j, t + su, q[0] + (H[0] - q[0]) * .1, q[1] + (H[1] - q[1]) * .1); });
   key(S, rb, t + su + bu, rp[0], rp[1]); off.concat(def).forEach(j => { if (j === rb) return; const q = posAtTr(S.pl[j].tr, t + su); key(S, j, t + su + bu, q[0], q[1]); });
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'bounce', i: -1, j: rb, t0: t + su, t1: t + su + bu, a: [H[0] - 1, H[1], make ? 2.9 : 3.1], b: [rp[0] + 3.5, rp[1] + 1, 1.05], fb: make ? .55 : .5, h: make ? 0 : .5, h2: .55 }); t += su + bu;
   const rebOff = off.indexOf(rb) >= 0; h = rb; passes = 0;
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: rb, t0: t, t1: t + .7, face: [200, 2995] }); off.concat(def).forEach(j => { const q = C(j); key(S, j, t + .7, q[0], q[1]); }); t += .7;
   if (!rebOff) { // the defence takes it out beyond the arc: the teams change sides
    const tmp = off; off = def; def = tmp; const out = [244, 2995 + (R() - .5) * 50]; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'dribble', j: h, t0: t, t1: t + 2.2, face: [200, 2995] }); key(S, h, t + 2.2, out[0], out[1]);
    const m2 = off[0] === h ? off[1] : off[0], mp2 = SP[Math.floor(R() * SP.length)]; key(S, m2, t + 2.2, mp2[0], mp2[1]); def.forEach((d, i) => { const g = guard(d, i ? mp2 : out); key(S, d, t + 2.2, g[0], g[1]); }); t += 2.2; } }
  // back to the club: the one with the ball carries it
  const ho = h; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: ho, t0: t, t1: t + 1e-3 }); let e = t; for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { const q = posAtTr(S.pl[j].tr, t), en = walkPath(S, j, t + .5 + j * .6, [[q[0], q[1]], [346, 3078], [372, 3104], [480, 3104], DOOR], 1.4); S.pl[j].vis[0][1] = en; e = Math.max(e, en); }
  const L = S.balls[0]; L[L.length - 1].t1 = S.pl[ho].vis[0][1]; S.end = e; S.kind = 'basket'; return S; }
 // tennis: a practice rally over the net, the bounce in the other half; now and then he catches it and serves again
 function genTennis(seed) { const R = rng(seed), S = Sess(), TI = [104, 3157, 342, 3267], NX = 223, BY = [3170, 3254];
  addPl(S, kit(90, '#f4f4f0', '#1f2326', '#f4f4f0', 1.74), DOOR[0], DOOR[1], 0); addPl(S, kit(91, '#2e8b57', '#f4f4f0', '#f4f4f0', 1.8), DOOR[0], DOOR[1], 0);

    bpush(S, 0, { k: 'bounce', i: h, j: o, t0: t, t1: t + du, a: [ax, a[1] + 1, first ? 2.6 : 1.0], b: [bx, oq[1] + 1, 1.0], fb: cl(bounce, .55, .8), h: first ? .3 : 1.0, h2: .7 });
    key(S, o, t + du, oq[0], oq[1]); const back = h === 0 ? [92, cl(a[1], 3175, 3250)] : [354, cl(a[1], 3175, 3250)]; key(S, h, t + du, back[0], back[1]); t += du; h = o; first = false; }
   // he catches it, walks to his serving spot; then he serves
   const c = posAtTr(S.pl[h].tr, t), spot = h === 0 ?   const ho = h; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: ho, t0: t, t1: t + 1e-3 }); let e = t;

 // five-a-side training: a slalom through the cones and a shot at the east goal; the keeper sends the ball back to the next one; the coach watches

 // the fitness corner: a man comes along the paths, does pull-ups, then the bike, and goes
 function genFit(seed) { const R = rng(seed), S = Sess(); addPl(S, kit(97, '#3d7a8a', '#1f2326', '#f4f4f0', 1.82), 648, 3306, 0);

 // =====================================================================================================================
 // the match day, by the game clock: every 3 days from day 2, the kick-off at 19:30 (one game minute = 2 s); the page can start one now
 const KICK = 1170, EVERY = 3, DAY0 = 2, WIN = [-150, 480], WD = ['ראשון', 'שני', 'שלישי', 'רביעי', 'חמישי', 'שישי', 'שבת'];
 function gm() { try { const c = gameClock(); return (c.day - 1) * 1440 + c.min; } catch (e) { return null; } }
 function matchNow() { const g = gm(); if (g == null) return null; const ov = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.__TC_A3_MATCH;
  const W1 = i => { try { return typeof LEAGUE4 !== 'undefined' ? LEAGUE4.winEnd(i) : WIN[1]; } catch (e) { return WIN[1]; } };   /* D‑578: the final and its ceremony — a longer window */
  if (ov && ov.K != null) { const u = (g - ov.K) * 2; if (u >= WIN[0] && u <= W1(ov.idx || 9001)) return { u, K: ov.K, idx: ov.idx || 9001 }; }
  const day = Math.floor(g / 1440) + 1; for (let d = day - 1; d <= day; d++) { if (d < DAY0 || (d - DAY0) % EVERY) continue; const K = (d - 1) * 1440 + KICK, u = (g - K) * 2; if (u >= WIN[0] && u <= W1(d)) return { u, K, idx: d }; } return null; }
 function nextMatch() { const g = gm(); if (g == null) return null; const day = Math.floor(g / 1440) + 1; for (let d = Math.max(DAY0, day); d < day + 8; d++) { if ((d - DAY0) % EVERY) continue; const K = (d - 1) * 1440 + KICK; if (K > g) return { day: d, K }; } return null; }
 function dateOf(day) { let cur = null; try { cur = gameClock().day; } catch (e) {} const k = cur == null ? null : day - cur, rel = k === 0 ? 'היום' : k === 1 ? 'מחר' : k === -1 ? 'אתמול' : k > 1 ? 'בעוד ' + k + ' ימים' : '';
  return { day, rel, lbl: 'יום ' + day + (rel ? ' (' + rel + ')' : ''), wd: String(day), dm: rel }; }   /* stadium 17.11: לפי שעון המשחק — 'יום N' כמו בשעון שבמסך (ולא תאריך אמיתי: הבעלים 16.11 "עבר יום שישי ולא התעדכן") */
 const CACHE = {}; function sess(kind, idx, gen) { const k = kind + ':' + idx, c = CACHE[kind]; if (c && c.k === k) return c.S; const S = gen((idx * 7919 + 17) | 0); CACHE[kind] = { k, S }; return S; }
 function matchInfo() { const M = matchNow(); if (!M) return { crowd: 0, q: 0, on: false, live: false, g1: 0, g2: 0, u: null };
  const u = M.u, S2 = SPORT2.a3Info(M.idx, u), sc = S2.score, ce = S2.leave || MT.end, crowd = u < -30 ? cl((u + 150) / 120, 0, 1) : u < ce ? 1 : cl(1 - (u - ce) / 48, 0, 1);   /* D‑578: after the final the crowd stays to the end of the lap of honour */
  return { crowd, q: u < -20 ? cl((u + 150) / 20, 0, 1) * cl((-20 - u) / 20, 0, 1) : 0, on: true, live: (u >= MT.h1[0] && u < MT.h1[1]) || (u >= MT.h2[0] && u < MT.h2[1]) || !!S2.ex, g1: sc[0], g2: sc[1], goal: S2.goal, cele: S2.cele, cer: S2.cer, fin: S2.fin, ex: S2.ex, pens: S2.pens, idx: M.idx, u, minute: u < MT.h1[1] ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(u / 4)) : u < MT.h2[0] ? 45 : Math.min(90, 45 + Math.floor((u - MT.h2[0]) / 4)), K: M.K }; }

 const segD = (px, py, ax, ay, bx, by) => { const vx = bx - ax, vy = by - ay, L = vx * vx + vy * vy || 1, t = cl(((px - ax) * vx + (py - ay) * vy) / L, 0, 1); return hyp(px - ax - vx * t, py - ay - vy * t); };

 // "צ'ק": השומר מוסר בהקפצה מהידיים שלו לתוקף, והמשחק מתחיל
 function bkCheck(S, a, r) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, th = E[a], q = E[r], u = S.t; th.hold = false; b.held = -1; b.mode = 'hand'; const p = ballOn(th.look, th.x, th.y, th.h, 2, th.jz, .12); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2];

 function bkThink(S) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, u = S.t, n = S.n, rf = E[S.rf];
  if (S.st === 'in' || S.st === 'out') return;

 function bkBall(S) { const b = S.B, E = S.E;

 // F4 — כדורעף החופים. המגרש [6300,3080,6460,3160] (16 × 8 מ׳), הקווים פנימה 0.6 מ׳, הרשת ב-x ‏6380, למעלה 2.43 מ׳, למטה 1.43 מ׳
 const VB = { x0: 6306, y0: 3086, x1: 6454, y1: 3154, nx: 6380, cy: 3120, top: 2.43, bot: 1.43, posts: [3080, 3160], W: [6262, 3064, 6498, 3200], board: [6344, 3072] };

 // ---- D‑555: כל מסירה — מהיד של שחקן אל היד של שחקן. היד — במקום שבו P34 מצייר אותה (אמצע שתי הידיים) ----
 // לגובה 1.8 מ׳, לכל אחד מ-8 הכיוונים של הציור: [x, y בעומק (כבר מכווץ במבט), גובה במ׳]; בגוף 11.25 פיקסלים למטר (K × SCALE × 10)
 const PXH = 11.25, BZ = .105, HT = {
  2: [[.017, .002, .776], [.01, .006, .776], [0, .007, .776], [-.01, .006, .776], [-.017, .002, .776], [-.015, -.004, .776], [0, -.007, .776], [.015, -.004, .776]],   // carry — אמות צמודות (קבלה) / מחזיק
  4: [[.123, .015, 1.846], [.07, .043, 1.846], [0, .051, 1.846], [-.07, .043, 1.846], [-.123, .015, 1.846], [-.108, -.028, 1.846], [0, -.051, 1.846], [.108, -.028, 1.846]],   // stop — ידיים למעלה (הגבהה, הנחתה, חסימה, הגשה)
  7: [[.342, .042, .643], [.194, .12, .643], [0, .143, .643], [-.194, .12, .643], [-.342, .042, .643], [-.3, -.078, .643], [0, -.143, .643], [.3, -.078, .643]] };   // bench — מתכופף נמוך (חפירה, הרמה מהחול)
 const dir8 = h => ((Math.round(h / (Math.PI / 4)) % 8) + 8) % 8, poseK = a => a === 6 ? 2 : a;
 function handAt(look, x, y, h, k, jz) { const kk = poseK(k), T = (HT[kk] || HT[2])[dir8(h)], s = look.h / 1.8; return [x + PXH * T[0] * s, y + PXH * T[1] * s, (kk === 7 ? T[2] + (look.h - 1.8) * .1 : T[2] * s) + (jz || 0)]; }
 const ballOn = (look, x, y, h, k, jz, bz) => { const p = handAt(look, x, y, h, k, jz); p[2] += bz == null ? BZ : bz; return p; };   // מרכז הכדור יושב על הידיים (רדיוס אחד מעליהן)
 const footFor = (look, B, h, k) => { const p = handAt(look, 0, 0, h, k, 0); return [B[0] - p[0], B[1] - p[1]]; };   // איפה לעמוד כדי שהיד תהיה בנקודה
 const zHand = (look, k) => handAt(look, 0, 0, 0, k, 0)[2];
 // ---- התנועה: כל שחקן הולך במסלול חלק (Hermite, מהמהירות שלו עכשיו) אל נקודה ובזמן שנקבעו מראש; קפיצה מתוזמנת; תנוחה בחלון ----
 const QG = 4 * DT, qT = t => Math.ceil(t / QG - 1e-6) * QG;   // רשת המגעים: כל 4 צעדים — הרישום של השחקנים ושל הכדור עובר בדיוק ברגע המגע
 const landT = (e, t) => e.J ? Math.max(t, e.J.t0 + 2 * e.J.v / G) : t;
 function goTo(e, P, t0, t1, face) { let V0 = [e.vx, e.vy]; const tl = landT(e, t0); if (tl > t0 + 1e-6) { t0 = tl; V0 = [0, 0]; }
  e.L = { t0, t1: Math.max(t1, t0 + .2), P0: [e.x, e.y], V0, P1: [cl(P[0], VB.W[0] + 5, VB.W[2] - 5), cl(P[1], VB.W[1] + 5, VB.W[3] - 5)] }; if (face) e.face = face; return e.L; }
 function walkTo(e, P, t, spd, face) { const d = hyp(P[0] - e.x, P[1] - e.y); return goTo(e, P, t, landT(e, t) + Math.max(.45, d / ((spd || 3) * 10) * 1.5), face); }
 const reach = (e, tau) => Math.max(0, tau - .12) * e.top * 10 / 1.5;   // עד כמה רחוק הוא מגיע בזמן (המהירות בשיא של המסלול — פי 1.5 מהממוצע)
 const far = (e, a) => [e.x + Math.cos(a) * 400, e.y + Math.sin(a) * 400];
 function fixAt(e, a, t, k, t0, t1) { e.fixH = a; e.fixT = (t0 == null ? t - .22 : Math.min(t0, t - .1)) - .2; e.fixT2 = t - .06; e.ps = { a: t0 == null ? t - .22 : t0, b: t1 == null ? t + .2 : t1, k }; e.face = far(e, a); }
 function legStep(e, t) { const L = e.L; let x = e.x, y = e.y, vx = 0, vy = 0;
  if (L && t < L.t1) { const D = L.t1 - L.t0, s = cl((t - L.t0) / D, 0, 1), s2 = s * s, s3 = s2 * s, a0 = 2 * s3 - 3 * s2 + 1, a1 = s3 - 2 * s2 + s, a2 = -2 * s3 + 3 * s2, d0 = 6 * s2 - 6 * s, d1 = 3 * s2 - 4 * s + 1, d2 = -6 * s2 + 6 * s;
   x = a0 * L.P0[0] + a1 * D * L.V0[0] + a2 * L.P1[0]; y = a0 * L.P0[1] + a1 * D * L.V0[1] + a2 * L.P1[1]; if (t >= L.t0) { vx = (d0 * L.P0[0] + d1 * D * L.V0[0] + d2 * L.P1[0]) / D; vy = (d0 * L.P0[1] + d1 * D * L.V0[1] + d2 * L.P1[1]) / D; } }
  else if (L) { x = L.P1[0]; y = L.P1[1]; e.L = null; }
  const sp = hyp(vx, vy); e.d += hyp(x - e.x, y - e.y) / (1 + 1.4 * cl((sp / 10 - 2.2) / 4, 0, 1)); e.x = x; e.y = y; e.vx = vx; e.vy = vy; e.mv = sp > 4;
  const fx = e.fixH != null && t >= e.fixT, hd = fx ? e.fixH : sp > 8 ? Math.atan2(vy, vx) : e.face ? Math.atan2(e.face[1] - e.y, e.face[0] - e.x) : null;
  if (hd != null && isFinite(hd)) { if (fx && t >= e.fixT2) e.h = hd; else { const df = wrapA(hd - e.h), mx = (fx ? 16 : 9) * DT; e.h = wrapA(e.h + cl(df, -mx, mx)); } }
  const J = e.J; e.jz = 0; if (J && t >= J.t0) { const u = t - J.t0; if (u >= 2 * J.v / G) e.J = null; else e.jz = Math.max(0, J.v * u - .5 * G * u * u); }
  const P = e.ps; e.sig = P && t >= P.a && t < P.b ? P.k : 0; if (P && t >= P.b) { e.ps = null; e.fixH = null; } }
 // ---- מסלול הכדור: מהנקודה A בזמן t0 אל הנקודה B בזמן t1, בכוח המשיכה — מדויק, בלי סטייה ----
 function mkF(A, t0, B, t1) { const T = t1 - t0; return { t0, t1, A: A.slice(), B: B.slice(), vx: (B[0] - A[0]) / T, vy: (B[1] - A[1]) / T, vz: (B[2] - A[2] + .5 * G * T * T) / T }; }
 const fAt = (F, t) => { const u = t - F.t0; return [F.A[0] + F.vx * u, F.A[1] + F.vy * u, F.A[2] + F.vz * u - .5 * G * u * u]; };
 const fNet = F => { if ((F.A[0] - VB.nx) * (F.B[0] - VB.nx) >= 0 || !F.vx) return 99; const p = fAt(F, F.t0 + (VB.nx - F.A[0]) / F.vx); return p[1] > VB.posts[0] - 3 && p[1] < VB.posts[1] + 3 ? p[2] : 99; };
 const fTop = F => fAt(F, F.t0 + cl(F.vz / G, 0, F.t1 - F.t0))[2];
 const tFly = (z0, z1, ap) => Math.sqrt(2 * Math.max(.02, ap - z0) / G) + Math.sqrt(2 * Math.max(.02, ap - z1) / G);
 const NETOK = VB.top + .16;   // מעל הרשת: התחתית של הכדור מעל הסרט העליון
 function setMode(S, m, t) { S.B.mode = m; S.MD.push([t, m]); }
 function fly(S, F, j, kind, why, nx) { F.j = j; F.kind = kind; F.why = why; S.F = F; S.FL.push({ t0: F.t0, t1: F.t1, j, kind, B: F.B.slice(), why }); S.B.held = -1; setMode(S, 'fly', F.t0); S.next = nx || null; return F; }
 function vbGen(seed) { const R = rng(seed), E = [], S = { kind: 'volley', seed, R, t0: 0, dur: VBS.T, E, ev: [], pts: [], FL: [], MD: [], B: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1, vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0, roll: 0, held: 0, hid: false, mode: 'held' }, step: vbStep, st: 'prep', srv: 0, sk: [0, 0], score: [0, 0], srvT: 0 };
  for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { const tm = j < 2 ? 0 : 1, k = j % 2, p = vbHome(tm, k); E.push(ent(j, LKV[j], p[0], p[1], { team: tm, i: k, vis: true, num: k + 1, numC: VBT[tm].num, top: 5.6 + R() * .7, h: tm ? Math.PI : 0, face: [VB.nx, VB.cy] })); }
  const s0 = E[0]; s0.x = VB.x0 - 10; s0.y = VB.cy - 14; s0.hold = true; S.spot = [s0.x, s0.y]; S.prepT = 3; S.MD.push([0, 'held']); const p = ballOn(s0.look, s0.x, s0.y, s0.h, 2, 0); S.B.x = p[0]; S.B.y = p[1]; S.B.z = p[2]; recInit(S); return S; }
 // הקבוצה ששלחה את הכדור — חוזרת להגנה: הקרוב לרשת נשאר ליד הרשת, השני — מאחור
 function vbDefend(S, t, tm) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, sd = side(tm), T = E.filter(e => e.team === tm), bl = T.slice().sort((a, c) => Math.abs(a.x - VB.nx) - Math.abs(c.x - VB.nx))[0], df = T.find(e => e !== bl);
  walkTo(bl, [VB.nx + sd * 10, cl(bl.y, VB.y0 + 10, VB.y1 - 10)], t, 3.4, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); walkTo(df, [VB.nx + sd * 44, cl(VB.cy + (R() - .5) * 18, VB.y0 + 8, VB.y1 - 8)], t, 4, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); }
 // הקבלה: השחקן r זז אל הנקודה שבה הכדור יגיע אליו, לפני שהוא מגיע, ומקבל אותו בגובה של התנוחה (אמות, או מתכופף נמוך)
 function vbRec(S, t, A, tm, r, kind, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, sd = side(tm), s = E.find(e => e.team === tm && e !== r);
  const pose = kind === 'spike' ? (R() < .6 ? 7 : 2) : kind === 'serve' ? (R() < .25 ? 7 : 2) : (R() < .3 ? 7 : 2), zc = zHand(r.look, pose) + BZ, spd = 120 + R() * 40;
  const setSpot = [VB.nx + sd * (14 + R() * 8), cl(VB.cy + (R() - .5) * 26, VB.y0 + 10, VB.y1 - 10)], blk = N && N.blk && !N.blk.hit ? N.blk : null, tl = landT(r, t);
  const okBlk = F => { if (!blk || (F.A[0] - VB.nx) * (F.B[0] - VB.nx) >= 0) return true; const p = fAt(F, F.t0 + (VB.nx - F.A[0]) / F.vx); return Math.abs(p[1] - blk.y) > 6 || p[2] > blk.z + .35; };
  for (let q = 0; q < 16; q++) { const ap = (kind === 'serve' ? 3.5 + R() * 1.6 : kind === 'shot' ? 3.6 + R() * 1.1 : Math.max(A[2] + .3, 2.9) + R() * .8) + q * .2;
   const G0 = kind === 'serve' ? [VB.nx + sd * (30 + R() * 38), cl(r.y + (R() - .5) * 30, VB.y0 + 4, VB.y1 - 4)] : [r.x, r.y];
   let tau = kind === 'spike' ? hyp(G0[0] - A[0], G0[1] - A[1]) / spd * (1 + q * .08) : tFly(A[2], zc, ap); const rc = reach(r, t + tau - .2 - tl) * .8, d0 = hyp(G0[0] - r.x, G0[1] - r.y);
   let Gp = d0 > rc ? [r.x + (G0[0] - r.x) * rc / d0, r.y + (G0[1] - r.y) * rc / d0] : G0.slice();
   if (kind !== 'serve') { const a = R() * TAU, m = R() * Math.min(rc, 12); Gp = [Gp[0] + Math.cos(a) * m, Gp[1] + Math.sin(a) * m]; }
   Gp = [sd < 0 ? cl(Gp[0], VB.W[0] + 6, VB.nx - 6) : cl(Gp[0], VB.nx + 6, VB.W[2] - 6), cl(Gp[1], VB.W[1] + 6, VB.W[3] - 6)];
   const ph = Math.atan2(setSpot[1] - Gp[1], setSpot[0] - Gp[0]), B = ballOn(r.look, Gp[0], Gp[1], ph, pose, 0);
   if (kind === 'spike') tau = hyp(B[0] - A[0], B[1] - A[1]) / spd * (1 + q * .08);
   const t1 = qT(t + Math.max(.3, tau)), F = mkF(A, t, B, t1); if (fNet(F) < NETOK || !okBlk(F) || fTop(F) > 7.5) continue;
   if (hyp(Gp[0] - r.x, Gp[1] - r.y) > reach(r, t1 - .18 - tl) + .5) continue;
   if (s && hyp(Gp[0] - s.x, Gp[1] - s.y) < 9) walkTo(s, [s.x + (s.x - Gp[0] || 1) * 1.2, s.y + (s.y - Gp[1]) * 1.2], t, 4);
   fly(S, F, r.j, 'touch', kind, { k: 'bump', ev: kind === 'serve' ? 'pass' : 'dig', j: r.j, tm, setter: s.j, setSpot });
   goTo(r, Gp, t, t1 - .18); fixAt(r, ph, t1, pose); walkTo(s, setSpot, t, 3.8, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); return true; }
  return false; }
 // הכדור עובר לצד השני: קבלה, או נקודה — על החול בתוך המגרש (אף אחד לא מספיק להגיע, אבל מישהו רץ אליו) או בחוץ (מישהו הולך אחריו)
 function vbOver(S, t, A, from, kind, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, fr = E[from], tm = 1 - fr.team, sd = side(tm), mine = E.filter(e => e.team === tm);
  const roll = R(), pOut = kind === 'serve' ? .05 : kind === 'over' ? .02 : .08, pKill = kind === 'serve' ? .06 : kind === 'over' ? 0 : (S.rl || 0) > 3 ? .45 : .26, spd = 120 + R() * 40;
  let res = roll < pOut ? 'out' : roll < pOut + pKill ? 'kill' : 'rec'; vbDefend(S, t, fr.team);
  if (res === 'rec') { const r = kind === 'serve' ? mine[R() < .5 ? 0 : 1] : N && N.dig != null ? E[N.dig] : mine.slice().sort((a, c) => Math.abs(c.x - VB.nx) - Math.abs(a.x - VB.nx))[0];
   if (vbRec(S, t, A, tm, r, kind, N)) return; res = 'kill'; }
  const blk = N && N.blk && !N.blk.hit ? N.blk : null, okBlk = F => { if (!blk || (F.A[0] - VB.nx) * (F.B[0] - VB.nx) >= 0) return true; const p = fAt(F, F.t0 + (VB.nx - F.A[0]) / F.vx); return Math.abs(p[1] - blk.y) > 6 || p[2] > blk.z + .35; };
  for (let q = 0; q < 40; q++) { const L = res === 'kill' ? [VB.nx + sd * (8 + R() * 64), VB.y0 + 3 + R() * (VB.y1 - VB.y0 - 6)] : R() < .6 ? [sd < 0 ? VB.x0 - 4 - R() * 10 : VB.x1 + 4 + R() * 10, VB.y0 + R() * (VB.y1 - VB.y0)] : [VB.nx + sd * (10 + R() * 60), R() < .5 ? VB.y0 - 4 - R() * 9 : VB.y1 + 4 + R() * 9];
   const B = [L[0], L[1], BZ], ap = (kind === 'serve' ? 3.5 + R() * 1.6 : kind === 'spike' ? 0 : Math.max(A[2] + .3, 3) + R() * 1.1) + (q > 20 ? .6 + (q - 20) * .1 : 0), tau = kind === 'spike' ? hyp(B[0] - A[0], B[1] - A[1]) / spd * (1 + (q % 10) * .1) : tFly(A[2], BZ, ap), t1 = qT(t + Math.max(.3, tau)), F = mkF(A, t, B, t1);
   if (fNet(F) < NETOK || !okBlk(F) || fTop(F) > 7.5) continue;
   if (res === 'kill' && q < 30 && mine.some(e => hyp(e.x - L[0], e.y - L[1]) < reach(e, t1 - landT(e, t)) * (kind === 'serve' ? .6 : 1) + 9)) continue;
   const ch = mine.slice().sort((a, c) => hyp(a.x - L[0], a.y - L[1]) - hyp(c.x - L[0], c.y - L[1]))[0]; fly(S, F, ch.j, 'sand', kind, null); F.pt = res === 'kill' ? fr.team : tm; F.res = res === 'kill' ? 'in' : 'out';
   const d = hyp(L[0] - ch.x, L[1] - ch.y), k = res === 'kill' ? Math.max(0, d - 3) / (d || 1) : Math.max(0, d - 14) / (d || 1);   // בפנים — רץ אליו ולא מספיק; בחוץ — הולך אחריו ומשאיר אותו
   goTo(ch, [ch.x + (L[0] - ch.x) * k, ch.y + (L[1] - ch.y) * k], t, res === 'kill' ? Math.max(t1 + .25, t + d / (ch.top * 10) * 1.5) : t1 + .2, [L[0], L[1]]); return; }
  if (kind !== 'over') { vbOver(S, t, A, from, 'over', null); return; }
  const r = mine[0]; if (!vbRec(S, t, A, tm, r, 'over', null)) { const B = [VB.nx + sd * 40, VB.cy, BZ], F = mkF(A, t, B, qT(t + tFly(A[2], BZ, Math.max(A[2], 2.6) + 2))); fly(S, F, r.j, 'sand', 'over', null); F.pt = fr.team; F.res = 'in'; goTo(r, [B[0] - sd * 3, B[1]], t, F.t1 + .3, [B[0], B[1]]); } }
 // אחרי הקבלה: אל המגביה, ליד הרשת; ההגנה של הצד השני — החוסם אל הרשת מול ההנחתה (או יורד ממנה), השני מאחור
 function vbToSetter(S, t, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, r = E[N.j], s = E[N.setter], tm = r.team, sd = side(tm), b = S.B, sy = N.setSpot[1];
  const ay = cl(sy + (sy < VB.cy ? 1 : -1) * (12 + R() * 14) * (R() < .8 ? 1 : -1), VB.y0 + 6, VB.y1 - 6), Ap = [VB.nx + sd * (7 + R() * 3), Math.abs(ay - sy) < 11 ? cl(sy + (ay < sy ? -12 : 12), VB.y0 + 6, VB.y1 - 6) : ay];
  const ph = Math.atan2(Ap[1] - sy, Ap[0] - N.setSpot[0]), B = ballOn(s.look, N.setSpot[0], sy, ph, 4, 0), need = hyp(N.setSpot[0] - s.x, N.setSpot[1] - s.y) / (s.top * 10) * 1.5 + .25;
  const t1 = qT(t + Math.max(need, tFly(b.z, B[2], Math.max(b.z, B[2]) + 2 + R() * .9))), F = mkF([b.x, b.y, b.z], t, B, t1);
  fly(S, F, s.j, 'touch', 'pass', { k: 'set', ev: 'set', j: s.j, hitter: r.j, Ap, tm }); goTo(s, N.setSpot, t, t1 - .2); fixAt(s, ph, t1, 4, t1 - .32, t1 + .15);
  walkTo(r, [Ap[0] + sd * (24 + R() * 8), cl(Ap[1] + (R() - .5) * 10, VB.y0 + 4, VB.y1 - 4)], t + .1, 3.4, [VB.nx, Ap[1]]);
  const o = 1 - tm, so = side(o), O = E.filter(e => e.team === o), bl = O.slice().sort((a, c) => Math.abs(a.x - VB.nx) - Math.abs(c.x - VB.nx))[0], df = O.find(e => e !== bl);
  S.blkOn = R() < .7; walkTo(bl, S.blkOn ? [VB.nx + so * 4.5, Ap[1]] : [VB.nx + so * 22, (Ap[1] + VB.cy) / 2], t, 4.2, [VB.nx - so * 40, Ap[1]]);
  walkTo(df, [VB.nx + so * (40 + R() * 10), cl(VB.cy - (Ap[1] - VB.cy) * .6 + (R() - .5) * 10, VB.y0 + 6, VB.y1 - 6)], t, 4.2, [VB.nx, VB.cy]);
  S.next.bl = bl.j; S.next.df = df.j; S.rl = (S.rl || 0) + 1; }
 // ההגבהה: אל היד של המנחית בשיא הקפיצה שלו; החוסם קופץ מולו
 function vbToHitter(S, t, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, s = E[N.j], h = E[N.hitter], tm = h.team, sd = side(tm), b = S.B, Ap = N.Ap;
  const type = R() < .22 ? 'shot' : 'spike', zs = zHand(h.look, 4), J = cl(VB.top + .3 + R() * .14 - zs, .45, .95), jv = Math.sqrt(2 * G * J), ph = Math.atan2(VB.cy + (R() - .5) * 40 - Ap[1], -sd * 60);
  const B = ballOn(h.look, Ap[0], Ap[1], ph, 4, J), need = hyp(Ap[0] - h.x, Ap[1] - h.y) / (h.top * 10) * 1.5 + .15;
  const t1 = qT(t + Math.max(tFly(b.z, B[2], Math.max(b.z, B[2]) + 1.1 + R() * .6), need + jv / G)), tj = t1 - jv / G, F = mkF([b.x, b.y, b.z], t, B, t1);
  const bl = E[N.bl], df = E[N.df], so = side(bl.team); let blk = null;
  if (S.blkOn) { const hit = type === 'spike' && R() < .16, tb = t1 + 2 * QG, zb = zHand(bl.look, 4), Jb = cl(NETOK + .06 - BZ - zb, .3, .95), jvb = Math.sqrt(2 * G * Jb), phb = sd > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI;
   const by = hit ? B[1] : cl(B[1] + (R() < .5 ? -1 : 1) * (7 + R() * 3), VB.y0, VB.y1), ft = [VB.nx + so * 4.5, by], Bb = ballOn(bl.look, ft[0], ft[1], phb, 4, Jb), tjb = tb - jvb / G;
   goTo(bl, ft, t, Math.max(t + .25, tjb - .05)); bl.J = { t0: tjb, v: jvb }; fixAt(bl, phb, tb, 4, tjb, tjb + 2 * jvb / G); blk = { j: bl.j, y: Bb[1], z: Bb[2], hit, tb, B: Bb }; }
  fly(S, F, h.j, 'touch', 'set', { k: 'attack', ev: type, j: h.j, type, blk, dig: S.blkOn ? df.j : null, tm });
  goTo(h, Ap, t, tj - .02); h.J = { t0: tj, v: jv }; fixAt(h, ph, t1, 4, tj, tj + 2 * jv / G);
  goTo(s, [VB.nx + sd * 30, cl(VB.cy - (Ap[1] - VB.cy) * .8, VB.y0 + 8, VB.y1 - 8)], t + .3, t + 1.6, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); }
 // אחרי החסימה: לרוב הכדור נופל על החול בצד של המנחית; לפעמים עולה ונשאר בצד של החוסם — והחבר שלו מקבל
 function vbBlockOut(S, t, bl) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, b = S.B, A = [b.x, b.y, b.z], atk = 1 - bl.team, sa = side(atk);
  if (R() < .75) for (let q = 0; q < 12; q++) { const L = [VB.nx + sa * (5 + R() * 16), cl(A[1] + (R() - .5) * 16, VB.y0 - 4, VB.y1 + 4)], t1 = qT(t + tFly(A[2], BZ, A[2] + .2 + q * .12)), F = mkF(A, t, [L[0], L[1], BZ], t1); if (fNet(F) < NETOK) continue;
   const ch = E.filter(e => e.team === atk).sort((a, c) => hyp(a.x - L[0], a.y - L[1]) - hyp(c.x - L[0], c.y - L[1]))[0]; fly(S, F, ch.j, 'sand', 'block', null); F.pt = bl.team; F.res = 'block';
   const d = hyp(L[0] - ch.x, L[1] - ch.y), k = Math.max(0, d - 3) / (d || 1); goTo(ch, [ch.x + (L[0] - ch.x) * k, ch.y + (L[1] - ch.y) * k], t, Math.max(t1 + .2, t + .4), [L[0], L[1]]); return; }
  const df = E.find(e => e.team === bl.team && e !== bl); if (vbRec(S, t, A, bl.team, df, 'over', null)) return; vbOver(S, t, A, bl.j, 'over', null); }
 function vbPoint(S, tm, why) { S.pts.push({ t: S.t, team: tm, n: 1 }); S.score[tm]++; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'point', team: tm, why }); S.st = 'dead'; S.deadT = S.t; S.next = null; if (S.srvT !== tm) { S.srvT = tm; S.sk[tm] = 1 - S.sk[tm]; } S.srv = tm * 2 + S.sk[tm]; }
 // הכדור הגיע לסוף המסלול: ליד של שחקן (מגע) או לחול
 function vbArrive(S, t) { const F = S.F, E = S.E, b = S.B;
  if (F.kind === 'sand') { setMode(S, 'free', t); b.vx = F.vx; b.vy = F.vy; b.vz = F.vz - G * (F.t1 - F.t0); S.ev.push({ t, k: 'mark', x: b.x, y: b.y }); vbFree(S); if (S.st === 'rally') vbPoint(S, F.pt, F.res); return; }
  const e = E[F.j], N = S.next || {}, A = [b.x, b.y, b.z]; S.ev.push({ t, k: N.ev || 'touch', j: e.j, x: b.x, y: b.y, z: b.z });
  if (N.k === 'catch') { setMode(S, 'held', t); b.held = e.j; e.hold = true; return; }
  if (N.k === 'serve') { S.st = 'rally'; vbOver(S, t, A, e.j, 'serve', null); return; }
  if (N.k === 'bump') { vbToSetter(S, t, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'set') { vbToHitter(S, t, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'attack') { if (N.blk && N.blk.hit) { fly(S, mkF(A, t, N.blk.B, N.blk.tb), N.blk.j, 'touch', N.type, { k: 'block', ev: 'block', j: N.blk.j }); vbDefend(S, t, e.team); } else vbOver(S, t, A, e.j, N.type, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'block') { vbBlockOut(S, t, e); return; }
  setMode(S, 'free', t); }
 // כדור חופשי — רק על החול (קפיצה קטנה, גלגול עם חיכוך); אף פעם לא באוויר
 function vbFree(S) { const b = S.B, px = b.x; b.vz -= G * DT; b.x += b.vx * DT; b.y += b.vy * DT; b.z += b.vz * DT; b.roll += hyp(b.vx, b.vy) * DT;
  if (b.z <= BZ) { b.z = BZ; if (b.vz < -1) { b.vz = -b.vz * .18; b.vx *= .35; b.vy *= .35; } else { b.vz = 0; const v = hyp(b.vx, b.vy); if (v > 0) { const nv = Math.max(0, v - 60 * DT); b.vx *= nv / v; b.vy *= nv / v; } } }
  if ((px - VB.nx) * (b.x - VB.nx) <= 0 && px !== b.x && b.y > VB.posts[0] && b.y < VB.posts[1]) { b.x = VB.nx + (Math.sign(px - VB.nx) || 1) * 4.5; b.vx = 0; }
  if (Math.abs(b.x - VB.nx) < 4.5 && b.z < .5) b.x = VB.nx + (Math.sign(b.x - VB.nx) || 1) * 4.5;
  b.x = cl(b.x, VB.W[0] + 6, VB.W[2] - 6); b.y = cl(b.y, VB.W[1] + 6, VB.W[3] - 6); }
 // בין הנקודות: מישהו הולך לכדור, מתכופף ומרים אותו, ומוסר מהידיים לידיים של המגיש; המגיש הולך לקו, זורק למעלה ומגיש
 function vbPrep(S, t) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, R = S.R, sv = E[S.srv], tm = sv.team, sd = side(tm);
  if (!S.spot) S.spot = [tm ? VB.x1 + 10 : VB.x0 - 10, cl(VB.cy + (R() - .5) * 36, VB.y0 + 4, VB.y1 - 4)];
  if (!S.placed) { S.placed = true; S.rl = 0; for (const e of E) { if (e === sv) continue; walkTo(e, e.team === tm ? [VB.nx + sd * 9, cl(VB.cy + (S.spot[1] < VB.cy ? 14 : -14), VB.y0 + 6, VB.y1 - 6)] : vbHome(e.team, e.i), t, 2.6, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); } }
  if (b.mode === 'fly' || b.mode === 'lift') return;
  if (b.mode === 'free') { if (b.z > BZ + .02 || hyp(b.vx, b.vy) > 3) return;
   if (S.fetch == null) { const c = E.filter(e => (e.x < VB.nx) === (b.x < VB.nx)).sort((a, q) => hyp(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) - hyp(q.x - b.x, q.y - b.y))[0]; S.fetch = c.j; let ph = Math.atan2(b.y - c.y, b.x - c.x) || 0, f = footFor(c.look, [b.x, b.y], ph, 7); if ((f[0] - VB.nx) * side(c.team) < 3.5) { ph = b.y > c.y ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2; f = footFor(c.look, [b.x, b.y], ph, 7); }
    walkTo(c, f, t, 2.6, [b.x, b.y]); const at = c.L ? c.L.t1 : t; S.pick = { at }; fixAt(c, ph, at + .25, 7, at, at + .55); return; }
   if (t >= S.pick.at + .05) { const c = E[S.fetch]; setMode(S, 'lift', t); S.lift = { j: c.j, t0: t, A: [b.x, b.y, b.z] }; S.ev.push({ t, k: 'pick', j: c.j }); } return; }
  const h = E[b.held]; if (!h) return;
  if (h !== sv) { if (!S.thr) { S.thr = { at: t + .6 }; goTo(sv, [sv.x + sv.vx * .15, sv.y + sv.vy * .15], t, t + .4, [h.x, h.y]); h.face = [sv.x, sv.y]; }
   if (t < S.thr.at || sv.L) return; const ph = Math.atan2(h.y - sv.y, h.x - sv.x), B = ballOn(sv.look, sv.x, sv.y, ph, 2, 0), A = [b.x, b.y, b.z]; let F = null;
   for (let q = 0; q < 14 && !F; q++) { const f = mkF(A, t, B, qT(t + tFly(A[2], B[2], (h.team !== sv.team ? 3.6 : 2.4) + q * .3))); if (fNet(f) >= NETOK) F = f; }
   if (!F) { walkTo(h, [VB.nx + side(h.team) * 30, h.y], t, 2.4, [sv.x, sv.y]); S.thr.at = t + 1.4; return; }
   h.hold = false; S.ev.push({ t, k: 'throw', j: h.j }); fly(S, F, sv.j, 'touch', 'throw', { k: 'catch', ev: 'catch', j: sv.j }); fixAt(sv, ph, F.t1, 2, F.t1 - .35, F.t1 + .05); S.thr = null; S.fetch = null; return; }
  if (!S.walk) { S.walk = 1; walkTo(sv, S.spot, t, 2.4, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); }
  if (sv.L || t < S.prepT) return;
  const ph = Math.atan2((VB.cy - sv.y) * .3, -sd), J = R() < .35 ? .3 + R() * .25 : 0, B = ballOn(sv.look, sv.x, sv.y, ph, 4, J), A = [b.x, b.y, b.z], t1 = qT(t + tFly(A[2], B[2], B[2] + .7 + R() * .6)), F = mkF(A, t, B, t1);
  sv.hold = false; S.ev.push({ t, k: 'toss', j: sv.j }); fly(S, F, sv.j, 'touch', 'toss', { k: 'serve', ev: 'serve', j: sv.j });
  if (J) { const jv = Math.sqrt(2 * G * J); sv.J = { t0: t1 - jv / G, v: jv }; fixAt(sv, ph, t1, 4, t1 - jv / G, t1 + jv / G); } else fixAt(sv, ph, t1, 4, t1 - .35, t1 + .25); S.walk = 0; }
 function vbStep(S) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, t = S.t + DT;   // המצב אחרי הצעד הזה — המצב בזמן t
  if (b.mode === 'fly') { const F = S.F, p = t >= F.t1 - 1e-6 ? F.B : fAt(F, t); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; b.roll += 2.2; }
  for (const e of E) legStep(e, t);
  for (let a = 0; a < 4; a += 2) { const A = E[a], B = E[a + 1], d = hyp(B.x - A.x, B.y - A.y); if (d < 6.5) { const m = A.ps || A.J ? B : B.ps || B.J ? A : B, o = m === A ? B : A; if (!(m.ps || m.J)) { const k = Math.min(1.2, 6.5 - d) / (d || 1); m.x += (m.x - o.x || .5) * k; m.y += (m.y - o.y) * k; if (m.L) { m.L.P1[0] += (m.x - o.x || .5) * k; m.L.P1[1] += (m.y - o.y) * k; } } } }   // חברים לקבוצה לא נכנסים זה בזה
  for (const e of E) { const sd = side(e.team); if ((e.x - VB.nx) * sd < 3) e.x = VB.nx + sd * 3; }   // לא עוברים את הרשת
  if (b.mode === 'fly' && t >= S.F.t1 - 1e-6) vbArrive(S, t);
  if (b.mode === 'held') { const e = E[b.held], p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, 2, e.jz); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; }
  else if (b.mode === 'lift') { const L = S.lift, e = E[L.j], u = sm((t - L.t0) / .3), p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, 7, e.jz); b.x = lerp(L.A[0], p[0], u); b.y = lerp(L.A[1], p[1], u); b.z = lerp(L.A[2], p[2], u); if (t >= L.t0 + .5) { setMode(S, 'held', t); b.held = L.j; e.hold = true; S.lift = null; } }
  else if (b.mode === 'free') vbFree(S);
  if (S.st === 'prep') vbPrep(S, t);
  if (S.st === 'dead' && t - S.deadT > 1.6) { S.st = 'prep'; S.prepT = t + 2.5; S.spot = null; S.fetch = null; S.placed = false; S.walk = 0; S.thr = null; S.pick = null; if (S.score[0] >= 21 || S.score[1] >= 21) S.ev.push({ t, k: 'game', s: S.score.slice() }); } }
 // D‑555 · הבדיקה של המגע: בכל רגע של מגע — המרחק בין מרכז הכדור (כפי שהוא מצויר) ליד של השחקן (כפי שהיא מצוירת). P — ‏P34 כשהוא טעון (בדיוק), אחרת הטבלה
 const TOUCH = { serve: 1, pass: 1, dig: 1, set: 1, spike: 1, shot: 1, block: 1, catch: 1 };
 function vbTouchD(S, v, P) { const p = getP(S, v.j, v.t), bb = getB(S, v.t); if (!p || !bb) return 99; const e = S.E[v.j], k = poseK(p.act); if (!HT[k]) return 98; let H;
  if (P && P.pose) { const A = P.pose(Object.assign({}, P.DEF, e.look), { k: ACT[p.act] }, dir8(p.h), 0).arms; H = [p.x + PXH * (A[0].hand[0] + A[1].hand[0]) / 2, p.y + PXH * (A[0].hand[1] + A[1].hand[1]) / 2, (A[0].hand[2] + A[1].hand[2]) / 2 + p.z]; }

 function auditSess(S, name, area) { const out = { name, frames: 0, bad: 0, why: [], overlap: 0, jumpP: 0, jumpB: 0, outArea: 0, post: 0, events: {} }; simTo(S, S.dur); const n = S.E.length, why = s => { out.bad++; if (out.why.length < 6) out.why.push(name + ': ' + s); };
  for (const v of S.ev) out.events[v.k] = (out.events[v.k] || 0) + 1;
  for (let f = 1; f < S.fP; f++) { const u = S.t0 + f / 15; out.frames++; for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const a = (f * n + j) * 6, p = a - n * 6, T = S.TP; if (T[a + 3] === 9) continue; if (!isFinite(T[a]) || !isFinite(T[a + 1])) { why('NaN #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); continue; }
    if (T[p + 3] !== 9 && hyp(T[a] - T[p], T[a + 1] - T[p + 1]) * 15 > 100) { out.jumpP++; why('player jump #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); }
    if (area && (T[a] < area[0] || T[a] > area[2] || T[a + 1] < area[1] || T[a + 1] > area[3])) { out.outArea++; why('out of area #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); }
    for (let q = j + 1; q < n; q++) { const c = (f * n + q) * 6; if (T[c + 3] === 9) continue; const d = hyp(T[a] - T[c], T[a + 1] - T[c + 1]); if (d < 4.2 && !(T[a + 3] === 2 || T[c + 3] === 2 || T[a + 3] === 3 || T[c + 3] === 3 || T[a + 3] >= 10 || T[c + 3] >= 10)) { out.overlap++; if (out.overlap < 3) why('overlap #' + j + '/#' + q + ' ' + d.toFixed(1) + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); } } } }
  for (let f = 1; f < S.fB; f++) { const a = f * 4, p = a - 4, T = S.TB; if (T[a + 2] === -99 || T[p + 2] === -99) continue; if (!isFinite(T[a])) { why('ball NaN'); continue; } if (hyp(T[a] - T[p], T[a + 1] - T[p + 1]) * 30 > 400) { out.jumpB++; why('ball jump at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }
   if (S.kind === 'match') for (const gx of [A3.x0, A3.x1]) for (const py of [A3.gy - A3.pw, A3.gy + A3.pw]) if (T[a + 2] < A3.cb && hyp(T[a] - gx, T[a + 1] - py) < 1.6) { out.post++; why('ball in post at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }
   if (S.kind === 'volley' && T[a + 1] > VB.posts[0] && T[a + 1] < VB.posts[1] && T[a + 2] < VB.top - .05 && T[a + 2] > .3 && (T[p] - VB.nx) * (T[a] - VB.nx) < 0) { out.post++; why('ball through the net at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }
   if (S.kind === 'basket') for (const H of BK.H) if (Math.abs(T[a + 1] - BK.cy) < 8.5 && T[a + 2] > 2.95 && T[a + 2] < 3.9 && (T[p] - H.bx) * (T[a] - H.bx) < 0) { out.post++; why('ball through the board at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); } }
  if (S.kind === 'volley') { out.touch = 0; out.touchMax = 0; for (const v of S.ev) { if (!TOUCH[v.k]) continue; const d = vbTouchD(S, v, null); out.touch++; out.touchMax = Math.max(out.touchMax, +d.toFixed(2)); if (!(d < 6)) why('touch ' + v.k + ' #' + v.j + ' ' + d.toFixed(1) + ' px at ' + v.t.toFixed(2)); }
   const A = vbAirCheck(S); out.air = A.bad; if (A.bad) why('ball in the air with nobody going to it: ' + A.bad); }
  if (S.n === 10) out.games = S.ev.filter(v => v.k === 'game').length;
  out.score = scoreAt(S, S.dur); return out; }

function a4FleetPathAudit(){const out={poses:0,hits:[],maxTurn:0};const L=parkedStepList();

  for(const [ph,route] of [['out',a4FleetOutbound(cfg,home)],['in',a4FleetInbound(cfg,home)]]){let ph0=null;
   for(let d=0;d<=route.total;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d);out.poses++;if(ph0!=null){let dh=Math.abs(p.heading-ph0)%(2*Math.PI);if(dh>Math.PI)dh=2*Math.PI-dh;if(dh>out.maxTurn&&dh<3)out.maxTurn=+dh.toFixed(3)}ph0=p.heading;
    const me=vehicleCollisionShape(home.asset,home.ref||'Sedan',p.x,p.y,p.heading);
    for(const o of L){if(o.id===id||Math.abs(o.x-p.x)>200||Math.abs(o.y-p.y)>200)continue;const b=vehicleCollisionShape(o.asset,o.ref||'Sedan',o.x,o.y,o.heading||0);if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,b,1.2)){if(out.hits.length<20)out.hits.push(id+' '+ph+' d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y)+' × '+o.id);break}}}}}}
 const PH=[[1065,3424,0],[1105,3424,0],[700,3424,0],[1231,3060,-Math.PI/2],[1231,2860,-Math.PI/2]];for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const cfg=A4_FLEET_CFG[name];for(const id of cfg.ids){const home=a4FleetParked(id);if(!home)continue;const route=a4FleetOutbound(cfg,home);
