const MAP_PIN_COLORS={transport:'#3a8fe0',service:'#3aa86a',commerce:'#b562c9',industry:'#d0643b',energy:'#d6b12f',port:'#6c5ce7',home:'#e0a43a',nature:'#1fa3a8'};
const MAP_KIND_CAT={train:'transport',bus:'transport',car:'service',fuel:'service',gear:'service',cross:'service',school:'service',bag:'commerce',hotel:'commerce',office:'commerce',box:'industry',factory:'industry',bolt:'energy',anchor:'port',home:'home',wave:'nature',dot:'service'};
const MAP_MAJOR_PINS=[['E3-STATION','train','תחנת רכבת'],['E3-TERMINAL','bus','מסוף אוטובוסים'],['PLAYER-HOME','home','בית השחקן'],['C2-MALL','bag','קניון'],['D2-HOTEL-1','hotel','המלון הגדול'],['D2-OFFICE-1','office','מגדל המטה'],['B2-LAKE','wave','אגם הפארק'],['D3-DEALER','car','סוכנות רכבים'],['D3-FUEL','fuel','תחנת דלק'],['D3-GARAGE','gear','מוסך'],['D4-DC','box','מרכז הפצה'],['E4-POWER','bolt','תחנת כוח'],['E5-DEPOT','train','חצר רכבות'],['E6-STATION','train','תחנת הנמל'],['E6-BERTH','anchor','רציף עמוק'],['C6-BERTH','anchor','רציף מכולות'],['D6-SERVICE','anchor','מעבורת לאי'],['D5-GATE','anchor','שער הנמל'],['B4-S1','bag','שכונת B4'],['B4-S2','cross','מרפאה'],['B4-S3','school','בית ספר'],['C4-FAB','factory','מפעל C4'],['APT-TERM','plane','שדה תעופה'],['APT-CARGO','box','מטען אווירי'],['APT-HANGARS','gear','האנגרים']];
function mapPinKind(id){
 if(/^APT-/.test(id)){if(/TERM|TOWER|HELI/.test(id))return'plane';if(/CARGO/.test(id))return'box';if(/RENT|PAX|SHORT/.test(id))return'car';if(/FUEL/.test(id))return'fuel';return'gear'}
 if(/^(E6|D6|C6)-/.test(id)){if(/STATION/.test(id))return'train';if(/BERTH|FERRY/.test(id))return'anchor';if(/WORKSHOP|DEPOT/.test(id))return'gear';if(/OFFICE|OPS|CUSTOMS/.test(id))return'office';return'box'}
 if(/HOTEL/.test(id))return'hotel';if(/OFFICE|BANK|POST|CONTROL/.test(id))return'office';if(/PHARMACY|CLINIC|S2$/.test(id))return'cross';
 if(/MALL|SUPER|MINI|MARKET|FISH|CAFE|RESTAURANT|HARDWARE|S1$|KIOSK/.test(id))return'bag';if(/S3$/.test(id))return'school';
 if(/POWER|GRID|SUB$|SOLAR|UTIL|WATER/.test(id))return'bolt';if(/^D5-/.test(id))return'anchor';if(/FUEL/.test(id))return'fuel';if(/GARAGE/.test(id))return'gear';
 if(/TAXI|PARKING|DEALER|IMPORT/.test(id))return'car';if(/STATION|RAIL|SIGNAL|DEPOT$|FREIGHT|STAFF|TERMINAL/.test(id))return'train';if(/HOME/.test(id))return'home';if(/LAKE/.test(id))return'wave';
 if(/WH|DC|DISPATCH|PARCELS|DOCKS|GATE/.test(id))return'box';if(/FAB|WS$/.test(id))return'factory';return'dot'}
let MAP_PINS=null;
function mapPins(){
 if(MAP_PINS)return MAP_PINS;const reg=navPoiRegistry(),out=[],seen=new Set();
 for(const [id,kind,short] of MAP_MAJOR_PINS){const p=reg[id];if(!p)continue;out.push({id,kind,label:short,full:p.label,chunk:p.chunk,x:p.x,y:p.y,major:true});seen.add(id)}
 for(const [id,p] of Object.entries(reg)){if(seen.has(id)||/^(BUS\d|ACT-)/.test(id))continue;out.push({id,kind:mapPinKind(id),label:p.label,full:p.label,chunk:p.chunk,x:p.x,y:p.y,major:false})}
 return MAP_PINS=out}
function mapIcon(c,kind,x,y,r,fill){
 c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.fillStyle=fill;c.fill();c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,r*.2);c.strokeStyle='#0b1218';c.stroke();
 if(kind==='dot'||r<4.5){c.restore();return}
 const u=r*.5;c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.fillStyle='#fff';c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,r*.15);c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
 const dots=(y0,dx)=>{for(const d of[-dx,dx]){c.beginPath();c.arc(d,y0,u*.17,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()}};
 switch(kind){
  case'train':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-u,1.6*u,1.65*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.8*u,-.25*u);c.lineTo(.8*u,-.25*u);c.stroke();dots(.28*u,.4*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.55*u,1.05*u);c.lineTo(-.9*u,1.4*u);c.moveTo(.55*u,1.05*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,1.4*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'bus':c.strokeRect(-u,-.8*u,2*u,1.55*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,-.1*u);c.stroke();dots(.95*u,.55*u);break;
  case'home':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,0);c.lineTo(0,-.95*u);c.lineTo(u,0);c.stroke();c.strokeRect(-.65*u,0,1.3*u,.95*u);break;
  case'bag':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-.3*u,1.6*u,1.25*u);c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-.3*u,.48*u,Math.PI,0);c.stroke();break;
  case'hotel':c.font='800 '+(r*1.25)+'px Arial,sans-serif';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.fillText('H',0,r*.07);break;
  case'office':c.strokeRect(-.55*u,-u,1.1*u,2*u);for(const yy of[-.5,0,.5]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.2*u,yy*u);c.lineTo(.2*u,yy*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'wave':for(const yy of[-.45,.2]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,yy*u);c.quadraticCurveTo(-.5*u,(yy-.45)*u,0,yy*u);c.quadraticCurveTo(.5*u,(yy+.45)*u,u,yy*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'car':c.strokeRect(-u,-.15*u,2*u,.8*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.6*u,-.15*u);c.lineTo(-.3*u,-.75*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.75*u);c.lineTo(.6*u,-.15*u);c.stroke();dots(.75*u,.55*u);break;
  case'fuel':c.strokeRect(-.65*u,-.95*u,1.15*u,1.9*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.4*u,-.5*u);c.lineTo(.25*u,-.5*u);c.moveTo(.5*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.9*u,.6*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'gear':c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,.5*u,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/4;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*.7*u,Math.sin(a)*.7*u);c.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*1.05*u,Math.sin(a)*1.05*u);c.stroke()}break;
  case'box':c.strokeRect(-.8*u,-.8*u,1.6*u,1.6*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-.8*u,0);c.lineTo(.8*u,0);c.moveTo(0,-.8*u);c.lineTo(0,.8*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'factory':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-u,.85*u);c.lineTo(-u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(-.35*u,-.6*u);c.lineTo(-.35*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.6*u);c.lineTo(.3*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(u,.85*u);c.closePath();c.stroke();c.beginPath();c.moveTo(.62*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.62*u,-.9*u);c.stroke();break;
  case'bolt':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(.25*u,-u);c.lineTo(-.6*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-.02*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-.25*u,u);c.lineTo(.6*u,-.2*u);c.lineTo(.02*u,-.2*u);c.closePath();c.fill();break;
  case'anchor':c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-.7*u,.25*u,0,Math.PI*2);c.moveTo(0,-.45*u);c.lineTo(0,.85*u);c.moveTo(-.55*u,-.1*u);c.lineTo(.55*u,-.1*u);c.moveTo(-.85*u,.25*u);c.arc(0,.1*u,.85*u,Math.PI,0,true);c.stroke();break;
  case'cross':c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,r*.27);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-.8*u);c.lineTo(0,.8*u);c.moveTo(-.8*u,0);c.lineTo(.8*u,0);c.stroke();break;
  case'plane':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-1.05*u);c.lineTo(.17*u,-.3*u);c.lineTo(u,.25*u);c.lineTo(.17*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(.12*u,.8*u);c.lineTo(.5*u,1.0*u);c.lineTo(0,.9*u);c.lineTo(-.5*u,1.0*u);c.lineTo(-.12*u,.8*u);c.lineTo(-.17*u,.15*u);c.lineTo(-u,.25*u);c.lineTo(-.17*u,-.3*u);c.closePath();c.fill();break;
  case'school':c.strokeRect(-.9*u,-.65*u,1.8*u,1.4*u);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-.65*u);c.lineTo(0,.75*u);c.stroke();break}
 c.restore()}
// pins with greedy label placement. o: {w,h,labels,minor,mini,sel,hits,rects}
function drawMapPins(c,T,o){
 c.save();const W=o.w,H=o.h,icons=[],labels=(o.rects||[]).slice(),rMaj=o.mini?2.3:o.rMaj||9,rMin=o.rMin||6.2,sel=o.sel,vis=[];
 const hit=(list,x,y,w,h)=>{for(const q of list)if(x<q.x+q.w&&x+w>q.x&&y<q.y+q.h&&y+h>q.y)return true;return false};
 for(const p of mapPins()){
  if(!p.major&&!o.minor&&p.id!==sel)continue;
  const x=T.x(p.x),y=T.y(p.y),r=p.major?rMaj:rMin;if(x<-r||y<-r||x>W+r||y>H+r)continue;
  if(!p.major&&p.id!==sel&&(hit(icons,x-r*.8,y-r*.8,r*1.6,r*1.6)||hit(o.rects||[],x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2)))continue;
  icons.push({x:x-r,y:y-r,w:r*2,h:r*2});vis.push({p,x,y,r})}
 for(const {p,x,y,r} of vis){
  const col=MAP_PIN_COLORS[MAP_KIND_CAT[p.kind]||'service'];
  if(p.id===sel){c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r+4.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke();c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r+7.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,224,138,.65)';c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke()}
  if(r>=4.5&&G7_SHOP_BRAND[p.id])g7LogoPin(c,G7_SHOP_BRAND[p.id].b,x,y,r*2.05);else mapIcon(c,p.kind,x,y,r,col);   /* p353 · p357: one picture */
  if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:p.id,label:p.full,x,y,r:Math.max(r+5,13)})}
 if(o.labels){const fs=o.fs||11;c.font='600 '+fs+'px Segoe UI,Arial';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='top';
  for(const {p,x,y,r} of vis){if(!p.major&&p.id!==sel)continue;const t=p.label,tw=c.measureText(t).width+4,lx=x-tw/2,ly=y+r+2;
   if(p.id===sel||(!hit(labels,lx,ly,tw,fs+3)&&!hit(icons.filter(q=>Math.abs(q.x+q.w/2-x)>.5||Math.abs(q.y+q.h/2-y)>.5),lx,ly,tw,fs+3))){labels.push({x:lx,y:ly,w:tw,h:fs+3});mapHaloText(c,t,x,ly,'#f4fbff')}}}
 c.restore()}

// ---- bus lines: dark halo under the colour, so they read on top of the real picture; stops are white-ringed ----
function drawBusLineMap(c,T,o={}){
 const lw=o.lw||2.3,off=o.off||2.6,sr=o.stop||3.4;c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
 const paths=BUS_LINES.map(line=>{const route=busRouteForLine(line),k=(line-2)*off,p=new Path2D();for(const seg of route){const e=byEdge[seg.edgeId],A=seg.dirSign>0?byNode[e.a]:byNode[e.b],B=seg.dirSign>0?byNode[e.b]:byNode[e.a],dx=B.x-A.x,dy=B.y-A.y,l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,ox=-dy/l*k,oy=dx/l*k;p.moveTo(T.x(A.x)+ox,T.y(A.y)+oy);p.lineTo(T.x(B.x)+ox,T.y(B.y)+oy)}return[line,p]});
 c.strokeStyle='rgba(6,12,18,.8)';c.lineWidth=lw+2.6;for(const [,p] of paths)c.stroke(p);
 for(const [line,p] of paths){c.strokeStyle=BUS_LINE_MAP_COLORS[line];c.lineWidth=lw;c.stroke(p)}
 for(const line of BUS_LINES)for(const st of busStopsForLine(line)){const x=T.x(st.busX),y=T.y(st.busY);c.fillStyle=busLineColor(line);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,sr,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,sr*.35);c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.stroke();if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:st.id,label:st.label,x,y,r:Math.max(sr+5,12)})}
 const tx=T.x(5250),ty=T.y(2130),q=Math.max(4.5,sr+1.4);c.fillStyle='#fff';c.strokeStyle='#17324a';c.lineWidth=1.6;c.beginPath();c.rect(tx-q,ty-q,2*q,2*q);c.fill();c.stroke();
 if(o.hits)o.hits.push({id:'BUS1-E3',label:'מסוף האוטובוסים E3',x:tx,y:ty,r:Math.max(q+5,13)});
 for(const b of BUS_VEHICLES){c.fillStyle=busLineColor(b.line);c.beginPath();c.arc(T.x(b.x),T.y(b.y),sr+.8,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.lineWidth=1.2;c.strokeStyle='#fff';c.stroke()}
 c.restore()}
function drawPlayerMap(c,T,size=5){
 const A=playerActor(),x=T.x(A.x),y=T.y(A.y),a=PlayerProfile.mode==='walk'?PlayerPed.heading:PlayerCar.heading,ph=(performance.now()%1700)/1700;
 c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,224,138,'+(.6*(1-ph)).toFixed(3)+')';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,size*(1.6+ph*2.8),0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
 c.rotate(a);c.fillStyle='#ffe08a';c.strokeStyle='#071018';c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.5,size*.3);c.lineJoin='round';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(size*1.5,0);c.lineTo(-size,-size*.85);c.lineTo(-size*.45,0);c.lineTo(-size,size*.85);c.closePath();c.stroke();c.fill();c.restore()}

 const {w,h}=fitMapCanvas(miniCv,miniCtx),c=miniCtx;c.clearRect(0,0,w,h);const T=mapTf(w,h,W80(),5);   /* p333 */
 drawMapBase(c,T);drawMapZones(c,T,{w,h,lw:1,pass:'base'});drawBusLineMap(c,T,{lw:1.5,off:1.8,stop:1.5});drawNavigationMap(c,T);drawMapPins(c,T,{w,h,mini:true});drawPlayerMap(c,T,3.8);
 const vw=innerWidth/Camera.zoom,vh=innerHeight/Camera.zoom;c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.8)';c.lineWidth=1;c.strokeRect(T.x(Camera.x-vw/2),T.y(Camera.y-vh/2),vw*T.s,vh*T.s)}

function drawFullMap(){
 if(!State.mapOpen)return;const {w,h}=fitMapCanvas(fullCv,fullCtx),c=fullCtx;c.clearRect(0,0,w,h);const T=g77FzT(w,h);   /* GATE-77P · p249 · D-169 */
 const rects=[];drawMapBase(c,T);drawMapZones(c,T,{w,h,lw:1.8,pass:'base'});drawMapZones(c,T,{w,h,pass:'labels',dry:true,rects});drawBusLineMap(c,T,{lw:2.8,off:3.3,stop:3.7});drawNavigationMap(c,T);drawMapPins(c,T,{w,h,labels:true,minor:T.s>=.1,rMaj:clamp(T.s*70,6,9.5),rMin:clamp(T.s*46,4.6,6.4),fs:clamp(T.s*85,9,11),rects});drawMapZones(c,T,{w,h,pass:'labels'});drawPlayerMap(c,T,6.5)}

// ---- phone map: pan, zoom, layers, tappable pins with navigation ----
const PHONEMAP={cx:ACTIVE_BOUNDS.x+ACTIVE_BOUNDS.w/2,cy:ACTIVE_BOUNDS.y+ACTIVE_BOUNDS.h/2,s:0,sel:null,layers:{bus:true,poi:true,zones:true},ptrs:new Map(),pinch:0,moved:0,hits:[],w:340,h:310,raf:0};
function pmLimits(){const P=PHONEMAP;return{fit:Math.min((P.w-12)/ACTIVE_BOUNDS.w,(P.h-12)/ACTIVE_BOUNDS.h),min:Math.min((P.w-8)/W80().w,(P.h-8)/W80().h),max:.5}}
function pmClamp(){const P=PHONEMAP,L=pmLimits();if(!P.s)P.s=L.fit;P.s=clamp(P.s,L.min,L.max);const W=W80();P.cx=clamp(P.cx,W.x,W.x+W.w);P.cy=clamp(P.cy,W.y,W.y+W.h)}   /* p333 */
function pmSoon(){const P=PHONEMAP;if(P.raf)return;P.raf=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{P.raf=0;drawPhoneMap()})}
function pmZoomAt(f,px,py){const P=PHONEMAP;pmClamp();const wx=P.cx+(px-P.w/2)/P.s,wy=P.cy+(py-P.h/2)/P.s;P.s*=f;pmClamp();P.cx=wx-(px-P.w/2)/P.s;P.cy=wy-(py-P.h/2)/P.s;pmClamp();pmSoon()}
function pmInfoHtml(){
 const id=PHONEMAP.sel,p=id&&navPoiRegistry()[id];
 if(!p)return`<div class="pnote" style="margin:0">גע בסימון במפה לפרטים ולניווט · גרור להזזה · צביטה או גלגלת לזום</div>`;
 const ch=MAP_CHUNKS.find(q=>q.id===p.chunk),on=State.navigation?.targetId===id;
 return`<div class="pmInfoRow"><div><b>${p.label}</b><small>אזור ${p.chunk||'—'}${ch?' · '+ch.name:''}</small></div><button data-nav-target="${id}">${on?'הניווט פעיל':'נווט לכאן'}</button></div>`}
function phoneMap(){
 const P=PlayerProfile.progression.discoveredChunks,Ly=PHONEMAP.layers,lgd=Object.entries({transport:'תחבורה',service:'שירותים',commerce:'מסחר ועסקים',industry:'תעשייה ולוגיסטיקה',energy:'אנרגיה',port:'נמל',home:'מגורים',nature:'טבע'}).map(([k,t])=>`<span><i style="background:${MAP_PIN_COLORS[k]}"></i>${t}</span>`).join('');
 return pcard('מפת העיר',`<div class="phoneMapBox"><canvas id="phoneMapCanvas"></canvas><div class="pmCtl"><button data-pm="in" aria-label="הגדל">+</button><button data-pm="out" aria-label="הקטן">−</button><button data-pm="me" aria-label="המיקום שלי">${ic('nav',16)}</button><button data-pm="fit" aria-label="כל העיר">⤢</button></div></div>`
  +`<div class="pmLayers">${[['bus','קווי אוטובוס'],['poi','מקומות'],['zones','אזורים']].map(([k,t])=>`<button data-pm-layer="${k}" class="${Ly[k]?'on':''}">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div>`
  +`<div class="pmInfo" id="pmInfo">${pmInfoHtml()}</div>`
  +`<div class="pmLegend">${(typeof lcMapLines==='function'?lcMapLines():BUS_LINES).map(l=>`<span><i class="ln" style="background:${BUS_LINE_MAP_COLORS[l]}"></i>קו ${l}</span>`).join('')}${lgd}</div>`
  +`<div style="margin-top:9px">${P.map(c=>pchip(c,'ok')).join('')}${pchip('אזורים שגילית: '+P.length+'/'+MAP_SHOWN_IDS.size,'off')}</div><div class="phoneActions"><button class="primary" data-phone-action="fullmap">פתח מפה מלאה</button></div>`,'map')}
function drawPhoneMap(){
 const cvp=$('phoneMapCanvas');if(!cvp)return;const P=PHONEMAP,r=cvp.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2),W=Math.max(2,Math.round(r.width*d)),H=Math.max(2,Math.round(r.height*d));
 if(cvp.width!==W||cvp.height!==H){cvp.width=W;cvp.height=H}
 P.w=r.width;P.h=r.height;pmClamp();const c=cvp.getContext('2d');c.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);c.clearRect(0,0,P.w,P.h);
 const T={x:v=>P.w/2+(v-P.cx)*P.s,y:v=>P.h/2+(v-P.cy)*P.s,s:P.s},hits=[],Ly=P.layers;
 drawMapBase(c,T);
 const rects=[];if(Ly.zones){drawMapZones(c,T,{w:P.w,h:P.h,lw:1.4,pass:'base'});drawMapZones(c,T,{w:P.w,h:P.h,pass:'labels',dry:true,rects})}
 if(Ly.bus)drawBusLineMap(c,T,{lw:clamp(1.6+P.s*9,1.8,3.6),off:clamp(2+P.s*10,2.2,4),stop:clamp(2.6+P.s*12,3,5.4),hits});
 drawNavigationMap(c,T);
 if(Ly.poi)drawMapPins(c,T,{w:P.w,h:P.h,labels:true,minor:P.s>=.1,sel:P.sel,hits,rMaj:clamp(7.5+P.s*10,8,11),rMin:clamp(5+P.s*8,5.4,8),fs:10.5,rects});
 if(Ly.zones)drawMapZones(c,T,{w:P.w,h:P.h,pass:'labels'});
 if(State.phoneApp==='taxi')g77TaxiMapDraw(c,T);drawPlayerMap(c,T,clamp(3.4+P.s*8,3.6,6));
 P.hits=hits;

/* FISHX (p640, builder 7, 4.11): the fishing gear. The one rod table is the game's RODS (extended to objects, level 1…5, just above), the drawing of a rod
   (catalog side view and in the 3/4 world at the people's scale: 10 px = 1 m × P34.SCALE), the terminal tackle, the bucket, the fish,
   the fishing poses of P34 (kinds f1…f5 × 8 frames) and the catch story of the lake anglers (seeded, its own random — not Math.random). */
var FISHX = (function () {
  'use strict';
  let S = 1.125; const sync = () => { if (typeof P34 !== 'undefined' && P34.SCALE) S = P34.SCALE };   // the people's scale (P34.SCALE), read when drawing
  const K = .6, PXM = 10, TAU = Math.PI * 2, D2R = Math.PI / 180;
  // ---- the rods: level 1…5 (the game's rodLevel, rod-l2…rod-l5 unchanged) ----
  // len m · cast m · power kg (line) · sens 1…5 · dia butt/tip mm · handle [length m, colour, kind] · reel · guides · blank colour · tip colour
  // ---- the baits: the game's LAKE_BAITS (5) + two lures (new rows of the same table); size in cm, drawn real ----
  // ---- the lake species (the game's LAKE_FISH + FSP: length cm, body width, peak, colours, tail) ----
  // ---- small helpers ----
  const shade = (hex, k) => { const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16), f = v => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(v * k))); return 'rgb(' + f(n >> 16) + ',' + f((n >> 8) & 255) + ',' + f(n & 255) + ')' };
  const P = (x, y, p) => [x + p[0] * S * PXM, y + (p[1] - K * p[2]) * S * PXM];   // world metres (around the ground point x, y) → world px
  function rng(seed) { let a = seed >>> 0; return () => { a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0; let t = a; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296 } }

  // ================= the catalog view (side, butt on the right): x0,y0 = the butt end; ppm = px per metre =================
  function reelSide(c, kind, x, y, k) {   // x, y: the reel foot on the rod's underside; k: px per cm
    if (kind === 'none') return;
    const big = { open: 1, spin: 1.25, free: 1.45, surf: 1.9 }[kind] || 1, r = 2.4 * k * big, stem = 2.4 * k * big;
    c.save(); c.translate(x, y);
    c.fillStyle = '#9aa3ab'; c.fillRect(-1.6 * k, 0, 3.2 * k, .5 * k);                      // the foot
    c.fillStyle = '#5b6168'; c.fillRect(-.5 * k, 0, 1 * k, stem);                            // the stem
    c.fillStyle = kind === 'surf' ? '#2a2f35' : kind === 'free' ? '#3a3d33' : '#30353b';
    c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(0, stem + r, r * 1.05, r, 0, 0, TAU); c.fill();                 // the body
    const sl = (kind === 'surf' ? 3.4 : 2) * k * big * .55;                                   // the spool, toward the tip (left)
    c.fillStyle = kind === 'surf' ? '#c7cdd2' : '#b9c0c6'; c.fillRect(-r - sl - .6 * k, stem + r * .35, sl, r * 1.3);
    c.fillStyle = '#e7ebee'; c.fillRect(-r - sl - .6 * k, stem + r * .35, sl, r * .35);         // the line on the spool
    c.strokeStyle = '#d6dbe0'; c.lineWidth = Math.max(1, .35 * k); c.beginPath(); c.arc(-r - sl * .5, stem + r, r * .95, Math.PI * .95, Math.PI * 2.05); c.stroke();   // the bail
    c.strokeStyle = '#2b2f33'; c.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, .5 * k); c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(0, stem + r); c.lineTo(r * 1.5, stem + r * 1.8); c.stroke();   // the handle
    c.fillStyle = '#1b1d20'; c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(r * 1.6, stem + r * 1.9, .9 * k, .6 * k, 0, 0, TAU); c.fill();
    if (kind === 'free') { c.fillStyle = '#c0392b'; c.fillRect(r * .4, stem + r * .1, 1.6 * k, .7 * k) }       // the free-spool lever
    if (kind === 'spin' || kind === 'surf') { c.fillStyle = '#c9a43a'; c.fillRect(-r - sl - 1.3 * k, stem + r * .6, .8 * k, r * .8) }   // the front drag
    c.restore();
  }
  function rodSide(c, rod, x0, y0, ppm, o) {
    o = o || {}; const mn = o.min || 1.2, lw1 = o.min ? o.min * .5 : 1, L = rod.len * ppm, k = ppm / 100, w0 = Math.max(mn, rod.dia[0] / 1000 * ppm * 1.6), w1 = Math.max(mn * .66, rod.dia[1] / 1000 * ppm * 1.6);   // o.min: the thinnest width (catalog px 1.2; in the world, e.g. the C2 shop, smaller)
    const sag = o.bend ? o.bend * L * .18 : 0, Y = u => y0 + sag * u * u, W = u => w0 + (w1 - w0) * Math.pow(u, .8), X = u => x0 - u * L;
    // the blank, tapered (a slight sag at the tip when loaded)
    c.save(); c.fillStyle = rod.blank; c.beginPath(); const N = 40;
    for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) { const u = i / N; c.lineTo(X(u), Y(u) - W(u) / 2) } for (let i = N; i >= 0; i--) { const u = i / N; c.lineTo(X(u), Y(u) + W(u) / 2) } c.closePath(); c.fill();
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.22)'; c.beginPath(); for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) { const u = i / N; c.lineTo(X(u), Y(u) - W(u) / 2) } for (let i = N; i >= 0; i--) { const u = i / N; c.lineTo(X(u), Y(u) - W(u) / 6) } c.closePath(); c.fill();
    // the tip section, painted
    const tu = rod.kind === 'pole' ? .96 : .9; c.strokeStyle = rod.tip; c.lineWidth = w1 * 1.1; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(X(tu), Y(tu)); for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) { const u = tu + (1 - tu) * i / 8; c.lineTo(X(u), Y(u)) } c.stroke();
    // the joints (telescopic: a ring at each section) / the ferrules
    for (let s = 1; s < rod.secs; s++) { const u = s / rod.secs; c.fillStyle = rod.kind === 'pole' ? '#c9b26a' : shade(rod.blank, .7); c.fillRect(X(u) - mn, Y(u) - W(u) * .75, mn * 2, W(u) * 1.5) }
    // the handle
    const hl = rod.handle[0] * ppm, hw = w0 * 1.75; c.fillStyle = rod.handle[1];
    if (rod.kind === 'spin') { c.fillRect(x0 - hl * .38, y0 - hw / 2, hl * .38, hw); c.fillRect(x0 - hl, y0 - hw / 2, hl * .32, hw) }   // the split grip
    else c.fillRect(x0 - hl, y0 - hw / 2, hl, hw);
    if (rod.handle[2].indexOf('שעם') === 0) { c.fillStyle = 'rgba(90,60,30,.35)'; for (let i = 0; i < hl / 3; i++) { const xx = x0 - (i * 2.7) % hl, yy = y0 - hw / 2 + ((i * 7) % 10) / 10 * hw; c.fillRect(xx, yy, mn * .8, mn * .8) } }
    c.fillStyle = '#15171a'; c.fillRect(x0 - mn * 1.6, y0 - hw * .55, mn * 2.4, hw * 1.1);   // the butt cap
    // the reel seat and the reel
    const rs = rod.kind === 'spin' ? hl * .5 : rod.kind === 'surf' ? hl * .62 : hl * .78;
    if (rod.reel !== 'none') { c.fillStyle = '#7d858d'; c.fillRect(x0 - rs - 6 * k, y0 - w0 * .7, 12 * k, w0 * 1.4); reelSide(c, rod.reel, x0 - rs, y0 + w0 * .6, k * 1.0) }
    // the guides: from the reel to the tip, smaller and closer toward the tip
    for (let i = 0; i < rod.guides; i++) { const u = .2 + .78 * Math.pow((i + 1) / rod.guides, .78), gx = X(u), gy = Y(u), r = Math.max(mn * 1.1, (rod.kind === 'surf' ? 2.8 : 1.6) * k * (1.35 - u));
      c.strokeStyle = '#1d2024'; c.lineWidth = lw1; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(gx, gy); c.lineTo(gx, gy + r * 1.6); c.stroke(); c.strokeStyle = '#c3cad1'; c.lineWidth = Math.max(lw1, r * .35); c.beginPath(); c.arc(gx, gy + r * 1.6 + r, r, 0, TAU); c.stroke() }
    // the line: from the reel through the guides to the tip (and on the pole, tied to the tip)
    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,90,100,.55)'; c.lineWidth = lw1;
    if (rod.reel !== 'none') { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(x0 - rs - 4 * k, y0 + w0 + 4 * k); c.lineTo(X(1), Y(1)); c.stroke() }
    c.fillStyle = '#c9b26a'; c.beginPath(); c.arc(X(1), Y(1), Math.max(mn * 1.1, w1), 0, TAU); c.fill();   // the tip ring / the connector
    if (rod.kind === 'bottom') { const bx = X(.93), by = Y(.93); c.fillStyle = '#d4a62a'; for (const d of [-4, 4]) { c.beginPath(); c.arc(bx + d * k, by - 4 * k, 2.6 * k, 0, TAU); c.fill() } c.fillStyle = '#7a5a12'; c.fillRect(bx - mn * .8, by - 4 * k, mn * 1.6, 4 * k) }
    c.restore();
    return { tipX: X(1), tipY: Y(1), reelX: x0 - rs };
  }

  // ================= the 3/4 world (people's scale) =================
  // the arms of the fishing poses (P34 kinds f1…f5, 8 frames): [right d1, right d2, left d1, left d2] in the upper-body frame (forward, outward, up)
  const A = {
    hold: [[.30, .12, -.94], [.90, -.20, .38], [.25, .10, -.96], [.80, -.55, .20]], back: [[.05, .25, .96], [-.35, -.05, .94], [.45, .15, 0], [.85, -.45, .25]],
    fwd: [[.75, .15, .62], [.97, -.05, .2], [.45, .12, -.4], [.9, -.35, .2]], strike: [[.3, .15, .45], [.35, -.1, .93], [.35, .12, -.8], [.8, -.45, .4]],
    reelA: [[.35, .12, -.85], [.9, -.2, .4], [.3, .15, -.9], [.75, -.5, .45]], reelB: [[.35, .12, -.85], [.9, -.2, .4], [.3, .15, -.9], [.75, -.55, -.05]],
    lift: [[.35, .18, .55], [.25, -.1, .97], [.3, .12, -.6], [.7, -.6, .4]], fish: [[.03, .1, -1], [.25, .05, -.97], [.5, .15, -.8], [.95, -.15, .25]],
    down: [[.03, .07, -1], [.1, .03, -1], [.03, .07, -1], [.1, .03, -1]], pole: [[.35, .12, -.9], [.85, -.25, .45], [.1, .12, -.99], [.55, -.3, -.4]],
    poleUp: [[.35, .15, .2], [.4, -.15, .9], [.3, .12, -.85], [.75, -.3, .55]], two: [[.3, .15, .5], [.3, -.15, .9], [.35, .1, -.2], [.85, -.45, .1]] };
  // per kind, per frame (0 wait · 1 cast back · 2 cast forward · 3 bite · 4 reel a · 5 reel b · 6 lift · 7 fish in hand): [arms, rod elevation°, bend, on the rest?]
  const F = {
    pole:   [['pole', 22, .04], ['poleUp', 60, .05], ['fwd', 14, .03], ['pole', 30, .38], ['pole', 40, .45], ['poleUp', 52, .5], ['poleUp', 74, .55], ['fish', 8, 0]],
    float:  [['hold', 18, .03], ['back', 62, .06, 0, 1], ['fwd', 28, .04], ['strike', 50, .32], ['reelA', 34, .42], ['reelB', 36, .44], ['lift', 68, .5], ['fish', 6, 0]],
    spin:   [['reelA', 10, .07], ['back', 55, .08, 0, 1], ['fwd', 24, .05], ['strike', 46, .36], ['reelA', 30, .46], ['reelB', 32, .48], ['lift', 64, .52], ['fish', 6, 0]],
    bottom: [['down', 26, .04, 1], ['back', 58, .07, 0, 1], ['fwd', 30, .05], ['down', 26, .3, 1], ['reelA', 40, .46], ['reelB', 42, .48], ['lift', 70, .55], ['fish', 6, 0]],
    surf:   [['down', 58, .06, 1], ['two', 40, .1, 0, 1], ['fwd', 34, .06], ['down', 58, .3, 1], ['two', 52, .55], ['reelB', 40, .5], ['lift', 66, .6], ['fish', 8, 0]] };
  const KINDS = ['pole', 'float', 'spin', 'bottom', 'surf'], kindOf = rod => 'f' + (KINDS.indexOf(rod.kind) + 1);
  // the P34 patch: the fishing kinds join the activities (8 frames), their arms come from FX.A / FX.F
  function armsFor(k, fr, right) { const kind = KINDS[+k.slice(1) - 1], f = F[kind] && F[kind][fr | 0]; const a = A[(f && f[0]) || 'hold']; return right ? [a[0], a[1]] : [a[2], a[3]] }
  const dirOf = h => ((Math.round(h / (Math.PI / 4)) % 8) + 8) % 8;
  // the rod in the world: x, y = the angler's ground point (world px), h = heading; look for the hand (P34.pose); line → [wx, wy] the water point or null
  function rodWorld(g, rod, x, y, h, fr, look, o) { sync();
    o = o || {}; const f = F[rod.kind][fr | 0], bend = (o.bend != null ? o.bend : f[2]), onRest = !!f[3], back = !!f[4], res = o.res || 1, hl = rod.handle[0];
    let el = f[1] * D2R, az = h + (back ? Math.PI * .92 : .12), u, root, butt, Lr;
    if (onRest) { const R = restGeo(rod, h);   // on the rest: the rod lies on the two V's (bottom) / leans on the tripod from its cup (surf)
      if (rod.kind === 'surf') { u = unit(R.top, R.cup); butt = R.cup; root = along(R.cup, u, .55); Lr = rod.len - .55 }
      else { u = unit(R.front, R.back); root = along(R.back, u, .12); butt = along(R.back, u, -hl * .5); Lr = rod.len - hl * .5 - .12 }
      el = Math.asin(u[2]); az = Math.atan2(u[1], u[0]) }
    else { u = [Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el), Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el), Math.sin(el)];
      let hand = [Math.cos(h) * .35, Math.sin(h) * .35, 1.0]; try { const Sx = P34.pose(look, { k: kindOf(rod) }, dirOf(h), fr | 0); const r = Sx.arms.find(a => a.side < 0); if (r) hand = r.hand } catch (e) { }
      root = hand; const k_ = rod.kind === 'spin' ? .55 : .75; Lr = rod.len - hl * k_;
      butt = [root[0] - u[0] * hl * k_, root[1] - u[1] * hl * k_, Math.max(.03, root[2] - u[2] * hl * .75)] }
    const dx = Math.cos(az), dy = Math.sin(az);
    const tip0 = [root[0] + u[0] * Lr, root[1] + u[1] * Lr, root[2] + u[2] * Lr], drop = bend * Lr * .42;
    const tip = [tip0[0] + dx * drop * Math.sin(el) * .35, tip0[1] + dy * drop * Math.sin(el) * .35, tip0[2] - drop * Math.cos(el * .6)];
    const mid = [(root[0] + tip0[0]) / 2, (root[1] + tip0[1]) / 2, (root[2] + tip0[2]) / 2 - drop * .18];
    // the curve (screen), drawn in short pieces, the width from the real diameter × the people's scale with a floor of ~0.8 device px
    const Pb = P(x, y, butt), Pr = P(x, y, root), Pm = P(x, y, mid), Pt = P(x, y, tip), q = (a, b, c2, t) => [(1 - t) * (1 - t) * a[0] + 2 * (1 - t) * t * b[0] + t * t * c2[0], (1 - t) * (1 - t) * a[1] + 2 * (1 - t) * t * b[1] + t * t * c2[1]];
    const minW = .8 / res, wB = Math.max(minW * 1.5, rod.dia[0] / 1000 * S * PXM * 2.6), wT = Math.max(minW, rod.dia[1] / 1000 * S * PXM * 2);   // ×2.6 the real diameter: thin, still read at the game zoom
    g.save(); g.lineCap = 'round';
    g.strokeStyle = rod.handle[1]; g.lineWidth = Math.max(minW * 2, wB * 1.7); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(Pb[0], Pb[1]); g.lineTo(Pr[0], Pr[1]); g.stroke();
    const n = 10; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = q(Pr, Pm, Pt, i / n), b = q(Pr, Pm, Pt, (i + 1) / n), t = (i + .5) / n;
      g.strokeStyle = t > .88 ? rod.tip : rod.blank; g.lineWidth = wB + (wT - wB) * t; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); g.lineTo(b[0], b[1]); g.stroke() }
    if (rod.reel !== 'none') { const rr = { open: .045, spin: .055, free: .065, surf: .085 }[rod.reel] * S * PXM, rp = P(x, y, [root[0], root[1], root[2] - .07]), mr = { open: 1.1, spin: 1.3, free: 1.5, surf: 1.9 }[rod.reel] / res;   // the reel: real × 1.45, never under ~1–2 screen px
      g.fillStyle = '#2f343a'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(rp[0], rp[1], Math.max(rr, mr), Math.max(rr * .8, mr * .8), 0, 0, TAU); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#c3cad1'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(rp[0] - Math.max(rr, mr) * .3, rp[1] - Math.max(rr, mr) * .2, Math.max(rr, mr) * .38, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
    if (res >= 4 && rod.guides) for (let i = 1; i <= rod.guides; i++) { const p = q(Pr, Pm, Pt, Math.pow(i / (rod.guides + 1), .8)); g.fillStyle = '#c3cad1'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p[0], p[1] + wB * .6, .5 / res * 1.4, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
    if (rod.kind === 'bottom') { const b = q(Pr, Pm, Pt, .94), ring = o.bell ? Math.sin(o.t * 40) * .25 : 0; g.fillStyle = '#e8b52a'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(b[0] + ring, b[1] - .25, Math.max(.4, 1.5 / res), 0, TAU); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#7a5a12'; g.lineWidth = .4 / res; g.stroke() }
    // the line to the water
    if (o.line) { const [wx, wy] = o.line, sl = o.slack != null ? o.slack : (bend > .2 ? 0 : .5); g.strokeStyle = o.night ? 'rgba(220,235,255,.5)' : 'rgba(240,248,255,.78)'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(.5 / res, .12);
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(Pt[0], Pt[1]); g.quadraticCurveTo((Pt[0] + wx) / 2, (Pt[1] + wy) / 2 + sl * Math.min(6, Math.hypot(wx - Pt[0], wy - Pt[1]) * .06), wx, wy); g.stroke() }
    g.restore();
    return { tip: Pt, root: Pr, butt: Pb };
  }
  // the rest of the bottom rod (two V's) and the tripod of the surf rod: set on the pier at the start, standing there to the end
  const unit = (a, b) => { const v = [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]], n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1; return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] }, along = (p, u, d) => [p[0] + u[0] * d, p[1] + u[1] * d, p[2] + u[2] * d];
  function restGeo(rod, h) { const fx = Math.cos(h), fy = Math.sin(h), lx = -Math.sin(h), ly = Math.cos(h), s = -.3, at = (f, z) => [fx * f + lx * s, fy * f + ly * s, z];
    return rod.kind === 'surf' ? { top: at(.55, 1.25), cup: at(-.05, .1), feet: [at(.9, 0), [fx * .35 + lx * (s - .3), fy * .35 + ly * (s - .3), 0], [fx * .35 + lx * (s + .3), fy * .35 + ly * (s + .3), 0]] } : { front: at(.8, .5), back: at(-.1, .3) } }
  function rest(g, rod, x, y, h, res) { sync(); if (rod.kind !== 'bottom' && rod.kind !== 'surf') return; const R = restGeo(rod, h), minW = .8 / res, lw = Math.max(minW * 1.4, .28); g.save(); g.lineCap = 'round';
    if (rod.kind === 'surf') { const top = P(x, y, R.top); g.strokeStyle = '#a7b0b8'; g.lineWidth = lw; for (const f of R.feet) { const p = P(x, y, f); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); g.lineTo(top[0], top[1]); g.stroke() }
      g.strokeStyle = '#5b6168'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(top[0] - 1, top[1] - .7); g.lineTo(top[0], top[1] + .2); g.lineTo(top[0] + 1, top[1] - .7); g.stroke();
      const c0 = P(x, y, R.cup), c1 = P(x, y, [R.cup[0], R.cup[1], 0]); g.strokeStyle = '#a7b0b8'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(c1[0], c1[1]); g.lineTo(top[0], top[1]); g.stroke(); g.fillStyle = '#4a5056'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(c0[0], c0[1], Math.max(.5, 1.1 / res), Math.max(.3, .7 / res), 0, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
    else for (const at of [R.front, R.back]) { const s0 = P(x, y, [at[0], at[1], 0]), s1 = P(x, y, at); g.strokeStyle = '#5a4630'; g.lineWidth = lw; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(s0[0], s0[1]); g.lineTo(s1[0], s1[1] + .3); g.stroke(); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(s1[0] - .8, s1[1] - .5); g.lineTo(s1[0], s1[1] + .3); g.lineTo(s1[0] + .8, s1[1] - .5); g.stroke();
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(s0[0] + .4, s0[1] + .2, .7, .3, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
    g.restore() }
  // the float on the water (state: 0 calm, 1 bite — dips), the lit tip at night
  function float(g, x, y, t, bite, night, res) { sync(); const r = Math.max(.55, 1.1 / res), dip = bite ? (Math.sin(t * 9) > 0 ? .9 : 0) : Math.sin(t * 2.2) * .45;   // the float bobs on the small waves
    g.save(); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (bite ? .55 : .3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(.12, .5 / res); const rr = (bite ? 2.2 : 1.4) + Math.sin(t * 3) * .7;
    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y + .3, rr * 1.6, rr * .6, 0, 0, TAU); g.stroke();
    if (dip < .8) { g.fillStyle = '#f2f0ea'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y + dip, r * .55, r * .4, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = night ? '#ffe34d' : '#e2372b'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - r * .5 + dip, r * .3, r * .55, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();
      if (night) { const q = g.createRadialGradient(x, y - r * .5, 0, x, y - r * .5, r * 3.5); q.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,240,120,.55)'); q.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,120,0)'); g.fillStyle = q; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y - r * .5, r * 3.5, 0, TAU); g.fill() } }
    g.restore() }
  // ---- the fish (from the game's FSP numbers): side (in the hand) or top (in the bucket); ppc = px per cm ----
  // the fish = the asset library's own fish (TurboCity: one id per species, the size variant sz), stretched to the catch's real length (cm); the mouth at mx, my, the head along ang
  const FZ = [.6, .85, 1, 1.35];   // the asset library's size variants (its own FZ)
  function fishAt(g, id, cm, mx, my, ang, ppc, si, v, t) { sync(); if (typeof TurboCity === 'undefined' || !TurboCity.get(id)) return; const sp = LAKE_FISH.concat(COAST_FISH).find(q => q.id === id); if (!sp) return;
    const sz = si == null ? 2 : si, scale = ppc * cm / (sp.base * FZ[sz]), I = TurboCity.info(id, { scale }), c = I.an.find(a => a[0] === 'Center') || ['C', I.w / 2, I.h / 2];
    g.save(); g.translate(mx, my); g.rotate(ang); TurboCity.draw(g, id, -cm * ppc / 2 - c[1], -c[2], { mode: 'runtime', scale, v: v == null ? 3 : v, sz, time: t || 0 }); g.restore() }
  function fish(g, id, cm, x, y, ang, ppc, top, si, v) { const Ld = cm * ppc; return fishAt(g, id, cm, x + Math.cos(ang) * Ld / 2, y + Math.sin(ang) * Ld / 2, ang, ppc, si, v == null ? (top ? 0 : 3) : v, 0) }
  // which bait fits which rod: the lures — the casting rods only; the natural baits — the rod's list (lake), any rod but the casting rod (sea)
  function fitsLv(lv, id) { const rod = RODS[(lv | 0) - 1]; if (!rod) return true; const b = (typeof LAKE_BAITS !== 'undefined' && LAKE_BAITS[id]) || (typeof COAST_BAITS !== 'undefined' && COAST_BAITS[id]) || {};
    if (b.lure || b.reusable || /^lure-/.test(id)) return rod.kind === 'spin' || rod.kind === 'surf'; if (typeof LAKE_BAITS !== 'undefined' && LAKE_BAITS[id]) return rod.baits.includes(id); return rod.kind !== 'spin' }
  // ---- the bucket (20 l: 0.32 m across, 0.34 m high, × the people's scale) with its fish seen from above; at x, y (the ground point) ----
  function bucket(g, x, y, rows, res, night, col) { sync(); const R = .16 * S * PXM, H = .34 * S * PXM * K, c = col || '#2f73b8';
    g.save(); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x + 1, y + .6, R * 1.1, R * .55, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();
    const gr = g.createLinearGradient(x - R, 0, x + R, 0); gr.addColorStop(0, shade(c, 1.15)); gr.addColorStop(1, shade(c, .7)); g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - R, y - H); g.lineTo(x - R * .86, y); g.ellipse(x, y, R * .86, R * .43, 0, Math.PI, 0, true); g.lineTo(x + R, y - H); g.closePath(); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = shade(c, .55); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H, R, R * .5, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = night ? '#24445c' : '#7fb3c9'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H + .25, R * .88, R * .42, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();   // the water inside
    g.save(); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H + .25, R * .88, R * .42, 0, 0, TAU); g.clip();
    (rows || []).forEach((q, i) => { const a = (i * 2.3) + .6, rr = R * (.12 + .08 * (i % 3)), ppc = S * PXM / 100; fish(g, q.id, q.cm, x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y - H + .25 + Math.sin(a) * rr * .5, a + Math.PI / 2, ppc, true, q.si, 1) });   // the game's fish, its real length, bent (the game's turning pose)
    g.restore();
    g.strokeStyle = '#c9d1d8'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(.15, .6 / res); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H, R, R * .5, 0, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.95, true); g.stroke();   // the handle
    g.restore() }
  function tackleBox(g, x, y, res) { sync(); const w = .42 * S * PXM, d = .24 * S * PXM, h = .2 * S * PXM * K; g.save();
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2 + .6, y - d / 2 + .8, w, d);
    g.fillStyle = '#3c6b46'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - d / 2 - h, w, h + d * .1); g.fillStyle = '#4f8a5c'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - d / 2 - h - d * .5, w, d * .5);
    g.fillStyle = '#d8b13a'; g.fillRect(x - .5, y - d / 2 - h * .6, 1, h * .35); g.fillStyle = '#2a2d31'; g.fillRect(x - w * .2, y - d / 2 - h - d * .5 - .5, w * .4, .5); g.restore() }
  // ---- the catch story of one lake angler: seeded; st: wait → bite → fight → lift → (keep | release) → wait ----
  const ST = { wait: 0, bite: 1, fight: 2, lift: 3, keep: 4, release: 5, lost: 6 };
  function anglerNew(seed, rodLv, bait, hasBucket) { return { r: rng(seed), rodLv, bait, hasBucket, st: 'wait', t: 0, next: 0, fish: null, bucket: [], log: [] } }
  function anglerStep(A_, dt, pick, now) {   // pick(rodLv, bait, rnd) → {id, name, cm, si}
    const R = A_.r; A_.t += dt; if (!A_.next) A_.next = 20 + R() * 60;
    if (A_.st === 'wait' && A_.t >= A_.next) { A_.st = 'bite'; A_.t = 0; A_.dur = .7 + R() * .9; A_.fish = pick(A_.rodLv, A_.bait, R) }
    else if (A_.st === 'bite' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.st = 'fight'; A_.t = 0; A_.dur = 1.6 + (A_.fish.si + 1) * 1.1 + R() * 1.5; A_.escapes = R() < .18 }
    else if (A_.st === 'fight' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.t = 0; if (A_.escapes) { A_.st = 'lost'; A_.dur = 2; A_.log.push([now, 'lost', A_.fish]) } else { A_.st = 'lift'; A_.dur = 1.3 } }
    else if (A_.st === 'lift' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.t = 0; A_.dur = 1.6; const small = A_.fish.si === 0 && R() < .5, full = A_.bucket.length >= 6;
      if (A_.hasBucket && !small && !full) { A_.st = 'keep'; A_.bucket.push(A_.fish); A_.log.push([now, 'keep', A_.fish]) } else { A_.st = 'release'; A_.log.push([now, 'release', A_.fish]) } }
    else if ((A_.st === 'keep' || A_.st === 'release' || A_.st === 'lost') && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.st = 'wait'; A_.t = 0; A_.fish = null; A_.next = 30 + R() * 150 }
    return A_ }
  // the frame of the pose for a state (and the bend, the float)
  function anglerFrame(A_, rod, t) { const s = A_.st;
    if (s === 'wait') return { fr: rod.kind === 'spin' ? (Math.floor(t * 2) % 2 ? 5 : 4) : 0, bend: null, bite: false };
    if (s === 'bite') return { fr: 3, bend: .25 + Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 9)) * .25, bite: true, bell: true };
    if (s === 'fight') return { fr: Math.floor(t * 2.4) % 2 ? 5 : 4, bend: .4 + Math.sin(t * 5) * .1, bite: true };
    if (s === 'lift') return { fr: 6, bend: .5, fishUp: true };
    return { fr: 7, bend: 0, inHand: s !== 'lost' } }
  return { KINDS, A, F, fitsLv, rng, shade, P, rodSide, reelSide, rodWorld, float, fish, bucket, tackleBox, armsFor, kindOf, dirOf, anglerNew, anglerStep, anglerFrame, fishAt, rest, restGeo, S, K, PXM };
})();

   ACTIVE_REGIONS.push(r);MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.add(id);const e={id,mode,r,note:o.note||'',by:o.by||''};L.zones.push(e);return e}

   const e={id,mode,r,fn,note:o.note||'',by:o.by||''};L.walk.push(e);return e}

/* ===== D-511 (8.11) · TCSND — the sound of the cinema and the theatre (the first sound in the game; the rest of the game stays silent until its stage).
   Everything is synthesized here with Web Audio: an orchestra (strings, brass, horn, flute, clarinet, harp, piano, celesta, pizzicato, basses, timpani,
   drums, cymbals, bells), the ambience (the sea, the wind, the rain, the train, the hall) and the effects. No file from outside, no voice.
   The AudioContext is created only on the player's click (the browser's policy); the show's events are scheduled ahead against the show's clock;
   closing the screen silences the session at once; the volume and the mute are kept (localStorage). ===== */
var TCSND=(function(){
 const st={ctx:null,master:null,comp:null,ana:null,rev:null,noise:null,lfo:null,vol:.8,mute:false,notes:0,sfx:0,ambOn:0,err:null,created:0,S:null,sessions:0};
 try{const q=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tcShowAudio')||'{}');if(isFinite(q.v))st.vol=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,+q.v));st.mute=!!q.m}catch(e){}
 const keep=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('tcShowAudio',JSON.stringify({v:st.vol,m:st.mute}))}catch(e){}};
 const mtof=m=>440*Math.pow(2,(m-69)/12),R=Math.random;
 function masterLevel(){return st.mute?0:Math.pow(st.vol,1.6)*.95}
 /* the hall: a stereo impulse — early reflections and a long soft tail */
 function makeIR(ctx,sec,decay){const n=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*sec),b=ctx.createBuffer(2,n,ctx.sampleRate);for(let ch=0;ch<2;ch++){const d=b.getChannelData(ch);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const t=i/n;d[i]=(R()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-t,decay)*(t<.012?0:1)}for(const [ms,g] of [[11,.5],[19,.35],[27,.3],[41,.22]]){const i=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*ms/1000*(ch?1.07:1));if(i<n)d[i]+=g*(ch?-1:1)}}return b}
 function ensure(){if(st.ctx)return st.ctx;const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC){st.err='no-audio';return null}
  try{const ctx=new AC({latencyHint:'playback'});st.ctx=ctx;st.created=Date.now();
   st.master=ctx.createGain();st.master.gain.value=masterLevel();st.comp=ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();st.comp.threshold.value=-16;st.comp.knee.value=12;st.comp.ratio.value=3.2;st.comp.attack.value=.008;st.comp.release.value=.28;
   const tone=ctx.createBiquadFilter();tone.type='peaking';tone.frequency.value=3200;tone.Q.value=.8;tone.gain.value=-3.5;   /* a softer top for the synthesized strings */
   st.comp.connect(tone);tone.connect(st.master);st.master.connect(ctx.destination);st.ana=ctx.createAnalyser();st.ana.fftSize=2048;st.master.connect(st.ana);
   st.rev=ctx.createConvolver();st.rev.buffer=makeIR(ctx,2.8,3.2);const rg=ctx.createGain();rg.gain.value=.55;st.rev.connect(rg);rg.connect(st.comp);
   const n=ctx.sampleRate*3,nb=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate),d=nb.getChannelData(0);let b0=0,b1=0,b2=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const w=R()*2-1;b0=.99765*b0+w*.099;b1=.963*b1+w*.2965;b2=.57*b2+w*1.0526;d[i]=(b0+b1+b2+w*.1848)*.16}st.noise=nb;   /* pink noise */
   const wb=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate),wd=wb.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)wd[i]=R()*2-1;st.white=wb;
   st.lfo=ctx.createOscillator();st.lfo.frequency.value=5.3;st.vib=ctx.createGain();st.vib.gain.value=7;st.lfo.connect(st.vib);st.lfo.start();
   return ctx}catch(e){st.err=String(e&&e.message||e);st.ctx=null;return null}}
 /* a session = one show: its own buses, so that closing the screen cuts everything that was already scheduled */
 function session(){const ctx=st.ctx;if(!ctx)return null;const g=ctx.createGain();g.gain.value=1;g.connect(st.comp);const S={g,mus:ctx.createGain(),amb:ctx.createGain(),sfx:ctx.createGain(),send:ctx.createGain(),ambs:{},alive:true};
  S.mus.gain.value=.62;S.amb.gain.value=.5;S.sfx.gain.value=.75;S.send.gain.value=1;S.mus.connect(g);S.amb.connect(g);S.sfx.connect(g);
  S.musRev=ctx.createGain();S.musRev.gain.value=.42;S.mus.connect(S.musRev);S.musRev.connect(S.send);S.sfxRev=ctx.createGain();S.sfxRev.gain.value=.22;S.sfx.connect(S.sfxRev);S.sfxRev.connect(S.send);S.send.connect(st.rev);
  st.sessions++;return S}
 function endSession(S){if(!S||!S.alive)return;S.alive=false;const ctx=st.ctx,t=ctx.currentTime;try{S.g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);S.g.gain.setValueAtTime(S.g.gain.value,t);S.g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+.18)}catch(e){}
  setTimeout(()=>{try{S.g.disconnect();S.send.disconnect()}catch(e){}for(const k in S.ambs){try{S.ambs[k].stop()}catch(e){}}},420)}
 /* ---------- the instruments ---------- */
 function osc(type,f,t,end,dest,det){const o=st.ctx.createOscillator();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);if(det)o.detune.setValueAtTime(det,t);o.connect(dest);o.start(t);o.stop(end);return o}
 function gainEnv(dest,t,a,peak,hold,rel,sus){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak,t+a);if(sus!=null)g.gain.setTargetAtTime(peak*sus,t+a,.25);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+Math.max(a,hold),rel/3.5);g.connect(dest);return g}
 function noiseSrc(t,end,dest,white,rate){const s=st.ctx.createBufferSource();s.buffer=white?st.white:st.noise;s.loop=true;if(rate)s.playbackRate.value=rate;s.connect(dest);s.start(t,R()*2);s.stop(end);return s}
 function filt(type,f,q,dest){const b=st.ctx.createBiquadFilter();b.type=type;b.frequency.value=f;if(q!=null)b.Q.value=q;b.connect(dest);return b}
 function pan(x,dest){if(!st.ctx.createStereoPanner)return dest;const p=st.ctx.createStereoPanner();p.pan.value=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,x));p.connect(dest);return p}
 const INST={
  str(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),a=o.a!=null?o.a:.22,rel=o.r||.7,lp=filt('lowpass',Math.min(7000,f*(o.bright||4.2)+500),.6,pan(o.p||((m-62)/40),dest)),g=gainEnv(lp,t,a,v*.075,d,rel,.92);
   for(const det of [-9,-2,6,12]){const q=osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g,det);st.vib.connect(q.detune)}},
  cello(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.5,lp=filt('lowpass',f*3.4+300,.7,pan(-.2,dest)),g=gainEnv(lp,t,o.a||.12,v*.11,d,rel,.9);for(const det of [-6,5]){const q=osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g,det);st.vib.connect(q.detune)}},
  brass(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.28,lp=filt('lowpass',f*1.1,1.4,pan(o.p||.15,dest)),e=t+d+rel*1.6;lp.frequency.setValueAtTime(f*1.1,t);lp.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(Math.min(9000,f*6),t+.07);lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(Math.min(7000,f*3.6),t+.08,.15);lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f*1.2,t+d,rel/3);
   const g=gainEnv(lp,t,.045,v*.11,d,rel,.82);for(const det of [-5,4])osc('sawtooth',f,t,e,g,det);osc('square',f/2,t,e,gainEnv(lp,t,.05,v*.02,d,rel,.8))},
  horn(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.4,lp=filt('lowpass',f*2.4+200,.9,pan(-.25,dest)),g=gainEnv(lp,t,.11,v*.13,d,rel,.9);osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g,-3);osc('triangle',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g,3)},
  flute(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.18,P=pan(o.p!=null?o.p:.3,dest),g=gainEnv(P,t,.07,v*.16,d,rel,.9),e=t+d+rel*1.6;const a=osc('sine',f,t,e,g);const b=osc('triangle',f,t,e,gainEnv(P,t,.06,v*.035,d,rel,.9));
   const vg=st.ctx.createGain();vg.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);vg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(9,t+.35);st.lfo.connect(vg);vg.connect(a.detune);vg.connect(b.detune);
   noiseSrc(t,e,filt('bandpass',f*1.02,9,gainEnv(P,t,.03,v*.05,Math.min(d,.12),.15)),true)},
  clar(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.16,lp=filt('lowpass',f*3+400,.7,pan(-.3,dest)),g=gainEnv(lp,t,.05,v*.07,d,rel,.92);const q=osc('square',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g);const vg=st.ctx.createGain();vg.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);vg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(6,t+.4);st.lfo.connect(vg);vg.connect(q.detune)},
  oboe(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.14,bp=filt('bandpass',f*2.2,1.2,pan(.35,dest)),g=gainEnv(bp,t,.05,v*.2,d,rel,.9);const q=osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g);st.vib.connect(q.detune)},
  harp(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),P=pan(o.p!=null?o.p:(m-60)/30,dest);for(const [k,a,tau] of [[1,1,1.1],[2,.42,.55],[3,.16,.3],[4,.07,.18]]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.11*a,t+.004);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.005,tau*(o.sus||1));g.connect(P);osc('sine',f*k,t,t+tau*6,g)}},
  piano(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),P=pan((m-60)/36,dest),dd=Math.min(3.2,Math.max(.6,d+.5));for(const [k,a,tau,ty] of [[1,1,dd*.7,'triangle'],[1.002,.6,dd*.6,'sine'],[2,.3,dd*.32,'sine'],[3.01,.1,dd*.18,'sine']]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.12*a,t+.006);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*.05*a,t+.01,.18);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+d,Math.min(tau,.35));g.connect(P);osc(ty,f*k,t,t+d+1.6,g)}
   noiseSrc(t,t+.03,filt('lowpass',2400,.7,gainEnv(P,t,.002,v*.04,.01,.02)),true)},
  celesta(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),P=pan(.4,dest);for(const [k,a,tau] of [[1,1,.7],[4,.22,.12],[2,.18,.3]]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.09*a,t+.003);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.004,tau);g.connect(P);osc('sine',f*k,t,t+tau*6,g)}},
  pizz(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),lp=filt('lowpass',f*3.5,.8,pan((m-55)/40,dest)),g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.16,t+.005);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.01,.09);g.connect(lp);osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+.6,g);osc('triangle',f,t,t+.6,g)},
  bass(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.35,lp=filt('lowpass',f*2.6+120,.8,dest),g=gainEnv(lp,t,o.a||.08,v*.17,d,rel,.88);osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g,-4);osc('sine',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g)},
  timp(t,m,d,v,dest){const f=mtof(m),g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.42,t+.004);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.01,.5);g.connect(dest);const o=osc('sine',f*1.03,t,t+3,g);o.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f,t,.05);
   const g2=st.ctx.createGain();g2.gain.setValueAtTime(v*.12,t);g2.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t,.16);g2.connect(dest);osc('triangle',f*1.5,t,t+1,g2);noiseSrc(t,t+.12,filt('lowpass',380,.7,gainEnv(dest,t,.002,v*.2,.02,.06)))},
  kick(t,m,d,v,dest){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(v*.55,t);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t,.22);g.connect(dest);const o=osc('sine',78,t,t+1.4,g);o.frequency.setTargetAtTime(44,t,.07)},
  snare(t,m,d,v,dest){noiseSrc(t,t+.3,filt('bandpass',1900,.7,gainEnv(pan(.12,dest),t,.002,v*.3,.01,.14)),true);const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(v*.16,t);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t,.03);g.connect(dest);osc('triangle',190,t,t+.2,g)},
  brush(t,m,d,v,dest){noiseSrc(t,t+.2,filt('bandpass',3200,.6,gainEnv(pan(.1,dest),t,.012,v*.12,.03,.09)),true)},
  hat(t,m,d,v,dest){noiseSrc(t,t+.12,filt('highpass',7500,.7,gainEnv(pan(.25,dest),t,.002,v*.12,.01,.04)),true)},
  cym(t,m,d,v,dest){const L=d||2.2;noiseSrc(t,t+L*2,filt('highpass',5200,.5,gainEnv(pan(-.2,dest),t,.003,v*.2,.02,L)),true);noiseSrc(t,t+L,filt('bandpass',9000,1,gainEnv(dest,t,.002,v*.08,.01,L*.6)),true)},
  swell(t,m,d,v,dest){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(v*.22,t+d);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+d+.05);g.connect(dest);noiseSrc(t,t+d+.1,filt('highpass',4200,.5,g),true)},
  tri(t,m,d,v,dest){for(const [f,a,tau] of [[5320,1,.7],[7980,.4,.4],[11300,.2,.25]]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(v*.05*a,t);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t,tau);g.connect(pan(.45,dest));osc('sine',f,t,t+3,g)}},
  bell(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m);for(const [k,a,tau] of [[.5,.5,2.4],[1,1,1.9],[2,.55,1.1],[2.4,.38,.9],[3,.3,.6],[4.2,.2,.4],[5.4,.14,.3]]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.09*a,t+.003);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.004,tau*(o.sus||1));g.connect(pan(o.p||0,dest));osc('sine',f*k,t,t+tau*6*(o.sus||1),g)}},
  glock(t,m,d,v,dest){const f=mtof(m);for(const [k,a,tau] of [[1,1,.55],[2.76,.3,.2],[5.4,.12,.1]]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(v*.08*a,t);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t,tau);g.connect(pan(.3,dest));osc('sine',f*k,t,t+3,g)}}
 };
 /* ---------- the ambience: loops that live as long as the session, with a level ---------- */
 const AMB={
  sea(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain();const lp=filt('lowpass',650,.5,out),lfo=c.createOscillator(),lg=c.createGain(),am=c.createGain();am.gain.value=.55;lfo.frequency.value=.11;lg.gain.value=.45;lfo.connect(lg);lg.connect(am.gain);am.connect(lp);
   const s1=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,am);const hp=filt('highpass',2600,.4,out),am2=c.createGain();am2.gain.value=.12;lg.connect(am2.gain);am2.connect(hp);const s2=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,am2,true,.5);lfo.start();return{out,stop(){for(const q of [s1,s2,lfo])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  wind(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),bp=filt('bandpass',520,2.2,out),lfo=c.createOscillator(),lg=c.createGain();lfo.frequency.value=.07;lg.gain.value=320;lfo.connect(lg);lg.connect(bp.frequency);const am=c.createGain();am.gain.value=.9;const l2=c.createOscillator(),g2=c.createGain();l2.frequency.value=.19;g2.gain.value=.5;l2.connect(g2);g2.connect(am.gain);am.connect(bp);
   const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,am);const lo=filt('lowpass',180,.5,out);const s2=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,lo);lfo.start();l2.start();return{out,stop(){for(const q of [s,s2,lfo,l2])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  rain(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),hp=filt('highpass',1300,.4,filt('lowpass',9000,.4,out)),g=c.createGain();g.gain.value=.55;g.connect(hp);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,g,true);const body=filt('lowpass',420,.5,out),g2=c.createGain();g2.gain.value=.5;g2.connect(body);const s2=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,g2);return{out,stop(){for(const q of [s,s2])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  train(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),lp=filt('lowpass',140,.7,out);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,lp,false,.7);const hum=c.createGain();hum.gain.value=.25;hum.connect(filt('lowpass',300,.7,out));const o=osc('sawtooth',46,c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,hum);return{out,stop(){for(const q of [s,o])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  city(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),lp=filt('lowpass',320,.5,out);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,lp,false,.8);return{out,stop(){try{s.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  room(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),lp=filt('lowpass',260,.5,out);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,lp,false,.6);return{out,stop(){try{s.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  engine(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),lp=filt('lowpass',220,.9,out),am=c.createGain();am.gain.value=.6;const l=c.createOscillator(),lg=c.createGain();l.frequency.value=7;lg.gain.value=.4;l.connect(lg);lg.connect(am.gain);am.connect(lp);const o=osc('sawtooth',54,c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,am);l.start();return{out,stop(){for(const q of [o,l])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  fire(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),bp=filt('bandpass',900,.6,out);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,bp);return{out,stop(){try{s.stop()}catch(e){}}}}
 };
 function amb(S,name,level,fade,t){if(!S||!S.alive||!AMB[name])return;let a=S.ambs[name];if(!a){if(level<=.001)return;a=AMB[name](S);a.g=st.ctx.createGain();a.g.gain.value=0;a.out.connect(a.g);a.g.connect(S.amb);S.ambs[name]=a;st.ambOn++}
  const at=t||st.ctx.currentTime;a.g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(at);a.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(Math.max(0,level),at,Math.max(.02,(fade||1)/3))}
 /* ---------- the effects ---------- */
 const SFX={
  clack(S,t,v){for(const dt of [0,.085]){noiseSrc(t+dt,t+dt+.1,filt('bandpass',1250,1.6,gainEnv(S.sfx,t+dt,.002,v*.28,.01,.05)));INST.kick(t+dt,0,0,v*.25,S.sfx)}},
  horn(S,t,v,p){const d=p||1.4,lp=filt('lowpass',1500,.8,S.sfx),g=gainEnv(lp,t,.06,v*.09,d,.25,.95);for(const f of [311,370,466])osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+d+.6,g)},
  shiphorn(S,t,v,p){const d=p||2.2,lp=filt('lowpass',600,.8,S.sfx),g=gainEnv(lp,t,.15,v*.16,d,.5,.95);for(const f of [87,110,131])osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+d+1,g,R()*8)},
  whistle(S,t,v){const g=gainEnv(pan(.3,S.sfx),t,.01,v*.07,.55,.08),o=osc('sine',2650,t,t+.8,g);const l=st.ctx.createOscillator(),lg=st.ctx.createGain();l.frequency.value=34;lg.gain.value=120;l.connect(lg);lg.connect(o.frequency);l.start(t);l.stop(t+.8)},
  brake(S,t,v,p){const d=p||2.4,bp=filt('bandpass',2600,6,S.sfx),g=gainEnv(bp,t,.08,v*.4,d,.3,.9);const o=osc('sawtooth',1300,t,t+d+.6,g);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(980,t+d);noiseSrc(t,t+d+.4,filt('highpass',3000,.6,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.1,v*.18,d,.4)),true)},
  thunder(S,t,v){noiseSrc(t,t+.4,filt('bandpass',1600,.5,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.004,v*.35,.05,.25)),true);const lp=filt('lowpass',240,.6,S.sfx),g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.9,t+.12);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*.5,t+.2,.4);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+1.2,1.1);g.connect(lp);noiseSrc(t,t+6,g,false,.6)},
  hammer(S,t,v){for(const [f,a,tau] of [[820,1,.35],[1390,.6,.22],[2210,.4,.15],[3120,.25,.1]]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(v*.1*a,t);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t,tau);g.connect(pan(R()-.5,S.sfx));osc('sine',f,t,t+1.6,g)}noiseSrc(t,t+.05,filt('highpass',2000,.6,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.001,v*.2,.005,.02)),true)},
  weld(S,t,v,p){const d=p||1.2,g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.12,t+.05);g.gain.setValueAtTime(v*.12,t+d);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+d+.1);g.connect(filt('highpass',3500,.5,S.sfx));noiseSrc(t,t+d+.2,g,true)},
  crane(S,t,v,p){const d=p||2.5,g=gainEnv(filt('lowpass',900,.7,S.sfx),t,.3,v*.08,d,.4,.95),o=osc('sawtooth',90,t,t+d+.8,g);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(130,t+d*.5);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(100,t+d)},
  splash(S,t,v){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.35,t+.03);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.05,.25);const bp=filt('bandpass',1200,.6,S.sfx);bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(2500,t);bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(500,t+.6);g.connect(bp);noiseSrc(t,t+1.2,g,true)},
  wave(S,t,v){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.5,t+.6);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.8,.5);const lp=filt('lowpass',900,.5,S.sfx);g.connect(lp);noiseSrc(t,t+3,g)},
  gull(S,t,v){for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const t0=t+k*.28,g=gainEnv(pan(.5-R(),S.sfx),t0,.02,v*.035,.16,.06),o=osc('sine',1500,t0,t0+.35,g);o.frequency.setValueAtTime(1350,t0);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1900,t0+.07);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1200,t0+.2)}},
  applause(S,t,v,p){const d=p||5,n=Math.round(d*90);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const u=i/n,tt=t+u*d+R()*.03,env=Math.min(1,u*5)*Math.min(1,(1-u)*2.4),f=900+R()*2200;noiseSrc(tt,tt+.05,filt('bandpass',f,1.4,gainEnv(pan(R()*1.6-.8,S.sfx),tt,.001,v*env*(.14+R()*.12),.008,.03)),true)}},
  chime(S,t,v){INST.bell(t,76,1,v*.8,S.sfx,{sus:.7,p:.2})},
  tick(S,t,v,p){noiseSrc(t,t+.04,filt('bandpass',p?2200:3100,4,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.001,v*.25,.004,.02)),true)},
  gear(S,t,v){for(let k=0;k<6;k++)SFX.tick(S,t+k*.07,v*.6,k%2)},
  clock(S,t,v,p){for(let k=0;k<(p||1);k++)INST.bell(t+k*1.1,52,1,v*1.2,S.sfx,{sus:1.4})},
  boing(S,t,v){const g=gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.005,v*.12,.35,.2),o=osc('triangle',190,t,t+.8,g);const l=st.ctx.createOscillator(),lg=st.ctx.createGain();l.frequency.value=14;lg.gain.setValueAtTime(90,t);lg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+.6);l.connect(lg);lg.connect(o.frequency);l.start(t);l.stop(t+.8);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(330,t+.5)},
  whoosh(S,t,v,p){const d=p||.8,g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.3,t+d*.6);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+d);const bp=filt('bandpass',500,1.2,S.sfx);bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(400,t);bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(3000,t+d);g.connect(bp);noiseSrc(t,t+d+.1,g,true)},
  click(S,t,v){noiseSrc(t,t+.03,filt('highpass',1800,.7,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.001,v*.3,.004,.012)),true)},
  lamp(S,t,v){const g=gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.3,v*.03,1.2,.5,.8);osc('sawtooth',100,t,t+2.4,filt('lowpass',600,.5,g));SFX.click(S,t,v)},
  spark(S,t,v){for(let k=0;k<5;k++)noiseSrc(t+k*.04,t+k*.04+.05,filt('highpass',4000,.5,gainEnv(S.sfx,t+k*.04,.001,v*.2*R(),.01,.02)),true)},
  firework(S,t,v){INST.kick(t,0,0,v*.7,S.sfx);for(let k=0;k<26;k++){const tt=t+.25+R()*1.1;noiseSrc(tt,tt+.04,filt('highpass',3000+R()*3000,.5,gainEnv(pan(R()*2-1,S.sfx),tt,.001,v*.1*R(),.005,.02)),true)}},
  kite(S,t,v,p){const d=p||1.5,am=st.ctx.createGain();am.gain.value=0;const l=st.ctx.createOscillator(),lg=st.ctx.createGain();l.frequency.value=11;lg.gain.value=v*.08;l.connect(lg);lg.connect(am.gain);l.start(t);l.stop(t+d);am.connect(filt('bandpass',700,.8,S.sfx));noiseSrc(t,t+d,am,true)},
  creak(S,t,v){const g=gainEnv(filt('bandpass',420,6,S.sfx),t,.05,v*.25,.5,.1),o=osc('sawtooth',38,t,t+.8,g);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(52,t+.5)},
  steps(S,t,v,p){for(let k=0;k<(p||4);k++){const tt=t+k*.32;noiseSrc(tt,tt+.06,filt('lowpass',500,.7,gainEnv(S.sfx,tt,.002,v*.3,.01,.04)))}},
  ratchet(S,t,v,p){for(let k=0;k<(p||8);k++)SFX.tick(S,t+k*.11,v,k%2)},
  rope(S,t,v){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.2,t+.15);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+.5);g.connect(filt('bandpass',900,2,S.sfx));noiseSrc(t,t+.6,g)},
  bump(S,t,v){INST.kick(t,0,0,v*.6,S.sfx);noiseSrc(t,t+.2,filt('lowpass',700,.6,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.002,v*.25,.02,.08)))},
  wipe(S,t,v){noiseSrc(t,t+.35,filt('bandpass',1400,2.5,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.05,v*.07,.15,.08)))},
  flag(S,t,v,p){SFX.kite(S,t,v*.7,p||1.2)},
  pour(S,t,v){noiseSrc(t,t+1.1,filt('bandpass',2400,3,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.08,v*.06,.8,.2)),true)}
 };
 /* ---------- the score: chords, melodies and cues → note events in the show's time ---------- */
 const PC={C:0,D:2,E:4,F:5,G:7,A:9,B:11};
 function nm(s){const m=/^([A-G])([#b]?)(-?\d)$/.exec(s);if(!m)return 60;return 12*(+m[3]+1)+PC[m[1]]+(m[2]==='#'?1:m[2]==='b'?-1:0)}
 const QUAL={'':[0,4,7],m:[0,3,7],dim:[0,3,6],aug:[0,4,8],'7':[0,4,7,10],m7:[0,3,7,10],maj7:[0,4,7,11],sus4:[0,5,7],sus2:[0,2,7],add9:[0,4,7,14],m9:[0,3,7,14],'6':[0,4,7,9]};
 function chord(s){const m=/^([A-G])([#b]?)(m7|m9|maj7|m|dim|aug|7|sus4|sus2|add9|6)?(?:\/([A-G])([#b]?))?$/.exec(s);if(!m)return{r:0,iv:[0,4,7],b:0};const r=(PC[m[1]]+(m[2]==='#'?1:m[2]==='b'?-1:0)+12)%12;const b=m[4]?(PC[m[4]]+(m[5]==='#'?1:m[5]==='b'?-1:0)+12)%12:r;return{r,iv:QUAL[m[3]||''],b}}
 function prog(s,cb){return s.trim().split(/\s+/).map(x=>{const [n,len]=x.split(':');return{c:chord(n),beats:len?+len:cb}})}
 function melody(s){let b=0;const out=[];for(const x of s.trim().split(/\s+/)){const [n,len]=x.split(':');const d=+(len||1);if(n!=='r'&&n!=='-')out.push([b,d,nm(n)]);b+=d}return{notes:out,len:b}}
 const near=(pc,lo)=>{let m=lo-((lo%12)+12)%12+pc;if(m<lo)m+=12;return m};
 /* a cue: {t0,t1,bpm,ch,cb,pad,bass,arp,pulse,mel,mel2,drums,timp,v,end,fadeIn} */
 function compose(c,out){const beat=60/c.bpm,P=prog(c.ch||'C',c.cb||4),V=c.v==null?.8:c.v,E=(t,i,m,d,v,o)=>{if(t<c.t1-.02)out.push({t,k:'n',i,m,d:Math.max(.05,Math.min(d,c.t1+(c.tail||.6)-t)),v:v*V*(c.fadeIn&&t<c.t0+c.fadeIn?Math.max(.15,(t-c.t0)/c.fadeIn):1),o:o||{}})};
  let b=0,ci=0;const tb=b=>c.t0+b*beat,span=(c.t1-c.t0)/beat;
  while(b<span){const ch=P[ci%P.length],L=ch.beats,t=tb(b),dur=L*beat,tones=ch.c.iv.map(x=>(ch.c.r+x)%12),root=ch.c.b;
   if(c.pad){const lo=c.padLo||55;const vo=ch.c.iv.slice(0,4).map((x,k)=>near((ch.c.r+x)%12,lo+(k?3:0)));vo.sort((a,b)=>a-b);for(const m of vo)E(t,c.pad,m,dur*.98,c.padV||.55,{a:c.padA||.3,r:.8})}
   if(c.bass){const m=near(root,c.bassLo||36);if(c.bass==='timp')E(t,'timp',m,1,.7);else if(c.bass==='walk'){for(let k=0;k<L;k++)E(tb(b+k),'pizz',k%2?m+7:m,beat*.9,.8)}else E(t,c.bass,m,dur*.97,.7)}
   if(c.timp&&(ci%(c.timpEvery||1)===0))E(t,'timp',near(root,40),1,c.timp===2?.95:.65);
   if(c.arp){const r=c.arpR||.5,pat=c.arpPat||'up',lo=c.arpLo||60,ns=[...tones.map(p=>near(p,lo)),near(tones[0],lo)+12],seq=pat==='updown'?[...ns,...ns.slice(1,-1).reverse()]:pat==='broken'?[ns[0],ns[2],ns[1],ns[3]||ns[0]+12]:ns;for(let k=0;k*r<L-.001;k++)E(tb(b+k*r),c.arp,seq[k%seq.length],r*beat*(c.arp==='harp'||c.arp==='piano'?3:1),(c.arpV||.5)*(k%2?.85:1))}
   if(c.pulse){const r=c.pulseR||.5;for(let k=0;k*r<L-.001;k++){const m=near(root,c.pulseLo||43)+(c.pulseOct&&k%2?12:0);E(tb(b+k*r),c.pulse,m,r*beat*.7,(c.pulseV||.55)*(k%(1/r*2)===0?1.15:1),{a:.02,r:.12})}}
   if(c.drums){const D=c.drums;for(let k=0;k<L;k++){const tt=tb(b+k);if(D==='march'){E(tt,'snare',0,.1,k%2?.35:.55);if(k%2)E(tt+beat/2,'snare',0,.1,.3);if(k===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.6)}
     else if(D==='train'){E(tt,'brush',0,.1,.55);E(tt+beat/2,'brush',0,.1,.35);if(k%2===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.35)}
     else if(D==='soft'){if(k===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.4);E(tt+beat/2,'hat',0,.1,.3)}
     else if(D==='build'){for(let q=0;q<4;q++)E(tt+q*beat/4,'snare',0,.06,.12+.5*((b+k+q/4)/span))}
     else if(D==='dance'){if(k%2===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.5);else E(tt,'snare',0,.1,.4);E(tt+beat/2,'hat',0,.1,.3)}}}
   b+=L;ci++}

 /* the show's whole event list: cues + sfx [t,name,v,p] + ambience [t,name,level,fade] */
 function build(spec){const ev=[];for(const c of spec.cues||[])compose(c,ev);for(const s of spec.sfx||[])ev.push({t:s[0],k:'s',s:s[1],v:s[2]==null?.8:s[2],p:s[3]});for(const a of spec.amb||[])ev.push({t:a[0],k:'a',a:a[1],v:a[2],f:a[3]||1.5});for(const n of spec.notes||[])ev.push({t:n[0],k:'n',i:n[1],m:typeof n[2]==='string'?nm(n[2]):n[2],d:n[3]||1,v:n[4]||.7,o:n[5]||{}});ev.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);return ev}
 function fire(S,e,at){try{if(e.k==='n'){const f=INST[e.i];if(f){f(at,e.m,e.d,e.v,S.mus,e.o||{});st.notes++}}else if(e.k==='s'){const f=SFX[e.s];if(f){f(S,at,e.v,e.p);st.sfx++}}else if(e.k==='a')amb(S,e.a,e.v,e.f,at)}catch(x){st.err=String(x&&x.message||x)}}
 /* play(spec) → a player bound to the show clock: pump(showT) each frame; pause/resume/stop */
 function play(spec){const ctx=ensure();const P={ev:build(spec),i:0,S:null,synced:false,pump,pause,resume,stop,count:0};
  function start(showT){if(!st.ctx||P.S)return;P.S=session();st.S=P.S;const lv={};let i=0;while(i<P.ev.length&&P.ev[i].t<showT-.05){const e=P.ev[i];if(e.k==='a')lv[e.a]=e;i++}P.i=i;for(const k in lv){const e=lv[k];amb(P.S,e.a,e.v,.5)}}
  function pump(showT){if(P.done||!st.ctx)return;if(st.ctx.state==='suspended'&&!P.paused){try{st.ctx.resume()}catch(e){}}if(st.ctx.state!=='running')return;if(!P.S)start(showT);const S=P.S;if(!S||!S.alive)return;const now=st.ctx.currentTime;
   while(P.i<P.ev.length&&P.ev[P.i].t<showT+.32){const e=P.ev[P.i++];if(e.t<showT-.12&&e.k!=='a')continue;fire(S,e,now+Math.max(0,e.t-showT)+.02);P.count++}}
  function pause(){P.paused=true;try{st.ctx&&st.ctx.suspend()}catch(e){}}
  function resume(){P.paused=false;try{st.ctx&&st.ctx.resume()}catch(e){}}
  function stop(){P.done=true;const S=P.S;if(S)endSession(S);if(st.S===S)st.S=null;P.S=null;setTimeout(()=>{try{if(st.ctx&&!st.S&&st.ctx.state==='running')st.ctx.suspend()}catch(e){}},520)}
  return P}

 /* D-542: the music and the ambience go down under the speech */

/* ===== D-511 · TCK — the drawing kit of the films and the plays: sky by the hour, sun, moon, stars, clouds, the sea, a city skyline, rain and lightning,
   light (glow, beams), and the actors — men and boys with a face that acts (eyes, brows, mouth, blink), arms and legs that move (two-bone IK), clothes and hats. ===== */
var TCK=(function(){
 const TAU=Math.PI*2,cl=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v,lerp=(a,b,u)=>a+(b-a)*u,sm=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u*u*(3-2*u)},seg=(t,a,b)=>cl((t-a)/(b-a),0,1),eio=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u<.5?4*u*u*u:1-Math.pow(-2*u+2,3)/2};
 const HX={};function hx(h){if(HX[h])return HX[h];let s=String(h).replace('#','');if(s.length===3)s=s.split('').map(q=>q+q).join('');const n=parseInt(s.slice(0,6),16)||0;return HX[h]=[n>>16&255,n>>8&255,n&255]}
 function mix(a,b,u){const A=hx(a),B=hx(b);u=cl(u,0,1);return'#'+A.map((v,i)=>Math.round(v+(B[i]-v)*u).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}

 /* keyframes [[t,v1,v2..],..] → values (smooth between keys) */
 function kf(keys,t,ease){ease=ease||sm;if(t<=keys[0][0])return keys[0].slice(1);for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1];if(t<b[0]){const u=ease((t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]));return a.slice(1).map((v,j)=>typeof v==='string'?mix(v,b[j+1],u):lerp(v,b[j+1],u))}}return keys[keys.length-1].slice(1)}
 /* a walker: keys [[t,x,y],..] → {x,y,moving,dir,ph} — the phase of the step comes from the distance walked */
 function walker(keys,stride){stride=stride||46;const segs=[];let acc=0;for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1],d=Math.hypot(b[1]-a[1],(b[2]||0)-(a[2]||0));segs.push({a,b,d,acc});acc+=d}
  return t=>{if(t<=keys[0][0])return{x:keys[0][1],y:keys[0][2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:0};for(const q of segs){if(t<q.b[0]){const u0=(t-q.a[0])/(q.b[0]-q.a[0]),u=lerp(u0,sm(u0),.55),x=lerp(q.a[1],q.b[1],u),y=lerp(q.a[2]||0,q.b[2]||0,u);return{x,y,moving:q.d>1?1:0,dir:Math.sign(q.b[1]-q.a[1]),ph:(q.acc+q.d*u)/stride}}}const L=keys[keys.length-1];return{x:L[1],y:L[2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:acc/stride}}}
