// ---- 4. audit ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function rlMinRadius(pts){let m=1e9;for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){const a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i],c=pts[i+1],ab=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]),bc=Math.hypot(c[0]-b[0],c[1]-b[1]),ca=Math.hypot(a[0]-c[0],a[1]-c[1]),ar=Math.abs((b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(c[0]-a[0])*(b[1]-a[1]))/2;if(ar<1e-6)continue;m=Math.min(m,ab*bc*ca/(4*ar))}return m}
function rlMaxAngle(pts){let m=0;for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){const a=Math.atan2(Math.abs(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0]),Math.abs(pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]));m=Math.max(m,a)}return m}
function rlAudit(){
 const issues=[];
 const need=['Q-BASE','EAST-A','EAST-B','EAST-C','B-LINK','ISL-A1','ISL-A2','ISL-B1','ISL-B2','ISL-X','EAST-B2','EAST-B3','EAST-B4','EAST-N1','B-0','B-STUB','XN','A-0','A-00','A-ARC2','Q-BASE-E','Q-SID-X','Q-SID-XQ','P1','P2','Q2-C','Q2-D1','Q2-D2','Q2-E','X-P1','X-Q2','Q2-LINK','P2-LINK'];
 for(const id of need)if(!RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id])issues.push('no-seg:'+id);
 if(issues.length)return{ok:false,issues};
 // reach: east line leaves the world, island branch ends in G8
 const east=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['EAST-C'],isl=RAIL_NODE_BY_ID['ISL-END'];
 if(east.pts[east.pts.length-1][0]<WORLD.w+300)issues.push('east-line-too-short');
 if(!(isl.x>=8400&&isl.x<=9600&&isl.y>=6900&&isl.y<=7750))issues.push('island-end-outside-H9');   /* S13: תחנת האי ב-H9 (D‑259) */
 if(RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['EAST-A'].pts[0][0]!==RL_COAST_X)issues.push('bridge-not-at-coast');
 // wide arcs
 const arcs=[['A-ARC',350],['A-ARC2',350],['B-LINK',350],['ISL-A1',250],['ISL-B1',190],['P2-LINK',240]];   /* s16c · D‑665: ISL-B1 — הפס הפנימי של הזוג לאי, מקביל לפס א׳ (250) במרחק 3.8 מ׳ מבפנים: 19 מ׳ (לאישורך) */
 for(const [id,min] of arcs){const g=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id],r=rlMinRadius(g.pts);if(r<min)issues.push('arc-too-tight:'+id+':'+r.toFixed(0));
  // RAIL-03: a multi-point arc with a gradual heading (no 45°/90° kink, no single diagonal shortcut)
  let mx=0;for(let i=2;i<g.pts.length;i++){const h0=Math.atan2(g.pts[i-1][1]-g.pts[i-2][1],g.pts[i-1][0]-g.pts[i-2][0]),h1=Math.atan2(g.pts[i][1]-g.pts[i-1][1],g.pts[i][0]-g.pts[i-1][0]);let d=Math.abs(h1-h0);if(d>Math.PI)d=2*Math.PI-d;mx=Math.max(mx,d)}if(g.pts.length<20||mx>3/57.3)issues.push('arc-not-smooth:'+id+':'+(mx*57.3).toFixed(1)+'°')}
 for(const id of['XOVER','XN']){const a=rlMaxAngle(RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id].pts)*57.3;if(a>46)issues.push('crossover-too-steep:'+id+':'+a.toFixed(0))}
 // GATE-75 S2: the horizontal port S-links, measured against their (horizontal) parent tracks
 for(const id of['X-P1','X-Q2','Q2-LINK']){const p=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id].pts;let m=0;for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++)m=Math.max(m,Math.atan2(Math.abs(p[i][1]-p[i-1][1]),Math.abs(p[i][0]-p[i-1][0])));if(m*57.3>46||p.length<20)issues.push('crossover-too-steep:'+id+':'+(m*57.3).toFixed(0))}
 // routes over the real graph
 const routes=[['RB-A-S','Q-E'],['N-B-END','Q-E'],['RB-SP-S','SW-Q'],['Q-E','B-J'],['B-J','ISL-END'],['B-J','ISL-END-B'],['ISL-END','ISL-END-B'],['B-J','EAST-END-N'],['ISL-J','EAST-END'],['B-J','END-B'],['END-B','N-B-END'],['SW-N-B','RB-A-N'],['RB-A-N','SW-LS'],['Q-E','END-Q'],['RB-A-S','P2-W'],['P1-W','Q2-W'],['Q2-W','B-J'],['P1-W','Q-E'],['Q2-W','END-Q']];
 for(const [a,b] of routes)if(!railRoute(a,b))issues.push('no-route:'+a+'>'+b);
 // trains: every leg joins, every stop is consistent with the next run (the rope's tail on arrival is the next run's head on departure)
 let trainsOk=0;
 for(const T of RL_TRAINS){
  if(T.err){issues.push(T.id+':'+T.err);continue}
  for(let k=0;k<T.runs.length;k++){
   const R=T.runs[k],N=T.runs[(k+1)%T.runs.length],endP=rlAt(R.P,R.thru?R.P.len-T.L:R.P.len),startN=rlAt(N.P,0);   /* D‑536: a stop without reversal (thru) — the next run starts at the tail */
   if(Math.hypot(endP.x-startN.x,endP.y-startN.y)>.8)issues.push(T.id+':run'+k+':stop-mismatch:'+Math.hypot(endP.x-startN.x,endP.y-startN.y).toFixed(1));
   const tail=rlAt(R.P,R.thru?R.P.len:R.P.len-T.L),head=rlAt(N.P,T.L);
   if(Math.hypot(tail.x-head.x,tail.y-head.y)>.8)issues.push(T.id+':run'+k+':rope-mismatch:'+Math.hypot(tail.x-head.x,tail.y-head.y).toFixed(1))}
  trainsOk++}
 // the quay stop lies under the E6 cranes
 for(const q of FL_TRAINS.map(rlTrain))if(q&&!q.err){for(const k of[flQuayRun(q)]){const R=q.runs[k],e=rlAt(R.P,R.P.len),tail=rlAt(R.P,R.P.len-q.L);if(e.x<4400||e.x>4560||Math.abs(e.y-PORT_SIDING_Y)>.5)issues.push('quay-stop-off-berth:'+e.x.toFixed(0));if(Math.abs(tail.y-PORT_SIDING_Y)>.5||tail.x>RAIL_NODE_BY_ID['Q-E'].x-30)issues.push('quay-stop-fouls-junction:'+tail.x.toFixed(0))}
  if(q.cars.filter(c=>/^W\d$/.test(c.id)).length!==4)issues.push(q.id+'-not-4-wagons');
  // GATE-76 S1: the Rail–Air stop on T1 — the whole train north of the RB-74 deck
  {const k=q.runs.findIndex(r=>r.stop==='airport'),R=k>=0?q.runs[k]:null;if(!R)issues.push(q.id+'-no-airport-run');else{const tail=rlAt(R.P,R.P.len-q.L);if(tail.y>G74_BRIDGE.y0-8)issues.push('ra-stop-on-deck:'+tail.y.toFixed(0))}}}
 // GATE-75 S2: the C6 work train — work stop on W2 under the C6 crane rail, parking on P1, reversals on W2 clear of the turnouts
 {const sh=rlTrain('SHT-C6'),nd=id=>RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[id];if(!rlTrain('FRT-4')||rlTrain('FRT-4').err)issues.push('no-FRT-4:'+(rlTrain('FRT-4')&&rlTrain('FRT-4').err));if(!sh||sh.err)issues.push('no-SHT-C6');else{
  if(sh.cars.filter(c=>/^W\d$/.test(c.id)).length!==4)issues.push('SHT-C6-not-W1-W4');
  for(let k=0;k<sh.runs.length;k++){const R=sh.runs[k],b=[];for(let u=R.P.len-sh.L;u<=R.P.len+.01;u+=8)b.push(rlAt(R.P,u));const x0=Math.min(...b.map(p=>p.x)),x1=Math.max(...b.map(p=>p.x)),off=y=>b.some(p=>Math.abs(p.y-y)>.5);
   if(R.stop==='work'){if(off(PORT_W2_Y))issues.push('SHT-C6-work-off-W2');if(x0<nd('Q2-W').x+15||x1>PORT_CRANE_RAILS[0].x1-20)issues.push('SHT-C6-work-outside-C6-cranes:'+Math.round(x0)+'-'+Math.round(x1))}
   else if(R.stop==='park'){if(off(PORT_P_Y))issues.push('SHT-C6-park-off-P1');if(x0<nd('P1-W').x+10||x1>nd('P1-SW').x-20)issues.push('SHT-C6-park-not-clear:'+Math.round(x0)+'-'+Math.round(x1))}
   else if(R.stop==='turn'){if(off(PORT_W2_Y))issues.push('SHT-C6-turn-off-W2');if(x0<nd('Q2-X').x+40||x1>nd('Q2-EE').x-40)issues.push('SHT-C6-turn-fouls-turnout:'+Math.round(x0)+'-'+Math.round(x1));if(R.dwell>30)issues.push('SHT-C6-waits-on-W2')}
   else issues.push('SHT-C6-unknown-stop:'+R.stop)}}}
 // RAIL-03 speed contract: sampled on every run of every train — whenever any car touches a flagged arc / crossover the speed is within its limit
 const sp=rlSpeedAudit();if(!sp.ok)issues.push(...sp.issues);
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,12),trains:RL_TRAINS.length,trainsOk,cycles:RL_TRAINS.map(t=>Math.round(t.cycle)),lens:RL_TRAINS.map(t=>Math.round(t.L)),minR:{A_ARC:Math.round(rlMinRadius(RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['A-ARC'].pts)),A_ARC2:Math.round(rlMinRadius(RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['A-ARC2'].pts)),P2_LINK:Math.round(rlMinRadius(RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['P2-LINK'].pts)),B_LINK:Math.round(rlMinRadius(RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['B-LINK'].pts)),ISL_ARC:Math.round(Math.min(rlMinRadius(RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['ISL-A1'].pts),rlMinRadius(RAIL_SEG_BY_ID['ISL-B1'].pts)))}   /* D‑634: הפס הצר מבין שני הפסים לאי */,speed:rlSpeedAudit().summary,eastEnd:east.pts[east.pts.length-1][0]}}
// RAIL-03 speed contract check (pure: re-samples the timetable). For every run: the speed on the restricted zones never exceeds the limit,
// the train is down to the limit before the head enters and does not speed up until the tail has left.
function rlSpeedAudit(step=.25){
 const issues=[],summary={};
 for(const T of RL_TRAINS){if(T.err)continue;let maxIn=0,samples=0,zones=0;
  for(let k=0;k<T.runs.length;k++){const R=T.runs[k],lim=R.prof.lim;zones+=lim.length;let prevV=0,prevIn=false;
   for(let t=0;t<=R.tm;t+=step){const q=rlProfAt(R.prof,t),u=T.L+q.d;samples++;
    let cap=Infinity;for(const [s0,s1,vm] of lim)if(u>s0+.5&&u-T.L<s1-.5)cap=Math.min(cap,vm);
    if(cap<Infinity){maxIn=Math.max(maxIn,q.v/cap);if(q.v>cap+.6)issues.push(T.id+':run'+k+':over-limit:'+q.v.toFixed(1)+'>'+cap+'@'+t.toFixed(1))}
    prevV=q.v}}
  summary[T.id]={zones,samples,maxSpeedVsLimit:+maxIn.toFixed(3),runTimes:T.runs.map(r=>+r.tm.toFixed(1))}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,6),summary}}
// heavy: sweep two cycles; cars never overlap each other or the standing stock, and always stay on the track (harness only)
function rlSweepAudit(step=.5,cycles=2){
 const issues=[];let n=0,minGap=1e9;
 const stock=[];for(const o of[...PORT_STOCK,...RAIL_STOCK]){const p=railPointAt(o.seg,o.s);if(!p)continue;stock.push({id:o.id,x:p.x,y:p.y,h:p.heading,l:rlCarLen(o.asset),w:FREIGHT_W})}
 const T0=Math.max(...RL_TRAINS.map(t=>t.cycle))*cycles;
 for(let t=0;t<T0;t+=step){
  const snap=RL_TRAINS.filter(T=>!T.err).map(T=>({T,cars:rlCars(rlState(T,t*1000))}));
  for(let i=0;i<snap.length;i++){
   const A=snap[i].cars;
   for(let a=0;a<A.length;a++){
    // inside the same train neighbours keep their coupling gap
    for(let b=a+1;b<A.length;b++)if(rlObbHit({...rlObb(A[a])},{...rlObb(A[b])},-1))issues.push('self-overlap:'+A[a].id+'/'+A[b].id+'@'+t);
    for(let j=i+1;j<snap.length;j++)for(const c of snap[j].cars){if(c.x>G76_VIS_X||A[a].x>G76_VIS_X)continue;if(rlObbHit(rlObb(A[a]),rlObb(c),3))issues.push('train-train:'+A[a].id+'/'+c.id+'@'+t)}
    for(const s of stock)if(rlObbHit(rlObb(A[a]),s,3))issues.push('train-stock:'+A[a].id+'/'+s.id+'@'+t);
    n++}}
  if(issues.length>8)break}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,8),samples:n,span:T0}}

// ==== GATE-75 S2 · PORT-06 / D-16 / K-14 / RAIL-06 / QA-48: the four port tracks ============================================================
// the future sea train FRT-3 (D-01: loco + 7 container wagons, ≈ 1432 px) and the margin a standing train keeps to a turnout / buffer
const PORT_FRT3_LEN=rlCarLen('RL-FR-01')+7*rlCarLen('RL-FR-05')+7*RL_GAP,PORT_FIT_M=40,PORT_TURNBACK_GUARD_Y=3360;
// clear runs of a horizontal track: the stretches between consecutive turnouts / buffers / track ends (chunk boundaries and joints do not cut)
function portClearRuns(t){const xs=[];let lo=1e9,hi=-1e9;for(const id of t.segs){const g=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id];if(!g)continue;for(const p of g.pts){lo=Math.min(lo,p[0]);hi=Math.max(hi,p[0])}for(const nid of[g.from,g.to]){const n=RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[nid];if(n&&(n.type==='turnout'||n.type==='buffer'))xs.push(n.x)}}
 xs.push(lo,hi);const u=[...new Set(xs.map(x=>+x.toFixed(2)))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),runs=[];for(let i=1;i<u.length;i++)runs.push([u[i-1],u[i]]);return{lo,hi,runs}}
// which segments a standing train covers at the end of a run (from the legs of the run)
function rlStopSegs(Tr,R){let s=0;const out=[];for(const [id,A,B] of R.legs){const g=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id],a=A==='S'?0:A==='E'?g.len:A,b=B==='S'?0:B==='E'?g.len:B,d=Math.abs(b-a);if(s+d>R.P.len-Tr.L+.5&&s<R.P.len-.5)out.push(id);s+=d}return out}
// dyn > 0: sweep that many cycles of the longest train (step s) — no two trains / train and parked stock overlap, and the way ahead of every
// moving train (head -> end of its run) is free of every other train and of the parked stock: a passing or a working train is never blocked
function portTrackAudit(dyn=0,step=1){
 const issues=[],qa=[],T=PORT_TRACKS,seg=id=>RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[id],node=id=>RAIL_NODE_BY_ID[id],tracks={};
 if(T.length!==4||T.filter(t=>t.use==='work').length!==2||T.filter(t=>t.use==='park').length!==2)issues.push('not-2-work-2-park');
 // 1. straight and flush at their own line, inside the crane portal (bed clear of the crane-rail legs y 5030-5046 / 5184-5200)
 const tk={};for(const t of T){const r=portClearRuns(t);tk[t.id]={...t,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,runs:r.runs,clear:Math.max(0,...r.runs.map(q=>q[1]-q[0]))};
  for(const id of t.segs){const g=seg(id);if(!g){issues.push(t.id+':no-seg:'+id);continue}if(g.pts.length!==2||g.pts.some(p=>Math.abs(p[1]-t.y)>.01))issues.push(t.id+':not-straight:'+id);if(!PORT_FLUSH_SEGS.has(id))issues.push(t.id+':not-flush:'+id)}
  if(t.y-21<PORT_RAIL_L+8||t.y+21>PORT_RAIL_W-8)issues.push(t.id+':bed-on-crane-rail-legs');
  tracks[t.id]={use:t.use,y:t.y,x:[Math.round(r.lo),Math.round(r.hi)],clear:Math.round(tk[t.id].clear)}}
 // 2. two tracks side by side are ≥ 36 px apart (a wagon is FREIGHT_W = 29 px wide: ≥ 7 px between two wagons)
 const ids=Object.keys(tk);let minSp=1e9;for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<ids.length;j++){const a=tk[ids[i]],b=tk[ids[j]];if(a.lo<b.hi&&b.lo<a.hi){const d=Math.abs(a.y-b.y);minSp=Math.min(minSp,d);if(d<36)issues.push('spacing:'+a.id+'/'+b.id+':'+d)}}
 // 3. RAIL-06 / D-01: each work track has one clear run for FRT-3 + 40 px at either end, and lies under a crane rail
 const need3=PORT_FRT3_LEN+2*PORT_FIT_M;
 for(const t of Object.values(tk).filter(t=>t.use==='work')){if(!t.runs.some(q=>q[1]-q[0]>=need3))qa.push(t.id+':too-short-for-FRT-3:'+Math.round(t.clear)+'<'+Math.round(need3));
  const cov=PORT_CRANE_RAILS.reduce((s,c)=>s+Math.max(0,Math.min(c.x1,t.hi)-Math.max(c.x0,t.lo)),0);tracks[t.id].craneRail=Math.round(cov);if(cov<900)issues.push(t.id+':not-under-a-crane-rail')}
 // 4. the parking tracks hold what waits on them (+ 15 px to the buffer, + 20 px to the joint)
 const sh=rlTrain('SHT-C6'),shL=sh&&!sh.err?sh.L:1e9;
 const p2L=(()=>{const st=PORT_STOCK.filter(o=>T.find(t=>t.id==='P2').segs.includes(o.seg));return st.reduce((s,o)=>s+rlCarLen(o.asset),0)+Math.max(0,st.length-1)*PORT_COUPLE})();
 if(tk.P1.clear<shL+35)qa.push('P1-too-short-for-SHT-C6:'+Math.round(tk.P1.clear)+'<'+Math.round(shL+35));tracks.P1.holds='SHT-C6 '+Math.round(shL)+' px';
 if(tk.P2.clear<p2L+35)qa.push('P2-too-short-for-the-D6-train');tracks.P2.holds='STK-D6 '+Math.round(p2L)+' px';
 // 5. connections: every track reaches main A, main B (east line + B link) and the east line; P1 reaches both work tracks
 const routes=[['RB-A-S','Q-X'],['Q-X','B-J'],['Q-X','END-B'],['RB-A-S','Q2-W'],['Q2-W','B-J'],['Q2-W','END-B'],['P1-W','Q-E'],['P1-W','Q2-W'],['P1-W','B-J'],['RB-A-S','P2-W'],['P2-W','B-J'],['P2-W','END-B']];
 for(const [a,b] of routes)if(!railRoute(a,b))issues.push('no-route:'+a+'>'+b);
 // 6. parked stock only on the parking tracks; both work tracks are served by STS cranes (the wagon positions lie on them)
 const parkSegs=new Set(T.filter(t=>t.use==='park').flatMap(t=>t.segs)),workSegs=new Set(T.filter(t=>t.use==='work').flatMap(t=>t.segs));
 for(const o of PORT_STOCK)if(!parkSegs.has(o.seg))issues.push(o.id+':parked-off-the-parking-tracks');
 const sl=flWagonSlots();if(sl.E6.length!==4||!sl.E6.every(w=>Math.abs(w.y-tk.W1.y)<.6))issues.push('E6-wagon-positions-not-on-W1');if(sl.C6.length!==4||!sl.C6.every(w=>Math.abs(w.y-tk.W2.y)<.6))issues.push('C6-wagon-positions-not-on-W2');
 // 7. QA-48 stops: a wait (> 30 s) on the port rail is a work stop on a work track or a wait on a parking track; no train waits on a main;
 //    a standing train covers no turnout (≥ 20 px clear) and stands ≥ 10 px from a buffer (no train is sent to a track shorter than itself)
 const turnouts=RAIL_NODES.filter(n=>n.type==='turnout'),ends=RAIL_NODES.filter(n=>n.type==='buffer'||n.type==='terminus'),stops=[];
 for(const Tr of RL_TRAINS){if(Tr.err){qa.push(Tr.id+':'+Tr.err);continue}
  for(let k=0;k<Tr.runs.length;k++){const R=Tr.runs[k],segs=rlStopSegs(Tr,R),b=[];for(let u=R.P.len-Tr.L;u<=R.P.len+.01;u+=4)b.push(rlAt(R.P,u));
   const port=segs.every(id=>seg(id).port),onMain=segs.some(id=>/^MAIN-/.test(seg(id).track)),onWork=segs.every(id=>workSegs.has(id)),onPark=segs.every(id=>parkSegs.has(id));
   let cls=onWork?'work-track':onPark?'parking-track':onMain?'main':port?'port':'line';
   /* D‑536: a passenger train at a station platform stands on the main by design; the coast platform (map: y 2700–3560) holds XN's turnout and the port platform the
      crossover's — the block plan keeps every other train off them while it stands there (tcRailPaxAudit) */
   const paxSt=(!!Tr.pax||!!Tr.passenger)&&R.stop==='station'; /* S16ג: גם רכבת האי RL-PS-02 עומדת ברציף תחנה */
   if(R.dwell>30&&!paxSt){if(onMain)qa.push(Tr.id+':'+R.stop+':waits-on-a-main');else if(port&&!((onWork&&(R.stop==='quay'||R.stop==='work'))||onPark))qa.push(Tr.id+':'+R.stop+':waits-off-work/parking-tracks')}
   if(onWork&&R.dwell>30&&R.stop!=='quay'&&R.stop!=='work')qa.push(Tr.id+':'+R.stop+':parks-on-a-work-track');
   let tMin=1e9,tN='',eMin=1e9;for(const p of b){for(const n of turnouts){const d=Math.hypot(p.x-n.x,p.y-n.y);if(d<tMin){tMin=d;tN=n.id}}for(const n of ends)eMin=Math.min(eMin,Math.hypot(p.x-n.x,p.y-n.y))}
   if(tMin<20&&!paxSt)qa.push(Tr.id+':'+R.stop+':stands-on-turnout:'+tN+':'+tMin.toFixed(0));if(eMin<10)qa.push(Tr.id+':'+R.stop+':into-the-buffer');
   stops.push({train:Tr.id,stop:R.stop,dwell:R.dwell,on:cls,segs:segs.join('+'),turnout:Math.round(tMin)+'@'+tN})}}
 for(const o of PORT_STOCK){const p=railPointAt(o.seg,o.s),h=rlCarLen(o.asset)/2;for(const n of turnouts)if(Math.hypot(p.x-n.x,p.y-n.y)<h+20)qa.push(o.id+':parked-on-turnout:'+n.id)}
 // 8. the fence along main A keeps ≥ 24 px from every port track centre line

function rlpDoors(S){/* the doors on the platform side whose door lies on the platform (selective door operation where the platform is short) */

 for(const c of rlCars(S)){const ux=Math.cos(c.heading),uy=Math.sin(c.heading),nx=-uy,ny=ux,pc=(p[0]+p[2])/2,sd=Math.sign((pc-c.x)*nx+0*ny)||1;
  for(const f of[-.3,.3]){const dx=c.x+ux*f*c.car.len,dy=c.y+uy*f*c.car.len;if(dy<p[1]+6||dy>p[3]-6)continue;out.push({car:c.id,x:dx+nx*sd*11.2,y:dy+ny*sd*11.2,ux,uy,nx:nx*sd,ny:ny*sd})}}
 return out}
function rlpDoorsOpen(S){if(!S||S.moving||!RLP.stops[S.R.at])return 0;if(S.type==='N')return 0;const o=Math.min(1,(S.dwellDone-2)/1.5),c=Math.min(1,(S.dwellLeft-4)/1.5);return Math.max(0,Math.min(o,c))}
/* the passengers of one stop: alighting from the doors to the platform's way out, boarding from the way out to the doors */
function rlpPeople(S){const st=RLP.stops[S.R.at];if(!st||S.moving||S.type==='N')return[];const D=rlpDoors(S);if(!D.length)return[];
 const alight=S.R.at==='e3'?(S.type==='S'):!S.R.first,board=S.R.at==='e3'?true:!S.R.last,px=(st.plat[0]+st.plat[2])/2,out=[],v=11,seed=(S.slot*7+S.k*3)&1023;
 const path=(d)=>[[d.x,d.y],[px,d.y],[px,st.acc[1]],st.acc];
 const plen=P=>{let L=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)L+=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);return L};
 const at=(P,d)=>{for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const l=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);if(d<=l||i===P.length-1){const f=l?Math.min(1,d/l):0;return{x:P[i-1][0]+(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0])*f,y:P[i-1][1]+(P[i][1]-P[i-1][1])*f,h:Math.atan2(P[i][1]-P[i-1][1],P[i][0]-P[i-1][0])}}d-=l}return{x:P[0][0],y:P[0][1],h:0}};
 const [na,nb]=st.n,open=rlpDoorsOpen(S);
 for(let i=0;i<na&&alight;i++){const d=D[(i*3+seed)%D.length],P=path(d),L=plen(P),t=S.dwellDone-3-i*2.2;if(t<0||open<=0&&t<.5)continue;const s=t*v;if(s>=L)continue;const q=at(P,s);out.push({id:'RLP-ALIGHT-'+S.R.at+'-'+i,x:q.x,y:q.y,h:q.h,l:RLP_LOOKS[(i+seed)%RLP_LOOKS.length],d:s})}
 for(let i=0;i<nb&&board;i++){const d=D[(i*3+seed+1)%D.length],P=path(d).reverse(),L=plen(P),tEnd=S.dwellLeft-6-i*1.8,s=L-tEnd*v;if(s<0||s>=L||tEnd<0)continue;const q=at(P,s);out.push({id:'RLP-BOARD-'+S.R.at+'-'+i,x:q.x,y:q.y,h:q.h,l:RLP_LOOKS[(i+seed+2)%RLP_LOOKS.length],d:s})}
 return out}

/* ---- the check (D‑536): the geometry, the stops inside the platforms, and one whole game day of all the trains — no two trains in a block, no jump,
   no train standing more than 60 s outside a station, a stop or a signal ---- */
function tcRailPaxAudit(o={}){const out={ok:true,issues:[],err:RLP.err,plan:RLP.plan};const iss=s=>{out.issues.push(s);out.ok=false};rlpEnsure();const T=rlTrain(RLP.id);

  (out.stops=out.stops||{})[ty+':'+R.at]=[Math.round(y0),Math.round(y1),rlpDoors({...S,R}).length];if(R.at!=='port'&&(y0<p[1]-.5||y1>p[3]+.5))iss('train-off-platform:'+R.at+':'+Math.round(y0)+'-'+Math.round(y1));if(!rlpDoors({...S,R}).length)iss('no-door-on-platform:'+R.at)}
 /* one game day: every train, every 0.5 s */
 const pax={n:0,max:0,off:0,where:[]},day=1440/G84_CLOCK.rate*(o.days||1),dt=o.dt||.5,w0=o.w0!=null?o.w0:Math.ceil(SIM_LOOP&&SIM_LOOP.simNow?SIM_LOOP.simNow/1000:0),prev={},open={},long=[],types={},shared={},firstDep=[],lastArr=[];let samples=0;
 for(let w=w0;w<=w0+day;w+=dt){samples++;const occ={};
  for(const Q of RL_TRAINS){if(Q.err)continue;const S=rlState(Q,w*1000);if(!S)continue;for(const b of g76Blocks(S))(occ[b]=occ[b]||[]).push(Q.id);
   const cs=rlCars(S);if(prev[Q.id])for(let i=0;i<cs.length;i++){const p=prev[Q.id][i];if(Math.hypot(cs[i].x-p.x,cs[i].y-p.y)>RL_V*dt+2){iss('jump:'+cs[i].id+'@'+w.toFixed(1));break}}prev[Q.id]=cs.map(c=>({x:c.x,y:c.y}));
   if(!S.moving){if(!open[Q.id])open[Q.id]={w,stop:S.R.stop,at:S.R.at||S.R.to}}else if(open[Q.id]){const s=open[Q.id];if(w-s.w>60&&!['airport','quay','work','park','border','beyond','station','turn'].includes(s.stop))long.push([Q.id,s.stop,Math.round(w-s.w)]);open[Q.id]=null}
   if(Q===T){types[S.type]=(types[S.type]||0)+dt/(T.cycle/2);
    /* the passengers: every one on the platform of the stop (or at the door, beside the car) — never on a road */
    const PP=rlpPeople(S);if(PP.length){pax.n+=PP.length;pax.max=Math.max(pax.max,PP.length);const st=RLP.stops[S.R.at],p=st.plat;for(const q of PP){const inP=q.x>=p[0]-2&&q.x<=p[2]+2&&q.y>=p[1]-2&&q.y<=p[3]+2,atDoor=Math.abs(q.x-(p[0]+p[2])/2)<40&&q.y>=p[1]-2&&q.y<=p[3]+2;if(!inP&&!atDoor){pax.off++;if(pax.where.length<4)pax.where.push(q.id+'@'+Math.round(q.x)+','+Math.round(q.y))}}}}}
  for(const [b,L] of Object.entries(occ))if(L.length>1){const k=b+':'+L.join('+');shared[k]=(shared[k]||0)+1;if(!out.firstShared)out.firstShared=k+'@'+w.toFixed(1)}}

 for(let j=j0;j<j0+Math.ceil(day/H)+1;j++){const ty=rlpType(T,j),w=rlpSlotW(T,j);if(ty!=='S')tt.push([ty,hh(w)]);}
 /* the level crossings (LX-1 / LX-2 at x 6060 on the coast road, the cargo lane at y 700): they close for every train of rlSnap; the passenger train's paths never reach them */
 {let xm=-1e9,ym=1e9;for(const P of Object.values(T.pat))for(const R of P.runs)for(const p of R.P.pts){xm=Math.max(xm,p[0]);ym=Math.min(ym,p[1])}out.lx={pathXmax:Math.round(xm),pathYmin:Math.round(ym),lxX:(typeof P684LX!=='undefined'?P684LX.x:null),cargoLaneY:(typeof G76_XING!=='undefined'?G76_XING.y:null),crosses:0};
  if(typeof P684LX!=='undefined'&&xm>=P684LX.x-P684LX.hw)out.lx.crosses++;if(typeof G76_XING!=='undefined'&&ym<=G76_XING.y)out.lx.crosses++}

 out.runTimes=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(T.pat).map(([k,P])=>[k,P.runs.map(r=>[r.at,+r.tm.toFixed(1),+r.dwell.toFixed(1)])]));
 out.issues=out.issues.slice(0,16);return out}

function rliInPoly(P,x,y){let c=false;for(let i=0,j=P.length-1;i<P.length;j=i++){const a=P[i],b=P[j];if((a[1]>y)!==(b[1]>y)&&x<(b[0]-a[0])*(y-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1])+a[0])c=!c}return c}
function rliDoors(S){const st=RLI.stops[S.R.at],P=rliPlatPoly(S.R.at);if(!st||!P)return[];const out=[];let cx=0,cy=0;for(const p of P){cx+=p[0];cy+=p[1]}cx/=P.length;cy/=P.length;
 for(const c of rlCars(S)){const ux=Math.cos(c.heading),uy=Math.sin(c.heading),nx=-uy,ny=ux,sd=Math.sign((cx-c.x)*nx+(cy-c.y)*ny)||1;
  for(const f of[-.3,.3]){const dx=c.x+ux*f*c.car.len,dy=c.y+uy*f*c.car.len,x=dx+nx*sd*11.2,y=dy+ny*sd*11.2;if(!rliInPoly(P,x+nx*sd*20,y+ny*sd*20))continue;   /* the platform edge is ~26 px from the track centre; the door — 11.2 */out.push({car:c.id,x,y,ux,uy,nx:nx*sd,ny:ny*sd})}}return out}
function rliDoorsOpen(S){if(!S||S.moving||!RLI.stops[S.R.at])return 0;const o=Math.min(1,(S.dwellDone-2)/1.5),c=Math.min(1,(S.dwellLeft-4)/1.5);return Math.max(0,Math.min(o,c))}

function rliWaiting(T,now){const st=RLI.stops.island,R0=T.runs[0],R1=T.runs[1],C=T.cycle,tt=now/1000+T.off,tc=((tt%C)+C)%C,since=((tc-R1.t0)%C+C)%C,toArr=((R0.t1-tc)%C+C)%C,out=[];if(!rliSvc())return out;

 return out}

function rliAudit(){const issues=[],T=rlTrain(RLI.id);if(RLI.err)issues.push('err:'+RLI.err);if(!T){issues.push('no-train');return{ok:false,issues}}
 for(const R of T.runs){const S={T,R,u:R.P.len,fwd:true,moving:false,dwellDone:10,dwellLeft:10,g:0},cs=rlCars(S),P=rliPlatPoly(R.at);if(!P){issues.push('no-platform:'+R.at);continue}
  for(const c of cs){const ux=Math.cos(c.heading),uy=Math.sin(c.heading);for(const f of[-.45,.45]){let inside=false;for(const sd of[-1,1])if(rliInPoly(P,c.x+ux*f*c.car.len-uy*sd*34,c.y+uy*f*c.car.len+ux*sd*34))inside=true;if(!inside)issues.push('car-off-platform:'+R.at)}}

 for(const q of RL_TRAINS){if(q.err||q.pax||q.passenger)continue;for(const R of q.runs||[])for(const l of R.legs||[])if(/^ISL-/.test(l[0]))issues.push('freight-to-island:'+q.id)}   /* D‑23 */

 try{const P=rliPlatPoly('island');for(const B of RLI_ST.benches)if(!rliInPoly(P,B.p[0],B.p[1]))issues.push('bench-off-platform');for(const p of RLI_ST.bins)if(!rliInPoly(P,p[0],p[1]))issues.push('bin-off-platform')}catch(e){issues.push('furniture:'+e.message)}

// ===== PORT FLOW · v1.92 ===========================================================================================================================
// One schedule for the whole container business: ships, cranes, road trucks and freight wagons.  Everything is a pure function of the clock
// (nothing is saved): a ship CALL is planned once (stacks on deck, which box goes where, which crane does it when) and then replayed.
//   unload  : crane lifts the top box of a stack  -> a truck standing in the quay-road lane (or a wagon on the siding)
//   load    : crane lifts the box off a truck/wagon -> places it on the next free tier of a stack
// Trucks drive the REAL road graph (lane centres, the engine's own turn curves), stop under the boom, and go back to the city (E6: the E5
// logistics warehouse) or to the C6 gate (the road that C5 will join).  C6 trucks also visit the yard (ledger +/-1 box, tiers drawn live).
const FL_PRE={C6:96,E6:74};                        // seconds of the first call that have already elapsed when the game starts
const FL_V={VC:60,ACC:18,DEC:20,LAT:34,GANTRY:90,TROLLEY:130};
const FL_YARD_DWELL=4,FL_BOX_DX=PORT_TRUCK_BOX_DX;
const FL_STAND={   // bx: x of the box centre while the truck stands; dir: +1 east / -1 west
 'E6-CR1':{bx:4969,dir:-1,y:4938},'E6-CR2':{bx:5365,dir:1,y:4982},
 'C6-CR1':{bx:2831,dir:-1,y:4938},'C6-CR2':{bx:3063,dir:1,y:4982},'C6-CR3':{bx:3346,dir:-1,y:4938}};   // GATE-75: quay road y 4960
const flClamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
function flBin(arr,v){let lo=0,hi=arr.length-1,r=-1;while(lo<=hi){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(arr[m]<=v){r=m;lo=m+1}else hi=m-1}return r}
const flEdgeLen=e=>Math.hypot(byNode[e.b].x-byNode[e.a].x,byNode[e.b].y-byNode[e.a].y);

// ---- 1. routes on the real road graph ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const FL_CAR={id:'FL-ROUTE',dirSign:1,targetSpeed:48,kind:'truck',ref:'SemiLong',asset:'LV-SM-01'};
function flTok(t){const dir=t.endsWith('-')?-1:1,e=byEdge[t.slice(0,-1)];if(!e)throw new Error('flow: no edge '+t);return{e,dir}}
function flLeg(toks,tA,tB){
 const ds=toks.map(flTok),out=[];
 for(let i=0;i<ds.length-1;i++){const n1=ds[i].dir>0?ds[i].e.b:ds[i].e.a,n2=ds[i+1].dir>0?ds[i+1].e.a:ds[i+1].e.b;if(n1!==n2)throw new Error('flow: '+toks[i]+' does not join '+toks[i+1])}
 const push=(x,y)=>{const l=out[out.length-1];if(!l||Math.hypot(l[0]-x,l[1]-y)>.25)out.push([x,y])};
 let ta=tA;
 for(let i=0;i<ds.length;i++){
  const {e,dir}=ds[i],last=i===ds.length-1;let plan=null;
  if(!last){FL_CAR.dirSign=dir;plan=trafficPlanTo(FL_CAR,e,{edge:ds[i+1].e,dirSign:ds[i+1].dir});if(!plan)throw new Error('flow: no turn '+toks[i])}
  const tb=last?tB:plan.ts,n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.abs(tb-ta)*flEdgeLen(e)/5));
  for(let j=0;j<=n;j++){const p=trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dir,ta+(tb-ta)*j/n,0);push(p.x,p.y)}
  if(plan){
   const nx=plan.next,g=plan.rightGeom,from=g?.from||trafficEdgePoint(e.id,dir,plan.ts,plan.sourceLane||0),to=g?.to||trafficEdgePoint(nx.edge.id,nx.dirSign,plan.te,plan.nextLane||0);
   let c1,c2;if(g){c1=g.c1;c2=g.c2}else{const chord=Math.hypot(to.x-from.x,to.y-from.y),k=Math.max(8,chord*.39);c1={x:from.x+Math.cos(from.heading)*k,y:from.y+Math.sin(from.heading)*k};c2={x:to.x-Math.cos(to.heading)*k,y:to.y-Math.sin(to.heading)*k}}
   for(let j=1;j<=16;j++){const t=j/16,u=1-t;push(u*u*u*from.x+3*u*u*t*c1.x+3*u*t*t*c2.x+t*t*t*to.x,u*u*u*from.y+3*u*u*t*c1.y+3*u*t*t*c2.y+t*t*t*to.y)}
   ta=plan.te}
 }
 return out;
}

const FL_C6_FAM={};
const FL_ROUTES=new Map();
function flRoute(key){
 let R=FL_ROUTES.get(key);if(R)return R;
 const sp=FL_SPEC[key];if(!sp)throw new Error('flow: no route '+key);
 const pts=[],hidden=[];let jumpAt=-1;
 sp.legs.forEach((lg,i)=>{const leg=flLeg(lg.toks,lg.tA,lg.tB);if(i>0)jumpAt=pts.length;for(const p of leg)pts.push(p)});
 const n=pts.length,x=new Float32Array(n),y=new Float32Array(n),s=new Float32Array(n),h=new Float32Array(n);
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){x[i]=pts[i][0];y[i]=pts[i][1];s[i]=i?s[i-1]+Math.hypot(x[i]-x[i-1],y[i]-y[i-1]):0}
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=Math.max(0,i-1),b=Math.min(n-1,i+1);h[i]=Math.atan2(y[b]-y[a],x[b]-x[a])}
 if(jumpAt>0){hidden.push([s[jumpAt-1],s[jumpAt]]);h[jumpAt-1]=h[jumpAt-2];h[jumpAt]=h[jumpAt+1]}
 R={key,sp,n,x,y,s,h,L:s[n-1],hidden,stops:[],seg:[]};
 // stops: snap to the polyline
 const nearest=(px,py,from=0)=>{let bi=-1,bd=1e18;for(let i=from;i<n;i++){const d=(x[i]-px)**2+(y[i]-py)**2;if(d<bd){bd=d;bi=i}}return bi};
 let from=0;
 for(const st of sp.stops){
  let px=st.x,py=st.y;
  if(st.k==='stand'){const i0=nearest(st.bx,st.y,from);px=st.bx-Math.cos(h[i0])*FL_BOX_DX;py=y[i0]}
  const i=nearest(px,py,from);from=i+1;
  const o={k:st.k,i,s:s[i],x:x[i],y:y[i],h:h[i],name:st.k+':'+key};
  if(st.k==='stand'){o.bx=x[i]+Math.cos(h[i])*FL_BOX_DX;o.by=y[i]+Math.sin(h[i])*FL_BOX_DX}
  R.stops.push(o)}
 // speed limit along the polyline: straight cruise, slower in curves
 const vlim=new Float32Array(n).fill(FL_V.VC);
 for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){let dh=Math.abs(h[i+1]-h[i-1]);if(dh>Math.PI)dh=2*Math.PI-dh;const ds=Math.max(.5,s[i+1]-s[i-1]);if(dh>.02)vlim[i]=flClamp(Math.sqrt(FL_V.LAT/(dh/ds)),14,FL_V.VC)}
 for(let r=0;r<2;r++)for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){const m=Math.min(vlim[i-1],vlim[i],vlim[i+1]);if(m<vlim[i])vlim[i]=(vlim[i]+m)/2}
 const bounds=[0,...R.stops.map(q=>q.i),n-1];
 for(let b=0;b<bounds.length-1;b++){
  const i0=bounds[b],i1=bounds[b+1],m=i1-i0,v=new Float32Array(m+1),T=new Float32Array(m+1);
  for(let i=0;i<=m;i++)v[i]=vlim[i0+i];v[0]=0;v[m]=0;
  for(let i=1;i<=m;i++){const ds=s[i0+i]-s[i0+i-1];v[i]=Math.min(v[i],Math.sqrt(v[i-1]*v[i-1]+2*FL_V.ACC*ds))}
  for(let i=m-1;i>=0;i--){const ds=s[i0+i+1]-s[i0+i];v[i]=Math.min(v[i],Math.sqrt(v[i+1]*v[i+1]+2*FL_V.DEC*ds))}
  for(let i=1;i<=m;i++){const ds=s[i0+i]-s[i0+i-1];T[i]=T[i-1]+2*ds/(v[i-1]+v[i]+1e-6)}
  R.seg.push({i0,i1,T,dur:T[m]})}
 FL_ROUTES.set(key,R);return R;
}
// local time (seconds since the truck started) -> arclength; dw[k] = dwell at stop k
function flRouteS(R,tau,dw){
 let t=tau;
 for(let k=0;k<R.seg.length;k++){
  const g=R.seg[k];
  if(t<=g.dur){const j=Math.min(g.T.length-2,Math.max(0,flBin(g.T,t))),t0=g.T[j],t1=g.T[j+1],f=t1>t0?(t-t0)/(t1-t0):0;return R.s[g.i0+j]+(R.s[g.i0+j+1]-R.s[g.i0+j])*flClamp(f,0,1)}
  t-=g.dur;
  if(k<R.stops.length){const w=dw[k];if(t<=w)return R.s[g.i1];t-=w}
 }
 return R.L;
}
function flRouteDur(R,dw){let d=0;for(let k=0;k<R.seg.length;k++){d+=R.seg[k].dur;if(k<R.stops.length)d+=dw[k]}return d}
// local times at which the truck stands at stop k: [arrive, depart]
function flStopTimes(R,dw){const out=[];let t=0;for(let k=0;k<R.stops.length;k++){t+=R.seg[k].dur;out.push([t,t+dw[k]]);t+=dw[k]}return out}
function flPoseAtS(R,s){
 const i=Math.min(R.n-2,Math.max(0,flBin(R.s,s))),d=R.s[i+1]-R.s[i],f=d>1e-6?flClamp((s-R.s[i])/d,0,1):0;
 const C=R.__cs||g77FlCs(R),ca=C[2*i],sa=C[2*i+1],cb=C[2*i+2],sb=C[2*i+3];   /* D-220 · p292 */
 return{x:R.x[i]+(R.x[i+1]-R.x[i])*f,y:R.y[i]+(R.y[i+1]-R.y[i])*f,h:Math.atan2(sa+(sb-sa)*f,ca+(cb-ca)*f)}
}
function flAlphaAtS(R,s){
 let a=Math.min(1,s/26,(R.L-s)/26);
 for(const [h0,h1] of R.hidden)a=Math.min(a,flClamp(Math.max(h0-s,s-h1)/22,0,1));
 return flClamp(a,0,1)}

// ---- 2. trucks: timetable actors ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
let FL_TID=0;
function flMakeTruck(R,aStand,dwStand,o){
 const dw=R.stops.map(st=>st.k==='stand'?dwStand:FL_YARD_DWELL),st=flStopTimes(R,dw),si=R.stops.findIndex(q=>q.k==='stand'),t0=aStand-st[si][0];
 const tr={id:'FL-TRK-'+(++FL_TID),R,dw,t0,dur:flRouteDur(R,dw),stopT:st.map(q=>[q[0]+t0,q[1]+t0]),color:o.color||0,kind:o.kind,box:o.box||null,cargo:[],berth:R.sp.berth,sm:null};
 return tr;
}
function flTruckAt(tr,t){
 const tau=t-tr.t0;if(tau<-.001||tau>tr.dur+.001)return null;
 const s=flRouteS(tr.R,tau,tr.dw),p=flPoseAtS(tr.R,s);p.a=flAlphaAtS(tr.R,s);p.s=s;return p}
function flTruckBox(tr,t){for(const c of tr.cargo)if(t>=c.a&&t<c.b)return c.box;return null}
// poses on a 0.5 s grid for conflict tests
const FL_GRID=.5;
function flSamples(tr){
 if(tr.sm)return tr.sm;
 const k0=Math.ceil(tr.t0/FL_GRID),k1=Math.floor((tr.t0+tr.dur)/FL_GRID),n=Math.max(0,k1-k0+1),sm={k0,k1,x:new Float32Array(n),y:new Float32Array(n),h:new Float32Array(n),a:new Float32Array(n)};
 if(g77Fls().on){sm.f=new Uint8Array(n);g77Fls().made++}else for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const p=flTruckAt(tr,(k0+i)*FL_GRID);sm.x[i]=p.x;sm.y[i]=p.y;sm.h[i]=p.h;sm.a[i]=p.a}   /* D-220 · p292: the poses when asked */
 tr.sm=sm;return sm}
const FL_SHAPE=(x,y,h)=>vehicleCollisionShape('LV-SM-01','SemiLong',x,y,h);
function flConflict(a,b,pad=7){
 if(a.t0>b.t0+b.dur||b.t0>a.t0+a.dur)return false;
 const A=flSamples(a),B=flSamples(b),k0=Math.max(A.k0,B.k0),k1=Math.min(A.k1,B.k1);
 for(let k=k0;k<=k1;k++){
  const i=k-A.k0,j=k-B.k0;if(A.f&&!A.f[i])g77FlsAt(A,a,i);if(B.f&&!B.f[j])g77FlsAt(B,b,j);   /* D-220 · p292 */
  if(A.a[i]<.05||B.a[j]<.05)continue;
  if(Math.abs(A.x[i]-B.x[j])>215||Math.abs(A.y[i]-B.y[j])>215)continue;
  if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(FL_SHAPE(A.x[i],A.y[i],A.h[i]),FL_SHAPE(B.x[j],B.y[j],B.h[j]),pad))return{b,x:A.x[i],y:A.y[i],t:k*FL_GRID}}
 return false}

// GATE-75 · PORT-05: the wagon positions the cranes serve — FRT-1 W1-W4 at the E6 quay stop (two orientations: the loco leads into the quay
// in the first loop of the cycle and trails in the second, so the four wagons stand at two sets of positions) and the four static wagons of
// the C6 train. Cranes never pass each other, so the wagons (west to east) are split evenly between the berth's wagon cranes (west to east).
function flAssignWagons(bid,xs){const b=portBerth(bid);if(!b)return xs.map(()=>null);   /* S10 א: הרציף C6 יצא ממערכת הזרימה — הקרונות של רכבת העבודה שומרים את המטען שלהם */const cr=b.wagonCranes||b.cranes.map(q=>q[0]);
 /* S10 א: מסילת המנופים של E6 מתחילה בגבול האזור (ב-D6 אין מנופי גשר) — קרון שעומד מחוץ לטווח הנסיעה של המנופים לא מקבל מנוף (עד ש-E6 נבנה, והעצירה של הרכבת עוברת כולה ל-E6); הקרונות שבטווח מתחלקים בין המנופים כמו קודם */
 const reach=x=>cr.some(id=>{const q=flCraneTravel(id);return x>=q[0]&&x<=q[1]}),ord=xs.map((x,i)=>({x,i})).filter(o=>reach(o.x)).sort((p,q)=>p.x-q.x),out=new Array(xs.length).fill(null);ord.forEach((o,r)=>{out[o.i]=cr[Math.min(cr.length-1,Math.floor(r*cr.length/ord.length))]});return out}
let FL_WAGON_SLOTS=null;

function flCraneDomain(c){const b=portBerth(c.berth),xs=c.set.map(i=>b.stationX(i)),st=FL_STAND[c.id];if(st)xs.push(st.bx);{const sl=flWagonSlots();for(const w of [...(c.berth==='E6'?[...sl.E6,...sl.E6b]:sl[c.berth]||[])])if(w.crane===c.id)xs.push(w.x)}return[Math.min(...xs),Math.max(...xs)]}
// where a crane may travel at all: its crane rail (bogies 4 px clear of the end stops) minus the fixed grab cranes of another berth on the same rail
function flCraneTravel(cid){const c=portCraneById(cid),rail=portCraneRail(c.home);let lo=rail.x0+4+PORT_HW+12,hi=rail.x1-4-PORT_HW-12;
 for(const o of PORT_CRANES){if(o.berth===c.berth||o.kind!=='grab'||portCraneRail(o.home)!==rail)continue;if(o.home<c.home)lo=Math.max(lo,o.home+FL_CRANE_SEP);else hi=Math.min(hi,o.home-FL_CRANE_SEP)}

function flCraneForX(bid,x){const b=portBerth(bid);for(const [id] of b.cranes){const d=flCraneDomain(portCraneById(id));if(x>=d[0]-2&&x<=d[1]+2)return id}return null}
function flVisitT(T,cyc){

 // GATE-75: every wagon of the consist is a working position under the E6 cranes · GATE-76 S1: one quay visit per cycle (run 1) ·
 // S3: FRT-1 (W1-W4) and FRT-4 (W5-W8) stop at the same place, half a cycle apart
 const wq=T.cars.map((c,ci)=>({c,ci})).filter(q=>/^W\d$/.test(q.c.id)),wc=flAssignWagons('E6',wq.map(q=>cars[q.ci].x)),wag=wq.map((q,i)=>({idx:i,car:q.c.id,x:cars[q.ci].x,y:cars[q.ci].y,crane:wc[i]}));

// GATE-75 S2: the C6 wagons are the four wagons of the C6 work train SHT-C6. They keep their boxes from visit to visit (one persistent ledger
// of crane moves), but the cranes may only work them while the train stands at its work stop on W2 (run 1 of its cycle): every visit is a
// window [ta, td] on that ledger. Outside the windows the train is moving or parked on P1 and no move touches it.
let FL_C6G=null;const FL_C6VIS=new Map();let FL_C6_EK=0;

// the C6 ship calls that reach time t are planned (in order, deterministic) before the wagons of the work train are drawn
function flEnsureC6(t){const b=FL_CONT.find(q=>q.id==='C6');if(!b)return;for(let n=0;n<240;n++){const cl=flCall(b,FL_C6_EK);if(cl.t0>t)break;if(cl.tNext<=t)FL_C6_EK++;else break}}

// ---- 5. ledgers (persist from call to call) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// ---- 6. the call planner ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const FL_CALLS={C6:[],E6:[]},FL_TRK={C6:[],E6:[]};

function flStandOf(c){const R=flRoute(c.berth==='E6'?c.id:c.id+'-L'),st=R.stops.find(q=>q.k==='stand');return{bx:st.bx,ty:st.y}}
function flPlanCall(b,k){const __t=performance.now(),g=flPlanCallG(b,k);let r=g.next();while(!r.done)r=g.next();const W=g77Bw();if(!W.end){W.flN++;W.flMs+=performance.now()-__t}return r.value}   /* D-220 · p290 */
const FL_AHEAD=new Map(),FL_AHEAD_STATS={started:0,taken:0,finishedOnDemand:0,ms:0,maxSliceMs:0};
function flCall(b,k){const a=FL_CALLS[b.id];while(a.length<=k){const P=FL_AHEAD.get(b.id);if(P&&P.k===a.length){FL_AHEAD.delete(b.id);if(!P.done){let r=P.g.next();while(!r.done)r=P.g.next();P.r=r.value;FL_AHEAD_STATS.finishedOnDemand++}FL_AHEAD_STATS.taken++;a.push(P.r)}else{if(P)FL_AHEAD.delete(b.id);a.push(flPlanCall(b,a.length))}}return a[k]}
// one frame's share: start the next call of a berth once 30% of its current call has passed, advance pending plans within budgetMs
function flPlanAheadStep(budgetMs,nowMs,maxSlices=Infinity){const t0=performance.now(),t=nowMs/1000;let sl=0;
 for(const b of FL_CONT){const a=FL_CALLS[b.id];if(!a||!a.length)continue;let P=FL_AHEAD.get(b.id);
  if(!P){const k=FL_K[b.id],c=a[k];if(!c||a.length!==k+1||t-c.t0<=(c.tNext-c.t0)*.3)continue;P={k:k+1,g:flPlanCallG(b,k+1),done:false,r:null};FL_AHEAD.set(b.id,P);FL_AHEAD_STATS.started++}
  while(!P.done&&performance.now()-t0<budgetMs&&sl++<maxSlices){const s=performance.now(),r=P.g.next();const d=performance.now()-s;if(d>FL_AHEAD_STATS.maxSliceMs)FL_AHEAD_STATS.maxSliceMs=d;if(r.done){P.done=true;P.r=r.value}}
  if(performance.now()-t0>=budgetMs||sl>=maxSlices)break}
 const d=performance.now()-t0;FL_AHEAD_STATS.ms+=d;return d}
window.__TC_FL_AHEAD=()=>({pending:[...FL_AHEAD.entries()].map(([b,P])=>({berth:b,k:P.k,done:P.done})),...FL_AHEAD_STATS,ms:+FL_AHEAD_STATS.ms.toFixed(1),maxSliceMs:+FL_AHEAD_STATS.maxSliceMs.toFixed(2)});
const FL_ETA=(dx,dy)=>Math.max(1.8,1.2+1.25*Math.max(Math.abs(dx)/FL_V.GANTRY,Math.abs(dy)/FL_V.TROLLEY));
// keyframes of one crane move.  kind 'U': ship -> partner, 'L': partner -> ship.  Returns {K, tAbove, tClear, tLock, tPlace}
function flOpKeys(kind,p0,sl,pt,f,s){
 const K=[];let t=s;const add=(x,ty,h,ld,dt)=>{K.push({t,x,ty,h,ld});t+=dt};
 const lock=1.0*f,low=1.7*f,hoist=1.6*f,low2=1.8*f,rel=1.0*f,up=1.0*f,A=kind==='U'?sl:pt,B=kind==='U'?pt:sl;
 add(p0.x,p0.ty,.6,null,FL_ETA(A.x-p0.x,A.ty-p0.ty));            // k0 -> travel over the pick-up point
 const tOver=t;add(A.x,A.ty,.6,null,low);                         // k1 -> lower onto the box
 add(A.x,A.ty,0,null,lock);                                       // k2 -> twist-lock
 const tLock=t;add(A.x,A.ty,0,'box',hoist);                       // k3 -> hoist
 add(A.x,A.ty,1,'box',FL_ETA(B.x-A.x,B.ty-A.ty));                 // k4 -> travel over the drop point
 const tDropOver=t;add(B.x,B.ty,1,'box',low2);                    // k5 -> lower
 const tPlace=t;add(B.x,B.ty,0,null,rel);                         // k6 -> release (the box is down)
 const tRel=t;add(B.x,B.ty,0,null,up);                            // k7 -> spreader up
 add(B.x,B.ty,.6,null,0);                                         // k8 end
 const tHoisted=tLock+hoist;
 return{K,t0:s,t1:t,tLock,tPlace,tOver,tDropOver,tRel,tHoisted,
  tAbove:kind==='U'?tDropOver:tOver,tClear:kind==='U'?tRel+.5*up+.2:tHoisted+.4}
}
// GATE-75 · PORT-08 crane interference: two cranes on one rail never come closer than FL_CRANE_SEP between centres (bogie to bogie + 6 px).
// Every move is checked (0.1 s) against the committed moves of the other cranes of the berth — a crane holds its last position between
// moves. A crane that is idle in the way is first moved aside (a 'Y' yield move, recursively for the next crane), a crane still working in
// the way delays the move until it is done. The return to the home positions ('R') is placed the same way, west to east.
const FL_CRANE_SEP=2*(PORT_HW+12)+6,FL_CLASH_DT=.1;
function flKeysX(K,t){if(t<=K[0].t)return K[0].x;const Z=K[K.length-1];if(t>=Z.t)return Z.x;let j=0;while(j<K.length-2&&t>=K[j+1].t)j++;const a=K[j],b=K[j+1],dt=b.t-a.t,u=dt>0?flClamp((t-a.t)/dt,0,1):1,travel=Math.abs(b.x-a.x)+Math.abs(b.ty-a.ty)>1;return portLerp(a.x,b.x,travel?portEase(u):u)}
function flCraneXAt(cr,t){const ops=cr.ops;if(!ops.length||t<ops[0].t0)return cr.home;const op=ops[flBin(cr.t0s,t)];return t>=op.t1?op.K[op.K.length-1].x:flKeysX(op.K,t)}
function flCrEnd(cr){return cr.ops.length?cr.ops[cr.ops.length-1].t1:-Infinity}
function flClash(call,cid,K){const t0=K[0].t,t1=K[K.length-1].t;
 for(const [jid,cj] of Object.entries(call.cr)){if(jid===cid)continue;const end=flCrEnd(cj),tEnd=Math.max(t1,end);
  for(let t=t0;t<=tEnd+1e-6;t+=FL_CLASH_DT)if(Math.abs(flKeysX(K,t)-flCraneXAt(cj,t))<FL_CRANE_SEP+2)return{j:jid,t,busy:t<end-1e-6}}
 return null}
function flYield(call,queues,jid,side,need,tMin,depth){
 if(depth>3)return null;const cr=call.cr[jid],q=queues.find(o=>o.id===jid),lim=flCraneTravel(jid);if(!q)return null;
 if((side>0&&need>lim[1])||(side<0&&need<lim[0]))return null;
 let s=Math.max(flCrEnd(cr),call.tw0);
 for(let it=0;it<60;it++){const x0=flCraneXAt(cr,s),target=side>0?Math.max(x0,need):Math.min(x0,need);if(Math.abs(target-x0)<.5)return s;
  const tt=Math.max(1.6,FL_ETA(target-x0,0)),ty=q.pos.ty,K=[{t:s,x:x0,ty,h:.6,ld:null},{t:s+tt,x:target,ty,h:.6,ld:null}],cl=flClash(call,jid,K);
  if(!cl){const op={kind:'Y',crane:jid,t0:s,t1:s+tt,K,dur:tt};cr.ops.push(op);cr.t0s.push(s);q.ready=Math.max(q.ready,s+tt);q.pos={x:target,ty,h:.6};call.yields=(call.yields||0)+1;return s+tt}
  if(cl.busy){s=Math.max(s+FL_CLASH_DT,flCrEnd(call.cr[cl.j]));continue}
  const y=flYield(call,queues,cl.j,side,target+side*(FL_CRANE_SEP+3),s,depth+1);if(y==null)return null;s=Math.max(s,y)}
 return null}
// the earliest start ≥ s0 at which the keyframes Kof(s) clash with no other crane (idle cranes in the way are moved aside first)
function flPlace(call,queues,cid,s0,Kof){let s=s0;
 for(let it=0;it<80;it++){const K=Kof(s),cl=flClash(call,cid,K);if(!cl)return{s,K};
  if(cl.busy){s=Math.max(s+FL_CLASH_DT,flCrEnd(call.cr[cl.j]));continue}
  const xs=K.map(q=>q.x),side=flCraneXAt(call.cr[cl.j],cl.t)>flKeysX(K,cl.t)?1:-1,need=side>0?Math.max(...xs)+FL_CRANE_SEP+3:Math.min(...xs)-FL_CRANE_SEP-3;
  const y=flYield(call,queues,cl.j,side,need,s,0);if(y==null){s=Math.max(s+1,flCrEnd(call.cr[cl.j])+1);continue}s=Math.max(s,y)}
 call.placeFail=(call.placeFail||0)+1;return null}
function* flPlanCallG(b,k){
 const prev=k>0?FL_CALLS[b.id][k-1]:null,t0=prev?prev.tNext:-FL_PRE[b.id],rnd=portRng(portHash('flcall|'+b.id+'|'+k)),led=FL_LED[b.id];
 const call={b,k,t0,name:portShipName(b,k),livery:portLivery(b,k),slots:[],cr:{},trucks:[],ops:[],tw0:t0+PORT_ARRIVE+2};
 const cranes=b.cranes.map(([id])=>portCraneById(id));
 // -- stacks on deck: boxes that stay, boxes to discharge, free places to load; arrival ~55-80 % full, departure ~70 %
 const stock=flStock(b,'yard',t0),drift=stock<led.s0-6?-1:stock>led.s0+6?1:0;
 const queues=[];
 for(const c of cranes){
  const list=[];
  for(const wb of c.set)for(let wr=b.rows-1;wr>=0;wr--)list.push({id:call.slots.length+list.length,crane:c.id,wb,wr,cx:b.cargoX0+wb*PORT_PITCH+PORT_PITCH/2,cy:b.cargoY0+wr*PORT_ROWP+PORT_ROWP/2,type:rnd()<.32?'20':'40',tiers:[null,null,null]});
  const N=list.length,idx=list.map((_,i)=>i);for(let i=N-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(rnd()*(i+1));[idx[i],idx[j]]=[idx[j],idx[i]]}
  const nU=flClamp(Math.round(N*(.15+.06*rnd())),2,6),nL=flClamp(nU+(drift>0?1:drift<0?-1:Math.round(rnd()*2-1)),2,6),tf=flClamp(.70-nL/N+(rnd()-.5)*.08,.15,.6),nT=Math.round(N*tf);
  const hPick=()=>{const r=rnd();return r<.34?1:r<.76?2:3};
  const Us=idx.slice(0,nU),Ls=idx.slice(nU,nU+nL),Ts=idx.slice(nU+nL,nU+nL+nT);
  for(const i of Ts){const s=list[i],h=hPick();for(let t=0;t<h;t++)s.tiers[t]={box:flNewBox(rnd,s.type),tIn:-Infinity,tOut:Infinity}}
  const uq=[],lq=[];
  for(const i of Us){const s=list[i],h=hPick();for(let t=0;t<h;t++)s.tiers[t]={box:flNewBox(rnd,s.type),tIn:-Infinity,tOut:Infinity};for(let t=h-1;t>=0;t--)uq.push({kind:'U',slot:s,tier:t})}
  for(const i of Ls){const s=list[i],h=hPick();for(let t=0;t<h;t++)lq.push({kind:'L',slot:s,tier:t})}
  const q=[];while(uq.length||lq.length){const pickU=uq.length&&(!lq.length||rnd()<.5);q.push(pickU?uq.shift():lq.shift())}
  call.slots.push(...list);
  const st=flStandOf(c);
  queues.push({c,id:c.id,q,ready:call.tw0+rnd()*3,pos:{x:c.home,ty:st.ty,h:.6},stand:st,done:0});
  call.cr[c.id]={ops:[],t0s:[],home:c.home,standTy:st.ty,domain:flCraneDomain(c),travel:flCraneTravel(c.id)};
 }
 call.arrFill=call.slots.filter(s=>s.tiers[0]).length/call.slots.length;
 // -- schedule: the crane that is free first takes its next move; trucks must not conflict with trucks already planned
 const mine=FL_TRK[b.id];for(let i=mine.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(mine[i].t0+mine[i].dur<t0-200)mine.splice(i,1);
 let guard=0;
 while(guard++<400){
  const cur=queues.filter(q=>q.q.length).sort((a,b2)=>a.ready-b2.ready)[0];if(!cur)break;
  flScheduleOp(call,cur,cur.q.shift(),rnd,mine,queues);yield 0;
 }
 // -- return to the home position while the ship leaves (GATE-75: west to east, interference-checked)
 call.tw1=Math.max(call.tw0,...queues.map(q=>q.ready))+1.5;
 for(const q of [...queues].sort((a,b2)=>a.c.home-b2.c.home)){
  const cr=call.cr[q.id],e=q.pos,tt=Math.max(5,FL_ETA(q.c.home-e.x,q.stand.ty-e.ty)),home=q.c.home,sty=q.stand.ty;
  const Kof=s0=>[{t:s0,x:e.x,ty:e.ty,h:.6,ld:null},{t:s0+tt,x:home,ty:sty,h:.6,ld:null}];
  const st=Math.max(call.tw1,flCrEnd(cr)),pl=flPlace(call,queues,q.id,st,Kof)||{s:st,K:Kof(st)};
  const op={kind:'R',crane:q.id,t0:pl.s,t1:pl.s+tt,K:pl.K};
  cr.ops.push(op);cr.t0s.push(op.t0);q.pos={x:home,ty:sty,h:.6};q.ready=op.t1}
 call.tdep0=call.tw1;call.tdep1=call.tdep0+PORT_DEPART;call.tNext=call.tdep1+PORT_GAP+8+rnd()*14;
 call.depFill=call.slots.filter(s=>s.tiers[0]&&s.tiers[0].tOut===Infinity).length/call.slots.length;
 call.total=call.ops.length;
 return call;
}
function flScheduleOp(call,cur,op,rnd,mine,queues){
 const b=call.b,c=cur.c,cr=call.cr[c.id],sl={x:op.slot.cx,ty:op.slot.cy-2.8*op.tier},f=.86+.26*rnd(),colour=Math.floor(rnd()*8);
 // -- partner: a wagon of the train standing at the quay (E6) / of the C6 work train at its work stop on W2 (C6), or a truck
 const grp=b.id==='E6'?flVisitAt(cur.ready+2):flC6VisitAt(cur.ready+2);
 let wag=null;
 // GATE-75 S2: while the C6 work train stands under the cranes its wagons come first (the train has a fixed slot; trucks can wait)
 if(grp&&rnd()<(b.id==='C6'?.8:.6)){
  const ok=grp.wag.filter(w=>{if(w.crane!==c.id)return false;const st=flWagState(grp,w.idx,1e9);return op.kind==='U'?!st:!!st&&st.type===op.slot.type});
  if(ok.length)wag=ok[Math.floor(rnd()*ok.length)]}
 const pos0=cur.pos;
 let K,tr=null,s=cur.ready,firstBad=null;
 for(let tries=0;tries<420;tries++){
  const partner=wag?{x:wag.x,ty:wag.y??PORT_SIDING_Y}:{x:cur.stand.bx,ty:cur.stand.ty};
  K=flOpKeys(op.kind,pos0,sl,partner,f,s);
  if(wag){if(grp.td<K.t1+3){wag=null;s=cur.ready;continue}   // the train leaves before this move would be done: use a truck instead
   if(grp.ta>K.t0){s=grp.ta;continue}}
  // GATE-75: crane interference (moves idle neighbours aside, waits for busy ones)
  const pl=flPlace(call,queues,c.id,s,ss=>flOpKeys(op.kind,pos0,sl,partner,f,ss).K);
  if(!pl){s+=1;continue}
  if(pl.s>s+1e-6){s=pl.s;continue}
  if(wag)break;
  const R=flRoute(b.id==='E6'?c.id:c.id+'-'+op.kind),aT=K.tAbove-1.2,dT=K.tClear;
  tr=flMakeTruck(R,aT,Math.max(3,dT-aT),{color:colour,kind:op.kind});
  let bad=null;for(const o of mine){const c2=flConflict(tr,o);if(c2){bad=c2;break}}
  if(!bad||tries>=400){if(bad){call.fallbacks=(call.fallbacks||0)+1;tr.badAt=bad}break}
  if(!firstBad)firstBad=bad;tr=null;s+=.75;
 }
 // -- commit
 const o={kind:op.kind,crane:c.id,slot:op.slot,tier:op.tier,K:K.K,t0:K.t0,t1:K.t1,tLock:K.tLock,tPlace:K.tPlace,party:wag?'wagon':'truck',dur:K.t1-K.t0};
 if(op.kind==='U'){const ti=op.slot.tiers[op.tier];ti.tOut=K.tLock;o.box=ti.box}
 else{
  let box;
  if(wag){box={...flWagState(grp,wag.idx,1e9)}}else box=flNewBox(rnd,op.slot.type);
  op.slot.tiers[op.tier]={box,tIn:K.tPlace,tOut:Infinity};o.box=box}
 if(wag){
  o.wag=wag;o.grp=grp.id;
  grp.ops.push({t:op.kind==='U'?K.tPlace:K.tLock,idx:wag.idx,box:op.kind==='U'?{...o.box}:null});
  call.wagonMoves=(call.wagonMoves||0)+1;
 }else if(tr){
  const st=tr.stopT,si=tr.R.stops.findIndex(q=>q.k==='stand'),yi=tr.R.stops.findIndex(q=>q.k==='yard');
  if(op.kind==='U'){const end=yi>=0?(st[yi][0]+st[yi][1])/2:tr.t0+tr.dur;tr.cargo.push({a:K.tPlace,b:end,box:o.box});flLedAdd(b.id,end,+1)}
  else{const a=yi>=0?(st[yi][0]+st[yi][1])/2:tr.t0;tr.cargo.push({a,b:K.tLock,box:o.box});flLedAdd(b.id,a,-1)}
  tr.op=o;o.truck=tr;tr.tries=Math.round((s-cur.ready)/.75);tr.firstBad=firstBad;call.trucks.push(tr);mine.push(tr);
 }
 call.ops.push(o);cr.ops.push(o);cr.t0s.push(o.t0);
 cur.ready=o.t1;cur.pos={x:K.K[K.K.length-1].x,ty:K.K[K.K.length-1].ty,h:.6};
}

// ---- 7. berth clock + crane pose (replace the old fixed cycle for the two container berths) -----------------------------------------------
const FL_K={C6:0,E6:0};
function flBerthAt(b,now){
 const t=now/1000;let k=FL_K[b.id];
 while(true){const c=flCall(b,k);if(t>=c.tNext){k++;continue}if(k>0&&t<c.t0){k--;continue}break}
 FL_K[b.id]=k;
 const call=flCall(b,k),tin=t-call.t0,dep=call.tdep0-call.t0;
 let phase,u=1,loadT=0;
 if(tin<PORT_ARRIVE){phase='arrive';u=tin/PORT_ARRIVE}
 else if(t<call.tdep0){phase='load';loadT=tin-PORT_ARRIVE}
 else if(t<call.tdep1){phase='depart';u=(t-call.tdep0)/PORT_DEPART;loadT=dep-PORT_ARRIVE}
 else{phase='gap';loadT=dep-PORT_ARRIVE}
 let off=0,alpha=1;
 if(phase==='arrive'){off=PORT_SLIDE*(1-portEase(u));alpha=Math.min(1,u*3.2)}
 else if(phase==='depart'){off=PORT_SLIDE*portEase(u);alpha=Math.min(1,(1-u)*3.2)}
 else if(phase==='gap'){off=PORT_SLIDE;alpha=0}
 let ext=0;
 if(phase==='arrive')ext=portEase((tin-(PORT_ARRIVE-7))/6);
 else if(phase==='load')ext=1;
 else if(phase==='depart')ext=1-portEase((t-call.tdep0)/6);
 return{b,k,call,tin,tAbs:t,phase,u,loadT,off,alpha,ext,present:phase!=='gap',name:call.name,livery:call.livery};
}
function portBerthAt(b,now){return b.kind==='container'?flBerthAt(b,now):portBerthAtOld(b,now)}
function flCranePose(c,S,now){
 const b=S.b,t=now/1000,call=S.call,cr=call.cr[c.id],tipFar=b.cargoY0+b.rows*PORT_ROWP+4,tipNear=PORT_RAIL_W+78;
 const P={x:c.home,tipY:portLerp(tipNear,tipFar,S.ext),ty:cr.standTy,h:.6,load:null,slot:null,grab:null,j:-1,p:0};
 const ops=cr.ops;if(!ops.length||t<ops[0].t0)return P;
 const i=flBin(cr.t0s,t),op=ops[i];
 const K=op.K;
 if(t>=op.t1){const e=K[K.length-1];P.x=e.x;P.ty=e.ty;P.h=e.h;return P}
 let j=0;while(j<K.length-2&&t>=K[j+1].t)j++;
 const a=K[j],bb=K[j+1],dt=bb.t-a.t,u=dt>0?flClamp((t-a.t)/dt,0,1):1,e=portEase(u);
 const travel=Math.abs(bb.x-a.x)+Math.abs(bb.ty-a.ty)>1;
 const w=travel?e:u;
 P.x=portLerp(a.x,bb.x,w);P.ty=portLerp(a.ty,bb.ty,w);P.h=portLerp(a.h,bb.h,travel?w:e);
 if(a.ld==='box'&&op.box){P.load=op.box;P.slot=op.slot||null;P.j=0;P.p=u}
 return P}
function portCranePose(c,S,now){return c.kind==='spreader'?flCranePose(c,S,now):portCranePoseOld(c,S,now)}

// ---- 8. ship deck: every box is on the deck from tIn to tOut -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
var FL_DECK;

 for(let i=0;i<slots.length;i++){const s=slots[i];for(let ti=0;ti<3;ti++){const q=s.tiers[ti];if(!q||t<q.tIn||t>=q.tOut)continue;h=Math.imul(h^(i*4+ti+1),16777619);n++}}
 if(!n)return;

 ctx.drawImage(D.cv,D.x0,D.y0+S.off+bob,D.w,D.h);

// ---- 9. trucks on the road ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const FL_ACTIVE=[];
function flFrame(now){
 const t=now/1000;FL_ACTIVE.length=0;PG_STATE.flNow=t;PG_STATE.flNear.length=0;
 for(const b of FL_CONT){
  const S=portBerthAt(b,now);
  if(S.tin>(S.call.tNext-S.call.t0)*.4&&FL_CALLS[b.id].length<=S.k+1)flCall(b,S.k+1);
  for(let k=Math.max(0,S.k-2);k<=S.k+1;k++){
   const call=FL_CALLS[b.id][k];if(!call)continue;
   for(const tr of call.trucks){
    if(t>=tr.t0-PG_T.FL_T-1&&t<=tr.t0+tr.dur)PG_STATE.flNear.push(tr);
    if(t<tr.t0||t>tr.t0+tr.dur)continue;
    const p=flTruckAt(tr,t);if(!p||p.a<.02)continue;
    FL_ACTIVE.push({id:tr.id,x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:p.h,asset:'LV-SM-01',ref:'SemiLong',alpha:p.a,tr,box:flTruckBox(tr,t),kind:'truck'})}}}
 // a truck never drives over the person on foot
 if(PlayerProfile?.mode==='walk')for(const v of FL_ACTIVE){
  const sh=trafficVehicleShape(v);
  if(!pointHitsVehicleBody(PlayerPed.x,PlayerPed.y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS,sh,0))continue;
  const c=Math.cos(v.heading),s=Math.sin(v.heading),dx=PlayerPed.x-v.x,dy=PlayerPed.y-v.y,l=-dx*s+dy*c,side=l>=0?1:-1,need=sh.radius+PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS+1.5;
  PlayerPed.x+=(-s)*side*(need-Math.abs(l)+1);PlayerPed.y+=c*side*(need-Math.abs(l)+1)}
 // GATE-75 S4: the port gates run on the same clock as the port trucks
 try{pgTick(now)}catch(e){if(!PG_STATE.err){PG_STATE.err=String(e&&e.stack||e);console.error('port gates',e)}}
}
function drawFlowTrucks(now){
 const v=portView(300);
 for(const o of FL_ACTIVE){
  if(o.x<v.x0-120||o.x>v.x1+120||o.y<v.y0-120||o.y>v.y1+120)continue;
  const sc=roadVehicleScaleFor('LV-SM-01','SemiLong'),I=TurboCity.info('LV-SM-01',{scale:sc});
  if(SEMI_ART.on){const L=SEMI_ART.L/2,h=o.heading||0;o.saPose=saTrailPose('FL:'+o.id,o.x+Math.cos(h)*L,o.y+Math.sin(h)*L,h,o.saPose||{})}   /* p490: שני גופים */
  if(!c34Flow(o,sc,I,now)&&!(o.saPose&&saDrawSemi(o.saPose,'container',o.tr.color,{alpha:o.alpha,cargo:o.box}))){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=o.alpha;ctx.translate(o.x,o.y);ctx.rotate(o.heading);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.24)';ctx.fillRect(-I.w/2+4,-I.h/2+7,I.w-8,I.h-12);

  if(o.box)flDrawBox(ctx,o.box,FL_BOX_DX,0);
  ctx.restore()}   /* p378 */
  Targets.add({id:o.id,label:'משאית מכולות · '+(o.tr.berth==='E6'?'מהמחסן של E5':'שער C6')+(o.box?' · נושאת מכולה':' · ריקה'),category:'port-truck',x:o.x,y:o.y,shape:'circle',r:26/Camera.zoom})}
}
function trafficCarCollisionAt(x,y,r=PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS,ignoreId=null){

function dynamicVehicleBodyBlocked(entity,x,y,heading,parked=null){
 const a=dynamicVehicleBodyBlockedLegacy189(entity,x,y,heading,parked);if(a)return a;

 return null}

// ---- 12. audits ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function flStats(a){if(!a.length)return{min:0,med:0,max:0};const s=[...a].sort((x,y)=>x-y);return{min:+s[0].toFixed(1),med:+s[s.length>>1].toFixed(1),max:+s[s.length-1].toFixed(1)}}
function flAudit(n=3){
 const issues=[],per={};let calls=0,moves=0,trucks=0,wm=0;
 for(const b of FL_CONT){
  const durs=[],waits=[],cyc=[],tiers=[0,0,0,0],st=[];
  for(let k=0;k<n;k++){
   const c=flCall(b,k);calls++;cyc.push(c.tNext-c.t0);
   for(const [id,cr] of Object.entries(c.cr)){
    const ops=cr.ops.filter(o=>o.kind!=='R'&&o.kind!=='Y');let last=null;
    for(const o of ops){moves++;durs.push(o.dur);if(last)waits.push(o.t0-last.t1);last=o;
     {const gx=o.K.reduce((a,q,i)=>i?a+Math.abs(q.x-o.K[i-1].x):0,0);if(o.dur<10||o.dur>23+1.25*gx/FL_V.GANTRY)issues.push(b.id+'#'+k+' move '+o.dur.toFixed(1)+'s (gantry '+Math.round(gx)+' px)')}
     if(o.party==='wagon')wm++;
     else if(o.truck){
      // at the moment of the hand-over the truck stands still and the box hangs exactly over its trailer
      const tt=o.kind==='U'?o.tPlace:o.tLock,tr=o.truck,p=flTruckAt(tr,tt),p2=flTruckAt(tr,tt+.4),p1=flTruckAt(tr,tt-.4);
      if(!p||!p2||!p1)issues.push(b.id+'#'+k+' no truck at hand-over');
      else{
       const bx=p.x+Math.cos(p.h)*FL_BOX_DX,by=p.y+Math.sin(p.h)*FL_BOX_DX,P=flCranePose(portCraneById(id),{b,call:c,ext:1},tt*1000);
       if(Math.abs(P.x-bx)>2.5||Math.abs(P.ty-by)>2.5)issues.push(b.id+'#'+k+' '+id+' crane '+Math.round(P.x)+','+Math.round(P.ty)+' vs box '+Math.round(bx)+','+Math.round(by));
       if(Math.hypot(p2.x-p1.x,p2.y-p1.y)>1.5)issues.push(b.id+'#'+k+' truck moving at the hand-over');
       if(!flTruckBox(tr,tt+.05)&&o.kind==='U')issues.push('no box on truck after unload');
       if(o.kind==='L'&&!flTruckBox(tr,tt-.05))issues.push('no box on truck before load')}}
     // the crane must be where the box is at lock and release
     const lk=o.K.find(q=>q.ld==='box');if(!lk)issues.push('no lock');
    }
    // crane domain: work moves (U/L) inside the crane's own stations / stand / wagon slots; every move (incl. yields) on its travel range
    for(const o of cr.ops)for(const [qi,q] of o.K.entries()){if((o.kind==='U'||o.kind==='L')&&qi>0&&(q.x<cr.domain[0]-3.5||q.x>cr.domain[1]+3.5))issues.push(id+' x '+Math.round(q.x)+' outside domain '+cr.domain.map(Math.round).join('..'));if(q.x<cr.travel[0]-.5||q.x>cr.travel[1]+.5)issues.push(id+' x '+Math.round(q.x)+' off its rail range '+cr.travel.map(Math.round).join('..'))}
   }
   // crane separation over the whole call (sampled)
   const ids=Object.keys(c.cr);
   for(let t=c.tw0;t<c.tdep1;t+=.5){
    const xs=ids.map(id=>flCranePose(portCraneById(id),{b,call:c,ext:1},t*1000).x).sort((x,y)=>x-y);
    for(let i=1;i<xs.length;i++)if(xs[i]-xs[i-1]<FL_CRANE_SEP-1){issues.push(b.id+'#'+k+' cranes '+Math.round(xs[i]-xs[i-1])+'px apart at '+t.toFixed(0));t=c.tdep1;break}}
   // tiers
   for(const s of c.slots)for(let i=0;i<3;i++)if(s.tiers[i]){tiers[i+1]++;if(i>0&&!s.tiers[i-1])issues.push('floating tier')}
   if(c.arrFill<.45||c.arrFill>.9)issues.push(b.id+'#'+k+' arrival fill '+c.arrFill.toFixed(2));
   if(c.depFill<.5||c.depFill>.9)issues.push(b.id+'#'+k+' departure fill '+c.depFill.toFixed(2));
   trucks+=c.trucks.length;
   // trucks: same stand never occupied twice at once, every truck conflict-free against its neighbours
   const all=c.trucks;for(let i=0;i<all.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<all.length;j++)if(flConflict(all[i],all[j],3)){issues.push(b.id+'#'+k+' trucks overlap '+all[i].id+'/'+all[j].id);i=all.length;break}
  }
  const L=FL_LED[b.id];let lo=1e9,hi=-1e9,v=L.s0,clamps=0;for(const e of L.ev){const nv=v+e.d;if(nv<L.lo||nv>L.hi)clamps++;v=flClamp(nv,L.lo,L.hi);lo=Math.min(lo,v);hi=Math.max(hi,v)}
  if(clamps>12)issues.push(b.id+' ledger hit its limits '+clamps+' times');
  per[b.id]={dur:flStats(durs),wait:flStats(waits),cycle:flStats(cyc),tiers:tiers.slice(1),stock:[lo===1e9?L.s0:lo,hi===-1e9?L.s0:hi],fallbacks:FL_CALLS[b.id].slice(0,n).reduce((a,c)=>a+(c.fallbacks||0),0)};
 }
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,12),calls,moves,trucks,wagonMoves:wm,craneSep:FL_CRANE_SEP,yields:FL_CONT.reduce((acc,bb)=>acc+FL_CALLS[bb.id].slice(0,n).reduce((m,c)=>m+(c.yields||0),0),0),placeFail:FL_CONT.reduce((acc,bb)=>acc+FL_CALLS[bb.id].reduce((m,c)=>m+(c.placeFail||0),0),0),perBerth:per}
}
function flRouteAudit(){
 const issues=[];let routes=0,samples=0;
 for(const key of Object.keys(FL_SPEC)){
  let R;try{R=flRoute(key)}catch(e){issues.push(key+': '+e.message);continue}
  routes++;
  if(R.stops.length!==FL_SPEC[key].stops.length)issues.push(key+' stops');
  for(const st of R.stops){
   if(st.k==='stand'){const x=FL_STAND[(FL_SPEC[key].berth==='E6'?key:key.replace(/-[LU]$/,''))];if(Math.abs(st.bx-x.bx)>14)issues.push(key+' stand box x '+Math.round(st.bx)+' vs '+x.bx);if(Math.abs(st.y-x.y)>6)issues.push(key+' stand lane y '+Math.round(st.y)+' vs '+x.y)}
   {const hh=R.h[st.i],ax=Math.min(Math.abs(Math.sin(hh)),Math.abs(Math.cos(hh)));if(ax>.04)issues.push(key+' '+st.k+' not along the road axis ('+hh.toFixed(2)+' rad)')}}
  // every point lies on a real lane: close to the centre line of a port/E5-spine edge, and inside the road
  for(let i=0;i<R.n;i+=6){
   if(R.hidden.some(h=>R.s[i]>=h[0]-30&&R.s[i]<=h[1]+30))continue;
   samples++;let ok=false;
   for(const e of EDGES){if(!(flPortEdge(e)))continue;const a=byNode[e.a],b2=byNode[e.b],dx=b2.x-a.x,dy=b2.y-a.y,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy,f=flClamp(((R.x[i]-a.x)*dx+(R.y[i]-a.y)*dy)/l2,0,1),d=Math.hypot(R.x[i]-(a.x+dx*f),R.y[i]-(a.y+dy*f));if(d<44){ok=true;break}}
   if(!ok){issues.push(key+' off-road at s='+Math.round(R.s[i]));break}}
  // the polyline is smooth (no kinks beyond the engine's own turns)
  for(let i=2;i<R.n;i++){if(R.hidden.some(h=>R.s[i]>=h[0]-8&&R.s[i]<=h[1]+8))continue;let d=Math.abs(R.h[i]-R.h[i-1]);if(d>Math.PI)d=2*Math.PI-d;if(d>.45){issues.push(key+' kink '+d.toFixed(2)+' at '+Math.round(R.s[i]));break}}
  // a truck that stops at the stand fits between the stand and the next stop / the end
  const dur=flRouteDur(R,R.stops.map(()=>5));if(!(dur>20&&dur<400))issues.push(key+' duration '+dur.toFixed(0));
 }
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,12),routes,samples}
}
function flWagonAudit(){
 const issues=[];let ops=0,visits=new Set();
 for(const b of FL_CONT)for(let k=0;k<FL_CALLS[b.id].length;k++){
  const c=FL_CALLS[b.id][k];
  for(const o of c.ops){
   if(o.party!=='wagon')continue;ops++;visits.add(o.grp);
   // crane over the wagon at lock (U: at release)
   const tt=o.kind==='U'?o.tPlace:o.tLock,P=flCranePose(portCraneById(o.crane),{b,call:c,ext:1},tt*1000);
   if(Math.abs(P.x-o.wag.x)>3)issues.push(o.crane+' not over the wagon: '+Math.round(P.x)+' vs '+Math.round(o.wag.x));
   if(Math.abs(P.ty-(o.wag.y??PORT_SIDING_Y))>3)issues.push('wagon ty '+Math.round(P.ty));
   if(b.id==='E6'){const v=flVisitAt(o.t0+1);if(!v||o.t1>v.td+.5)issues.push('E6 wagon move outside the standing window')}
   else{const v=flC6VisitAt(o.t0+1);if(!v||o.t1>v.td+.5)issues.push('C6 wagon move outside the work stop on W2')}}}
 // wagon states: every state is a box or empty; never two boxes taken from an empty wagon
 for(const v of [...FL_VIS.values(),FL_C6G].filter(Boolean)){
  const by={};for(const o of [...v.ops].sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t)){const st=by[o.idx]===undefined?v.init[o.idx]:by[o.idx];if(o.box&&st)issues.push(v.id+' wagon '+o.idx+' filled twice');if(!o.box&&!st)issues.push(v.id+' wagon '+o.idx+' emptied twice');by[o.idx]=o.box}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,10),ops,visits:visits.size}
}
// GATE-75 · PORT-08 acceptance: every container move of n ship calls per container berth is traced every 0.1 s. While the box hangs on the
// spreader it has the trolley's centre (attached), stays on the boom (back-reach end … tip), never touches a leg, stays between the side frames
// inside the portal and crosses a portal beam only hoisted (h ≥ .85). ≥ 10 traced transfers per type: ship→truck (U-truck), truck→ship
// (L-truck), ship→wagon (U-wagon), wagon→ship (L-wagon). Render probe: the crane is drawn on an off-screen canvas with and without its
// superstructure; every interior opaque pixel of the superstructure ('top' layer) must be identical in the full picture → 0 container-over-crane px,
// and the box must be visible (it is drawn at all).
let PORT_PROBE_CV=null;
function portCraneProbe(c,b,call,t){
 const P=flCranePose(c,{b,call,ext:1},t*1000),S={b,call,ext:1,phase:'load'},W=300,H=Math.ceil(P.tipY-PORT_BOOM_BACK+80),x0=P.x-W/2,y0=PORT_BOOM_BACK-30;
 if(!PORT_PROBE_CV)PORT_PROBE_CV=window.document.createElement('canvas');const cv=PORT_PROBE_CV;cv.width=W;cv.height=H;const g=cv.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
 const shot=only=>{g.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);g.clearRect(0,0,W,H);g.translate(-x0,-y0);drawPortCrane(c,P,S,t*1000,g,only);return g.getImageData(0,0,W,H).data};
 const full=shot(null),top=shot('top'),bare=shot(['portal','top']);let over=0,opaque=0,visible=0;
 const op=i=>i>=0&&i<top.length&&top[i+3]===255;for(let i=0;i<full.length;i+=4){if(op(i)&&op(i-4)&&op(i+4)&&op(i-4*W)&&op(i+4*W)){opaque++;if(Math.abs(full[i]-top[i])>2||Math.abs(full[i+1]-top[i+1])>2||Math.abs(full[i+2]-top[i+2])>2)over++}if(full[i]!==bare[i]||full[i+1]!==bare[i+1]||full[i+2]!==bare[i+2]||full[i+3]!==bare[i+3])visible++}
 return{over,opaque,visible,load:!!P.load}}
function portCraneTraceAudit(n=4,maxProbes=40){
 const types={'U-truck':0,'L-truck':0,'U-wagon':0,'L-wagon':0},issues=[],hw=PORT_HW,yL=PORT_RAIL_L,yW=PORT_RAIL_W;
 let samples=0,overPx=0,probes=0,hidden=0,minSide=1e9,minBeamH=1e9,maxAttach=0;
 const probeEvery=Math.max(1,Math.floor(FL_CONT.length*n*30/Math.max(1,maxProbes)));let opN=0;
 const enough=()=>Object.values(types).every(v=>v>=10);   /* S9 · S7F268: the calls are traced until every type has its 10 transfers (4 calls at least, 8 at most) — the E6 trucks' shorter way from the north gate moved the mix of the first 4 calls */
 for(let k=0;k<8&&(k<n||!enough());k++)for(const b of FL_CONT){const call=flCall(b,k);
  for(const o of call.ops){if(o.kind!=='U'&&o.kind!=='L')continue;const key=o.kind+'-'+o.party;types[key]=(types[key]||0)+1;const c=portCraneById(o.crane);opN++;
   for(let t=o.t0;t<=o.t1+1e-6;t+=.1){const P=flCranePose(c,{b,call,ext:1},t*1000);if(!P.load)continue;samples++;
    const kk=1+PORT_BOX_HEIGHT_K*P.h,L=(P.load.type==='40'?PORT_CT_LEN['CT-40-01']:PORT_CT_LEN['CT-40-01']+4)*kk/2,Wb=PORT_CT_W*kk/2,bx0=P.x-L,bx1=P.x+L,by0=P.ty-Wb,by1=P.ty+Wb;
    if(P.ty<PORT_BOOM_BACK+13-.5||P.ty>P.tipY+.5)issues.push(o.crane+': box off the boom ty '+Math.round(P.ty));
    for(const lx of[P.x-hw,P.x+hw])for(const ly of[yL,yW])if(bx0<lx+8&&bx1>lx-8&&by0<ly+8&&by1>ly-8)issues.push(o.crane+': box through a leg');
    if(by1>yL-8&&by0<yW+8){const side=(hw-3)-L;minSide=Math.min(minSide,side);if(side<0)issues.push(o.crane+': box through a side frame')}
    for(const ly of[yL,yW])if(by0<ly+8&&by1>ly-8){minBeamH=Math.min(minBeamH,P.h);if(P.h<.85)issues.push(o.crane+': box through the portal beam (h '+P.h.toFixed(2)+')')}}
   // the hand-over: the box sits exactly on its carrier (truck checked by flAudit, wagon by flWagonAudit); here the spreader is attached
   {const tt=o.kind==='U'?o.tPlace-.05:o.tLock+.05,P=flCranePose(c,{b,call,ext:1},tt*1000);if(!P.load)issues.push(o.crane+': box not on the spreader during the lift')}
   if(probes<maxProbes&&opN%probeEvery===0){const tm=(o.tLock+o.tPlace)/2,r=portCraneProbe(c,b,call,tm);probes++;overPx+=r.over;if(!r.visible)hidden++}}}
 {const wagAll=flWagonSlots().E6.every(w=>w.crane);   /* S10 א: כשחלק מהקרונות עומדים מחוץ למסילת המנופים של E6 (עד ש-E6 נבנה) — מספיקה העברה אחת מכל סוג של קרון */
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(types))if(v<(/wagon/.test(k)&&!wagAll?1:10))issues.push('only '+v+' traced '+k+' transfers')}
 if(overPx>0)issues.push(overPx+' container-over-crane pixels');if(hidden>0)issues.push(hidden+' probes without a visible box');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,10),types,samples,probes,containerOverCranePx:overPx,minSideClearance:+minSide.toFixed(1),minBeamHoist:+minBeamH.toFixed(2),portalInner:2*(hw-3),box40Hoisted:+(PORT_CT_LEN['CT-40-01']*(1+PORT_BOX_HEIGHT_K)).toFixed(1)}}
// GATE-75 · PORT-05: every working wagon position is served — over n calls each of FRT-1 W1-W4 (E6) and C6 W1-W4 gets crane moves
function portWagonSlotAudit(n=6){const slots=flWagonSlots(),served={E6:[0,0,0,0],C6:[0,0,0,0]};for(const b of FL_CONT)for(let k=0;k<n;k++)for(const o of flCall(b,k).ops)if(o.party==='wagon'&&served[b.id])served[b.id][o.wag.idx]=(served[b.id][o.wag.idx]||0)+1;
 const issues=[];for(const id of(portBerth('C6')?['E6','E6b','C6']:['E6','E6b'])){   /* S10 א: הרציף C6 יצא ממערכת הזרימה — המנופים של C6 ב-021k */const bid=id==='C6'?'C6':'E6';if(slots[id].length!==4)issues.push(id+' has '+slots[id].length+' wagon slots');slots[id].forEach((w,i)=>{if(!w.crane&&id!=='C6'&&w.x<PORT_CRANE_RAILS[PORT_CRANE_RAILS.length-1].x0+PORT_HW+16)return;   /* S10 א: הקרון עומד ב-D6, מחוץ למסילת המנופים של E6 — עד ש-E6 נבנה */if(!w.crane)issues.push(id+' '+w.id+' has no crane');const tr=flCraneTravel(w.crane);if(w.x<tr[0]||w.x>tr[1])issues.push(id+' '+w.id+' out of reach of '+w.crane);if(id!=='E6b'&&!served[bid][i])issues.push(bid+' '+w.id+' never served')})}

// ==== GATE-77 S6c · p172 · D-180: the apron poles out of the aircraft envelopes; QA-54 + the fixed objects ============================
// measured (QA-54 matrix, every stand × type, + the vehicles of a 30-min run): no place within ±200 px / y 330–480 of any of them is clear of
// every aircraft envelope (taxi-in, parked, pushback) and every vehicle — so all seven come down for now (MOVELIST 13; the places — D-182)
var G77_FX={on:true,r:3,m:4,dt:.5,move:{'APT-FL-6045':null,'APT-FL-6405':null,'APT-FL-6765':null,'APT-FL-7120':null,'APT-FL-7205':null,'APT-FL-C5430':null,'APT-FL-C5990':null},down:[]};
function g77PoleMoves(){for(const [id,to] of Object.entries(G77_FX.move)){const i=APT_POLES.findIndex(p=>p.id===id);if(i<0)continue;
  if(to===null){G77_FX.down.push(APT_POLES[i]);APT_POLES.splice(i,1)}else{APT_POLES[i].x0=APT_POLES[i].x;APT_POLES[i].y0=APT_POLES[i].y;APT_POLES[i].x=to[0];APT_POLES[i].y=to[1]}}}
function g77FixedObjs(){return APT_POLES.map(p=>({id:p.id,x:p.x,y:p.y,r:G77_FX.r}))}
function g77FixedHits(P){const out=[],seen=new Set(),O=g77FixedObjs();if(!O.length)return out;
 for(const r of P.tracks||[]){if(!r.tr||r.tr.kind!=='ac')continue;const S=r.tr.seq,dur=S.dur;
  for(let t=0;t<=dur;t+=G77_FX.dt){const pose=S.at(t);if(!pose)continue;let near=null;for(const o of O)if(Math.hypot(o.x-pose[0],o.y-pose[1])<520){(near||(near=[])).push(o)}if(!near)continue;
   const sh=[];apttShapes(r.tr,pose,sh);for(const s of sh){if(s.L!=='F'&&s.L!=='W')continue;
    for(const o of near){if(seen.has(o.id))continue;if(o.x<s.x0-o.r-G77_FX.m||o.x>s.x1+o.r+G77_FX.m||o.y<s.y0-o.r-G77_FX.m||o.y>s.y1+o.r+G77_FX.m)continue;
     const box=apttObb(o.x,o.y,0,[-o.r,o.r,-o.r,o.r],'X','fixed');if(apttObbHit(box,s,G77_FX.m)){seen.add(o.id);out.push('FIXED '+o.id+' ✕ '+(P.ac||'').slice(3,5)+'@'+(P.stand||'')+' '+(r.main?'main':'trk')+' t+'+t.toFixed(1))}}}}}
 return out}
g77PoleMoves();   // GATE-77 S6c · p172 · D-180
APT_POLES.forEach(p=>APT_LIGHTS.push({id:p.id,kind:p.kind,x:p.x,y:p.y}));
