// ---------- geometry audit (used by the QA panel) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const aptOver=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y;
const aptFp=b=>({id:b.id,x:b.x+b.info.fp[0],y:b.y+b.info.fp[1],w:b.info.fp[2],h:b.info.fp[3]});
function aptRoadRects(){return[...EDGES.filter(e=>/^TC-(E2|F2|G2)-/.test(e.globalRoadId)||e.id==='D2-COM-E'||e.id==='D2-AIR-L').map(e=>{const a=_NODE_BY_ID[e.a],b=_NODE_BY_ID[e.b],h=_ROAD_HALF(e)+20;return{id:e.id,x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+2*h,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+2*h}}),{id:'E2-SVC-LANE',x:4800,y:1182,w:948,h:136,lane:true}]}   // GATE-74: + D2-AIR-L and the private lane (old R-AIR)
function aptGeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],roads=aptRoadRects(),fps=APT_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp);
 const regs=[E0_REGION,F0_REGION,G0_REGION,E1_REGION,F1_REGION,G1_REGION,E2_REGION,F2_REGION,G2_REGION];
 const inReg=(r)=>[[r.x,r.y],[r.x+r.w,r.y],[r.x,r.y+r.h],[r.x+r.w,r.y+r.h]].every(([px,py])=>regs.some(g=>px>=g.x&&px<=g.x+g.w&&py>=g.y&&py<=g.y+g.h));
 for(const f of fps){if(!inReg(f))issues.push(f.id+':outside-regions');for(const r of roads)if(aptOver(f,r))issues.push(f.id+':on-road '+r.id)}
 for(let i=0;i<fps.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<fps.length;j++)if(aptOver(fps[i],fps[j]))issues.push(fps[i].id+'/'+fps[j].id+':overlap');
 for(const L of APT_LOTS){const q={x:L.x,y:L.y,w:L.w,h:L.h};if(!inReg(q))issues.push(L.id+':outside-regions');for(const r of roads)if(aptOver(q,r))issues.push(L.id+':on-road '+r.id);for(const f of fps)if(aptOver(q,f))issues.push(L.id+':under '+f.id)}
 for(const st of APT_STALLS){const L=APT_LOTS.find(l=>l.id===st.lot);if(st.x<L.x||st.y<L.y||st.x+st.w>L.x+L.w||st.y+st.h>L.y+L.h)issues.push(st.id+':outside-lot')}
 const cars=PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-P-/.test(c.id)).length;
 // runway/taxiway/apron relations
 const R=APT_RWY,T=APT_TWY;
 if(T.cy-T.w/2-(R.cy+R.w/2)<60)issues.push('runway-taxiway-gap');
 for(const s of APT_STANDS){if(s.cargo)continue;const acn=TurboCity.info(s.aircraft,{scale:APT_GS/(TurboCity.get(s.aircraft).res||1),rot:1}),na=acn.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Nose Gear'),box={x:s.cx-na[1],y:s.ng-na[2],w:acn.w,h:acn.h};
  if(box.y+11<APT_TWY.cy+APT_TWY.w/2-1)issues.push(s.id+':aircraft-on-taxiway');
  const tb=aptFp(aptB(s.term));if(box.y+box.h-11>tb.y+1)issues.push(s.id+':aircraft-into-terminal');
  {const off=(s.gateX-s.cx)*(s.door==='R'?-1:1);if(s.gateX-15<tb.x||s.gateX+15>tb.x+tb.w)issues.push(s.id+':bridge-off-terminal');{const K=G77_K72.st[s.id];if(K?Math.abs(s.gateX-K.rx)>.01:(off<20||off>36))issues.push(s.id+':bridge-not-at-rotunda')}}}   // GATE-77 S5c: the rotunda d px out from the door line (D-78)   // GATE-73 S2: straight bridges — rotunda on the terminal face, in line with the door
 for(let i=0;i<APT_STANDS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<APT_STANDS.length;j++){const a=APT_STANDS[i],b=APT_STANDS[j];if(!a.cargo&&!b.cargo&&Math.abs(a.cx-b.cx)<300)issues.push(a.id+'/'+b.id+':stands-too-close')}
 // the landside line: every terminal entrance reachable from the sidewalk side
 for(const id of['APT-TERM','APT-TOWER','APT-CARGO']){const p=APT_INTERACTIONS[id],b=aptB(id==='APT-TERM'?'APT-TERM-2':id),f=aptFp(b);if(!(p.x>=f.x-4&&p.x<=f.x+f.w+4&&p.y>=f.y+f.h-2&&p.y<=APT_ROAD_Y-48))issues.push(id+':poi-not-on-forecourt');if(aptSolidAt(p.x,p.y,10))issues.push(id+':poi-blocked')}
 for(const p of Object.values(APT_INTERACTIONS)){const rg=regs.find(g=>p.x>=g.x&&p.x<=g.x+g.w&&p.y>=g.y&&p.y<=g.y+g.h);if(!rg||rg.id&&false)issues.push(p.id+':poi-outside');}
 // trees and poles clear of roads
 for(const t of APT_TREES)for(const r of roads)if(aptOver({x:t.x-8,y:t.y-8,w:16,h:16},r))issues.push(t.id+':on-road');
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues,issueCount:issues.length,buildings:APT_BUILDINGS.length,lots:APT_LOTS.length,stalls:APT_STALLS.length,cars,trees:APT_TREES.length,lights:APT_LIGHTS.length,stands:APT_STANDS.length,pois:Object.keys(APT_INTERACTIONS).length}
}

// ====================================================================================================================================
// v1.94 · AIRPORT B — traffic model. Pure functions of time: every aircraft / vehicle pose is computed from (clock, offsets).
// Needs: APTT_SPEC {ac:{id:{fp,an,w,h}},veh:{id:{gs,fp,an}},jb}  and  APTT_C {RWY,TWY,stands,GA,HELI,bld[],BRIDGE_Y}.
// Nothing here touches the DOM, so the same file is used by the offline solver (Node) and by the game.
// ====================================================================================================================================
const APTT_T=420, APTT_DT=.25;                 // one timetable cycle (s) and the audit step (s)
const APTT_WT=.75;                             // wings: the outer 25 % of each half-span is treated as visually passable
const apttTW=Math.PI*2;
const apttCl=(x,a,b)=>x<a?a:x>b?b:x;
const apttSm=x=>{x=apttCl(x,0,1);return x*x*(3-2*x)};
const apttAng=(a,b,t)=>{const d=(((b-a+Math.PI)%apttTW)+apttTW)%apttTW-Math.PI;return a+d*t};

// ---------- paths: polyline with rounded corners, sampled every ~2 px ----------------------------------------------------------------------
function apttPath(pts,r,o){
 if(pts.length>2){const q=[pts[0]],rr=Array.isArray(r)?[]:r;for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){if(Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-q[q.length-1][0],pts[i][1]-q[q.length-1][1])<.5){if(Array.isArray(r)&&i-1<r.length&&i>1)rr[q.length-2]=Math.max(rr[q.length-2]||0,r[i-1]||0);continue}q.push(pts[i]);if(Array.isArray(r)&&i<pts.length-1)rr[q.length-2]=r[i-1]}pts=q;if(Array.isArray(r))r=rr}
 const X=[],Y=[],arcIdx=[];
 const push=(x,y)=>{X.push(x);Y.push(y)};
 const line=(x0,y0,x1,y1)=>{const L=Math.hypot(x1-x0,y1-y0),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(L/2));for(let k=1;k<=n;k++)push(x0+(x1-x0)*k/n,y0+(y1-y0)*k/n)};
 push(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);let cx=pts[0][0],cy=pts[0][1];
 for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){
  const P=pts[i];
  if(i===pts.length-1){line(cx,cy,P[0],P[1]);break}
  const Q=pts[i+1];
  let ux=P[0]-cx,uy=P[1]-cy;const lu=Math.hypot(ux,uy);ux/=lu;uy/=lu;
  let vx=Q[0]-P[0],vy=Q[1]-P[1];const lv=Math.hypot(vx,vy);vx/=lv;vy/=lv;
  const cr=ux*vy-uy*vx,dt=ux*vx+uy*vy,phi=Math.atan2(Math.abs(cr),dt),rr=Array.isArray(r)?r[i-1]:r;
  if(phi<.002){line(cx,cy,P[0],P[1]);cx=P[0];cy=P[1];continue}
  let t=rr*Math.tan(phi/2);t=Math.min(t,o&&o.fullEnds&&i===1?lu:lu*.5,o&&o.fullEnds&&i===pts.length-2?lv:lv*.5);const re=t/Math.tan(phi/2);   /* GATE-77 S6b-c · p154 */
  const ax=P[0]-ux*t,ay=P[1]-uy*t;
  line(cx,cy,ax,ay);
  const sg=cr>0?1:-1,ox=ax+(-uy*sg)*re,oy=ay+(ux*sg)*re,a0=Math.atan2(ay-oy,ax-ox),m=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(re*phi/2)),i0=X.length-1;
  for(let k=1;k<=m;k++){const a=a0+sg*phi*k/m;push(ox+Math.cos(a)*re,oy+Math.sin(a)*re)}
  arcIdx.push([i0,X.length-1]);
  cx=X[X.length-1];cy=Y[Y.length-1];
 }
 const n=X.length,S=new Float64Array(n),TG=new Float64Array(n);
 for(let i=1;i<n;i++)S[i]=S[i-1]+Math.hypot(X[i]-X[i-1],Y[i]-Y[i-1]);
 for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++)TG[i]=Math.atan2(Y[i+1]-Y[i],X[i+1]-X[i]);TG[n-1]=TG[n-2];
 return{X,Y,S,TG,n,len:S[n-1],arcs:arcIdx.map(([a,b])=>({s0:S[a],s1:S[b]}))};
}
// position + tangent + sample index at arc length s (s may be negative: extrapolates backwards along the first tangent)
function apttAt(P,s){
 if(s<0){const k=P.TG[0];return[P.X[0]+Math.cos(k)*s,P.Y[0]+Math.sin(k)*s,k,0]}
 if(s>P.len)s=P.len;
 let lo=0,hi=P.n-1;while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(P.S[m]<=s)lo=m;else hi=m}
 const f=P.S[hi]>P.S[lo]?(s-P.S[lo])/(P.S[hi]-P.S[lo]):0;
 return[P.X[lo]+(P.X[hi]-P.X[lo])*f,P.Y[lo]+(P.Y[hi]-P.Y[lo])*f,P.TG[lo],lo];
}
// trailer tracking: the main gear follows the nose gear at a rigid distance d (aircraft off-tracking in turns)
function apttTrack(P,d,th0){
 const TH=new Float64Array(P.n);let mx=P.X[0]-d*Math.cos(th0),my=P.Y[0]-d*Math.sin(th0);TH[0]=th0;
 for(let i=1;i<P.n;i++){const nx=P.X[i],ny=P.Y[i];let vx=mx-nx,vy=my-ny;const l=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1;mx=nx+vx/l*d;my=ny+vy/l*d;TH[i]=Math.atan2(ny-my,nx-mx)}
 return TH;
}

// ---------- speed profiles: v(s) sampled every 3 px, time table by trapezoid integration ------------------------------------------------------
function apttProf(len,fn){
 const n=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(len/3)),d=len/n,v=new Float64Array(n+1),T=new Float64Array(n+1);
 for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)v[i]=Math.max(3,fn(i*d));
 for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)T[i]=T[i-1]+2*d/(v[i-1]+v[i]);
 return{len,n,d,v,T,dur:T[n]};
}
function apttTof(p,s){if(s<=0)return 0;if(s>=p.len)return p.dur;const f=s/p.d,i=Math.min(p.n-1,Math.floor(f));return p.T[i]+(p.T[i+1]-p.T[i])*(f-i)}
function apttSof(p,t){
 if(t<=0)return 0;if(t>=p.dur)return p.len;
 let lo=0,hi=p.n;while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(p.T[m]<=t)lo=m;else hi=m}
 return(lo+(t-p.T[lo])/(p.T[hi]-p.T[lo]))*p.d;
}
// generic ground profile: start/end speeds, accelerations, slow zones (arcs) with a smooth ramp
function apttVfn(len,o){
 const vmax=o.vmax,v0=o.v0??6,v1=o.v1??6,acc=o.acc??25,dec=o.dec??25,zones=o.zones||[],zacc=o.zacc??30;
 return s=>{let v=Math.min(vmax,Math.sqrt(v0*v0+2*acc*s),Math.sqrt(v1*v1+2*dec*Math.max(0,len-s)));
  for(const z of zones){const d=s<z[0]?z[0]-s:s>z[1]?s-z[1]:0;v=Math.min(v,Math.sqrt(z[2]*z[2]+2*zacc*d))}
  return v};
}
const apttArcZones=(P,v,pad=0)=>P.arcs.map(a=>[a.s0-pad,a.s1+pad,v]);

// ---------- legs / sequences -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// pose = [x,y,heading,z,alpha]
function apttMove(o){
 const P=o.path,pr=o.prof,TH=o.mode==='trk'?apttTrack(P,o.d,o.th0):null;
 return{kind:o.kind||'move',dur:pr.dur,len:P.len,path:P,prof:pr,meta:o.meta||{},
  pose(t){
   const s0=apttSof(pr,t),s=o.rev?P.len-s0:s0,a=apttAt(P,s),x=a[0],y=a[1];let th;
   if(o.mode==='trk'){th=TH[a[3]];if(o.endTh!=null)th=apttAng(th,o.endTh,apttSm((s-(P.len-o.endBlend))/o.endBlend))}
   else if(o.mode==='push')th=apttAng(o.th0,o.th1,apttSm((s-o.sa)/(o.sb-o.sa)));
   else if(o.mode==='fn')th=o.hdg(s,a[2]);
   else th=o.blend?apttAng(o.th0,a[2],apttSm(s/o.blend)):a[2];
   return[x,y,th,o.z?o.z(s,x,y):0,o.al?o.al(s,x,y):1];
  },
  endPose(){return this.pose(pr.dur)}};
}
const apttHold=(pose,dur,kind='hold')=>({kind,dur,pose:()=>pose});
const apttGap=dur=>({kind:'absent',dur,pose:()=>null});
function apttSeq(legs){
 let acc=0;const st=[];for(const l of legs){st.push(acc);acc+=l.dur}
 return{legs,st,dur:acc,
  at(t){if(t<0||t>=acc)return null;let i=legs.length-1;while(st[i]>t)i--;return legs[i].pose(t-st[i])},
  legAt(t){if(t<0||t>=acc)return null;let i=legs.length-1;while(st[i]>t)i--;return{i,leg:legs[i],t:t-st[i],start:st[i]}}};
}

// ---------- shapes (oriented boxes) for the conflict audit ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function apttAcGeom(id){
 if(apttAcGeom.c&&apttAcGeom.c[id])return apttAcGeom.c[id];
 const S=APTT_SPEC.ac[id],a=S.an,ng=a['Nose Gear']||[S.w/2,S.h/2],fp=S.fp;
 const g={ng,w:S.w,h:S.h,fp};
 g.F=[fp[0]-ng[0],fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0],fp[1]-ng[1],fp[1]+fp[3]-ng[1]];
 if(a['Left Wing']&&a['Main Gear']&&a['Tail']&&!/AC-HL/.test(id)){
  const tL=a['Left Wing'],tR=a['Right Wing'],mg=a['Main Gear'],tl=a['Tail'],nose=a['Nose'],cy=(tL[1]+tR[1])/2,half=(tR[1]-tL[1])/2;
  g.W=[tL[0]-12-ng[0],mg[0]+24-ng[0],cy-half*APTT_WT-ng[1],cy+half*APTT_WT-ng[1]];
  g.T=[tl[0]-ng[0],tl[0]+36-ng[0],cy-half*.3-ng[1],cy+half*.3-ng[1]];
  g.nose=nose[0]-ng[0];g.tail=tl[0]-ng[0];g.mgx=mg[0]-ng[0];
 }else{g.nose=fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0];g.tail=fp[0]-ng[0]}
 (apttAcGeom.c=apttAcGeom.c||{})[id]=g;return g;
}
function apttObb(x,y,th,box,layer,tag){
 const c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th),lx=(box[0]+box[1])/2,ly=(box[2]+box[3])/2,hx=(box[1]-box[0])/2,hy=(box[3]-box[2])/2;
 const wx=x+lx*c-ly*s,wy=y+lx*s+ly*c,ex=Math.abs(c)*hx+Math.abs(s)*hy,ey=Math.abs(s)*hx+Math.abs(c)*hy;
 return{x:wx,y:wy,hx,hy,c,s,L:layer,t:tag,x0:wx-ex,x1:wx+ex,y0:wy-ey,y1:wy+ey};
}
function apttObbHit(A,B,m){
 const dx=B.x-A.x,dy=B.y-A.y;
 for(let k=0;k<4;k++){let ux,uy;if(k===0){ux=A.c;uy=A.s}else if(k===1){ux=-A.s;uy=A.c}else if(k===2){ux=B.c;uy=B.s}else{ux=-B.s;uy=B.c}
  const rA=A.hx*Math.abs(ux*A.c+uy*A.s)+A.hy*Math.abs(-ux*A.s+uy*A.c),rB=B.hx*Math.abs(ux*B.c+uy*B.s)+B.hy*Math.abs(-ux*B.s+uy*B.c);
  if(Math.abs(dx*ux+dy*uy)>rA+rB+m)return false}
 return true;
}
// who may overlap whom: wings pass over tails / vehicles; vehicles pass under wings and tails; buildings only block fuselages and vehicles
const APTT_OK=new Set(['WT','TW','VW','WV','VT','TV']);
function apttConflict(a,b,m=6){
 const la=a.L,lb=b.L;
 if(la==='P'||lb==='P'){if(la===lb)return false;const p=la==='P'?a:b,o=la==='P'?b:a;if(o.L!=='V'&&o.L!=='F'&&o.L!=='W'&&o.L!=='T')return false;if(o.t===p.own)return false;return o.x0<=p.x1+3&&o.x1>=p.x0-3&&o.y0<=p.y1+3&&o.y1>=p.y0-3&&apttObbHit(o,p,3)}
 if(la==='R'||lb==='R')return la==='R'&&lb==='R'&&a.x0<=b.x1&&a.x1>=b.x0&&a.y0<=b.y1&&a.y1>=b.y0&&apttObbHit(a,b,0);
 if(la==='A'||lb==='A')return la==='A'&&lb==='A'&&a.x0<=b.x1+m&&a.x1>=b.x0-m&&a.y0<=b.y1+m&&a.y1>=b.y0-m&&apttObbHit(a,b,m);
 if(la==='EW'||lb==='EW')return e1WingConflict(a,b,m);
 if(la==='B'||lb==='B'){const o=la==='B'?b:a,bb=la==='B'?a:b,m=o.L==='V'?0:2;if(o.L!=='F'&&o.L!=='V')return false;return o.x0<=bb.x1+m&&o.x1>=bb.x0-m&&o.y0<=bb.y1+m&&o.y1>=bb.y0-m&&apttObbHit(o,bb,m)}
 if(typeof la==='string'&&typeof lb==='string'?(la.length+lb.length===2&&(la.length===1?((la==='W'&&(lb==='T'||lb==='V'))||(la==='T'&&(lb==='W'||lb==='V'))||(la==='V'&&(lb==='W'||lb==='T'))):APTT_OK.has(la.length===2?la:lb))):APTT_OK.has(la+lb))return false;
 return a.x0<=b.x1+m&&a.x1>=b.x0-m&&a.y0<=b.y1+m&&a.y1>=b.y0-m&&apttObbHit(a,b,m);
}
// shapes of one track at a pose.   track: {kind:'ac'|'veh'|'train', id, ...}
const APTT_RWY_BOX=()=>{const R=APTT_C.RWY;return[4000,8500,R.cy-R.w/2-20,R.cy+R.w/2+20]};
function apttShapes(tr,pose,out,lt){
 if(!pose)return out;
 const [x,y,th,z,al]=pose;
 if(tr.kind==='ac'){
  const g=apttAcGeom(tr.id);
  if(z>8){out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,g.F,'A',tr.nm),apttObb(x,y,th,g.W||g.F,'A',tr.nm));return out}
  out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,g.F,'F',tr.nm));if(G77_DKZ.on)g77DkTag(out[out.length-1],tr,x,y,th);   /* GATE-77P · p216 · D-194 */
  if(g.W){out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,g.W,'W',tr.nm));const full=aptFullWingEnvelope(g,x,y,th,tr.nm);if(full)out.push(full)}
  if(g.T)out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,g.T,'T',tr.nm));
 }else{
  if(al<.99)return out;                       // fading in/out at a door: not audited
  const hx=tr.hx,hy=tr.hy;
  out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,[-hx,hx,-hy,hy],'V',tr.nm));if(G77_DKZ.on)g77DkTag(out[out.length-1],tr,x,y,th);   /* p216 */
  if(tr.carts)for(let i=0;i<tr.carts.length;i++){const c=tr.carts[i],q=tr.cartAt(pose,i,lt,tr);out.push(apttObb(q[0],q[1],q[2],[-c.hx,c.hx,-c.hy,c.hy],'V',tr.nm));if(G77_DKZ.on)g77DkTag(out[out.length-1],tr,q[0],q[1],q[2])}   /* p216 */
 }
 return out;
}

const apttD=ac=>{const a=APTT_SPEC.ac[ac].an;return a['Nose Gear'][0]-a['Main Gear'][0]};

function apttArrive(ac,pts,radii,endTh){
 const K=APTT_CLS[ac],P=apttPath(pts,radii),sTd=APTT_X.TD-APTT_X.APP0,ex=P.arcs[0],len=P.len;
 const zones=P.arcs.map((a,i)=>[a.s0,a.s1,i?38:45]);
 const fn=s=>{
  let v;
  if(s<sTd-300)v=K.vApp;else if(s<sTd)v=K.vApp+(K.vTd-K.vApp)*(s-(sTd-300))/300;
  else{const a=(K.vTd*K.vTd-70*70)/(2*(ex.s0-sTd));v=Math.sqrt(Math.max(70*70,K.vTd*K.vTd-2*a*(s-sTd)))}
  if(s>ex.s1)v=Math.min(v,K.vTaxi);
  for(const z of zones){const d=s<z[0]?z[0]-s:s>z[1]?s-z[1]:0;v=Math.min(v,Math.sqrt(z[2]*z[2]+2*30*d))}
  return Math.min(v,Math.sqrt(36+2*22*Math.max(0,len-s)));
 };
 return apttMove({kind:'arrive',path:P,prof:apttProf(len,fn),mode:'trk',th0:0,d:apttD(ac),endTh,endBlend:70,
  z:s=>s<sTd?80*(1-s/sTd):0,al:()=>1,meta:{sTd,sEx0:ex.s0}});
}
function apttTaxi(ac,pts,radii,th0,kind='taxi',vmax){
 const K=APTT_CLS[ac],P=apttPath(pts,radii),len=P.len;
 const fn=apttVfn(len,{vmax:vmax||K.vTaxi,v0:6,v1:6,acc:20,dec:22,zones:apttArcZones(P,34,0)});
 return apttMove({kind,path:P,prof:apttProf(len,fn),mode:'trk',th0,d:apttD(ac)});
}
// generic: any path whose LAST arc is the turn onto the runway; speed ≤ taxi before it, constant acceleration after it, lift-off at xLo, climb-out fades at the world edge
// GATE-77 S6b · p144 · D-147 / WORLD-03: one east edge for whatever leaves or enters — from WORLD and from what the camera can show
const CAM_ZOOM_MIN=.45,VIEW_REF_W=2560;   // the farthest zoom (the map check, F4) · the widest supported window (css px)
function g77EdgeE(){return WORLD.x+WORLD.w+Math.ceil(VIEW_REF_W/2/CAM_ZOOM_MIN)}
// GATE-77 S6b-c · p153 · K-112 / K-113: everything the camera can show — the world plus half the largest supported window at the farthest
// zoom on every side (VIEW_REF_H: the tallest supported window, css px). Whatever enters or leaves does it beyond this box.
const VIEW_REF_H=1600;
function g77ViewR(){const mx=Math.ceil(VIEW_REF_W/2/CAM_ZOOM_MIN),my=Math.ceil(VIEW_REF_H/2/CAM_ZOOM_MIN);return{x0:WORLD.x-mx,x1:WORLD.x+WORLD.w+mx,y0:WORLD.y-my,y1:WORLD.y+WORLD.h+my}}
// how far the drawn aircraft (its sprite at the cap scale 1 + 130/420, and its shadow) reaches from its reference point
function g77AcReach(ac){const g=apttAcGeom(ac);if(!g||!g.F)return 260;const W=g.W||g.F;return Math.ceil(Math.max(-g.F[0],g.F[1],Math.abs(W[2]),Math.abs(W[3]),Math.abs(g.F[2]),Math.abs(g.F[3]))*(1+130/420)*1.25+130*.42+40)}
// K-112: the climb-out beyond the old end of the take-off track — drawn, never sampled (no shapes, no runway lock)
function g77OutLeg(ac,to){if(!to||!(to.dur>0))return null;const e=to.endPose();if(!e||!((e[3]||0)>8))return null;
 const q=to.pose(Math.max(0,to.dur-.25)),v=Math.max(80,Math.hypot(e[0]-q[0],e[1]-q[1])/.25),c=Math.cos(e[2]),sn=Math.sin(e[2]);if(c<.2)return null;
 const L=(g77ViewR().x1+g77AcReach(ac)-e[0])/c;if(!(L>0))return null;
 return{kind:'outbound',dur:L/v,len:L,pose:t=>{const s=v*Math.max(0,t);return[e[0]+s*c,e[1]+s*sn,e[2],Math.min(130,e[3]+s*.16),1]}}}
// K-113: the way in — from beyond the camera's reach north of the world, a base turn onto a short final, into the arrival leg's start
function g77InLeg(ac,arr){const K=APTT_CLS[ac];if(!K||!arr)return null;const a=arr.pose(0);if(!a)return null;
 const R=500,Lf=400,X0=a[0]-R-Lf,Ys=g77ViewR().y0-g77AcReach(ac);if(!(Ys<a[1]-R-10))return null;
 const P=apttPath([[X0,Ys],[X0,a[1]],[a[0],a[1]]],[R]),v=K.vApp,z0=a[3]||80;
 return apttMove({kind:'inbound',path:P,prof:apttProf(P.len,()=>v),th0:Math.PI/2,z:s=>z0+50*(1-s/P.len),al:()=>1})}
function apttTakeoff(ac,pts,radii,th0,xLo){
 // GATE-77 S6b-c · p153 · K-112: the track ends at APTT_X.END (its search and runway lock as before p144); the climb-out beyond is g77OutLeg
 const K=APTT_CLS[ac],P=apttPath(pts,radii),len=P.len,na=P.arcs.length,last=P.arcs[na-1],sAE=last.s1,xAE=apttAt(P,sAE)[0],sLo=sAE+((xLo||K.xLo)-xAE),vArc=30;
 const acc=(K.vLift*K.vLift-vArc*vArc)/(2*(sLo-sAE)),cap=Math.min(595,K.vLift*1.25);
 const zones=P.arcs.map((a,i)=>[a.s0,a.s1,i===na-1?vArc:34]);
 const pre=apttVfn(sAE,{vmax:K.vTaxi,v0:6,v1:vArc,acc:20,dec:30,zones});
 const fn=s=>s<sAE?pre(s):Math.min(cap,Math.sqrt(vArc*vArc+2*acc*(s-sAE)));
 return apttMove({kind:'takeoff',path:P,prof:apttProf(len,fn),mode:'trk',th0,d:apttD(ac),
  z:s=>s<sLo?0:Math.min(130,(s-sLo)*.16),al:()=>1,meta:{sAE,sLo}});   // GATE-77 S6b · p144 · K-106: no fade (D-147)
}
function apttPush(ac,cx,ngy,o={}){
 const K=APTT_CLS[ac],dir=o.dir||-1,yE=o.yE||APTT_X.LY,dx=o.dx||80,yMid=o.yMid??Math.max(yE+30,ngy-146);
 const P=apttPath([[cx,ngy],[cx,yMid],[cx+dir*dx,yE]],60),len=P.len;
 const fn=apttVfn(len,{vmax:K.vPush,v0:3,v1:3,acc:6,dec:6});
 return apttMove({kind:'push',path:P,prof:apttProf(len,fn),mode:'push',th0:Math.PI/2,th1:dir<0?Math.PI:0,sa:len*(o.sa??.2),sb:len*.95});
}

function apttVehMove(pts,radii,vmax,o={}){

  al:(s)=>{let a=1;const sIn=o.rev?len-s:s,sOut=o.rev?s:len-s;if(fadeIn)a=Math.min(a,sIn/fadeIn);if(fadeOut)a=Math.min(a,sOut/fadeOut);return apttCl(a,0,1)}});
}

 // ---- helicopters: H1/H2 exist since v1.93 (NE), H3-H6 in the G2 south airside enclave ---------------------------------------------------
 const hp=C.HELI;
 hp.forEach((h,i)=>A.helis.push({id:h.id,x:h.x,y:h.y,r:h.r,aircraft:h.aircraft,live:true,zone:'NE'}));

 bays:[{id:'N-PT1',fleet:'V-PT1',from:'Y-PT1',x:7346},{id:'N-PT2',fleet:'V-PT2',from:'Y-PT2',x:7382},{id:'N-PT3',fleet:'V-PT3',from:'Y-PT3',x:7418}]};
function g77NearBays(A){if(!G77_NB||!G77_NB.on)return;const N=G77_NB;
 for(const q of N.bays){if(A.bays.some(b=>b.id===q.id))continue;const src=A.bays.find(b=>b.id===q.from);if(!src)continue;src.occupied=false;
  A.bays.push({id:q.id,kind:src.kind,row:'NB',zone:'NB',x:q.x,w:N.w,x0:q.x-N.w/2,x1:q.x+N.w/2,y0:N.y0,y1:N.y1,yc:(N.y0+N.y1)/2,th:Math.PI/2,exitY:N.yW,asset:src.asset,scale:src.scale,occupied:true,fleetId:q.fleet})}}

// ==== GATE-77 S6b-d · p161 · D-119: +3 of the +6 (§6.8) in the free yard bays Y-PT1…3 ===============================================
var G77_FP={on:true,gc2:0,bays:{'Y-PT1':['SVC','V-SV3','VS-GS-01',.5],'Y-PT2':['GP','V-GP3','G7-GP',1],'Y-PT3':['LV','V-LV2','G7-LV',1]}};

  b.kind=q[0];b.fleetId=q[1];b.asset=q[2];b.scale=q[3];b.occupied=true;delete b.reserve;b.yc=(q[0]==='GP'||q[0]==='LV')?1390:1355}
 // the cargo GPU (GC — util .90 / .99, "no-gpu-vehicle" the biggest rejection): a second one in the west base, in the gap between the
 // west of the pushback tug W-PW1: x 5440 (5434–5446) — x 5507 (beside W-PW1) was in the tug's swing and x 5545 (between W-GC1 and W-HL1) too close to both (verify IDLE); the same row W (forward out to the lane, home along y 588)
 if(G77_FP.gc2&&!A.bays.some(b=>b.id==='W-GC2')){const g1=A.bays.find(b=>b.id==='W-GC1');if(g1){const x=G77_FP.gc2;A.bays.push(Object.assign({},g1,{id:'W-GC2',fleetId:'V-GC2',x,x0:x-g1.w/2,x1:x+g1.w/2}))}}}

// ====================================================================================================================================
// audit: every stand × every accepted aircraft (full geometry, no wing trimming) against buildings, neighbours, door envelopes, roads
// ====================================================================================================================================
function aplAudit(A){
 A=A||APL;const issues=[],C=APTT_C,Z=A.zones;
 const bld=C.bld.map(b=>({id:b.id,x0:b.x,x1:b.x+b.w,y0:b.y,y1:b.y+b.h}));
 const paved=[{x0:G77_STRIP.x,x1:G77_STRIP.x+G77_STRIP.w,y0:G77_STRIP.y,y1:G77_STRIP.y+G77_STRIP.h},{x0:5400,x1:6020,y0:394,y1:845},{x0:6020,x1:7236,y0:394,y1:772},{x0:G73_WEST_EXT.x,x1:G73_WEST_EXT.x+G73_WEST_EXT.w,y0:G73_WEST_EXT.y,y1:G73_WEST_EXT.y+G73_WEST_EXT.h},Z.wApron,Z.eBlock,Z.hard,Z.ne].map(r=>r.x0!==undefined?r:{x0:r.x,x1:r.x+r.w,y0:r.y,y1:r.y+r.h});
 const envOf=(s,ac)=>{const v=g77StandView(s,ac);return aplEnv(ac,v.ngx,v.ngy,v.th).map(aplBox)};
 const merge=a=>{let m={x0:1e9,x1:-1e9,y0:1e9,y1:-1e9};for(const b of a){m.x0=Math.min(m.x0,b.x0);m.x1=Math.max(m.x1,b.x1);m.y0=Math.min(m.y0,b.y0);m.y1=Math.max(m.y1,b.y1)}return m};
 const info=[];
 for(const s of A.stands){
  for(const ac of s.accepts){
   const env=envOf(s,ac),bb=merge(env);
   if(s.indoor){const h=bld.find(b=>b.id===s.hangar);if(!(bb.x0>=h.x0+4&&bb.x1<=h.x1-4&&bb.y0>=h.y0+4&&bb.y1<=h.y1-4))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': not inside '+s.hangar);continue}
   for(const e of env){
    for(const b of bld)if(aplHit(e,b,2))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': ✕ building '+b.id);
    for(const d of A.doors)if(aplHit(e,d,0))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': ✕ door envelope '+d.id);
    for(const d of A.alleys)if(aplHit(e,d,0))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': ✕ service alley '+d.id);
    if(aplHit(e,{x0:Z.perim.x,x1:Z.perim.x+Z.perim.w,y0:Z.perim.y,y1:Z.perim.y+Z.perim.h},0))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': ✕ perimeter road');
    if(e.y0<APT_Y.TS-4)issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': over the taxiway edge (y '+e.y0.toFixed(0)+')');
   }
   // all of the fuselage + wings inside the paved area
   if(!paved.some(p=>bb.x0>=p.x0-1&&bb.x1<=p.x1+1&&bb.y0>=p.y0-1&&bb.y1<=p.y1+1)){
    // the pax apron / cargo apron are adjacent: accept the union when the box straddles their common edge
    const u={x0:4805,x1:7236,y0:604,y1:845};const u2={x0:5400,x1:7236,y0:394,y1:772};
    const lg=s.large&&(ac==='AC-LG-01'||ac==='AC-MW-01')&&bb.x0>=6700&&bb.x1<=7316&&bb.y1<=772&&bb.y0>=G77_LG_EXT.y&&env.every(e=>e.y0>=APT_Y.LN||(e.x0>=G77_LG_EXT.x&&e.x1<=G77_LG_EXT.x+G77_LG_EXT.w));   // L + apron + the patch
    if(!lg&&!((bb.x0>=u.x0&&bb.x1<=u.x1&&bb.y0>=u.y0&&bb.y1<=u.y1)||(bb.x0>=u2.x0&&bb.x1<=u2.x1&&bb.y0>=u2.y0&&bb.y1<=u2.y1)))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': not on paving ['+bb.x0.toFixed(0)+'..'+bb.x1.toFixed(0)+' × '+bb.y0.toFixed(0)+'..'+bb.y1.toFixed(0)+']')}
   info.push({id:s.id,ac,x0:+bb.x0.toFixed(0),x1:+bb.x1.toFixed(0),y0:+bb.y0.toFixed(0),y1:+bb.y1.toFixed(0)});
  }
 }
 // neighbours: only the *default* occupant of every stand (first) against all accepted types of the others (largest possible neighbour)
 for(const a of A.stands){if(a.indoor)continue;
  for(const b of A.stands){if(b===a||b.indoor||a.id>=b.id)continue;
   for(const ac of a.accepts)for(const bc of b.accepts){if(g77Mars(a,ac,b)||g77Mars(b,bc,a))continue;
    const ea=envOf(a,ac),eb=envOf(b,bc);
    let hit=false;for(const p of ea)for(const q of eb)if(aplHit(p,q,3))hit=true;
    if(hit)issues.push('stands '+a.id+'('+ac.slice(3,5)+')/'+b.id+'('+bc.slice(3,5)+') overlap');
   }}}
 // GATE-77 S5d · D-97: the maintenance route (P6's line + the taxi line) free of buildings, bays and every stand but P6
 for(const r of g77MaintRoute()){for(const b of bld)if(aplHit(r,b,0))issues.push('maint-route '+r.id+' ✕ building '+b.id);
  for(const b of A.bays)if(b.x0!=null&&b.y0!=null&&aplHit(r,b,0))issues.push('maint-route '+r.id+' ✕ bay '+b.id);
  for(const s of A.stands){if(s.id==='P6'||s.indoor)continue;for(const ac of s.accepts)for(const e of envOf(s,ac))if(aplHit(r,e,0))issues.push('maint-route '+r.id+' ✕ stand '+s.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5))}}
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues,stands:A.stands.length,helis:A.helis.length,bays:A.bays.length,fleet:A.fleet.length,info};
}

// ====================================================================================================================================
// v1.94 · AIRPORT B — PERSISTENT GROUND-OPS FLEET (v3.83 contract).
// Every vehicle exists for the whole session: it STANDS IN ITS HOME BAY of the G2 yard, is dispatched for a task, drives out along the
// airside service roads, works, drives back and parks in the SAME bay.   No fade-in / fade-out, no spawn, no despawn.
// A task is one vehicle track  [out][work][back]  placed in the shared reservation table (apt_ops).  If no vehicle of the needed type is free,
// the work (and so the aircraft's turnaround) simply starts later; if nothing fits in time, the visit is not admitted (the aircraft waits).
// DOM free.  Needs apt_prim, apt_layout (APL), apt_ops (AO, aoSamp, aoSearch, aoCommit ...).
// ====================================================================================================================================
const AF={
 VMAX:{PT:46,BT:36,FT:44,SH:44,SVC:42,MX:40,ARFF:48,AB:40,MS:30,EMS:46,POL:50,BL:30,CT:38,GP:34,LV:36,WT:36,PW:46,GC:34,HL:26,CU:30,FW:44},

 cart:{hx:10,hy:6.5},

const afPtHx=()=>APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-PT-01'].fp[2]/2;
// ---------- path helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function afPL(list){ // list of [x,y,r]; coincident neighbours are merged
 const q=[];for(const p of list){const l=q[q.length-1];if(l&&Math.hypot(p[0]-l[0],p[1]-l[1])<.5){if(p[2]!=null)l[2]=p[2];continue}q.push([p[0],p[1],p[2]])}
 return{pts:q.map(p=>[p[0],p[1]]),rad:q.slice(1,-1).map(p=>p[2]==null?20:p[2])};
}
const afMv=(list,vm,o)=>{const {pts,rad}=afPL(list);return apttVehMove(pts,rad,vm,o)};
// row X (long vehicles, open to the hardstand): reverse straight out of the column, then forward round a right-hand loop onto the westbound lane
// row Y: forward out of the bay (south), west along lane O2, north on the west spine (x wOut), west on the hardstand lane;  back: east on the hardstand lane, south on the spine (x wIn), east along lane I into the bay
const afBayOutList=b=>{const L=APL.lanes;if(b.row==='EM')return g77AmbBayOut(b);return b.row==='HS'?[[b.x+22,AF.HW,0]]:b.row==='WR'?[[b.x-g77WLaneR('FW')-12,CARGO_W.lane,0]]:b.row==='W'||b.row==='WT'?[[b.x,b.yc,0],[b.x,CARGO_W.lane,14]]:b.row==='X'?(G77_YX&&G77_YX.on?(G77_YX.mode==='curve'?[[b.x+G77_YX.dx,AF.HW,0]]:[[b.x,L.xTop,0],[b.x-G77_YX.mx,AF.HW,G77_YX.mr]]):[[b.x,L.xTop,0],[L.wOut,L.xTop,16],[L.wOut,AF.HW,16]]):(()=>{const dd=b.x-L.wOut;if(dd<60)return[[b.x,b.yc,0],[b.x,L.O2,60],[L.wOut,L.O2-60,60],[L.wOut,AF.HW,30]];const r2=Math.min(60,dd-12),r1=Math.min(18,Math.max(6,dd-r2));return[[b.x,b.yc,0],[b.x,L.O2,r1],[L.wOut,L.O2,r2],[L.wOut,AF.HW,30]]})()};   /* GATE-77 S6b-c · p152 · K-104: the corner onto wOut r 24 → 60; only the bay next to the column (Y-BL1, 52 px) jogs diagonally (60 px up) */
const afBayIn=b=>{const L=APL.lanes;if(b.row==='EM')return g77AmbBayIn(b);return b.row==='HS'?[[b.x,AF.HE,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]]:b.row==='X'?[[b.x,AF.HE,20],[b.x,b.yc,0]]:[[L.wIn,AF.HE,30],[L.wIn,L.I,24],[b.x,L.I,b.kind==='MX'||b.kind==='BL'?6:16],[b.x,b.yc,0]]};
const afNodeGL=()=>({inX:AF.GLN,outX:AF.GLS}), afNodeAL=x=>({inX:x,outX:x});

// bag-train carts are articulated: cart i sits where the tractor's centre was d_i px of driving ago (forward-only tasks), straight behind it at rest
const AF_CD=[19,43];
function afCum(tr){
 if(tr._cum)return tr._cum;
 const dur=tr.seq.dur,dt=.1,n=Math.ceil(dur/dt)+1,C=new Float32Array(n);let p0=tr.seq.at(0)||tr.seq.at(1e-6);
 for(let i=1;i<n;i++){const p=tr.seq.at(Math.min(i*dt,dur-1e-6));C[i]=C[i-1]+(p&&p0?Math.hypot(p[0]-p0[0],p[1]-p0[1]):0);if(p)p0=p}
 return tr._cum=C;
}
function afCartAt(pose,i,lt,tr){
 const d=(tr&&tr.cd||AF_CD)[i];
 if(lt==null||!tr||!tr.seq||!tr.seq.legs.length){const c=Math.cos(pose[2]),s=Math.sin(pose[2]);return[pose[0]-c*d,pose[1]-s*d,pose[2]]}
 const C=afCum(tr),dt=.1,n=C.length,f=Math.min(Math.max(lt,0)/dt,n-1),a=Math.floor(f),b=Math.min(n-1,a+1),cur=C[a]+(C[b]-C[a])*(f-a),D=cur-d;
 if(D<=0){const p=tr.seq.at(0),c=Math.cos(p[2]),s=Math.sin(p[2]);return[p[0]+c*D,p[1]+s*D,p[2]]}
 let lo=0,hi=n-1;while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(C[m]<=D)lo=m;else hi=m}
 const tt=(lo+(C[hi]>C[lo]?(D-C[lo])/(C[hi]-C[lo]):0))*dt,p=tr.seq.at(Math.min(tt,tr.seq.dur-1e-6));
 return[p[0],p[1],p[2]];
}
function afTrackOf(v,legs){
 const extra=v.type==='BT'?(v.bay&&v.bay.carts>2?{carts:Array(v.bay.carts).fill(AF.cart),cartAt:afCartAt,cd:G77_CD4.slice(0,v.bay.carts)}:{carts:[AF.cart,AF.cart],cartAt:afCartAt}):v.type==='CU'?{carts:[AF.cart,AF.cart,AF.cart],cartAt:afCartAt,cd:G77_DK.cd}:{};
 return apttVehTrack(v.asset,v.id,0,legs,extra);
}

 });

}

// ---- S2 services: which (AIR-37 / 41 "as needed"), where (a work position per stand / type), how (a route per stand template) -----------

// AIR-41: water / lavatory "as needed", catering on most airline flights (always on the narrow-body), cabin service on every passenger

function g77Need(code,svc,ac){const h=g77Hash(code+'#'+svc)%100;
 if(svc==='catering')return ac==='AC-NB-01'?true:ac==='AC-RJ-01'?h<60:ac==='AC-TP-01'?h<35:h<50;

// +1: the service side is the aircraft's lateral −y (west for a nose-south stand); −1: the other side
// remote stands P6 / P5: the east side — the remote baggage trains use two columns on the west side (F2_REMOTE_BAG), the fuel truck
// / bus / stairs work forward; the aft east side is free and reached from the road y 590 behind the tails
function g77SideSign(sd){if(sd.id==='P6')return 1;return sd.svcSide?-sd.svcSide:(sd.zone==='ne'||sd.id==='GA1'||sd.id==='GA2'||sd.id==='P5')?-1:1}   // GATE-77 S5b: P6 serviced from the west
// the work position (centre) of a service vehicle, parallel to the fuselage on the service side, in three lanes measured from the fuselage
// edge (A 26 · B 49 · C 73.5 px; a long truck needs ≥ 34 px to turn in at the nose). Forward: cabin service, then catering, at the service door,
// outside the baggage train's columns (F: ≥ 82 px from the centre line). Aft — north of the baggage train's hairpin at the wing root
// (fy − 30 ± the tractor + the separation): belt loader (A), water and behind it the lavatory truck (C).
// Remote stands (east side, from the road behind the tails): catering / cabin service at the aft galley door (B), lavatory aft-most (B).
// GPU: remote stands only, in front of the nose (P6) / beside it (P5).
function g77SvcSpot(sd,ac,svc){

 const th=sd.th,u=[Math.cos(th),Math.sin(th)],n=[-Math.sin(th),Math.cos(th)],s=g77SideSign(sd);
 const P=(a,d)=>[sd.cx+u[0]*a+n[0]*d*s,sd.ngy+u[1]*a+n[1]*d*s];

 const rem=sd.id==='P6'||sd.id==='P5',F=Math.max(hw+34,82);   // F: outside the baggage train's return column c3 (centre line + 58 ± 6.5) + the separation
 const lgT=sd.ngy+tail<APT_Y.LS+20,aft=-(sd.ngy-(APT_Y.LS+48));
 if(svc==='belt'&&!S6A_LAY.old){const LY=s6aBagLay(sd,ac);if(LY&&LY.belt)return LY.blC}   // GATE-77 S6a M3b   // GATE-77 S5b · K-66: the large jet's tail is on L — its aft row stays 48 px south of L
 if(lgT&&svc==='belt')return P(aft,A+14);if(lgT&&svc==='water')return P(aft,C);if(lgT&&svc==='lavatory')return P(aft+49,C);
 if(svc==='catering'){if(!S6A_LAY.old&&sd.tpl==='bridge'){const ad=s6rCatAD(ac),D=s6aDimOf('CT');if(ad&&D)return P(ad[0],hw+S6R_CAT.gap+D[0]/2+.5)}if(!S6A_LAY.old&&rem){const ad=s6rCatADs(sd,ac),D=s6aDimOf('CT'),wst=sd.id==='P6'&&ad!==null&&typeof g2Rear==='function'&&g2Rear(sd,ac);if(ad&&D)return P(ad[0],(sd.id==='P6'&&!wst?-1:1)*(hw+S6R_CAT.gap+D[0]/2+.5))}   // GATE-77 S6r · M5b: P5 / P6 — square to the galley door
 if(!S6A_LAY.old&&(sd.tpl==='bridge'||rem))return P(s6aCatAlong(g,rem?1:1),hw+16.5);return rem?P(as-23.5,B):P(doorA+28,F)}   // GATE-77 S6a M3b: the aft door, beside the fuselage   // remote stands: the stairs / bus work at the forward door — the aft galley door
 if(svc==='belt')return P(as-26,A);
 if(svc==='cleaning'){const LY=!rem&&!S6A_LAY.old&&s6aBagLay(sd,ac);if(LY&&LY.belt)return P(Math.min(nose-28.5,doorA+34),hw+16.5);return rem?P(as-23.5,B):P(doorA+28,F)}   // the service door, before catering (the same spot, one after the other)
 if(svc==='water')return P(as-21,C);
 if(svc==='lavatory')return rem?P(as-70,B):P(as-70,C);   // bridge stands: behind the water truck in lane C (one after the other)
 if(svc==='gpu')return P(nose+19,0);   // GATE-77 S5b: P5 too — in front of the nose (the stairs stand beside it)   // P5: no column from the south (hangars) — beside the nose
 return null}

  if(sd.ngy+g.F[0]<APT_Y.LS+20&&!fwd){const yC=APT_Y.LS+18,oX=sd.cx+160,nC=sd.large?{node,inn:[[GLN,L,26],[GLN,yC,20],[x,yC,14],[x,y,0]],mode:'rev',back:[[x,yC,0],[GLS,yC,14],[GLS,L,22]]}:{node,inn:[[GLN,L,26],[oX,L,20],[oX,yC,14],[x,yC,14],[x,y,0]],mode:'rev',back:[[x,yC,0],[oX,yC,14],[oX,L,22],[GLS,L,26]]};return[nC,near]}   // GATE-77 S5b · K-66: the large jet — round the wing, not the tail
  return fwd?[near,tail]:[north,tail,near]}

// ==== 25.10 · K-160 / K-163 · p318: the route check of a service vehicle — through a grid of the obstacles (the same answer) ====
var G77_RC={on:true,pad:4,cell:48,calls:0,ms:0,stamp:0,sg:null,ig:null};
function g77RouteClear(sd,ac,role,D){

    for(const b of bld)if(apttConflict(a,b))return false;for(const b of AO.ST)if(b.L!=='S'&&aoC(a,b))return false}}}

 // 25.10 · p318: the obstacles in a grid of C px (each box grown by M — the largest margin of aoC / apttConflict / e1WingConflict); a
 // sample of the route is tested only against the obstacles in the cells its box covers.  Every test needs the two boxes to touch within
 // M, so an obstacle in no shared cell cannot change the answer — the same true / false.  A shape without a finite box is tested always.
 // The grids of the static obstacles (buildings, AO.ST) and of the idle fleet are kept while their lists are the same.
 const fin=b=>b.x0<=b.x1&&b.y0<=b.y1;

   const i0=Math.floor((b.x0-M)/C),i1=Math.floor((b.x1+M)/C),j0=Math.floor((b.y0-M)/C),j1=Math.floor((b.y1+M)/C);if((i1-i0+1)*(j1-j0+1)>4096){all.push(e);continue}
   for(let i=i0;i<=i1;i++)for(let j=j0;j<=j1;j++){const key=i*100003+j;let L=G.get(key);if(!L)G.set(key,L=[]);L.push(e)}}return{G,all}};

 let IG=RC.ig;if(!IG||IG.idle!==idle||IG.M!==M||IG.C!==C){const L=[];for(const [id,q] of idle)for(const b of q)L.push([b,0,0,id]);IG=RC.ig=Object.assign(grid(L),{idle,M,C})}

 for(const v of vs){const B=afBuild(v,D,20),seq=B.trk.seq,vid=v.id;   // every vehicle of the role (their bays differ)
  for(let t=0;t<seq.dur;t+=AO.DT){const p=seq.at(t);if(!p)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(B.trk,p,sh);
   for(const a of sh){const stamp=++RC.stamp;for(const f of own)if(aoC(a,f)){RC.ms+=performance.now()-T0;return false}
    for(const e of SG.all)if(hit(a,e)){RC.ms+=performance.now()-T0;return false}for(const e of IG.all)if(e[3]!==vid&&hit(a,e)){RC.ms+=performance.now()-T0;return false}
    if(!fin(a)){for(const S of [SG.G,IG.G])for(const L of S.values())for(const e of L)if(e[2]!==stamp){e[2]=stamp;if(e[3]!==vid&&hit(a,e)){RC.ms+=performance.now()-T0;return false}}continue}
    const i0=Math.floor(a.x0/C),i1=Math.floor(a.x1/C),j0=Math.floor(a.y0/C),j1=Math.floor(a.y1/C);
    for(let i=i0;i<=i1;i++)for(let j=j0;j<=j1;j++){const key=i*100003+j;
     const L=SG.G.get(key);if(L)for(const e of L)if(e[2]!==stamp){e[2]=stamp;if(hit(a,e)){RC.ms+=performance.now()-T0;return false}}

 RC.ms+=performance.now()-T0;return true}
function g77SvcRoute(sd,ac,role,c,k2){

function g77GseDest(role,sd,ac){

// the services of one visit, in the AIR-41 order: nominal start after on-block and the time at the aircraft
function g77SvcPlan(sd,ac,code,q,phase,dwell){
 const P=g77Prof(sd,ac);if(!P||G77_STAGE<2)return[];const out=[],walk=n=>8+Math.max(0,n-1)*.92,seats=P.seats||0;
 const add=(svc,t,hold)=>{if(!P.svc.includes(svc)||!g77Need(code,svc,ac))return;const role=(svc==='catering'&&typeof g77CsFor==='function'&&g77CsFor(ac))?'cats':G77_ROLE_OF[svc];   // GATE-77 S7-a · p185

 // early: before the baggage trains are planned (the loader is at the hold first and stays until the last load; the GPU from on-block)
 if(phase==='early'){add('gpu',4,Math.max(60,dwell-50));add('belt',6,Math.max(80,dwell-16));add('highloader',8,Math.max(90,dwell-40));return out}
 add('cleaning',12+walk(q.paxA),Math.min(110,Math.max(40,30+seats*.3)));
 add('water',24,30);add('lavatory',34,30);
 add('catering',20+q.paxA*.25,typeof s6rCatHold==='function'?s6rCatHold(sd,ac,code):Math.min(95,35+seats*.25));   // GATE-77 S6r · M5 · K-82
 return out}

function g77TrainBays(A){for(const b of g77TrainBayTable())if(!A.bays.some(q=>q.id===b.id))A.bays.push(b)}
// the stand loop: in column alongside the high loader (CG) / the forward door (TP cargo), the transfer point yT, out column 40 px further out
function g77StandLoop(sd,ac){const g=apttAcGeom(ac),P=g77Prof(sd,ac),side=g77CargoSide(sd),hw=g.F[3],hl=!!(P&&P.svc.includes('highloader')),S=APTT_SPEC.ac[ac];

 return{inX,outX,yT,hl,side,door:[sd.cx+side*hw,sd.ngy+(dr?dr[0]-ng[0]:-10)]}}
// one trip: kind 'in' (empty to the stand → the ULDs onto the dollies → the deck → home), 'out' (home → the deck → the ULDs → the stand → home)
function g77TrainBuild(v,sd,ac,kind,n){
 const vm=AF.VMAX.CU,LN=CARGO_W.lane,K=G77_DK,S=g77StandLoop(sd,ac),h=v.bay.x,cd=K.cd,O=K.outX,legs=[],ev=[];let pose=v.home,t=0;
 const go=(pts,kd)=>{const m=afMv(pts,vm,{th0:pose[2],blend:28,v0:4,v1:3});m.kind=kd||'mid';legs.push(m);pose=m.endPose();t+=m.dur;return m};
 const hold=(dur,tag)=>{const m=apttHold(pose,dur,'svc');m.cg=tag;legs.push(m);const a=t;t+=dur;return a};
 const U=(x0,y,x1)=>{const r=Math.abs(x1-x0)/2,top=y-12-r;return[[x0,y,0],[x0,top,r],[x1,top,r]]};
 const yS=k=>S.yT-cd[k],tx=S.hl?10:6,dk=4.5,out={kind,n,ev:[],stand:null,deck:null};
 const atStand=dir=>{const t0=t;for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const a=hold(tx,{at:'stand',k,dir});out.ev.push({k,t0:a,t1:a+tx,where:'stand',dir});if(k<n-1)go([[S.inX,yS(k),0],[S.inX,yS(k+1),0]],'svc')}out.stand={t0,t1:t}};
 const atDeck=dir=>{const t0=t;hold(n*dk+1,{at:'deck',dir});for(let k=0;k<n;k++)out.ev.push({k,t0:t0+.5+k*dk,t1:t0+.5+(k+1)*dk,where:'deck',dir});out.deck={t0,t1:t}};
 if(kind==='in'){
  go([...U(h,K.stopY,O),[O,LN,16],[S.inX,LN,16],[S.inX,yS(0),0]],'out');atStand('on');
  go([...U(S.inX,yS(n-1),S.outX),[S.outX,LN,16],[K.inX,LN,16],[K.inX,K.stopY,0]],'mid');atDeck('off');
  go([...U(K.inX,K.stopY,O),[O,LN,14],[h,LN,14],[h,K.stopY,0]],'back');
 }else{
  go([...U(h,K.stopY,O),[O,LN,14],[K.inX,LN,16],[K.inX,K.stopY,0]],'out');atDeck('on');
  go([...U(K.inX,K.stopY,O),[O,LN,16],[S.inX,LN,16],[S.inX,yS(0),0]],'mid');atStand('off');
  go([...U(S.inX,yS(n-1),S.outX),[S.outX,LN,16],[h,LN,14],[h,K.stopY,0]],'back');
 }
 const trk=afTrackOf(v,legs);trk.cg=out;return{trk,dur:trk.seq.dur,dStand:out.stand.t0,dStandEnd:out.stand.t1,deck:out.deck,cg:out}}
// the deck is one resource: outbound ULDs are built on it before the train comes (prep), inbound ULDs broken down after it has left (post)
const G77_ULD_BUILD=9;
function g77DeckIv(B,s,kind,n){const t0=aoT(s),CT=15;return kind==='out'?[t0+B.deck.t0-n*G77_ULD_BUILD-2-CT,t0+B.deck.t1]:[t0+B.deck.t0,t0+B.deck.t1+n*G77_ULD_BUILD+2+CT]}   // (+ the conveyor's travel: one conveyor)
function g77DeckFree(iv){const D=AO.g77Deck||(AO.g77Deck=[]);for(const q of D)if(iv[0]<q[1]&&iv[1]>q[0])return false;return true}
function g77DeckAdd(iv){const D=AO.g77Deck||(AO.g77Deck=[]);D.push(iv);AO.LOG.push(()=>{const i=D.indexOf(iv);if(i>=0)D.splice(i,1)});if(D.length>80){const c=AO.t-120;for(let i=D.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(D[i][1]<c&&D[i]!==iv)D.splice(i,1)}}
function* g77TrainG(sd,ac,kind,ulds,tStand,maxD,meta,xh){
 const n=ulds.length;let best=null;
 for(const v of afCands('CU',2)){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  const B=g77TrainBuild(v,sd,ac,kind,n),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sNom=Math.max(aoSlUp(tStand-B.dStand),afSEarliest()),lim=sNom+aoSl(maxD);let s0=sNom,s=-1;
  while(s0<=lim){s=(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,s0,best?Math.min(best.s-1,lim):lim,xh,sm.K));if(s<0)break;if(g77DeckFree(g77DeckIv(B,s,kind,n)))break;s0=s+4;s=-1}
  if(s<0)continue;if(!best||s<best.s)best={v,B,sm,s};if(s-sNom<=aoSl(6))break}
 if(!best)return null;
 best.B.cg.ulds=ulds.slice();best.B.cg.code=meta.code;
 const t0=aoT(best.s),task=afCommit(best.v,best.B.trk,best.sm,best.s,'cgo',Object.assign({kind,ulds:ulds.slice(),at:t0+best.B.dStand,done:t0+best.B.dStandEnd},meta));
 {const iv=g77DeckIv(best.B,best.s,kind,n);g77DeckAdd(iv);task.deck=g77DeckRec(best.B,best.s,kind,ulds,iv,task)}task.cg=best.B.cg;task.v=best.v;return task}
// the cargo of one visit (AIR-44): the units of the type both ways, as ULD ids; the trips of 3
function g77CargoUnits(code,q){const u=q&&q.cargoU||0,A=[],D=[];for(let k=0;k<u;k++){A.push(code+'/I'+(k+1));D.push(code+'/O'+(k+1))}return{in:A,out:D}}
function g77Chunks(a,n){const o=[];for(let i=0;i<a.length;i+=n)o.push(a.slice(i,i+n));return o}
// the trips of one visit: inbound first (the high loader takes the ULDs out of the aircraft), then outbound; one train at the stand at a time
function* g77CargoTripsG(sd,ac,code,q,hl,tOB,xh,P){
 const C=g77CargoUnits(code,q),S=g77StandLoop(sd,ac),trips=[];if(!C.in.length&&!C.out.length)return{trips,end:0};
 let tA=hl?hl.at+6:tOB+G77_CHOCK+24,end=0,left=Math.ceil(C.in.length/3)+Math.ceil(C.out.length/3);const tMax=hl?hl.done-4:Infinity;
 for(const [kind,list] of [['in',C.in],['out',C.out]])for(const ul of g77Chunks(list,3)){
  const r=yield* g77TrainG(sd,ac,kind,ul,tA,420,{code,svc:'cargo'},xh);if(!r||r.done>tMax)return null;
  trips.push(r);P.vt.push(r);tA=r.done+2;end=Math.max(end,r.done+4);left--;if(tA+left*36>tMax)return null}   // (a lower bound: 3 ULDs at the stand ≥ 36 s — give up early when the rest can no longer fit)
 P.cgo={in:C.in,out:C.out,trips,loop:S,hl:hl||null};return{trips,end}}   // (hl: the high loader's task {at, done, v})

// ==== GATE-77 S4 · the ULD deck (records) and the elevated conveyor ======================================================================
// a deck record per train stop: {kind, ulds, stop:[t0,t1] (the train at the deck), iv:[from,to] (prep / post included)}
function g77DeckRec(B,s,kind,ulds,iv,task){const t0=aoT(s),R={kind,ulds:ulds.slice(),n:ulds.length,stop:[t0+B.deck.t0,t0+B.deck.t1],iv,code:task&&task.code,v:task&&task.v};

const G77_CONV=[[5465,818],[5400,735],[5212,680]];   // AP-05's north face (inside) → a pillar between the lane and the rig apron → the deck's south end
function g77ConvLen(){if(g77ConvLen.v)return g77ConvLen.v;let l=0;for(let i=1;i<G77_CONV.length;i++)l+=Math.hypot(G77_CONV[i][0]-G77_CONV[i-1][0],G77_CONV[i][1]-G77_CONV[i-1][1]);return g77ConvLen.v=l}
function g77ConvAt(s){let l=s;for(let i=1;i<G77_CONV.length;i++){const a=G77_CONV[i-1],b=G77_CONV[i],d=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(l<=d){const u=l/d;return[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u,Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0])]}l-=d}const z=G77_CONV[G77_CONV.length-1];return[z[0],z[1],0]}
// the deck state at time t: ULDs on the three slots {k, id, a (0..1 built / remaining)}
function g77DeckState(t){const out=[];for(const R of AO.g77DeckR||[]){if(t<R.iv[0]||t>R.iv[1])continue;
 for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){const id=R.ulds[k],tx=R.stop[0]+.5+k*4.5;
  if(R.kind==='out'){const b0=R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+k*G77_ULD_BUILD,b1=b0+G77_ULD_BUILD;if(t<b0||t>=tx)continue;out.push({k,id,a:Math.min(1,(t-b0)/(b1-b0))})}
  else{const ta=tx+4.5,d0=R.stop[1]+k*G77_ULD_BUILD,d1=d0+G77_ULD_BUILD;if(t<ta||t>=d1)continue;out.push({k,id,a:t<d0?1:1-(t-d0)/(d1-d0)})}}}
 return out}
// the conveyor flow at t: +1 AP-05 → deck (outbound build), −1 deck → AP-05 (inbound break-down), 0 idle
function g77ConvFlow(t){for(const R of AO.g77DeckR||[]){if(R.kind==='out'&&t>=R.iv[0]&&t<R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+R.n*G77_ULD_BUILD)return 1;if(R.kind==='in'&&t>=R.stop[1]&&t<R.stop[1]+R.n*G77_ULD_BUILD+15)return -1}return 0}

// ==== GATE-77 S4 · the AP-05 ledger and QA-56 ===============================================================================================
// pieces per ULD (deterministic); a container from a truck dock or the rail–air rigs becomes up to 3 outbound ULDs (one train load), and the
// inbound ULDs of one train load are consolidated into one outbound container — pieces conserved
const G77_CONV_T=15;   // the conveyor's travel time (≈ 290 px at 20 px/s)
const G77_DOCKS=[{id:'D1',x:5510},{id:'D2',x:5554},{id:'D3',x:5598},{id:'D4',x:5642}],G77_DOCK_Y=944;
function g77UldPieces(id){return 6+g77Hash(id+'#p')%9}
function g77CargoLedger(P){
 if(!P||!P.cgo)return null;if(P.cgo.led)return P.cgo.led;const L={containers:[],ulds:{}},code=P.code;let j=0;
 for(const T of P.cgo.trips){const R=T.deck,cg=T.cg||T.tr&&T.tr.cg;if(!R||!cg)continue;const S=P.cgo.loop,n=T.ulds.length,t0=T.t0;
  const pcs=T.ulds.map(g77UldPieces),tot=pcs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),h=g77Hash(code+'#c'+j),rail=false,dock=G77_DOCKS[(T.kind==='out'?0:2)+h%2];
  const st=k=>cg.ev.find(e=>e.k===k&&e.where==='stand'),dk=k=>cg.ev.find(e=>e.k===k&&e.where==='deck');
  if(T.kind==='out'){const C={id:'CT-'+code+'-'+(++j),dir:'in',src:rail?'rail–air (FRT)':'truck '+dock.id,dock:rail?null:dock.id,pieces:tot,ulds:T.ulds.slice(),tArr:R.iv[0]-70-h%90,tOpen:R.iv[0]-24,tOpen1:R.iv[0]-1};L.containers.push(C);
   T.ulds.forEach((u,k)=>{const b0=R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+k*G77_ULD_BUILD,e1=dk(k),e2=st(k);L.ulds[u]={id:u,dir:'out',pieces:pcs[k],container:C.id,trip:T.v&&T.v.id,dolly:k,
    ev:[{t:C.tArr,at:'AP-05 · '+C.src},{t:C.tOpen,t1:C.tOpen1,at:'opened · forklift'},{t:b0-G77_CONV_T,t1:b0+G77_ULD_BUILD,at:'AP-05 → conveyor → deck slot '+k+' (built)'},
     {t:t0+e1.t0,t1:t0+e1.t1,at:'deck → dolly '+k,mover:T.v&&T.v.id},{t:t0+e1.t1,t1:t0+e2.t0,at:'dolly '+k+' · train',mover:T.v&&T.v.id},{t:t0+e2.t0,t1:t0+e2.t1,at:S.hl?'dolly → high loader → door':'dolly → door',mover:S.hl?(P.cgo.hl&&P.cgo.hl.v&&P.cgo.hl.v.id):T.v&&T.v.id},{t:t0+e2.t1,at:'aboard '+code}]}})}
  else{const C={id:'CX-'+code+'-'+(++j),dir:'out',dst:rail?'rail–air (FRT)':'truck '+dock.id,dock:rail?null:dock.id,pieces:tot,ulds:T.ulds.slice(),tFull:R.iv[1]+G77_CONV_T+1};L.containers.push(C);
   T.ulds.forEach((u,k)=>{const e2=st(k),e1=dk(k),d0=R.stop[1]+k*G77_ULD_BUILD;L.ulds[u]={id:u,dir:'in',pieces:pcs[k],container:C.id,trip:T.v&&T.v.id,dolly:k,
    ev:[{t:P.tOB,at:'aboard '+code},{t:t0+e2.t0,t1:t0+e2.t1,at:S.hl?'door → high loader → dolly':'door → dolly',mover:S.hl?(P.cgo.hl&&P.cgo.hl.v&&P.cgo.hl.v.id):T.v&&T.v.id},{t:t0+e2.t1,t1:t0+e1.t0,at:'dolly '+k+' · train',mover:T.v&&T.v.id},
     {t:t0+e1.t0,t1:t0+e1.t1,at:'dolly → deck slot '+k,mover:T.v&&T.v.id},{t:d0,t1:d0+G77_ULD_BUILD+G77_CONV_T,at:'deck slot '+k+' (broken down) → conveyor → AP-05'},{t:C.tFull,at:'container '+C.id+' → '+C.dst}]}})}}
 return P.cgo.led=L}
// QA-56: every ULD both ways — trips, the mover at both ends of every hop (train at the stand alongside the transfer point / at the deck
// alongside the slot, the high loader at the door), monotonic timeline, one conveyor at a time, pieces conserved
function g77CargoAudit(fl){
 fl=fl||AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);const r={visits:0,ulds:0,trips:0,containers:0,pieces:0,issues:[]},bad=m=>{if(r.issues.length<16)r.issues.push(m)};
 const conv=[];
 for(const P of fl){if(!P.cgo)continue;r.visits++;const L=g77CargoLedger(P),S=P.cgo.loop,hl=P.cgo.hl;
  const nIn=Math.ceil(P.cgo.in.length/3),nOut=Math.ceil(P.cgo.out.length/3),ti=P.cgo.trips.filter(t=>t.kind==='in').length,to=P.cgo.trips.filter(t=>t.kind==='out').length;
  if(ti!==nIn||to!==nOut)bad('TRIPS '+P.code+' '+ti+'/'+nIn+' '+to+'/'+nOut);
  const all=P.cgo.in.concat(P.cgo.out);for(const u of all){if(!L.ulds[u]){bad('NO-TRACE '+u);continue}r.ulds++;const ev=L.ulds[u].ev;for(let i=1;i<ev.length;i++){const a=ev[i-1],b=ev[i];if(b.t<(a.t1!=null?a.t1:a.t)-1e-6)bad('ORDER '+u+' '+a.at+' → '+b.at)}}
  for(const C of L.containers){r.containers++;let s=0;for(const u of C.ulds)s+=L.ulds[u]?L.ulds[u].pieces:0;if(s!==C.pieces)bad('PIECES '+C.id);r.pieces+=C.pieces}
  for(const T of P.cgo.trips){r.trips++;const cg=T.cg,tr=T.tr,t0=T.t0;if(!cg||!T.deck){bad('NO-TRIP-DATA '+P.code);continue}conv.push([T.kind==='out'?T.deck.iv[0]:T.deck.stop[1],T.kind==='out'?T.deck.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+T.ulds.length*G77_ULD_BUILD:T.deck.stop[1]+T.ulds.length*G77_ULD_BUILD+G77_CONV_T,P.code]);
   for(const e of cg.ev){const tm=(e.t0+e.t1)/2,p=tr.seq.at(tm),q=tr.cartAt(p,e.k,tm,tr);
    if(e.where==='stand'){if(Math.abs(q[1]-S.yT)>2.5||Math.abs(q[0]-S.inX)>2.5)bad('NOT-ALONGSIDE '+P.code+' dolly '+e.k+' @'+(t0+tm).toFixed(1));
     if(S.hl){if(!hl||t0+e.t0<hl.at-1e-6||t0+e.t1>hl.done+1e-6)bad('NO-LOADER '+P.code+' @'+(t0+e.t0).toFixed(1))}}
    else{const sy=G77_DK.stopY+G77_DK.cd[e.k];if(Math.abs(q[1]-sy)>2.5||Math.abs(q[0]-G77_DK.inX)>2.5)bad('NOT-AT-DECK '+P.code+' dolly '+e.k)}}}}
 conv.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]);for(let i=1;i<conv.length;i++)if(conv[i][0]<conv[i-1][1]-1e-6)bad('CONVEYOR '+conv[i-1][2]+' / '+conv[i][2]);
 r.ok=!r.issues.length;return r}
// the forklift at the truck docks (landside): it takes the container's goods into AP-05 while the container is opened (outbound build-up)
function g77ForkliftAt(t){for(const P of AO.flights.concat(AO.hist)){if(!P.cgo)continue;const L=g77CargoLedger(P);if(!L)continue;
 for(const C of L.containers){if(C.dir!=='in'||!C.dock||t<C.tOpen||t>C.tOpen1)continue;const d=G77_DOCKS.find(q=>q.id===C.dock),u=(t-C.tOpen)/(C.tOpen1-C.tOpen),ph=(u*3)%1,go=ph<.5;
  return{x:d.x+6,y:G77_DOCK_Y+8+(go?ph*2:2-ph*2)*14,load:go,th:Math.PI/2}}}return null}
function g77DrawForklift(now,v){g77DrawDocks(now,v)}
// the S4 world audit: the west cargo base, the deck loop and the conveyor clear of the buildings, the lanes and each other
function g77S4Audit(){const A=aptReady(),issues=[],bld=apttBldShapes(),W=A.bays.filter(b=>b.zone==='W'),box=b=>({x0:b.x0,x1:b.x1,y0:b.y0,y1:b.y1});
 const hit=(a,b,m=0)=>a.x0<b.x1+m&&a.x1>b.x0-m&&a.y0<b.y1+m&&a.y1>b.y0-m,lane={x0:CARGO_W.x0,x1:5739,y0:CARGO_W.lane-12,y1:CARGO_W.lane+12};
 for(let i=0;i<W.length;i++){const a=box(W[i]);if(hit(a,lane))issues.push(W[i].id+' on the cargo lane');for(const s of bld)if(hit(a,s))issues.push(W[i].id+' in '+s.t);for(let k=i+1;k<W.length;k++)if(hit(a,box(W[k]),2))issues.push(W[i].id+' × '+W[k].id)}
 for(const p of G77_CONV.slice(1,-1)){if(hit({x0:p[0]-3,x1:p[0]+3,y0:p[1]-3,y1:p[1]+3},lane))issues.push('conveyor pillar on the lane');if(p[1]>740&&p[1]<810&&p[0]>5330&&p[0]<5730)issues.push('conveyor pillar on the rig apron')}
 const fleet=A.fleet.filter(f=>['PW','GC','HL','CU','FW'].includes(f.type));
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,8),bays:W.length,fleet:fleet.length,types:[...new Set(fleet.map(f=>f.type))].join('/')}}

// ==== GATE-77 S4 M5 · D-57 — the warehouse book made visible (§6.7) ======================================================================
const G77V={lane:5228,laneV:50,pool0:6,stackY:593,doors:1.5,fkT:7.6,fkS:26.9/76.68,fkHalf:13.45,yIn:929,box:[952,1004],pal:[961,975,989]};
function g77SlotY(k){return G77_DK.stopY+G77_DK.cd[k]}
// the deck records of committed visits only (a planning attempt in progress may still roll its records back — never drawn)
function g77Decks(all){const c=all?-1e9:APT_OPS.clk,K=g77Decks;if(!all&&K.at===c&&K.n===(AO.g77DeckR||[]).length&&K.f===AO.flights.length)return K.v;const S=new Set();
 for(const P of AO.flights.concat(AO.hist)){if(!P.cgo||(P.t1!=null&&P.t1<c-600))continue;for(const T of P.cgo.trips)if(T.deck)S.add(T.deck)}
 const v=(AO.g77DeckR||[]).filter(R=>S.has(R));if(all)return v;K.at=c;K.n=(AO.g77DeckR||[]).length;K.f=AO.flights.length;return K.v=v}
function g77PathLen(P){let l=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)l+=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);return l}
function g77PathAt(P,s){for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const a=P[i-1],b=P[i],d=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(s<=d){const u=d?s/d:0;return[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u]}s-=d}const z=P[P.length-1];return[z[0],z[1]]}
// the deck lane per slot: the conveyor's end → the east roller lane → abreast of the slot → onto the ULD
function g77Lane(k){const C=g77Lane.c||(g77Lane.c=[]);if(C[k])return C[k];const y=g77SlotY(k),P=[[5212,680],[G77V.lane,672],[G77V.lane,y],[5216,y]],L=g77PathLen(P);return C[k]={P,L,dt:L/G77V.laneV}}
// the parcels of one deck record (one per piece of the book): out — warehouse → belt (15 s) → lane → lands on ULD k during its 9 s build;
// in — leaves ULD k during its 9 s break-down → lane → belt → warehouse
function g77Parcels(R){if(R.pp)return R.pp;const pp=[],B=G77_ULD_BUILD,CT=G77_CONV_T;
 for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){const id=R.ulds[k],m=g77UldPieces(id),dt=g77Lane(k).dt;
  if(R.kind==='out'){const b0=R.iv[0]+CT+k*B;for(let j=0;j<m;j++){const a=b0+(j+.5)*B/m;pp.push({k,j,id,out:1,t0:a-CT,c1:a,t1:a+dt})}}
  else{const d0=R.stop[1]+k*B;for(let j=0;j<m;j++){const l=d0+(j+.5)*B/m;pp.push({k,j,id,out:0,t0:l,c0:l+dt,t1:l+dt+CT})}}}
 return R.pp=pp}
// where a parcel is at t: [x,y,heading,onBelt] or null outside its life
function g77ParcelAt(p,t){if(t<p.t0||t>p.t1)return null;const L=g77ConvLen();
 if(p.out){if(t<p.c1){const q=g77ConvAt((t-p.t0)/G77_CONV_T*L);return[q[0],q[1],q[2],1]}const ln=g77Lane(p.k),q=g77PathAt(ln.P,(t-p.c1)*G77V.laneV);return[q[0],q[1],0,0]}
 if(t<p.c0){const ln=g77Lane(p.k),q=g77PathAt(ln.P,ln.L-(t-p.t0)*G77V.laneV);return[q[0],q[1],0,0]}
 const q=g77ConvAt(L-(t-p.c0)/G77_CONV_T*L);return[q[0],q[1],q[2],1]}
// the slots at t: {k, id, m pieces, c on board, full (net on), base 0..1 (sliding from / to the stack)}
function g77DeckView(t){const out=[];for(const R of g77Decks()){if(t<R.iv[0]-3||t>R.iv[1]+3)continue;const pp=g77Parcels(R);
 for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){const id=R.ulds[k],m=g77UldPieces(id),tx=R.stop[0]+.5+k*4.5;
  if(R.kind==='out'){const first=R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+k*G77_ULD_BUILD;if(t<first-2||t>=tx)continue;let c=0,last=0;for(const p of pp)if(p.k===k){if(p.t1<=t)c++;if(p.t1>last)last=p.t1}
   out.push({k,id,m,c,full:c===m&&t>=last,base:Math.min(1,Math.max(0,t-(first-2)))})}
  else{const ta=tx+4.5,d0=R.stop[1]+k*G77_ULD_BUILD,d1=d0+G77_ULD_BUILD;if(t<ta||t>=d1+1)continue;let c=m;for(const p of pp)if(p.k===k&&p.t0<=t)c--;
   out.push({k,id,m,c,full:t<d0,base:t<d1?1:1-(t-d1)})}}}
 return out}
// the empty-base pool: start 6, a base leaves the stack 2 s before its first parcel, comes back 1 s after the break-down (records folded on prune)
function g77Pool(t){let n=G77V.pool0+(AO.g77PoolOfs||0);for(const R of g77Decks())for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){if(R.kind==='out'){if(t>=R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+k*G77_ULD_BUILD-2)n--}else if(t>=R.stop[1]+(k+1)*G77_ULD_BUILD+1)n++}return n}
function g77PoolNet(R){return R.kind==='out'?-R.n:R.n}
function g77Smooth(u){u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,u));return u*u*(3-2*u)}
// the forklift jobs: one pallet per ULD; FL-U unloads the inbound boxes (D1 / D2) and ends 1 s before the conveyor takes the first piece;
// FL-L loads the outbound boxes (D3 / D4) from the moment the last piece is back in the warehouse
function g77DockJobs(t0,t1,fl){const out=[];for(const P of fl||AO.flights.concat(AO.hist)){if(!P.cgo||(P.t1!=null&&P.t1<t0-400))continue;const L=g77CargoLedger(P);if(!L)continue;
 for(const C of L.containers){if(!C.dock)continue;const n=C.ulds.length,dur=n*G77V.fkT,ta=C.dir==='in'?C.tOpen1-dur:C.tFull,tb=ta+dur;
  if(tb+G77V.doors<t0||ta-G77V.doors>t1)continue;out.push({P,C,ta,tb,n,unload:C.dir==='in',fk:C.dir==='in'?'FL-U':'FL-L',dock:G77_DOCKS.find(d=>d.id===C.dock),pcs:C.ulds.map(u=>L.ulds[u]?L.ulds[u].pieces:0)})}}
 return out}
// the forklift of a job at t: centre y (forks south), fork lift 0..1, the pallet it carries (index or -1), pallets in the box
function g77FkAt(J,t){const T=(J.tb-J.ta)/J.n,i=Math.min(J.n-1,Math.max(0,Math.floor((t-J.ta)/T))),u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(t-J.ta-i*T)/T)),slot=J.unload?i:J.n-1-i,yAt=G77V.pal[slot]-10,yIn=G77V.yIn;
 // .45 into the box · .10 forks (lift / lower) · .45 back into the warehouse (the drop / pick inside is instant)
 let y,lift,carry;if(u<.45){const w=u/.45;y=yIn+(yAt-yIn)*(1-(1-w)*(1-w));lift=J.unload?0:1;carry=!J.unload}else if(u<.55){y=yAt;const v=(u-.45)/.1;lift=J.unload?v:1-v;carry=J.unload?v>.5:v<.5}else{const w=(u-.55)/.45;y=yAt+(yIn-yAt)*w*w;lift=J.unload?1:0;carry=J.unload}
 const inBox=[];for(let q=0;q<J.n;q++){const sl=J.unload?q:J.n-1-q;let there;if(J.unload)there=q>i||(q===i&&u<.5);else there=q<i||(q===i&&u>=.5);if(t<J.ta)there=J.unload;if(t>=J.tb)there=!J.unload;if(there)inBox.push([sl,q])}
 return{x:J.dock.x,y,lift,carry:carry&&t>=J.ta&&t<J.tb?i:-1,inBox,slot}}
function g77DoorOpen(J,t){const d=G77V.doors;return t<J.ta-d||t>J.tb+d?0:t<J.ta?(t-(J.ta-d))/d:t>J.tb?1-(t-J.tb)/d:1}
function g77Pallet(g,x,y,m,al){g.save();g.globalAlpha=al==null?1:al;g.fillStyle='#a77a45';g.fillRect(x-5,y-5,10,10);   // one path per colour (PERF: draw ops)
 g.fillStyle='#c99a5e';g.beginPath();for(let j=0;j<Math.min(m,12);j++)g.rect(x-3.6+(j%3)*2.9,y-3.8+Math.floor(j/3)*2.4,2.5,2.1);g.fill();if(m>12){g.fillStyle='#e1c08f';g.beginPath();for(let j=12;j<m;j++){const jj=j-12;g.rect(x-3+(jj%3)*2.9,y-4.4+Math.floor(jj/3)*2.4,2.5,2.1)}g.fill()}g.restore()}

   if(F.carry>=0)g77Pallet(ctx,x,F.y+10.5-F.lift*1.2,J.pcs[F.carry],1);ctx.restore()}}}
function g77DrawDeckLive(now,v){const t=APT_OPS.clk,x=G77_DK.x;

function g77ConvParcels(t){const out=[];for(const R of g77Decks()){if(t<R.iv[0]-1||t>R.iv[1]+1)continue;for(const p of g77Parcels(R)){const q=g77ParcelAt(p,t);if(q&&q[3])out.push([q[0],q[1],q[2],p.out])}}return out}
// ---- the eye check (F9 → "בדיקה בעין", D-62): the next moment of each step of the chain, the airport clock forwarded to it
function g77LookAt(kind){const t=APT_OPS.clk+3;let best=null;const take=(at,x,y,z,lab)=>{if(at>=t&&(!best||at<best.at))best={at,x,y,z,lab}};
 if(kind==='dock')for(const J of g77DockJobs(t,t+3600))take(J.ta-1.5,J.dock.x,975,2.8,(J.unload?'פריקת מכולה ב-':'העמסת מכולה ב-')+J.dock.id);

// ==== visibleWorkAudit (D-57): every working element shows a moving object or a moving part; counts = the book; no jump ==================
function g77VisibleWork(fl,t0,t1){fl=fl||AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);const r={records:0,parcels:0,jobs:0,pallets:0,samples:0,poolMin:1e9,beltMax:0,idleHolds:0,issues:[]},bad=m=>{if(r.issues.length<16)r.issues.push(m)};
 const RS=g77Decks(true).filter(R=>R.iv[1]>=t0&&R.iv[0]<=t1),belt=[];
 for(const R of RS){r.records++;const pp=g77Parcels(R);
  for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){const m=g77UldPieces(R.ulds[k]),mine=pp.filter(p=>p.k===k);if(mine.length!==m)bad('PARCELS '+R.ulds[k]+' '+mine.length+'/'+m);
   if(R.kind==='out'){const tx=R.stop[0]+.5+k*4.5;if(Math.max(...mine.map(p=>p.t1))>tx-1e-6)bad('ULD-NOT-BUILT '+R.ulds[k])}}
  let a=1e9,b=-1e9;for(const p of pp){r.parcels++;let prev=null;for(let s=p.t0;s<=p.t1+1e-9;s+=.1){const q=g77ParcelAt(p,Math.min(s,p.t1));if(!q){bad('GAP '+p.id+'#'+p.j);break}if(prev&&Math.hypot(q[0]-prev[0],q[1]-prev[1])>6)bad('JUMP '+p.id+'#'+p.j+' @'+s.toFixed(1));prev=q}
   const s0=g77ParcelAt(p,p.t0),s1=g77ParcelAt(p,p.t1),W=G77_CONV[0],D=[5216,g77SlotY(p.k)],near=(q,z)=>q&&Math.hypot(q[0]-z[0],q[1]-z[1])<1.5;
   if(p.out?!(near(s0,W)&&near(s1,D)):!(near(s0,D)&&near(s1,W)))bad('ENDS '+p.id+'#'+p.j);const c0=p.out?p.t0:p.c0,c1=p.out?p.c1:p.t1;a=Math.min(a,c0);b=Math.max(b,c1)}
  belt.push([a,b,R.kind,R.code])}
 belt.sort((x,y)=>x[0]-y[0]);for(let i=1;i<belt.length;i++)if(belt[i][0]<belt[i-1][1]-1e-6&&belt[i][2]!==belt[i-1][2])bad('BELT-BOTH-WAYS '+belt[i-1][3]+' / '+belt[i][3]);
 // the forklift jobs: per forklift and per dock without overlap (doors included), in order with the conveyor, pallets = ULDs, pieces = the book
 const J=g77DockJobs(t0,t1,fl),by={};for(const j of J){r.jobs++;r.pallets+=j.n;const s=j.pcs.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0);if(s!==j.C.pieces)bad('PALLET-PIECES '+j.C.id);
  for(const key of [j.fk,j.dock.id])(by[key]||(by[key]=[])).push(j);
  const R=RS.filter(q=>q.ulds.join()===j.C.ulds.join()&&q.kind===(j.unload?'out':'in')).sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.iv[0]-j.ta)-Math.abs(b.iv[0]-j.ta))[0];if(R){const pp=g77Parcels(R);if(j.unload){if(j.tb>Math.min(...pp.map(p=>p.t0))-1+1e-6)bad('FORKLIFT-LATE '+j.C.id)}else if(j.ta<Math.max(...pp.map(p=>p.t1))-1e-6)bad('FORKLIFT-EARLY '+j.C.id)}}
 for(const [k,L] of Object.entries(by)){L.sort((x,y)=>x.ta-y.ta);for(let i=1;i<L.length;i++)if(L[i].ta-G77V.doors<L[i-1].tb+G77V.doors)bad('OVERLAP '+k+' '+L[i-1].C.id+' / '+L[i].C.id)}
 // every working element moving at every sampled moment (0.5 s): the forklift (pose or forks), a parcel on every running belt, the cargo trains holding at the stand / deck only while a ULD moves
 const trains=[];for(const v of AO.fleet)if(v.type==='CU')for(const k of v.tasks.concat(v.hist||[]))if(k.cg||k.tr&&k.tr.cg)trains.push(k);
 for(let t=t0;t<=t1;t+=.5){r.samples++;const pool=g77Pool(t);if(pool<r.poolMin)r.poolMin=pool;
  for(const j of J){if(t<j.ta||t>=j.tb)continue;const A=g77FkAt(j,t),B=g77FkAt(j,Math.min(j.tb-1e-3,t+.25)),C=g77FkAt(j,Math.max(j.ta,t-.25)),still=(P,Q)=>Math.abs(P.y-Q.y)<.05&&Math.abs(P.lift-Q.lift)<.01;if(still(A,B)&&still(C,A))bad('FORKLIFT-STILL '+j.C.id+' @'+t.toFixed(1))}   /* p402: still both ways */
  const bp=g77ConvParcels(t).length;r.beltMax=Math.max(r.beltMax,bp);
  for(const k of trains){const lt=t-k.t0;if(lt<0||lt>k.tr.seq.dur)continue;const cg=k.cg||k.tr.cg;const at=w=>w&&lt>=w.t0+1&&lt<=w.t1-1;if(!at(cg.stand)&&!at(cg.deck))continue;
   const p=k.tr.seq.at(lt),q=k.tr.seq.at(lt+.25),moving=p&&q&&Math.hypot(p[0]-q[0],p[1]-q[1])>.02,st=g77TrainUld(k.tr,lt);if(!moving&&!(st&&st.fly)){r.idleHolds++;if(r.idleHolds<=3)bad('TRAIN-IDLE '+(k.code||'')+' @'+t.toFixed(1))}}}
 if(r.poolMin<0)bad('ULD-BASE-POOL '+r.poolMin);
 // the S2 service vehicles that still stand at the aircraft without a visible object (their work plans and visuals: S6 — AIR-63)
 const s6={};for(const v of AO.fleet){if(['CU','HL','BT','BL','PT','PW'].includes(v.type))continue;for(const k of v.tasks.concat(v.hist||[])){if(k.t0>t1||k.t0+k.tr.seq.dur<t0)continue;const o=s6[v.type]||(s6[v.type]={tasks:0});o.tasks++}}
 r.s6Pending=s6;r.ok=!r.issues.length;return r}

// the asset at the airport scale (as aptBuildSpec: APT_GS / res) — any type, also the ones without a spec entry yet (LG, HC)
function g77AcInfo(id){const C=g77AcInfo.c||(g77AcInfo.c={});if(C[id])return C[id];const a=TurboCity.get(id);if(!a)return null;const sc=APT_GS/(a.res||1),I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:sc,rot:0}),an={};for(const q of I.an)if(an[q[0]]===undefined)an[q[0]]=[q[1],q[2]];return C[id]={sc,w:I.w,h:I.h,fp:I.fp,an}}
// the anchors of a type, relative to the nose gear: [forward (+ towards the nose), lateral (+ right)] — the frame of apttAcGeom
function g77Anchors(id){const C=g77Anchors.c||(g77Anchors.c={});if(C[id])return C[id];const S=g77AcInfo(id),D=G77_ANCH_DEF[id];if(!S||!D)return null;
 const fp=S.fp,L=fp[2],fw=fp[3],nx=fp[0]+L,cy=fp[1]+fw/2,an=S.an,ng=an['Nose Gear']||[fp[0]+L*.83,cy],rel=(x,y)=>[+(x-ng[0]).toFixed(1),+(y-ng[1]).toFixed(1)],at=(u,s,k=1)=>rel(nx-u*L,cy+s*k*fw/2),out={};
 for(const [n,u,s] of D.doors)out[n]=at(u,s,s?1:0);
 for(const [n,u,s] of D.belly)out[n]=at(u,s,.92);
 if(D.gpu!==false)out['Ground Power']=at(D.gpu,1,.35);if(D.water!==false)out['Water']=at(D.water,1,.45);if(D.waste!==false)out['Waste']=at(D.waste,1,.45);
 const tL=an['Left Wing'],tR=an['Right Wing'],mg=an['Main Gear'];
 if(tL&&tR&&mg&&!/AC-HL/.test(id)){out['Fuel L']=rel(mg[0]+(tL[0]-mg[0])*D.fuel,cy+(tL[1]-cy)*D.fuel);out['Fuel R']=rel(mg[0]+(tR[0]-mg[0])*D.fuel,cy+(tR[1]-cy)*D.fuel)}
 else out['Fuel']=at(D.fuel,1,1);
 out['Nose Gear']=[0,0];out._L=+L.toFixed(1);out._fw=+fw.toFixed(1);out._span=tL&&tR?+(tR[1]-tL[1]).toFixed(1):null;out._nose=+(nx-ng[0]).toFixed(1);out._tail=+(fp[0]-ng[0]).toFixed(1);
 return C[id]=out}
// the anchors' audit: on the fuselage skin (doors), inside the footprint, L / R mirrored, the bridge door (L1) = the sim's Door
function g77AnchorAudit(){const issues=[];let n=0;for(const id of Object.keys(G77_ANCH_DEF)){const A=g77Anchors(id),S=g77AcInfo(id);if(!A||!S){issues.push(id+' missing');continue}
  const hw=A._fw/2,ng=S.an['Nose Gear'];
  for(const [k,p] of Object.entries(A)){if(k[0]==='_')continue;n++;if(p[0]>A._nose+.5||p[0]<A._tail-.5)issues.push(id+' '+k+' off the fuselage length');
   if(/^Door|Cargo Door|Crew Door/.test(k)&&k!=='Nose Cargo Door'&&Math.abs(Math.abs(p[1])-hw)>.6)issues.push(id+' '+k+' not on the skin');
   if(/Fuel/.test(k)&&A._span&&Math.abs(p[1])>A._span/2)issues.push(id+' '+k+' outside the wing')}
  for(const [k,p] of Object.entries(A)){const m=k.match(/^Door L(\d)$/);if(m){const q=A['Door R'+m[1]];if(q&&Math.abs(q[0]-p[0])>A._L*.06)issues.push(id+' Door L/R'+m[1]+' not abreast')}}
  const d=S.an['Door'];if(d&&ng){const L1=A['Door L1']||A['Main Deck Cargo Door'];if(L1&&Math.hypot(L1[0]-(d[0]-ng[0]),L1[1]-(d[1]-ng[1]))>1.2)issues.push(id+' L1 ≠ the sim Door')}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,types:Object.keys(G77_ANCH_DEF).length,anchors:n,issues:issues.slice(0,12)}}
// ==== D-60 — the clearance check from the code =============================================================================================
function g77GeomAny(id){const S=g77AcInfo(id);if(!S)return null;const a=S.an,ng=a['Nose Gear'],fp=S.fp,tL=a['Left Wing'],tR=a['Right Wing'],tl=a['Tail'],nose=a['Nose'];
 return{F:[fp[0]-ng[0],fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0],fp[1]-ng[1],fp[1]+fp[3]-ng[1]],half:tL&&tR?(tR[1]-tL[1])/2:fp[3]/2,wx:tL?tL[0]-ng[0]:0,nose:nose?nose[0]-ng[0]:fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0],tail:tl?tl[0]-ng[0]:fp[0]-ng[0],L:fp[2],fw:fp[3]}}
// a parked aircraft heading south (th +π/2: the nose to +y): boxes in world coords — fuselage, full wing span band, tail
function g77ParkBoxes(id,cx,ngy){const g=g77GeomAny(id);if(!g)return null;const hwW=g.half,wy=ngy+g.wx;

// audit of the Ramp Services Park East: bays on the apron paving, south of the service-road band, clear (≥6 px) of every bridge-stand aircraft
// shape, of the GLN lane body and of the P4 push-back sweep; every chore stop is inside a bay that accepts the vehicle, and the vehicle fits
function goRspAudit(){
 const issues=[],A=aptReady(),R=RSP_E,rects=R.bays.map(rspBayRect),obb=r=>apttObb((r.x0+r.x1)/2,(r.y0+r.y1)/2,0,[-(r.x1-r.x0)/2,(r.x1-r.x0)/2,-(r.y1-r.y0)/2,(r.y1-r.y0)/2],'V',r.id);
 const AP=APT_APRON;
 for(const r of rects){
  {const Yd=G77_YARD;if(r.x0<Yd.x0||r.x1>Yd.x1||r.y0<Yd.y0||r.y1>Yd.y1)issues.push(r.id+':off-yard')}   // GATE-77 S5c: the yard beside the tower
  if(r.y1>RSP_E.lane-10.5-6)issues.push(r.id+':yard-lane');if(r.x1>AF.GLN-11-6)issues.push(r.id+':gln-lane');
  for(const b of F2_RAMP_C.bays.filter(b=>b.kind==='AB')){const y0=G77_YARD.busYc-41,y1=G77_YARD.busYc+41;if(r.x0<b.x+b.w/2&&r.x1>b.x-b.w/2&&r.y0<y1+6&&r.y1>y0-6)issues.push(r.id+':bus-bay '+b.id)}
  for(const s of A.stands.filter(s=>s.tpl==='bridge'))for(const ac of s.accepts)for(const e of aplEnv(ac,s.ngx,s.ngy,s.th))if(e.L!=='W'&&apttObbHit(obb(r),e,6))issues.push(r.id+':stand '+s.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5));
  // push-back sweep of P4 (every accepted type): fuselage and tail boxes never touch a bay (vehicles may stand under a wing, never under a fuselage)
  const pL=A.stands.find(s=>s.id==='P4');if(pL)for(const ac of pL.accepts){const D=aoDepLegs(pL,ac),P=D.push,g=apttAcGeom(ac);if(!P)continue;for(let t=0;t<=P.dur;t+=.5){const p=P.pose(t);for(const box of[g.F,g.T])if(apttObbHit(obb(r),apttObb(p[0],p[1],p[2],box,'F',ac),6)){issues.push(r.id+':P4-push-sweep '+ac.slice(3,5)+'@'+t.toFixed(1));break}}}
 }
 for(let i=0;i<rects.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<rects.length;j++)if(rects[i].x0<rects[j].x1&&rects[i].x1>rects[j].x0&&rects[i].y0<rects[j].y1+8&&rects[i].y1>rects[j].y0-8)issues.push('bays-too-close');
 for(const type of(RSP_E.bays.length?['SH','MX']:[])){const v={type};const D=afChoreDest(v,0);if(!D){issues.push(type+':no-chore');continue}   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e: no chore bays (D-113); the cleaning vans make none (M5d)
  const b=R.bays.find(q=>q.id===D.bay),end=D.inn[D.inn.length-1];if(!b||!b.for.includes(type)){issues.push(type+':wrong-bay');continue}
  if(Math.abs(end[0]-(b.x??R.x))>.5||Math.abs(end[1]-b.yc)>.5)issues.push(type+':stop-outside-bay');
  const asset={SH:'G7-SH',MX:'VS-TW-01',SVC:'VS-GS-01'}[type],fp=APTT_SPEC.veh[asset].fp;if(fp[2]>b.len-4||fp[3]>R.w-2)issues.push(type+':does-not-fit '+b.id)}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,12),bays:rects};
}

const CARGO_W={lane:700,band:[560,720],x0:5010,x1:5990,c3:{cx:5700,ngy:480}};   // S3b: west cargo service band + lane; C3 reserve (S4)
// ---------- AIR-28 · parked / idle vehicles never stand in a drive path -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Home bays of the terminal-side fleet (baggage pockets A/B/C, apron-bus pocket S) as rectangles, plus every other home footprint for the audit.
function afHomeRects(zone){const A=APL;return A.bays.filter(b=>(!zone||b.zone===zone)&&b.occupied!==false).map(b=>({id:b.id,x0:b.x0,x1:b.x1,y0:b.y0,y1:b.y1}))}
// Tug released at the nose of a pushed-back aircraft (on taxilane L): it drives south to the service road.  The straight column is used when it
// clears every F2 home bay by ≥4 px; otherwise the tug side-steps (jog at y 540–590, north of the pockets) to the nearest clear column.
function afTugBack(t){
 const L=AF.L,GLS=AF.GLS,hw=APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-PT-01'].fp[3]/2+7,homes=afTugBack.h||(afTugBack.h=afHomeRects('F2')),x0=t[0];
 const clear=x=>!homes.some(r=>x+hw>r.x0&&x-hw<r.x1);
 let x=x0;if(!clear(x0)){for(let d=6;d<=90;d+=6){if(clear(x0-d)){x=x0-d;break}if(clear(x0+d)){x=x0+d;break}}}
 const blk=homes.filter(r=>x0+hw>r.x0&&x0-hw<r.x1),yTop=blk.length?Math.min(...blk.map(r=>r.y0)):645,j0=Math.min(540,yTop-55),j1=Math.min(590,yTop-5);
 return Math.abs(x-x0)<.5?[[x0,t[1],0],[x0,L,30],[GLS,L,26]]:[[x0,t[1],0],[x0,j0,18],[x,j1,18],[x,L,14],[GLS,L,26]];
}
// AIR-28 audit (static): every home footprint lies inside its marked bay and off every through lane — the terminal service road L, the GLINK
// corridor, the hardstand lanes, the G2 yard lanes and spine — and off the deterministic tug-return columns of every bridge stand.
function goIdleAudit(){
 aptReady();const issues=[],A=APL,Lr=APL.lanes,hit=(a,b,m=0)=>a.x0<b.x1+m&&a.x1>b.x0-m&&a.y0<b.y1+m&&a.y1>b.y0-m;
 const lanes=[{id:'SERVICE-ROAD-L',x0:6004,x1:7236,y0:AF.L-12,y1:AF.L+12},{id:'GLINK',x0:AF.GLN-12,x1:AF.GLS+12,y0:APT_Y.TS,y1:AF.HE+10},
  {id:'HARD-LANE-W',x0:AF.GLN,x1:Lr.wOut,y0:AF.HW-11,y1:AF.HW+11},{id:'HARD-LANE-E',x0:AF.GLN,x1:Lr.wIn,y0:AF.HE-11,y1:AF.HE+11},
  {id:'YARD-SPINE-W',x0:Lr.wOut-11,x1:Lr.wIn+11,y0:AF.HW,y1:Lr.O2+11},{id:'YARD-LANE-I',x0:Lr.wIn,x1:Lr.spineIn,y0:Lr.I-11,y1:Lr.I+11},
  {id:'YARD-LANE-O2',x0:Lr.wOut,x1:Lr.spineOut,y0:Lr.O2-11,y1:Lr.O2+11},{id:'YARD-SPINE-E',x0:Lr.spineIn-11,x1:Lr.spineOut+11,y0:AF.HE,y1:1500}];
 const tug=[];for(const sd of A.stands.filter(q=>q.tpl==='bridge'))for(const ac of sd.accepts){const D=aoDepLegs(sd,ac),g=apttAcGeom(ac),off=g.nose+9+afPtHx(),p=D.push.pose(D.push.dur),c=Math.cos(p[2]),sn=Math.sin(p[2]),pts=afTugBack([p[0]+c*off,p[1]+sn*off]),hw=APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-PT-01'].fp[3]/2;
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){const a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i];tug.push({id:'TUG-'+sd.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5),x0:Math.min(a[0],b[0])-hw,x1:Math.max(a[0],b[0])+hw,y0:Math.min(a[1],b[1]),y1:Math.max(a[1],b[1])})}}
 let bodyOut=0,onLane=0,onTug=0;
 for(const f of A.fleet){
  const b=A.bays.find(q=>q.id===f.bay);if(!b)continue;const v={id:f.id,type:f.type,asset:f.asset},sh=[];apttShapes(afTrackOf(v,[]),[b.x,b.yc,b.th,0,1],sh,null);
  for(const q of sh){const r={x0:q.x0,x1:q.x1,y0:q.y0,y1:q.y1};
   if(r.x0<b.x0-1.5||r.x1>b.x1+1.5||r.y0<b.y0-1.5||r.y1>b.y1+1.5){bodyOut++;issues.push(v.id+':body-outside-bay '+b.id)}
   for(const l of lanes)if(hit(r,l)){onLane++;issues.push(v.id+':idle-on '+l.id)}
   for(const l of tug)if(hit(r,l,4)){onTug++;issues.push(v.id+':idle-in '+l.id)}}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,16),bodyOutsideBay:bodyOut,idleOnServiceRoad:onLane,idleInTugColumn:onTug,lanes:lanes.length,tugColumns:tug.length};
}
// AIR-28 audit (dynamic): sandbox run; every moving vehicle shape is tested against every OTHER vehicle's home footprint (whether that vehicle is at
// home or not — a home bay must never be a drive path).  parkedIdleLaneOverlap = number of 0.5 s samples that touch a foreign home footprint.
function goIdleOpsQa(minutes=20,seed=777){
 if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}
 return aoSandbox(()=>{AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed);const T=minutes*60;for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=1)aoStep(t);
  const homes=AO.fleet.map(v=>{const sh=[];apttShapes(v.tr0,v.home,sh,null);return{v:v.id,bay:v.bay.id,sh}});const by={};let n=0;
  for(const v of AO.fleet)for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks)){const S=k.tr.seq;for(let t=0;t<S.dur;t+=.5){const p=S.at(t);if(!p)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(k.tr,p,sh,t);
   for(const h of homes){if(h.v===v.id)continue;let x=false;for(const a of sh){for(const b of h.sh)if(a.x0<b.x1+2&&a.x1>b.x0-2&&a.y0<b.y1+2&&a.y1>b.y0-2&&apttObbHit(a,b,2)){x=true;break}if(x)break}
    if(x){n++;const key=h.bay+'<-'+v.id+':'+(k.role||'');by[key]=(by[key]||0)+1}}}}
  const st=goIdleAudit();
  return{ok:n===0&&st.ok,seed,minutes,parkedIdleLaneOverlap:n,idleOnServiceRoad:st.idleOnServiceRoad,bodyOutsideBay:st.bodyOutsideBay,where:Object.entries(by).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,8),tasks:AO.fleet.reduce((q,v)=>q+v.hist.length+v.tasks.length,0)};
 });
}

// ==== GATE-77 S6b-a · D-111: the fuel trucks fill up at the fuel depot (APT-FUEL) before they park =====================================
const S6B_DEPOT={on:true,x:8275,y:1050,th:-Math.PI/2,pump:[8252,1052],tankGauge:[8240,972,10,50],fillPt:{x0:8150,y0:950,x1:8300,y1:972},base:90,draw:.55,tau:900,fillMin:14,fillMax:36,fillK:.75,fills:0};
function s6bFillDur(hold){const D=S6B_DEPOT;return Math.max(D.fillMin,Math.min(D.fillMax,Math.round(hold*D.fillK)))}
// the fill leg of a fuel truck's task (start offset, duration), cached on the task
function s6bFillOf(k){if(k._fill!==undefined)return k._fill;let o=0,r=null;const L=k.tr&&k.tr.seq&&k.tr.seq.legs;if(L)for(const l of L){if(l.kind==='fill'){r=[o,l.dur];break}o+=l.dur}return k._fill=r}
// the depot gauge (%): every truck fill draws it down (draw × seconds), the pipe brings it back (τ); deterministic in the airport clock
function s6bDepotLevel(t){const D=S6B_DEPOT;if(typeof AO==='undefined'||!AO.fleet)return D.base;const L=D.led||(D.led=new Map());if(D.lastT!=null&&t<D.lastT-5)L.clear();D.lastT=t;   // a small ledger: finished tasks leave v.tasks

 let def=0;for(const [key,[a,d]] of L){const e=a+d;if(t-e>D.tau*4){L.delete(key);continue}if(t<a)continue;const got=D.draw*d*Math.min(1,(t-a)/Math.max(1,d));def+=t<=e?got:got*Math.exp(-(t-e)/D.tau)}
 return Math.max(8,Math.min(100,D.base-def))}
