   today}] (metres).  KIT34.sprite(type, variant, res, o) → {cv, ox, oy, k} (k: the picture's density against res — ½ for a plant's shadow).  KIT34.stats(), KIT34.clear(), KIT34.budgetMB (24). */
(function (G) {
'use strict';
const K = 0.6, PXM = 10, TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const nrm = v => { const n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1; return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] };
const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
const LD = nrm([-0.42, -0.55, 0.72]), VW = nrm([0, K, 1]), HV = nrm([LD[0] + VW[0], LD[1] + VW[1], LD[2] + VW[2]]);
const AMB = .62, DIF = .38, TOPB = AMB + DIF * LD[2];
const MAT = { paint: [.18, 10], metal: [.38, 16], glass: [.7, 28], leaf: [.06, 6], matte: [0, 1], wood: [.05, 6], stone: [.03, 4] };
function lit(n, mat) { let b = (AMB + DIF * Math.max(0, dot(n, LD))) / TOPB; if (n[2] < 0) b *= 1 + .3 * n[2]; const m = MAT[mat] || MAT.matte; if (m[0]) b += m[0] * Math.pow(Math.max(0, dot(n, HV)), m[1]); return b }
const hexRGB = h => { const n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); return [n >> 16 & 255, n >> 8 & 255, n & 255] };
const litC = (hex, b) => { const c = hexRGB(hex); if (b <= 1) return `rgb(${c[0] * b + 14 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[1] * b + 17 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[2] * b + 22 * (1 - b) | 0})`; const k = Math.min(1, (b - 1) * .6); return `rgb(${c[0] + (255 - c[0]) * k | 0},${c[1] + (255 - c[1]) * k | 0},${c[2] + (255 - c[2]) * k | 0})` };
const sh = (h, f) => { const c = hexRGB(h), m = f < 0 ? 0 : 255, k = Math.abs(f); return '#' + c.map(v => Math.round(v + (m - v) * k).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') };
const mix = (a, b, t) => { const A = hexRGB(a), B = hexRGB(b); return '#' + A.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (B[i] - v) * t).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') };
const SX = .25, SY = .32;   // p416 (R-08): the vehicles' sun (C34.SUN) — a point at height z casts its shadow z·(0.25, 0.32), 0.41 of the height
const SUN2 = (() => { const x = LD[0], y = LD[1] - K * LD[2], n = Math.hypot(x, y); return [x / n, y / n] })();   // the way to the sun on the screen (up-left)
const rng = s => () => { s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0; let t = s; t = Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 15, t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, t | 61); return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296 };
const N_UP = [0, 0, 1], N_S = [0, 1, 0];
const LS = litK => litK;   // (kept for symmetry with c34m)

// ===================================== primitives (the context is in metres, origin at the item's ground point) =====================================
// p417: an item turned a quarter at a time (QR 0…3, clockwise on the screen: +x → +y) — set by render() around one picture; the plan
// coordinates are turned before the projection, the normals with them (the sun and the camera stay)
let QR = 0;
const RQ = (x, y) => QR === 0 ? [x, y] : QR === 1 ? [-y, x] : QR === 2 ? [-x, -y] : [y, -x];
const RN = n => QR === 0 ? n : [...RQ(n[0], n[1]), n[2]];
const P = (x, y, z) => { const r = RQ(x, y); return [r[0], r[1] - K * z] };
function poly(c, pts) { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) c.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); c.closePath() }
function fillPoly3(c, pts3, col, mat, n) { const N = RN(n || faceN(pts3)); if (dot(N, VW) <= 1e-4) return; poly(c, pts3.map(p => P(p[0], p[1], p[2]))); c.fillStyle = litC(col, lit(N, mat)); c.fill() }
const faceN = Q => { let n = [0, 0, 0]; for (let i = 0; i < Q.length; i++) { const p = Q[i], q = Q[(i + 1) % Q.length]; n[0] += (p[1] - q[1]) * (p[2] + q[2]); n[1] += (p[2] - q[2]) * (p[0] + q[0]); n[2] += (p[0] - q[0]) * (p[1] + q[1]) } return nrm(n) };
// an axis-aligned box: the south face and the top (the east / west faces stand in the line of sight)
function box(c, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, col, o) {
  if (QR) { const a = RQ(x0, y0), b = RQ(x1, y1), q = QR; QR = 0; try { box(c, Math.min(a[0], b[0]), Math.max(a[0], b[0]), Math.min(a[1], b[1]), Math.max(a[1], b[1]), z0, z1, col, o) } finally { QR = q } return }   // p417
  o = o || {}; const m = o.mat || 'matte';
  const a = P(x0, y1, z1), b = P(x1, y1, z0);
  c.fillStyle = litC(o.side || col, lit(N_S, m)); c.fillRect(a[0], a[1], b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]);
  const t = P(x0, y0, z1); c.fillStyle = litC(o.top || col, lit(N_UP, m)); c.fillRect(t[0], t[1], x1 - x0, y1 - y0);
  if (o.edge) { c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)'; c.fillRect(a[0], a[1] - .012, x1 - x0, .025) }
}
// a box turned in plan: 4 corners (x, y), the faces that look south and the top
function boxR(c, plan, z0, z1, col, o) {
  o = o || {}; const m = o.mat || 'matte'; let ar = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const p = plan[i], q = plan[(i + 1) % 4]; ar += p[0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[1] }
  const pl = ar > 0 ? plan : plan.slice().reverse();
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const p = pl[i], q = pl[(i + 1) % 4]; fillPoly3(c, [[p[0], p[1], z0], [q[0], q[1], z0], [q[0], q[1], z1], [p[0], p[1], z1]], o.side || col, m) }
  fillPoly3(c, pl.map(p => [p[0], p[1], z1]), o.top || col, m, N_UP);
}
// a vertical cylinder: the south half of its side (shaded across), then the top disc
function cyl(c, cx, cy, r, z0, z1, col, o) {
  o = o || {}; const m = o.mat || 'matte', a = P(cx, cy, z1), b = P(cx, cy, z0); cx = a[0];   // p417: the turned centre
  c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(cx - r, a[1]); c.lineTo(cx - r, b[1]); c.arc(cx, b[1], r, Math.PI, 0, true); c.lineTo(cx + r, a[1]); c.arc(cx, a[1], r, 0, Math.PI, false); c.closePath();
  const g = c.createLinearGradient(cx - r, 0, cx + r, 0); for (const t of [0, .25, .5, .75, 1]) { const ang = Math.PI * (1 - t); g.addColorStop(t, litC(col, lit([Math.cos(ang), Math.sin(ang), 0], m))) }
  c.fillStyle = g; c.fill();
  if (!o.noTop) { c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, a[1], r, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = litC(o.top || col, lit(N_UP, m)); c.fill() }
}
// a cone (or a frustum r0 → r1)
function cone(c, cx, cy, r0, r1, z0, z1, col, o) {
  o = o || {}; const m = o.mat || 'matte', a = P(cx, cy, z1), b = P(cx, cy, z0); cx = a[0];   // p417
  c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(cx - r0, b[1]); c.arc(cx, b[1], r0, Math.PI, 0, true); c.lineTo(cx + r1, a[1]); if (r1 > 0) c.arc(cx, a[1], r1, 0, Math.PI, true); else c.lineTo(cx, a[1]); c.closePath();
  const sl = (r0 - r1) / Math.max(1e-6, z1 - z0), g = c.createLinearGradient(cx - r0, 0, cx + r0, 0);
  for (const t of [0, .25, .5, .75, 1]) { const ang = Math.PI * (1 - t); g.addColorStop(t, litC(col, lit(nrm([Math.cos(ang), Math.sin(ang), sl]), m))) }
  c.fillStyle = g; c.fill();
  if (r1 > 0 && !o.noTop) { c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, a[1], r1, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = litC(o.top || col, lit(N_UP, m)); c.fill() }
}
// a ball / an ellipsoid (rx, ry, rz) shaded from its normals: the image is an ellipse rx × √(ry² + K² rz²)
function ball(c, cx, cy, cz, rx, ry, rz, col, o) {
  o = o || {}; if (QR & 1) { const t = rx; rx = ry; ry = t }   // p417
  const m = o.mat || 'matte', p = P(cx, cy, cz), ey = Math.sqrt(ry * ry + K * K * rz * rz);
  const hx = p[0] + LD[0] * rx * .62, hy = p[1] + (LD[1] * ry - K * LD[2] * rz) * .62, R = Math.max(rx, ey) * 1.55;
  const g = c.createRadialGradient(hx, hy, 0, hx, hy, R); g.addColorStop(0, litC(col, (o.hi || 1.06) * lit(LD, m))); g.addColorStop(.42, litC(col, 1)); g.addColorStop(1, litC(col, o.lo || .62));
  c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(p[0], p[1], rx, ey, 0, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = g; c.fill();
}
// a thin bar between two points (poles' arms, rails, wires): a stroked line, lit from above
function bar(c, a, b, w, col, o) { o = o || {}; const p = P(...a), q = P(...b); c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); c.strokeStyle = litC(col, o.b || lit(nrm([0, .6, 1]), o.mat || 'metal')); c.lineWidth = w; c.lineCap = o.cap || 'round'; c.stroke() }
// a vertical pole (a thin cylinder without its cap)
function pole(c, x, y, z0, z1, r, col, mat) { cyl(c, x, y, r, z0, z1, col, { mat: mat || 'metal', noTop: true }) }
// a flat plate standing up, facing the camera ('s'), its back ('n') or turned 45° ('e' / 'w'): fn(c) paints the face in a unit box
// (−w/2 … w/2) × (0 … h) in the plate's own frame; the frame is mapped onto the plate by an affine transform
function plate(c, x, y, z0, w, h, face, fn, back, outline) {
  const ang = face === 'e' ? -Math.PI / 4 : face === 'w' ? Math.PI / 4 : 0, cs = Math.cos(ang), sn = Math.sin(ang); { const r = RQ(x, y); x = r[0]; y = r[1] }   // p417
  // u along the plate (east when facing south), v up: world = (x + u·cs, y + u·sn, z0 + v) → screen (x + u·cs, y + u·sn − K(z0 + v))
  c.save(); c.transform(cs, sn, 0, -K, x, y - K * z0);
  if (face === 'n') { c.fillStyle = litC(back || '#8d949b', lit([0, -1, 0], 'metal') + .35); c.beginPath(); fn(c, true); c.fill(); c.restore(); return }
  const n = nrm([-sn, cs, 0]), b = lit(n, 'paint'); c.globalAlpha = 1; fn(c, false, b);
  if (outline) { c.lineWidth = .02; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)'; c.stroke() }
  c.restore();
}
// the shadows.  The cast shadow of an item is drawn opaque into its own layer (so its parts join, nothing gets darker where two
// parts overlap) and laid on the ground at one strength (SH.a, the strongest any part asked for); the contact shadow goes to a
// second layer at its own strength, on top.  (render() sets SH; outside it they draw straight.)
const SH = { a: 0, contact: null };
const ink = a => { if (a > SH.a) SH.a = a; return 'rgba(10,14,20,1)' };
function shadowBlob(c, x, y, z, rx, ry, a) { ink(a || .3); const g = c.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10,14,20,1)'); g.addColorStop(.6, 'rgba(10,14,20,.85)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,14,20,0)');
  { const r = RQ(x, y); x = r[0]; y = r[1]; if (QR & 1) { const t = rx; rx = ry; ry = t } } c.save(); c.translate(x + z * SX, y + z * SY); c.scale(rx, ry); c.beginPath(); c.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = g; c.fill(); c.restore() }
function shadowLine(c, x, y, z0, z1, w, a) { { const r = RQ(x, y); x = r[0]; y = r[1] } c.save(); c.strokeStyle = ink(a || .28); c.lineWidth = w; c.lineCap = 'round'; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(x + z0 * SX, y + z0 * SY); c.lineTo(x + z1 * SX, y + z1 * SY); c.stroke(); c.restore() }
function shadowSeg(c, a3, b3, w, a) { a3 = [...RQ(a3[0], a3[1]), a3[2]]; b3 = [...RQ(b3[0], b3[1]), b3[2]]; c.save(); c.strokeStyle = ink(a || .28); c.lineWidth = w; c.lineCap = 'round'; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(a3[0] + a3[2] * SX, a3[1] + a3[2] * SY); c.lineTo(b3[0] + b3[2] * SX, b3[1] + b3[2] * SY); c.stroke(); c.restore() }
function shadowPoly(c, pts3, a) { c.save(); c.fillStyle = ink(a || .28); c.beginPath(); pts3.forEach((p, i) => { const r = RQ(p[0], p[1]), q = [r[0] + p[2] * SX, r[1] + p[2] * SY]; i ? c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : c.moveTo(q[0], q[1]) }); c.closePath(); c.fill(); c.restore() }
// the shadow of a box: the outline (convex hull) of its 8 corners laid on the ground
function shadowBox(c, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, a) { const q = []; for (const x of [x0, x1]) for (const y of [y0, y1]) for (const z of [z0, z1]) { const r = RQ(x, y); q.push([r[0] + z * SX, r[1] + z * SY]) }
  q.sort((u, w) => u[0] - w[0] || u[1] - w[1]); const cr = (o, u, w) => (u[0] - o[0]) * (w[1] - o[1]) - (u[1] - o[1]) * (w[0] - o[0]), lo = [], hi = [];
  for (const p of q) { while (lo.length > 1 && cr(lo[lo.length - 2], lo[lo.length - 1], p) <= 0) lo.pop(); lo.push(p) }
  for (let i = q.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = q[i]; while (hi.length > 1 && cr(hi[hi.length - 2], hi[hi.length - 1], p) <= 0) hi.pop(); hi.push(p) }
  const h = lo.slice(0, -1).concat(hi.slice(0, -1)); c.save(); c.fillStyle = ink(a || .28); c.beginPath(); h.forEach((p, i) => i ? c.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : c.moveTo(p[0], p[1])); c.closePath(); c.fill(); c.restore() }
function contact(c, rx, ry, a) { if (QR & 1) { const t = rx; rx = ry; ry = t } const g0 = SH.contact || c; g0.save(); g0.scale(rx, ry); const g = g0.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1); g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(8,11,16,${a || .5})`); g.addColorStop(.6, `rgba(8,11,16,${(a || .5) * .55})`); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(8,11,16,0)'); g0.fillStyle = g; g0.beginPath(); g0.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, TAU); g0.fill(); g0.restore() }
// a crown's shadow: soft discs along its height, each as wide as the crown at that height — a tall narrow crown casts a long
// narrow shadow, a low wide one a round one (o: the crown's x, y, cz, rx, ry, rz, shape)
const crownW = (shape, h) => shape === 'cone' ? Math.max(.08, 1 - h * .92) * 1.15 : shape === 'col' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, .15 + h * .9)) * .95 + .05 : Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (2 * h - 1) * (2 * h - 1)));
function crownShadow(c, o, a) {
  const rz = o.shape === 'flat' ? o.rz * .55 : o.rz, n = Math.max(3, Math.min(24, Math.ceil(rz * 2 / Math.max(.3, Math.min(o.rx, o.ry) * .45))));
  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const h = .08 + .84 * i / n, f = Math.max(.12, crownW(o.shape, h)) * 1.02; shadowBlob(c, o.x || 0, o.y || 0, o.cz + (2 * h - 1) * rz, o.rx * f + .15, o.ry * f + .15, a || .3) }
}

// ===================================== foliage =====================================
// a crown: leaf clusters in an ellipsoid volume (centre (0, 0, cz), radii rx, ry, rz), each a small lit ball, far ones first;
// o.shape: 'ell' | 'cone' (wide at the bottom) | 'col' (a column) | 'flat' (an umbrella); o.cols [dark, mid, light]; o.n clusters; o.leaf radius
function crown(c, o, R) {
  const n = o.n, pts = [];
  const [d0, d1, d2] = o.cols;
  // the core: a dark mass, so the gaps between the clusters read as depth
  ball(c, o.x || 0, o.y || 0, o.cz, o.rx * .86, o.ry * .86, o.rz * .86, sh(d0, -.12), { mat: 'leaf', lo: .55 });
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let u = R() * 2 - 1, th = R() * TAU, s = Math.sqrt(1 - u * u), rr = Math.pow(R(), .28);
    let dx = s * Math.cos(th) * rr, dy = s * Math.sin(th) * rr, dz = u * rr;
    if (o.shape === 'cone' || o.shape === 'col') { const w = crownW(o.shape, (dz + 1) / 2); dx *= w; dy *= w }
    else if (o.shape === 'flat') { dz *= .55 }
    const x = (o.x || 0) + dx * o.rx, y = (o.y || 0) + dy * o.ry, z = o.cz + dz * o.rz;
    const nn = nrm([dx, dy, dz * 1.1]);
    pts.push({ x, y, z, nn, d: K * y + z, r: o.leaf * (.75 + R() * .5), t: R() });
  }
  pts.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
  // every cluster is a clump: a flat body in the colour its normal gets from the sun, and 5 smaller dabs around its edge, lighter on
  // the side toward the sun (up-left on the screen) and darker away from it — a ragged outline and a leafy texture, no shine
  for (const p of pts) {
    const b = lit(p.nn, 'leaf'), base = p.t < .33 ? d0 : p.t < .8 ? d1 : d2;
    const col = mix(base, b > 1.02 ? d2 : d0, Math.min(.55, Math.abs(b - 1) * 1.4)), q = P(p.x, p.y, p.z), r = p.r;
    c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(q[0], q[1], r * .92, r * .86, 0, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = litC(col, b * .93); c.fill();
    const a0 = R() * TAU, dabs = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) { const a = a0 + j * 1.2566 + (R() - .5) * .5, s = Math.cos(a) * SUN2[0] + Math.sin(a) * SUN2[1]; dabs.push({ a, s, d: r * (.36 + R() * .24), rr: r * (.4 + R() * .16) }) }
    dabs.sort((u, w) => u.s - w.s);
    for (const e of dabs) { c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(q[0] + Math.cos(e.a) * e.d, q[1] + Math.sin(e.a) * e.d * .9, e.rr, e.rr * .9, 0, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = litC(col, b * (.97 + .15 * e.s)); c.fill() }
    if (b > 1.0) { c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(q[0] + SUN2[0] * r * .35, q[1] + SUN2[1] * r * .35, r * .3, r * .26, 0, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = litC(mix(col, d2, .5), b * 1.06); c.fill() }
  }
  if (o.flowers) for (let i = 0; i < o.flowers.n; i++) { const p = pts[(R() * pts.length) | 0]; if (dot(p.nn, VW) < .1) continue; const q = P(p.x + p.nn[0] * p.r * .6, p.y + p.nn[1] * p.r * .6, p.z + p.nn[2] * p.r * .6);
    c.beginPath(); c.arc(q[0], q[1], o.flowers.r * (.7 + R() * .6), 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = o.flowers.cols[i % o.flowers.cols.length]; c.fill() }
  return pts;
}
function trunk(c, x, y, h, r0, r1, col, o) {
  o = o || {}; cone(c, x, y, r0, r1, 0, h, col, { mat: 'wood', noTop: true });
  if (o.marks) { c.fillStyle = o.marks; const R = rng(o.seed || 3); for (let i = 0; i < o.nm; i++) { const z = R() * h * .9, w = r0 * (.4 + R() * .9), p = P(x - r0 * .7 + R() * r0 * .9, y + r0 * .4, z); c.fillRect(p[0], p[1], w * .9, h * .012 + .03) } }
}
function branches(c, x, y, z0, list, col, w) { for (const [dx, dy, z1] of list) bar(c, [x, y, z0], [x + dx, y + dy, z1], w, col, { mat: 'wood', b: .85 }) }

// --- a broad-leaved tree: trunk, a few branches, a crown; params: crown radius cr, height h, trunk radius tr, squash, colours
function broadleaf(p) {
  return { group: 'tree', w: p.cr * 2, d: p.cr * 2, h: p.h, v: p.v || 3, today: p.today, he: p.he,
    body(c, v, R) {
      const cols = p.colsV ? p.colsV[v % p.colsV.length] : p.cols, cz = p.h - p.crz, tz = cz - p.crz * .35;
      const lean = (R() - .5) * .25;
      trunk(c, 0, 0, tz + p.crz * .4, p.tr, p.tr * .6, p.bark, { marks: p.marks, nm: p.nm || 0, seed: v + 7 });
      branches(c, lean, 0, tz * .82, [[-p.cr * .45, .1, cz + p.crz * .1], [p.cr * .4, -.1, cz + p.crz * .2], [p.cr * .1, p.cr * .3, cz - p.crz * .1]], p.bark, p.tr * .55);
      const pts = crown(c, { x: lean, y: 0, cz, rx: p.cr, ry: p.cr * (p.sqy || 1), rz: p.crz, n: p.n, leaf: p.leaf, cols, shape: p.shape || 'ell', flowers: p.flowers ? Object.assign({}, p.flowers, { cols: p.flowers.colsV ? p.flowers.colsV[v % p.flowers.colsV.length] : p.flowers.cols }) : null }, R);
      if (p.fruit) { for (let i = 0; i < p.fruit.n; i++) { const q = pts[(R() * pts.length) | 0]; if (dot(q.nn, VW) < .2) continue; ball(c, q.x + q.nn[0] * q.r * .7, q.y + q.nn[1] * q.r * .7, q.z + q.nn[2] * q.r * .7, .09, .09, .09, p.fruit.cols[v % p.fruit.cols.length], { mat: 'paint' }) } }
      if (p.strands) { c.lineCap = 'round'; for (let i = 0; i < p.strands; i++) { const a = R() * Math.PI + Math.PI * .02, rr = p.cr * (.55 + R() * .45), x = Math.cos(a) * rr * (R() < .5 ? -1 : 1), y = Math.sin(a) * rr * .9, z = cz + p.crz * (R() * .3);
        const z1 = Math.max(.4, z - p.crz * (1.1 + R() * .7)), a1 = P(x, y, z), b1 = P(x * 1.04, y * 1.04, z1); c.strokeStyle = litC(R() < .5 ? cols[1] : cols[2], .9 + R() * .3); c.lineWidth = .07 + R() * .05; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(a1[0], a1[1]); c.quadraticCurveTo((a1[0] + b1[0]) / 2 + .1, (a1[1] + b1[1]) / 2, b1[0], b1[1]); c.stroke() } }
    },
    shadow(c, v, R) { const cz = p.h - p.crz, lean = (R() - .5) * .25; contact(c, p.tr * 2.4, p.tr * 1.4, .45); shadowLine(c, 0, 0, 0, cz - p.crz * .5, p.tr * 1.6, .3); crownShadow(c, { x: lean, cz, rx: p.cr, ry: p.cr * (p.sqy || 1), rz: p.crz, shape: p.shape || 'ell' }, .3) } };
}

// --- conifers: tiers of cones; the umbrella pine of the coast and the mountain
function conifer(p) {
  return { group: 'tree', w: p.r * 2, d: p.r * 2, h: p.h, v: p.v || 2, today: p.today, he: p.he,
    body(c, v, R) {
      const cols = v % 2 ? GR.dark : ['#1f4a2e', '#2f6a3c', '#5f9a5a'];
      trunk(c, 0, 0, p.h * .3, p.r * .1, p.r * .07, BARK.brown);
      const n = p.tiers; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const f = i / n, z0 = p.h * (.18 + f * .74), z1 = z0 + p.h * .28, r = p.r * (1 - f * .82);
        cone(c, 0, 0, r, 0, z0, z1, cols[1], { mat: 'leaf' });
        // the tier's ragged edge: small dark and light clusters along its lower rim
        for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) { const a = Math.PI * (k / 8), x = Math.cos(a) * r * .92, y = Math.sin(a) * r * .55; ball(c, x, y, z0 + .1, r * .2, r * .14, r * .12, k % 2 ? cols[0] : cols[1], { mat: 'leaf' }) }
        for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) { const a = Math.PI * (.15 + R() * .5), q = P(Math.cos(a) * r * .55 * -1, Math.sin(a) * r * .3, z0 + (z1 - z0) * .45); c.beginPath(); c.arc(q[0], q[1], r * .12, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,255,200,.16)'; c.fill() } }
    },
    shadow(c) { contact(c, p.r * .3, p.r * .18, .45); shadowLine(c, 0, 0, 0, p.h * .2, p.r * .16, .3); const n = 14; for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const f = i / n; shadowBlob(c, 0, 0, p.h * (.2 + .78 * f), p.r * (1 - f * .9) + .1, p.r * (1 - f * .9) * .9 + .1, .3) } } };
}

// --- palms: a ringed trunk, fronds arching out and down (rib and leaflets), dates or coconuts
function palm(p) {
  return { group: 'tree', w: p.L * 2, d: p.L * 2, h: p.h + 1, v: 2, today: p.today, he: p.he,
    body(c, v, R) {
      const lx = p.lean * (v ? -1 : 1), top = [lx, 0, p.h];
      // the trunk: segments with rings
      const segs = 14; for (let i = 0; i < segs; i++) { const t0 = i / segs, t1 = (i + 1) / segs, x0 = lx * t0 * t0, x1 = lx * t1 * t1, r0 = p.tr * (1 - t0 * .25), r1 = p.tr * (1 - t1 * .25);
        cone(c, x0, 0, r0, r1, p.h * t0, p.h * t1 + .02, i % 2 ? p.bark : sh(p.bark, -.08), { mat: 'wood', noTop: true }) }
      const fr = []; for (let i = 0; i < p.n; i++) { const a = i / p.n * TAU + R() * .3; fr.push({ a, d: Math.sin(a), l: p.L * (.82 + R() * .3) }) }
      fr.sort((q, r2) => q.d - r2.d);
      // the fronds behind (north) first, the fruit, then the fronds in front
      const drawF = f => { const ca = Math.cos(f.a), sa = Math.sin(f.a), pts = [];
        for (let k = 0; k <= 10; k++) { const t = k / 10, r = f.l * t; pts.push([top[0] + ca * r, top[1] + sa * r, top[2] + p.rise * t - p.droop * t * t]) }
        const up = nrm([ca * .3, sa * .3, 1]), b = lit(up, 'leaf'), col = litC(v ? p.cols[1] : p.cols[0], b * (.92 + f.d * .06));
        const w = l => f.l * .13 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, l * 1.05)), L2 = [], R2 = [];
        for (let k = 0; k <= 10; k++) { const t = k / 10, q = pts[k], ww = w(t); L2.push(P(q[0] - sa * ww, q[1] + ca * ww, q[2])); R2.push(P(q[0] + sa * ww, q[1] - ca * ww, q[2])) }
        c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(L2[0][0], L2[0][1]); for (const q of L2) c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); for (const q of R2.reverse()) c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); c.closePath(); c.fillStyle = col; c.fill();
        c.strokeStyle = litC(p.cols[2], b); c.lineWidth = f.l * .012; c.beginPath(); pts.forEach((q, k) => { const s = P(...q); k ? c.lineTo(s[0], s[1]) : c.moveTo(s[0], s[1]) }); c.stroke();
        c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,30,10,.35)'; c.lineWidth = f.l * .008; c.beginPath();
        for (let k = 2; k < 10; k++) { const q = pts[k], ww = w(k / 10); for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const a2 = P(q[0], q[1], q[2]), b2 = P(q[0] + s * sa * ww - ca * .15, q[1] - s * ca * ww - sa * .15, q[2] - .05); c.moveTo(a2[0], a2[1]); c.lineTo(b2[0], b2[1]) } } c.stroke() };
      for (const f of fr) if (f.d < 0) drawF(f);
      if (p.fruit) for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { const a = R() * Math.PI * 2; ball(c, top[0] + Math.cos(a) * .32, top[1] + Math.sin(a) * .32, top[2] - .25 - R() * .3, p.fruit[1], p.fruit[1], p.fruit[1], p.fruit[0], { mat: 'paint' }) }
      ball(c, top[0], top[1], top[2], p.tr * 1.3, p.tr * 1.3, p.tr * 1.2, p.cols[2], { mat: 'leaf' });
      for (const f of fr) if (f.d >= 0) drawF(f);
    },
    // the shadow: the curved trunk and every frond as its own shape on the ground — a star, as under a real palm
    shadow(c, v, R) { const lx = p.lean * (v ? -1 : 1), g = (x, y, z) => [x + z * SX, y + z * SY]; contact(c, p.tr * 2.2, p.tr * 1.3, .45);
      c.save(); c.strokeStyle = ink(.3); c.lineWidth = p.tr * 1.7; c.lineCap = 'round'; c.beginPath(); for (let i = 0; i <= 14; i++) { const t = i / 14, q = g(lx * t * t, 0, p.h * t); i ? c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : c.moveTo(q[0], q[1]) } c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = ink(.3); for (let i = 0; i < p.n; i++) { const a = i / p.n * TAU + R() * .3, l = p.L * (.82 + R() * .3), ca = Math.cos(a), sa = Math.sin(a), Lp = [], Rp = [];
        for (let k = 0; k <= 10; k++) { const t = k / 10, r = l * t, z = p.h + p.rise * t - p.droop * t * t, ww = l * .13 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, t * 1.05)), x = lx + ca * r, y = sa * r; Lp.push(g(x - sa * ww, y + ca * ww, z)); Rp.push(g(x + sa * ww, y - ca * ww, z)) }
        c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(Lp[0][0], Lp[0][1]); for (const q of Lp) c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); for (const q of Rp.reverse()) c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); c.closePath(); c.fill() }
      c.restore() } };
}

// --- shrubs, hedges, beds, ground plants, water plants; the coast and the mountain

function bed(p) { return { group: 'shrub', he: p.he, today: p.today, w: 3, d: 1.4, h: .55, v: 3,

    const fl = p.cols[v % p.cols.length], pts = []; for (let i = 0; i < p.n; i++) pts.push([-1.25 + (i % 9) * .31 + (R() - .5) * .08, -.45 + ((i / 9) | 0) * .3 + (R() - .5) * .06]); pts.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);

  shadow(c) { contact(c, 1.7, .9, .25); shadowPoly(c, [[-1.5, .7, 0], [1.5, .7, 0], [1.5, .7, .3], [-1.5, .7, .3]], .2) } } }

// ===================================== the street =====================================
// --- signs: the post and the plate (0.6 m), its face by kind; variant = the side it faces ('s', 'n', 'e', 'w')
const FACES = ['s', 'e', 'w', 'n'];
function sign(he, today, w, h, face) { return { group: 'street', street: 1, he, today, w: Math.max(w, .1), d: .1, h: 2.2 + h, v: FACES, sign: 1,
  body(c, v) { const f = typeof v === 'string' ? v : FACES[v % 4]; pole(c, 0, 0, 0, 2.2 + h * .5, .035, '#9aa1a8'); plate(c, 0, -.04, 2.2, w, h, f, (g, back, b) => face(g, back, b, w, h), '#8d949b', true) },
  // the plate's shadow is the plate's own outline laid on the ground: (u, v) of the plate → (u·cs + (2.2 + v)·SX, −.04 + u·sn + (2.2 + v)·SY)
  shadow(c, v) { const f = typeof v === 'string' ? v : FACES[v % 4], ang = f === 'e' ? -Math.PI / 4 : f === 'w' ? Math.PI / 4 : 0; contact(c, .12, .07, .4); shadowLine(c, 0, 0, 0, 2.2 + h * .5, .07, .28);
    c.save(); c.transform(Math.cos(ang), Math.sin(ang), SX, SY, 2.2 * SX, -.04 + 2.2 * SY); face(c, true, 1, w, h); c.fillStyle = ink(.28); c.fill(); c.restore() } } }
const B = (b, hex) => litC(hex, b || 1);
const shp = {
  oct(g, w, h) { const r = Math.min(w, h) / 2, cx = 0, cy = h / 2; g.beginPath(); for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const a = Math.PI / 8 + i * Math.PI / 4; g.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r) } g.closePath() },
  tri(g, w, h) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-w / 2, h); g.lineTo(w / 2, h); g.lineTo(0, 0); g.closePath() },
  circ(g, w, h) { g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(0, h / 2, w / 2, h / 2, 0, 0, TAU) },
  rect(g, w, h, r) { g.beginPath(); g.roundRect ? g.roundRect(-w / 2, 0, w, h, r || .04) : g.rect(-w / 2, 0, w, h) }
};
// in the plate's frame v goes up — the text is drawn mirrored back (scale(1, −1))
const label = (g, t, x, y, s, col, wt) => { g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.scale(1, -1); g.font = (wt || 800) + ' ' + s + 'px Arial,"Noto Sans Hebrew",sans-serif'; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle'; g.fillStyle = col; g.fillText(t, 0, 0); g.restore() };

// ===================================== the pictures and the cache =====================================
const KIT34 = G.KIT34 = { K, PXM, budgetMB: 24, rimPx: 30, small: 1, dpr: typeof devicePixelRatio !== 'undefined' ? Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1) : 1 };
const mk = (w, h) => { if (typeof OffscreenCanvas !== 'undefined') return new OffscreenCanvas(w, h); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; return c };
const CACHE = new Map(); let BYTES = 0, MADE = 0, MADE_MS = 0, EVICT = 0;
function put(key, e) { CACHE.set(key, e); BYTES += e.bytes; if (KIT34.budgetMB > 0) while (BYTES > KIT34.budgetMB * 1048576 && CACHE.size > 1) { const [k0, e0] = CACHE.entries().next().value; if (k0 === key) break; CACHE.delete(k0); BYTES -= e0.bytes; EVICT++ } }
const varKey = (t, v) => t.sign ? (typeof v === 'string' ? v : FACES[(v | 0) % 4]) : ((v | 0) % (typeof t.v === 'number' ? t.v : 1));
// one picture (body or shadow) of a type at pxm device px per metre; rim when the item is tall enough on the screen
// The picture is drawn on a roomy canvas (the box of the item and a margin of a third of its size, so nothing that leans or hangs
// out is cut) and then trimmed to what was really drawn — the cache keeps only the trimmed picture.
function render(t, v, pxm, which, rim, sc, q) { const q0 = QR; QR = (q | 0) & 3; try { return render0(t, v, pxm, which, rim, sc) } finally { QR = q0 } }   // p417
function render0(t, v, pxm, which, rim, sc) {
  const w = (QR & 1 ? t.d : t.w) * sc, d = (QR & 1 ? t.w : t.d) * sc, h = t.h * sc, isS = which === 'shadow', m = .6 + .35 * Math.max(w, d, h * .5);
  const x0 = -w / 2 - m, x1 = w / 2 + m + (isS ? h * SX : 0), y0 = isS ? -d / 2 - m : -d / 2 - K * h - m, y1 = d / 2 + m + (isS ? h * SY : 0);
  const pad = 3, W = Math.max(2, Math.ceil((x1 - x0) * pxm) + pad * 2), H = Math.max(2, Math.ceil((y1 - y0) * pxm) + pad * 2), ox = -x0 * pxm + pad, oy = -y0 * pxm + pad;
  const cv = mk(W, H), c = cv.getContext('2d'); c.setTransform(pxm * sc, 0, 0, pxm * sc, ox, oy); c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.lineCap = 'round';
  const R = rng(1009 + (typeof v === 'string' ? v.charCodeAt(0) : v) * 97 + t.he.length * 13);
  let out = cv;
  if (isS) { const cc = mk(W, H), g2 = cc.getContext('2d'); g2.setTransform(pxm * sc, 0, 0, pxm * sc, ox, oy); SH.a = 0; SH.contact = g2;
    try { t.shadow.call(t, c, v, R) } finally { SH.contact = null }
    const oc = mk(W, H), g = oc.getContext('2d'); g.globalAlpha = SH.a || .28; g.drawImage(cv, 0, 0); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(cc, 0, 0); out = oc }
  else t.body.call(t, c, v, R);
  // trim first (leaving room for the rim), then the rim on the small picture
  const ww = Math.max(1, Math.round(pxm * .012)), e = trim(out, ox, oy, rim && !isS ? ww + 1 : 1);
  if (rim && !isS) { const w2 = e.cv.width, h2 = e.cv.height, tc = mk(w2, h2), g = tc.getContext('2d');
    for (const [dx, dy] of [[ww, 0], [-ww, 0], [0, ww], [0, -ww], [ww * .7, ww * .7], [-ww * .7, ww * .7], [ww * .7, -ww * .7], [-ww * .7, -ww * .7]]) g.drawImage(e.cv, dx, dy);
    g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in'; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(18,22,28,.55)'; g.fillRect(0, 0, w2, h2); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.drawImage(e.cv, 0, 0); e.cv = tc }
  return e;
}
// the bounds of what was drawn, read from a copy 4 times smaller: two halvings, each an exact 2 × 2 average, so a block with any
// ink keeps some alpha; the bounds are then widened by a block
const half = cv => { const w = Math.ceil(cv.width / 2), h = Math.ceil(cv.height / 2), e = mk(w, h), g = e.getContext('2d'); g.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; g.drawImage(cv, 0, 0, cv.width / 2, cv.height / 2); return e };
function trim(cv, ox, oy, mg) {
  const W = cv.width, H = cv.height, q = W * H > 30000 ? 4 : 1;
  const src = q > 1 ? half(half(cv)) : cv, sw = src.width, shh = src.height;
  const a = src.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, sw, shh).data; let x0 = sw, x1 = -1, y0 = -1, y1 = -1;
  for (let y = 0; y < shh; y++) { const r = y * sw * 4; let f = -1, l = -1; for (let x = 0; x < sw; x++) if (a[r + x * 4 + 3]) { f = x; break } if (f < 0) continue;
    for (let x = sw - 1; x >= f; x--) if (a[r + x * 4 + 3]) { l = x; break } if (y0 < 0) y0 = y; y1 = y; if (f < x0) x0 = f; if (l > x1) x1 = l }
  if (y0 < 0) { const e = mk(1, 1); return { cv: e, ox: 0, oy: 0, bytes: 4 } }
  const X0 = Math.max(0, x0 * q - q - mg), Y0 = Math.max(0, y0 * q - q - mg), X1 = Math.min(W - 1, x1 * q + 2 * q + mg), Y1 = Math.min(H - 1, y1 * q + 2 * q + mg);
  const w = X1 - X0 + 1, h = Y1 - Y0 + 1, e = mk(w, h); e.getContext('2d').drawImage(cv, -X0, -Y0);
  return { cv: e, ox: ox - X0, oy: oy - Y0, bytes: w * h * 4 };
}
KIT34.sprite = function (type, variant, res, o) {
  const t = T[type]; if (!t) throw new Error('KIT34: unknown type ' + type); o = o || {};
  const v = varKey(t, variant), r = res || 1, sc = t.street ? KIT34.small : 1, which = o.which || 'body', q = (o.q | 0) & 3;
  const zoom = o.zoom != null ? o.zoom : r / KIT34.dpr, hpx = (t.h * sc * K + t.d * sc) * PXM * zoom, rim = which === 'body' && hpx >= KIT34.rimPx;
  const key = type + '|' + v + '|' + r + '|' + sc + '|' + which + '|' + (rim ? 1 : 0) + (q ? '|q' + q : '');
  let e = CACHE.get(key); if (e) return e;
  // the shadow of a plant is soft all over: it is kept at half the density (a quarter of the memory) and drawn back at full size
  const k = which === 'shadow' && t.group !== 'street' && r >= 1.5 ? .5 : 1;
  const t0 = performance.now(); e = render(t, v, PXM * r * k, which, rim, sc, q); e.k = k; MADE_MS += performance.now() - t0; MADE++; put(key, e); return e;
};
KIT34.drawShadow = function (ctx, x, y, type, variant, res, o) { const s = KIT34.sprite(type, variant, res, { which: 'shadow', q: o && o.q }), r = res * s.k; ctx.drawImage(s.cv, x - s.ox / r, y - s.oy / r, s.cv.width / r, s.cv.height / r) };
KIT34.drawBody = function (ctx, x, y, type, variant, res, o) { const s = KIT34.sprite(type, variant, res, o); ctx.drawImage(s.cv, x - s.ox / res, y - s.oy / res, s.cv.width / res, s.cv.height / res) };
KIT34.draw = function (ctx, x, y, type, variant, res, o) { o = o || {}; if (o.shadow !== false) KIT34.drawShadow(ctx, x, y, type, variant, res, o); KIT34.drawBody(ctx, x, y, type, variant, res, o) };
KIT34.list = () => Object.keys(T).map(type => { const t = T[type]; return { type, he: t.he, group: t.group, w: t.w, d: t.d, h: t.h, variants: t.sign ? FACES.slice() : t.v, today: t.today || [] } });

 if(line){g.strokeStyle=line;g.lineWidth=.6;g.strokeRect(x0+.3,y0-K*z1+.3,x1-x0-.6,y1-y0+K*(z1-z0)-.6)}}
// p387 (the draw operations, PERF_BUDGET D-216 (c): no scenario may get more): the faces are batched — one path per colour, the south faces
// of a layer first, then its tops, then its flat marks, one stroke for its outlines
function stsB(){return{s:new Map(),t:new Map(),m:new Map(),l:null,lc:null}}
function stsP(M,c){let p=M.get(c);if(!p){p=new Path2D();M.set(c,p)}return p}
function stsAdd(B,x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1,top,south,line){const K=stsK();if(south&&z1>z0)stsP(B.s,south).rect(x0,y1-K*z1,x1-x0,K*(z1-z0));if(top)stsP(B.t,top).rect(x0,y0-K*z1,x1-x0,y1-y0);
 if(line){(B.l||(B.l=new Path2D())).rect(x0+.3,y0-K*z1+.3,x1-x0-.6,y1-y0+K*(z1-z0)-.6);B.lc=line}}

function stsDraw(g,B){for(const M of [B.s,B.t,B.m])for(const [c,p] of M){g.fillStyle=c;g.fill(p)}if(B.l){g.strokeStyle=B.lc;g.lineWidth=.6;g.stroke(B.l)}}
// the ground shadow of a box: the hull of its foot and its top, both moved by the sun — added to the current path (one fill for all)
function stsHull(P){P.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]||a[1]-b[1]);const cr=(o,a,b)=>(a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1])-(a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0]),lo=[],up=[];
 for(const p of P){while(lo.length>=2&&cr(lo[lo.length-2],lo[lo.length-1],p)<=0)lo.pop();lo.push(p)}
 for(let i=P.length-1;i>=0;i--){const p=P[i];while(up.length>=2&&cr(up[up.length-2],up[up.length-1],P[i])<=0)up.pop();up.push(p)}
 up.pop();lo.pop();return lo.concat(up)}
function stsShadow(g,x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1){const S=stsSun(),P=[];for(const z of [z0,z1])for(const [x,y] of [[x0,y0],[x1,y0],[x1,y1],[x0,y1]])P.push([x+S.x*z,y+S.y*z]);
 const H=stsHull(P);g.moveTo(H[0][0],H[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<H.length;i++)g.lineTo(H[i][0],H[i][1]);g.closePath()}
// the parts of a crane (world px): [x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1]
function stsParts(c,P){const x=P.x,hw=PORT_HW,yL=PORT_RAIL_L,yW=PORT_RAIL_W,Hp=C34STS.Hp,Hb=C34STS.Hb,sp=c.kind==='spreader',bt=sp?PORT_BOOM_BACK:yL-46,tip=Math.max(P.tipY,yW+40);
 const o={x,yL,yW,Hp,Hb,bt,tip,sp,legs:[],beams:[],boom:[x-11,x+11,bt,tip+4,Hb-14,Hb],house:[x-24,x+24,yL-42,yL-4,Hb,Hb+26],trol:[x-17,x+17,P.ty-13,P.ty+13,Hb-6,Hb+6],cab:[x+3,x+17,P.ty+4,P.ty+15,Hb-30,Hb-8]};
 for(const y of [yL,yW]){o.legs.push({y,sill:[x-hw-12,x+hw+12,y-8,y+8,0,12],posts:[[x-hw-5,x-hw+5,y-5,y+5,12,Hp-14],[x+hw-5,x+hw+5,y-5,y+5,12,Hp-14]]});
  o.beams.push([x-hw-6,x+hw+6,y-6,y+6,Hp-16,Hp])}

 // what hangs: a box (its size and the height of its foot) or the grab
 const ld=P.load;let L=PORT_CT_LEN['CT-40-01'],W=PORT_CT_W;if(sp){const zMax=Hb-46,Hc=W;o.Hc=Hc;o.zl=16+Math.max(0,Math.min(1,P.h||0))*(zMax-Hc-16);o.L=ld&&ld.type!=='40'?L+4:L;o.W=W}
 else{const hh=P.hh!=null?P.hh:(P.h||0);o.zl=18+Math.max(0,Math.min(1,hh))*(Hb-80);o.L=22;o.W=22}
 return o}

// in the 3/4 pass (after c34Begin): the shadows on the ground, the legs into the queue
function c34StsBegin(now){const G=C34STS;if(!G.on||MAPBASE.pass||ctx.canvas!==cv||WTC_MODE===1||!c34Live()||!portInView())return;G.n.frames++;
 const ops=portOps(now),v=portView(200),K=stsK(),C=G.col;
 for(const c of PORT_CRANES){const S=ops[c.berth];if(!S)continue;const P=portCranePose(c,S,now);if(!stsVis(v,P))continue;const o=stsParts(c,P);G.n.cranes++;
  // the shadows (one path): sills, posts, portal beams, boom, house, trolley, what hangs
  ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();for(const l of o.legs){stsShadow(ctx,...l.sill);for(const q of l.posts)stsShadow(ctx,...q)}for(const q of o.beams)stsShadow(ctx,...q);for(const q of o.side)stsShadow(ctx,...q);
  stsShadow(ctx,...o.boom);if(o.sp)stsShadow(ctx,o.x-16,o.x+16,o.bt-4,o.bt+8,o.Hb-22,o.Hb+2);stsShadow(ctx,...o.house);stsShadow(ctx,...o.trol);
  if(o.sp&&P.load)stsShadow(ctx,o.x-o.L/2,o.x+o.L/2,P.ty-o.W/2,P.ty+o.W/2,o.zl,o.zl+o.Hc);else if(!o.sp&&P.grab)stsShadow(ctx,o.x-11,o.x+11,P.ty-11,P.ty+11,o.zl,o.zl+16);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.20)';ctx.fill('nonzero');ctx.restore();
  // the legs: one queue entry per rail (the sill on the rail, its two posts, the knee braces of the portal frame in that plane)
  for(const l of o.legs){G.n.legs++;C34G.q.push({y:l.y+8,f:()=>{const g=ctx,B=stsB();stsAdd(B,...l.sill,C.legT,C.leg,'rgba(10,24,40,.55)');for(const q of l.posts)stsAdd(B,...q,C.legT,C.leg,'rgba(10,24,40,.55)');
   stsMark(B,C.bogie,l.sill[0],l.y-10-K*12,16,20);stsMark(B,C.bogie,l.sill[1]-16,l.y-10-K*12,16,20);g.save();stsDraw(g,B);
   g.strokeStyle=C.legS;g.lineWidth=3;g.beginPath();for(const s of [-1,1]){g.moveTo(o.x+s*(PORT_HW-4),l.y+5-K*(o.Hp-62));g.lineTo(o.x+s*(PORT_HW-52),l.y+5-K*(o.Hp-15))}g.stroke();g.restore()}})}}}
// in the overhead pass, instead of today's crane: the portal beams, what hangs, the boom, the house, the trolley

 try{const o=stsParts(c,P),g=ctx,K=stsK(),C=G.col;g.save();

/* ---- A34M (p390: the aircraft library a34g.js, run after the 3/4 view is armed) ---- */
function a34LibInit(){if(window.A34)return true;if(!C34G.armed)return false;
/* a34.js — Turbo City · D‑268 · the aircraft in the 3/4 view (oblique, K = 0.6): the sample before the whole fleet (step 4).
   Plain script, defines window.A34.  No dependence on the game's globals.
   World: x east, y south, z up, in METRES; the page turns metres into its field scale s (7.47 px/m today, 10 px/m in the new field):
   screen = ((x)·s, (y − K·z)·s).  The ground plan is not foreshortened; a surface at height z moves up (north on the screen) by K·z.
   The sun, the ambient and the colour ramp are the vehicles' (c34m.js: LD, AMB .62, DIF .38, litC), the materials' gloss the people's.
   The geometry follows the game's aircraft table (AC: length, span, fuselage width, wing chords, sweep, engines) and the details of
   air_({...}) (nose / tail-cone lengths, doors, windows, engines, tailplane span, the tri-jet's third engine, the upper deck); the
   heights are the class's real ones (A34.TYPES[id].src says which).
   An aircraft is a set of PIECES — the body (fuselage, fin, upper tail, tail engine), each wing, each engine, each low tailplane, the
   gear legs — and every piece carries the sort key of the scene: y of its south edge + (height of its lowest point) / K. */
(function (G) {
'use strict';
const K = 0.6, TAU = Math.PI * 2, D2R = Math.PI / 180;
const nrm = v => { const n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1; return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] };
const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
const sub = (a, b) => [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]];
const crs = (a, b) => [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];
const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t, cl = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
const sm = x => { x = cl(x, 0, 1); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) };
// ---- the sun (c34m.js) and the view ----
const LD = nrm([-0.42, -0.55, 0.72]), VW = nrm([0, K, 1]), HV = nrm([LD[0] + VW[0], LD[1] + VW[1], LD[2] + VW[2]]);
const AMB = .62, DIF = .38, TOPB = AMB + DIF * LD[2];
const MAT = { paint: [.2, 9], metal: [.34, 14], glass: [.75, 30], rubber: [.03, 6], matte: [0, 1] };
function lit(n, mat) { let b = (AMB + DIF * Math.max(0, dot(n, LD))) / TOPB; if (n[2] < 0) b *= 1 + .3 * n[2]; const m = MAT[mat] || MAT.paint; if (m[0]) b += m[0] * Math.pow(Math.max(0, dot(n, HV)), m[1]); return b }
const hexRGB = h => { const n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); return [n >> 16 & 255, n >> 8 & 255, n & 255] };
const litC = (hex, b) => { const c = hexRGB(hex); if (b <= 1) return `rgb(${c[0] * b + 14 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[1] * b + 17 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[2] * b + 22 * (1 - b) | 0})`; const k = Math.min(1, (b - 1) * .6); return `rgb(${c[0] + (255 - c[0]) * k | 0},${c[1] + (255 - c[1]) * k | 0},${c[2] + (255 - c[2]) * k | 0})` };
const mixC = (a, b, f) => { const p = hexRGB(a), q = hexRGB(b); return '#' + p.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (q[i] - v) * f).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') };
const sh = (h, f) => { const c = hexRGB(h), m = f < 0 ? 0 : 255, k = Math.abs(f); return '#' + c.map(v => Math.round(v + (m - v) * k).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') };   // the game's sh()
const lum = h => { const c = hexRGB(h); return (c[0] * .299 + c[1] * .587 + c[2] * .114) / 255 };
// the shadow on the ground (D‑277, one sun for the whole game): a point at height z falls z·(C34.SUN.x, C34.SUN.y) = z·(0.25, 0.32) to the
// south-east — 0.41 of its height, as every vehicle's (it was z·(0.583, 0.764), its own sun)

// a smooth curve through a table (Catmull-Rom on the samples; flat outside them)
function tab(X, Y, x) { const n = X.length; if (x <= X[0]) return Y[0]; if (x >= X[n - 1]) return Y[n - 1]; let i = 0; while (x > X[i + 1]) i++;
  const t = (x - X[i]) / (X[i + 1] - X[i]), y0 = Y[Math.max(0, i - 1)], y1 = Y[i], y2 = Y[i + 1], y3 = Y[Math.min(n - 1, i + 2)], m1 = (y2 - y0) / 2, m2 = (y3 - y1) / 2;
  return (2 * t * t * t - 3 * t * t + 1) * y1 + (t * t * t - 2 * t * t + t) * m1 + (-2 * t * t * t + 3 * t * t) * y2 + (t * t * t - t * t) * m2 }

// ======================================================================================================================================
// the fuselage: rings along a (metres aft of the nose tip).  ring(a) → {zm, rv, rs, hump}; the point at angle θ (0 = east side,
// 90° = crown): (rs·cos θ, yN − a, zm + rv·sin θ + hump·g(sin θ))
function fusShape(t) {
  const L = t.L, R = t.fw / 2, Rz = (t.fh || t.fw) / 2, zc = t.zb + Rz, nl = t.nl * L, tlv = t.tl * L * 1.3, zTip = zc - .12 * Rz, NR = NOSE[t.id],   // Rz: the half height (t.fh, the E175's 3.35 on 3.01)
  xN = NR ? NR.x[NR.x.length - 1] : 0;
  // D‑278 (the owner 09:21, "the front must be real"): an ogive — the plan narrows over 1.6 nose lengths to a rounder point, the crown
  // rises over 1.9 (the cockpit's slope), the chin over 1.0
  const At = 1.9 * nl, Ab = 1.0 * nl, As = 1.6 * nl, aT = L - tlv, ze = zc + .4 * Rz, re = .15 * R;
  const sq = (x, A, e) => x >= A ? 1 : Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - Math.pow(1 - x / A, e || 2.3)), .5);
  const hr = t.hr || [.2, 2.2], hump = a => !t.hump ? 0 : t.hump * sm((a - hr[0] * nl) / (hr[1] * nl)) * (1 - sm((a - .3 * L) / (.1 * L)));
  const f = a => {
    let top, bot, rs;
    if (NR && a < xN) { top = zc + tab(NR.x, NR.top, a); bot = zc + tab(NR.x, NR.bot, a); rs = tab(NR.x, NR.hw, a); if (a < .02) { rs = Math.max(rs, .0) } }   // R‑14: the real nose
    else if (a < aT) { top = zTip + (zc + Rz - zTip) * sq(a, At, 2.1); bot = zTip - (zTip - (zc - Rz)) * sq(a, Ab, 2.4); rs = R * sq(a, As, 1.75) }
    else { const s = (a - aT) / (L - aT); top = zc + Rz + (ze + re - (zc + Rz)) * Math.pow(s, 1.8); bot = zc - Rz + (ze - re - (zc - Rz)) * Math.pow(s, .8); rs = R + (re - R) * Math.pow(s, 1.3) }
    return { zm: (top + bot) / 2, rv: (top - bot) / 2, rs, hump: hump(a) };
  };
  // D‑281 (option 1): round the cockpit the upper half of the section is broader (a superellipse, q < 1), so the sill runs across the
  // nose in a very shallow V — the crown itself (q⁰ = 1) unchanged; ahead and aft of the cockpit as approved
  if (t.hump && NR && NR.cab) f.hgW = 1;
  if (NR && NR.cab && NR.cab.q) { const zs = zc + NR.cab.zs; let aC = 0; while (aC < L * .5) { const r = f(aC); if (r.zm + r.rv + r.hump >= zs) break; aC += .02 }
    const q0 = NR.cab.q; f.q = a => lerp(1, lerp(q0, 1, sm((a - aC - 2.2) / 2)), sm((a - aC + 1.1) / .9)) }
  if (t.box) { const n = t.box, nl2 = nl * 1.6; f.box = a => a < nl2 ? 2 + (n - 2) * sm(a / nl2) : a > L - tlv * .7 ? 2 + (n - 2) * (1 - sm((a - (L - tlv * .7)) / (tlv * .7))) : n }   // round at the nose and the tail's end
  f.R = R; f.Rz = Rz; f.zc = zc; f.nl = nl; f.At = At; f.As = As; f.aT = aT; f.aC = Math.max(At, Ab, As, xN, t.hump ? .42 * L : 0); f.L = L; f.NR = NR;
  return f;
}
const hg = s => sm((s - .4) / .6);   // the upper deck: a ridge on the crown
const hgW = s => sm((s - .12) / .7);   // D‑281: the 747's upper deck as broad as the real one (its cockpit ~3.5 m wide)
function fusP(F, yN, a, th) { const r = F(a), q = F.q ? F.q(a) : 1; let s = Math.sin(th), c = Math.cos(th);
  if (F.box) { const e = 2 / F.box(a); c = Math.sign(c) * Math.pow(Math.abs(c), e); s = Math.sign(s) * Math.pow(Math.abs(s), e) }   // a box-like section (t.box): a superellipse
  return [r.rs * c, yN - a, r.zm + r.rv * (s > 0 && q !== 1 ? Math.pow(s, q) : s) + (s > 0 ? r.hump * (F.hgW ? hgW(s) : hg(s)) : 0)] }
function fusN(F, yN, a, th) {   // the outward normal
  const e = .004, p = fusP(F, yN, a, th), pa = fusP(F, yN, a + .05, th), pt = fusP(F, yN, a, th + e);
  let n = nrm(crs(sub(pt, p), sub(pa, p))); const r = F(a); if (dot(n, [p[0], 0, p[2] - r.zm]) < 0) n = [-n[0], -n[1], -n[2]]; return n;
}
// D‑278: the point of the nose at height z in the direction phi (degrees; 0 ahead, 90 abeam) seen from the axis at the full-width
// station a = F.As, on the side sd (+1 east) → { p, a, th } (null when the nose does not reach that height there)
function nosePt(F, yN, phi, z, sd) {
  const at = a => { const r = F(a); let s = (z - r.zm) / (r.rv || 1e-6); if (s > 1 || s < -1) return null; const th = Math.asin(s), x = r.rs * Math.cos(th); return { a, th, ph: Math.atan2(x, F.As - a) / D2R } };
  const A1 = F.As * 1.8; let best = null, prev = null;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 240; i++) { const a = A1 * i / 240, q = at(a); if (!q) { prev = null; continue }
    if (prev && (prev.ph - phi) * (q.ph - phi) <= 0) { let lo = prev, hi = q; for (let k = 0; k < 24; k++) { const m = at((lo.a + hi.a) / 2); if (!m) break; if ((lo.ph - phi) * (m.ph - phi) <= 0) hi = m; else lo = m } best = lo; break }
    prev = q }
  if (!best) return null;
  const th = sd > 0 ? best.th : Math.PI - best.th;
  return { p: fusP(F, yN, best.a, th), a: best.a, th };
}
// the livery on the body: colour at (a, θ) and the breaks along a for the strip at θ (so a boundary is a smooth curve)
function liveryFns(t, lv, F) {
  const L = t.L, nl = F.nl, tl = t.tl * L, tail0 = L - 1.35 * tl;
  const tailAt = th => tail0 + .14 * tl * Math.max(0, Math.sin(th));   // the tail section's front edge bulges aft on the crown (the game's curve)
  const w = lv.w, bA0 = 1.1 * nl, bP = (tail0 - bA0) / 8, beak = w === 'allover' ? mixC(lv.s, lv.b, .42) : lv.s;
  // fieldfix 17.11 (הבעלים 12.11 01:40: "המטוסים ב-3/4 קיבלו את הצבעים הישנים והפחות צבעוניים של חברות התעופה, ולא מה שיש להם במבט הרגיל"):
  // המקור — הצבעים זהים (LIV של 013, אותו מספר), אבל הצייר של 3/4 צייר ארבעה סגנונות בגרסה הישנה והפשוטה: dots בלי הנקודות, split — רק החצי התחתון,
  // swoosh — פס דק, spine — פס צר בלי הקווים. עכשיו כמו הצייר מלמעלה (013:wrap): הנקודות הצבעוניות (lv.d), האחורי בצבע הזנב עם התפר, הגל שעולה
  // מהבטן אל השדרה ונמשך עד הזנב עם הקו בצבע הסמל, הפס הרחב בשדרה עם שני קווי הסמל. FFLIV.on = false — הישן.
  const FF = (G.FFLIV || (G.FFLIV = { on: true })).on !== false, R = t.fw / 2, D = lv.d || [lv.s, lv.t, lv.m];
  const DOTS = []; if (FF && w === 'dots') { let i = 0; for (let a = .6 * nl; a < tail0 - .2 * R; a += .9 * R) for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const r = 1.3 * R * (.14 + .08 * ((i * 7) % 3)), da = ((i * 13) % 5 - 2) * R * .06; DOTS.push({ a: a + da, th: (-20 + 32 * k) * D2R, r: Math.max(.22, r), c: D[i % D.length] }); i++ } }
  const dotsAt = (() => { const M = new Map(); return th => { let q = M.get(th); if (q) return q; q = []; for (const d of DOTS) { let e = th - d.th; e = Math.atan2(Math.sin(e), Math.cos(e)); const v = R * e / d.r; if (Math.abs(v) < 1) q.push({ d, ha: d.r * Math.sqrt(1 - v * v) }) } M.set(th, q); return q } })();
  const spS = a => -20 + 110 * sm((a - .12 * L) / (.54 * L));   // swoosh: הגבול (מעלות) לאורך הגוף — מהבטן ליד האף אל השדרה ב-0.66 L
  const spA = d => { if (d <= -20) return .12 * L; if (d >= 90) return .66 * L; let lo = .12 * L, hi = .66 * L; for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2; if (spS(m) < d) lo = m; else hi = m } return (lo + hi) / 2 };
  const seam = th => .47 * L - .05 * L * Math.cos(th);   // split: התפר המעוקל (האחורי בצבע הזנב)
  const col = (a, th) => {
    const s = Math.sin(th), c = Math.abs(Math.cos(th)), deg = Math.asin(cl(s, -1, 1)) / D2R;
    if (a > tailAt(th)) return lv.t;
    if (FF) {
      if (w === 'dots') { for (const q of dotsAt(th)) if (Math.abs(a - q.d.a) < q.ha) return q.d.c; if (s < -.5) return lv.u; return lv.b }
      if (w === 'split') { const z = seam(th); if (a > z) return lv.t; if (a > z - .28 * R && a < z - .12 * R) return lv.s; if (s < -.5) return lv.u; return lv.b }
      if (w === 'swoosh') { if (a > .12 * L) { const b = spS(a); if (deg < b) return lv.s; if (deg < b + 7) return lv.m } if (s < -.5) return lv.u; return lv.b }
      if (w === 'spine') { if (a > .5 * nl && s > 0 && c < .46) return lv.s; if (a > .5 * nl && s > 0 && c < .54) return lv.m; if (deg > 5 && deg < 9) return lv.s; if (s < -.45) return lv.u; return lv.b }
    }
    if (w === 'allover') { if (a < .09 * nl) return beak;   // the beak: a small soft tip (the owner 14:39 (4): smaller, softer; it was .16 · nl, black)
      if (deg > 4 && deg < 8) return lv.s; if (s < -.45) return lv.u; return lv.b }
    if (w === 'nose') { const nb = 1.15 * nl - .12 * nl * Math.max(0, s); if (a < nb) return lv.s; if (deg > 5 && deg < 8) return lv.s; if (s < -.5) return lv.u; return lv.b }
    if (w === 'spine') { if (a > .8 * nl && c < .36 && s > 0) return lv.s; if (deg > 5 && deg < 9) return lv.s; if (s < -.45) return lv.u; return lv.b }
    // p390 · the game's other styles: bands (two stripes along the side), split (the lower half in the second colour), swoosh (a band
    // that rises from the belly at the nose to the crown at the tail), dots (as classic; the confetti is left out)
    if (w === 'bands') { const u = a - bA0 - .9 * Math.cos(th) * t.fw / 2; if (a > bA0 && a < tail0 - .2 * bP && u > 0 && (u % bP) < .42 * bP) return lv.s; if (s < -.5) return lv.u; return lv.b }   // the game's: slanted stripes across the body
    if (w === 'split') { if (a > .9 * nl && s < -.08) return lv.s; return lv.b }
    if (w === 'swoosh') { const q = a / L, d0 = -35 + 85 * q; if (a > nl && deg > d0 && deg < d0 + 10) return lv.s; if (s < -.5) return lv.u; return lv.b }
    // classic: the cheat line under the windows, a thin one above
    if (a > 1.3 * nl && deg > 5 && deg < 13) return lv.s; if (a > 1.6 * nl && deg > 29 && deg < 31.5) return lv.s; if (s < -.5) return lv.u; return lv.b;
  };
  const breaks = th => { const s = Math.sin(th), B = [tailAt(th)];
    if (FF && w === 'dots') { for (const q of dotsAt(th)) B.push(q.d.a - q.ha, q.d.a + q.ha); return B }
    if (FF && w === 'split') { const z = seam(th); B.push(z, z - .28 * R, z - .12 * R); return B }
    if (FF && w === 'swoosh') { const d = Math.asin(cl(s, -1, 1)) / D2R; B.push(.12 * L, spA(d), spA(d - 7)); return B }
    if (FF && w === 'spine') { B.push(.5 * nl); return B }
    if (w === 'allover') B.push(.09 * nl); if (w === 'nose') B.push(1.15 * nl - .12 * nl * Math.max(0, s)); if (w === 'spine') B.push(.8 * nl); if (w === 'classic') B.push(1.3 * nl, 1.6 * nl);
    if (w === 'bands') { const o = .9 * Math.cos(th) * t.fw / 2; for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) B.push(bA0 + o + k * bP, bA0 + o + (k + .42) * bP) }
    return B };
  return { col, breaks, tailAt };
}

// ======================================================================================================================================
// a face: { P: [[x,y,z] …], c: hex, m: material, n?: normal, g?: [nA, nB] (a gradient across the face from edge 0–3 to edge 1–2),
//           both?: no back-face test, a?: alpha, line?: stroke only (w metres) }
function face(P, c, m, o) { return Object.assign({ P, c, m: m || 'paint' }, o || {}) }
const orient = (f, d) => { if (dot(faceN(f.P), d) < 0) f.P.reverse(); return f };
const faceN = P => { let n = [0, 0, 0]; for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { const p = P[i], q = P[(i + 1) % P.length]; n[0] += (p[1] - q[1]) * (p[2] + q[2]); n[1] += (p[2] - q[2]) * (p[0] + q[0]); n[2] += (p[0] - q[0]) * (p[1] + q[1]) } return nrm(n) };

// the fuselage as strips: per θ facet, along a; merged where the section is constant and the colour does not change
function buildFuselage(t, lv, yN, F, LF, opt) {
  const faces = [], N = opt && opt.lod ? 40 : 72, L = t.L, base = [];
  const nA = 18, step = a => a < F.aC ? Math.max(.12, F.nl / 12) : a > F.aT ? Math.max(.15, (L - F.aT) / 16) : 1.2;
  for (let a = 0; a < L - 1e-6;) { base.push(a); a = Math.min(L, a + step(a)) } base.push(L);
  for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) {
    const t0 = -Math.PI / 2 + k * TAU / N, t1 = t0 + TAU / N, tm = (t0 + t1) / 2;
    const A = base.concat(LF.breaks(tm).filter(x => x > 0 && x < L)).sort((p, q) => p - q);
    let run = null;
    const flush = () => { if (!run) return; const P = [fusP(F, yN, run.a0, t0), fusP(F, yN, run.a0, t1), fusP(F, yN, run.a1, t1), fusP(F, yN, run.a1, t0)], am = (run.a0 + run.a1) / 2;
      faces.push(face(P, run.c, 'paint', { g: [fusN(F, yN, am, t0), fusN(F, yN, am, t1)], g4: [fusN(F, yN, run.a0, t0), fusN(F, yN, run.a0, t1), fusN(F, yN, run.a1, t1), fusN(F, yN, run.a1, t0)], fus: 1 })); run = null };   // g4: the corners' normals (the owner 14:39 (1): the light smooth along the body too)
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < A.length; i++) {
      const a0 = A[i], a1 = A[i + 1]; if (a1 - a0 < 1e-4) continue;
      const c = LF.col((a0 + a1) / 2, tm), flat = a0 >= F.aC - 1e-6 && a1 <= F.aT + 1e-6;
      if (run && run.flat && flat && run.c === c && Math.abs(run.a1 - a0) < 1e-6) { run.a1 = a1; continue }
      flush(); run = { a0, a1, c, flat };
    }
    flush();
  }
  return faces;
}

// a body of revolution along y (a nacelle): rings (y, ρ) around the axis (x0, ·, z0); strips with gradients
function buildRevolve(x0, z0, rings, col, mat, N) {
  const faces = []; N = N || 40;
  for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) {
    const t0 = k * TAU / N, t1 = t0 + TAU / N;
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < rings.length; i++) {
      const [ya, ra, ca] = rings[i], [yb, rb] = rings[i + 1];
      const P = [[x0 + ra * Math.cos(t0), ya, z0 + ra * Math.sin(t0)], [x0 + ra * Math.cos(t1), ya, z0 + ra * Math.sin(t1)], [x0 + rb * Math.cos(t1), yb, z0 + rb * Math.sin(t1)], [x0 + rb * Math.cos(t0), yb, z0 + rb * Math.sin(t0)]];
      const rp = (rb - ra) / ((yb - ya) || 1e-6), nn = th => nrm([Math.cos(th), -rp, Math.sin(th)]);
      faces.push(face(P, ca || col, mat, { g: [nn(t0), nn(t1)] }));
    }
  }
  return faces;
}
// a disc facing +y (south) at y, centre (x0, z0): ellipse on the screen
function disc(x0, y, z0, r, col, mat, o) { const P = []; for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) { const t = i / 28 * TAU; P.push([x0 + r * Math.cos(t), y, z0 + r * Math.sin(t)]) } return face(P, col, mat, Object.assign({ n: [0, 1, 0] }, o || {})) }

// a lofted plate along a span (wing, tailplane, winglet): stations [{x, yLE, yTE, z, t}] (x = |span position| × side), chord profile
const CH = [0, .03, .12, .3, .55, .8, 1], TOP = [0, .3, .44, .5, .42, .27, .05], BOT = [0, .26, .36, .38, .3, .17, .03];
function buildPlate(st, col, o) {
  o = o || {}; const faces = [];
  const pt = (s, i, up) => { const y = lerp(s.yLE, s.yTE, CH[i]); return [s.x, y, s.z + (up ? TOP[i] : -BOT[i]) * s.t] };
  for (let j = 0; j + 1 < st.length; j++) {
    const A = st[j], B = st[j + 1];
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < CH.length; i++) {
      faces.push(orient(face([pt(A, i, 1), pt(B, i, 1), pt(B, i + 1, 1), pt(A, i + 1, 1)], col, o.mat || 'paint'), [0, i === 0 ? .5 : 0, 1]));
      faces.push(orient(face([pt(A, i + 1, 0), pt(B, i + 1, 0), pt(B, i, 0), pt(A, i, 0)], sh(col, -.12), o.mat || 'paint'), [0, i === 0 ? .5 : 0, -1]));
    }
  }
  // the ends (the root is inside the fuselage; the tip cap)
  const cap = s => { const U = [], D = []; for (let i = 0; i < CH.length; i++) { U.push(pt(s, i, 1)); D.push(pt(s, i, 0)) } return U.concat(D.reverse()) };
  faces.push(face(cap(st[st.length - 1]), sh(col, -.06), 'paint', { both: false }));
  return faces;
}
// the same plate standing up (fin): stations [{z, yLE, yTE, t}] at x = 0
function buildFin(st, col) {
  const faces = [];
  const pt = (s, i, side) => [side * (side > 0 ? TOP[i] : BOT[i]) * s.t * (BOT[i] > 0 || TOP[i] > 0 ? 1 : 1), lerp(s.yLE, s.yTE, CH[i]), s.z];
  const half = (s, i, side) => [side * .5 * s.t * (i === 0 ? 0 : [0, .55, .82, .97, 1, .82, .2][i]), lerp(s.yLE, s.yTE, CH[i]), s.z];
  for (let j = 0; j + 1 < st.length; j++) {
    const A = st[j], B = st[j + 1];
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < CH.length; i++) for (const sd of [1, -1]) {
      faces.push(orient(face([half(A, i, sd), half(A, i + 1, sd), half(B, i + 1, sd), half(B, i, sd)], col, 'paint'), [sd, i === 0 ? .3 : 0, 0]));
    }
  }
  const T = st[st.length - 1], U = [], D = []; for (let i = 0; i < CH.length; i++) { U.push(half(T, i, 1)); D.push(half(T, i, -1)) }
  faces.push(orient(face(U.concat(D.reverse()), sh(col, .06), 'paint'), [0, 0, 1]));
  void pt; return faces;
}
// an oriented box: the plan polygon (4 corners, any order around), z bottom / top per corner
function boxFaces(plan, zb, zt, cols, o) {
  o = o || {}; const faces = [], n = plan.length, Zb = i => Array.isArray(zb) ? zb[i] : zb, Zt = i => Array.isArray(zt) ? zt[i] : zt;
  // orientation: make the plan counter-clockwise in (x, y) with y south → use the signed area
  let ar = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = plan[i], q = plan[(i + 1) % n]; ar += p[0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[1] }
  const pl = ar > 0 ? plan : plan.slice().reverse(), zbb = ar > 0 ? i => Zb(i) : i => Zb(n - 1 - i), ztt = ar > 0 ? i => Zt(i) : i => Zt(n - 1 - i);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n, p = pl[i], q = pl[j];
    faces.push(face([[p[0], p[1], zbb(i)], [q[0], q[1], zbb(j)], [q[0], q[1], ztt(j)], [p[0], p[1], ztt(i)]], cols.side || cols.top, o.mat || 'matte', { side: i })) }
  faces.push(face(pl.map((p, i) => [p[0], p[1], ztt(i)]), cols.top, o.mat || 'matte', { top: 1 }));
  return faces;
}
// a vertical cylinder: centre, radius, z0..z1 (the drum of the bridge, a column)
function vcyl(cx, cy, r, z0, z1, col, mat, N) {
  const faces = []; N = N || 24;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const a = i / N * TAU, b = (i + 1) / N * TAU;
    faces.push(face([[cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a), z0], [cx + r * Math.cos(b), cy + r * Math.sin(b), z0], [cx + r * Math.cos(b), cy + r * Math.sin(b), z1], [cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a), z1]], col, mat, { g: [[Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a), 0], [Math.cos(b), Math.sin(b), 0]] })) }
  const T = []; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const a = i / N * TAU; T.push([cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a), z1]) }
  faces.push(face(T, sh(col, .05), mat, { n: [0, 0, 1] }));
  return faces;
}

// ======================================================================================================================================
// the aircraft: pieces in local metres (origin at the nose gear on the ground, nose to the south = +y)
// ======================================================================================================================================
// D‑281 (the owner 13:50, a standing rule: every detail where the 3D body and the real type's proportions put it, every direction
// from the one model in the one projection, no fix for one direction): the cockpit's windows as one fixed shape on the nose's surface — every view comes from the one body in the one projection (x, y − K·z), only what faces the camera drawn.
//  * the sill: one straight line along the cockpit at the height zs over the axis (a small fall aft, sl, allowed);
//  * the stations along the body (metres from the nose tip): the windscreen from the centre post (where the crown reaches the sill)
//    up to aw on the crown; the pillars [bottom, top] between the windscreen and the opening window, between it and the rear one,
//    and the rear one's end — every pillar leans aft;
//  * the upper edge of every side window just under the roof line of its station (m below the crown in the profile; the rear one
//    m3); the windscreen's from the crown at aw down to the first pillar's top;
//  * per type (NOSE[id].cab) or, for the other types, in fuselage radii from the crown's crossing of the sill.
function cabOf(t, NR, F) {
  // the owner 14:39 (3): the row lower (h ×0.8) and its wrap to the sides shorter (ls ×0.75, lr ×0.7) — the NOSE tables.
  // D‑281 (option 1, the coordinator 14:15 for the owner; agent 3 14:10): one low row (~11 % of the nose's width) on the surface — no
  // cut, the outline smooth: the sill zs one height for the windscreen and the side windows; the windscreen's two panes from the centre
  // post to a corner only vd aft of it (a very shallow V), up to zs + h on the steep part of the crown; then on each side a short
  // opening window and a shorter rear one (ls, lr), their pillars leaning aft (lean); the rear one lower (80 %)
  const R = F.R, C = NR && NR.cab ? NR.cab : {};
  return { zs: C.zs != null ? C.zs : .62 * R, h: C.h != null ? C.h : .22 * R, vd: C.vd != null ? C.vd : .075 * R, lean: C.lean != null ? C.lean : .1 * R, ls: C.ls != null ? C.ls : .28 * R, lr: C.lr != null ? C.lr : .2 * R, sb: C.sb != null ? C.sb : .4, n: C.n || 2, pil: C.pil };
}
function cockpit3D(F, yN, t, NR, decor) {
  const R = F.R, zc = F.zc, C = cabOf(t, NR, F), sc = NR && NR.cab ? 1 : R / 2, post = .022 * sc, pil = C.pil || .028 * sc, pad = .02 * sc;   // the owner 14:39 (2): thin frame and posts (a light aircraft's pillars: cab.pil)
  const crown = a => { const r = F(a); return r.zm + r.rv + r.hump - zc };
  const cross = z => { let a = 0; while (a < F.L * .5 && crown(a) < z) a += .05; let lo = Math.max(0, a - .05), hi = a; for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2; if (crown(m) < z) lo = m; else hi = m } return hi };
  const aC = cross(C.zs), aT = cross(C.zs + C.h), zS = C.zs, zH = C.zs + C.h;
  // the stations: the windscreen's corner, then n side windows (the first ls long, the others lr) — the airliners 2, a light aircraft's cabin more
  const PB = []; { let b = aC + C.vd; PB.push([b, b + C.lean]); for (let k = 1; k <= C.n; k++) { b += k === 1 ? C.ls : C.lr; PB.push([b, b + C.lean * (1 + .15 * k)]) } }
  const b1 = PB[0][0], b2 = PB[1][0], b3 = PB[PB.length - 1][0], aw = aT;
  const zSill = () => zS;
  const thAt = (a, z) => { const r = F(a), Z = zc + z, zt = r.zm + r.rv + r.hump; if (Z >= zt) return Math.PI / 2; if (Z <= r.zm - r.rv) return -Math.PI / 2;
    const q = F.q ? F.q(a) : 1; let lo = -1, hi = 1; for (let k = 0; k < 22; k++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2, zz = r.zm + r.rv * (m > 0 && q !== 1 ? Math.pow(m, q) : m) + (m > 0 ? r.hump * (F.hgW ? hgW(m) : hg(m)) : 0); if (zz < Z) lo = m; else hi = m } return Math.asin((lo + hi) / 2) };
  const pt = (a, z, sd, xMin) => { let th = thAt(a, z); if (xMin) { const r = F(a), tm = Math.acos(Math.min(1, xMin / Math.max(1e-3, r.rs))); th = Math.min(th, tm) } const T = sd > 0 ? th : Math.PI - th; return { p: fusP(F, yN, a, T), n: fusN(F, yN, a, T) } };
  // the side windows' lower edge: one horizontal line sb·h above the windscreen's (agent 3 14:30: cut level, on aft, not down); the rear one's top a little lower
  const pane = k => { const [p0, q0] = k === 0 ? [aC, aT] : PB[k - 1], [p1, q1] = PB[k], zb = k === 0 ? zS : zS + C.sb * C.h, zt = k === C.n ? zH - .12 * C.h : zH;
    return { B: u => [lerp(p0, p1, u), zb], T: u => [lerp(q0, q1, u), zt], k } };
  const GL = ['#2a4256', '#57748c', '#c4d9e8'], info = { panes: [], aRef: aC, bend: 0, cab: { aC, aw, PB, zs: C.zs, sl: 0, h: C.h } };
  for (const sd of [1, -1]) {
    const frame = [], glass = [], extra = [];
    for (let k = 0; k <= C.n; k++) {
      const P = pane(k), len = Math.hypot(P.B(1)[0] - P.B(0)[0], .5 * (P.T(1)[0] - P.T(0)[0])) || 1, n = k === 0 ? 8 : 5;
      for (const grow of [true, false]) {
        const du0 = grow ? 0 : (k === 0 ? 0 : pil / len), du1 = grow ? -.01 : pil / len, dwb = grow ? -pad : pil * .8, dwt = grow ? 0 : pil * .8 + pad, xMin = k === 0 && !grow ? post : 0;
        const at = (u, w) => { const B = P.B(u), T = P.T(u), hb = (T[1] - B[1]) || 1, wb = dwb / hb, wt = 1 - dwt / hb, W = lerp(wb, wt, w), a = lerp(B[0], T[0], W);
          if (grow && k === 0 && u <= 1e-9) { const p = fusP(F, yN, a, Math.PI / 2); return { p, n: fusN(F, yN, a, Math.PI / 2) } }   // the frame closes on the centre post
          return pt(a, lerp(B[1], T[1], W), sd, xMin) };
        const U = i => lerp(du0, 1 - du1, i / n), outl = [];
        const nm = at(.5, .5).n;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const u0 = U(i), u1 = U(i + 1), um = (u0 + u1) / 2, Q = [at(u0, 0), at(um, 0), at(u1, 0), at(u1, 1), at(um, 1), at(u0, 1)], c = at(um, .5);
          let PP = Q.map(q => q.p); if (dot(faceN(PP), c.n) < 0) PP = PP.reverse();
          if (grow) frame.push(face(PP, '#28323b', 'matte', { n: c.n, noSeam: 1 }));
          else glass.push(face(PP, GL[1], 'glass', { g: [nm, nm], grad: GL, gax: [at(um, 0).p, at(um, 1).p], noSeam: 1 })) }
        if (!grow) { for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) outl.push(at(U(i), 0)); for (let j = 1; j <= 4; j++) outl.push(at(U(n), j / 4)); for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) outl.push(at(U(i), 1)); for (let j = 3; j >= 1; j--) outl.push(at(U(0), j / 4));
          info.panes.push({ sd, k, far: false, P: outl.map(q => q.p), N: outl.map(q => q.n), AZ: [P.B(0), P.B(1), P.T(1), P.T(0)] }) }
        if (!grow && k === 0) for (const f of [.3, .72]) { const A = at(f, .02), Bq = at(f - .08, .25); extra.push({ line: 1, P: [A.p, Bq.p], c: '#1b2229', w: .022 * sc, n: A.n }) }
        // the sky in the glass: a soft slanted streak across the pane (on its surface)
        if (!grow) { const S = [at(.16, .08), at(.34, .08), at(.56, .94), at(.38, .94)]; let SP = S.map(q => q.p.map((v, i) => v + q.n[i] * .004)); const cn = at(.36, .5).n; if (dot(faceN(SP), cn) < 0) SP = SP.reverse();
          extra.push(face(SP, '#ffffff', 'matte', { n: cn, a: .2, noSeam: 1 })) }
      }
    }
    decor.push(...frame, ...glass, ...extra);
  }
  return info;
}
function bandFor(m, h) {
  const I = m.info, dec = [], BD = cockpit3D(I.F, I.yN, I.t, NOSE[I.id], dec), body = m.pieces.find(p => p.kind === 'body');
  const pieces = m.pieces.map(p => p !== body ? p : Object.assign({}, p, { decor: p.decor.slice(0, I.bandAt).concat(dec, p.decor.slice(I.bandAt)) }));
  return { pieces, info: Object.assign({}, I, { band: BD }) };
}
// the owner 16:46 (1): the model as drawn takes exactly the real length and span — the fin's and the T-tail's trailing edge past the tail
// cone and the winglets' cant outward used to add up to 3.6% (HC-01 2.5 m, NB-01 1.2 m of span); the first build of a type measures its plan
// box and the type is built from then on with L and WS scaled so that the box is L × WS (one factor per type: the row's fit [kL, kW], measured
// offline so that the game pays nothing; a row without it is measured on its first build and kept in FIT)
const FIT = {};
function fitOf(id, livKey, opt, t0) { const m = buildRaw(id, livKey, Object.assign({}, opt, { lod: 1 }), t0); let xa = 1e9, xb = -1e9, ya = 1e9, yb = -1e9;
  for (const p of m.pieces) { for (const f of p.faces || []) for (const q of f.P) { xa = Math.min(xa, q[0]); xb = Math.max(xb, q[0]); ya = Math.min(ya, q[1]); yb = Math.max(yb, q[1]) } }
  const kL = t0.L / Math.max(.1, yb - ya), kW = t0.WS / Math.max(.1, xb - xa);
  return FIT[id] = { kL: Math.abs(kL - 1) < .002 ? 1 : Math.min(1.05, kL), kW: Math.abs(kW - 1) < .002 ? 1 : Math.min(1.05, kW) } }
function build(id, livKey, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const t0 = TYPES[id]; if (!t0) throw new Error('A34: unknown type ' + id); t0.id = id;
  const f = opt.raw ? { kL: 1, kW: 1 } : t0.fit ? { kL: t0.fit[0], kW: t0.fit[1] } : FIT[id] || fitOf(id, livKey, opt, t0);   // t0.fit: measured once (dev/fleet_dims.js checks it)
  return buildRaw(id, livKey, opt, f.kL === 1 && f.kW === 1 ? t0 : Object.assign({}, t0, { L: t0.L * f.kL, WS: t0.WS * f.kW, Lr: t0.L, WSr: t0.WS })) }
function buildRaw(id, livKey, opt, t) {
  opt = opt || {};
  const lv = livKey && typeof livKey === 'object' ? livKey : LIV[livKey || t.liv], L = t.L, R = t.fw / 2, HS = t.WS / 2, yN = .17 * L, yC = -.33 * L, x0 = .06 * L, TF = t.boom ? Object.assign({}, t, { L: t.L * t.boom.pod }) : t, F = fusShape(TF), LF = liveryFns(TF, lv, F), NRV = opt.lod ? 24 : 44;
  const ofU = u => yC + u * L;   // game frame u (fraction of L from the centre, + forward) → local y
  const pieces = [];
  const piece = (kind, faces, extra) => { const p = Object.assign({ kind, faces, decor: [] }, extra || {}); pieces.push(p); return p };
  const topAt = a => { const r = F(a); return r.zm + r.rv + r.hump };
  // ---- the body ----
  const body = buildFuselage(TF, lv, yN, F, LF, opt);
  const decor = [];
  // the cockpit's windows (D‑281): one low row fixed on the nose — cockpit3D() below
  const bandAt = decor.length, BD = opt.noBand ? null : cockpit3D(F, yN, t, NOSE[id], decor);   // p390: noBand — the game adds the band of each direction (bandFor)
  // the nose's gloss (R‑14 (2)): a soft highlight along the upper curve of the nose
  { const nl = F.nl, a0 = .12 * nl, a1 = Math.min(F.aC * .55, 1.1 * nl), P = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) P.push(fusP(F, yN, lerp(a0, a1, i / 8), 101 * D2R)); for (let i = 8; i >= 0; i--) P.push(fusP(F, yN, lerp(a0, a1, i / 8), 118 * D2R));
    decor.push(face(P.map(p => [p[0], p[1], p[2] + .01]), '#ffffff', 'matte', { n: [0, 0, 1], a: .16, noSeam: 1 })) }
  // the front door, the bridge's (R‑14 (3)): the port side's first door — a panel, its outline, its window
  { const NR = NOSE[id], a = NR ? NR.door : (t.doors && t.doors[0] || .2) * L, P = [], W = [];
